articles.title: Autel Expands Nissan Diagnostic and ADAS Access
articles.author: Brake and Front End Staff

paras.en: Autel U.S. has released diagnostic and ADAS software updates for Nissan vehicles using the Consult 4 platform. The updates expand bidirectional control and ADAS calibration access across supported North American vehicles.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 已使用 Consult 4 平台为日产汽车发布了诊断和 ADAS 软件更新。这些更新扩展了受支持的北美车辆的双向控制和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: The Nissan diagnostic software is available on supported MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets. ADAS calibration capability is available on these tablets with ADAS calibration software installed.
paras.zh: Nissan 诊断软件可在受支持的 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。这些安装了 ADAS 校准软件的平板电脑上提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: Supported Autel tablets access protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth. The independent service works with manufacturers and aftermarket tool providers to verify shops, technicians and tools for secure vehicle access.
paras.zh: 支持的 Autel 平板电脑通过 AutoAuth 访问受保护的车辆功能。该独立服务与制造商和售后工具提供商合作，验证商店、技术人员和工具以确保车辆安全访问。

paras.en: Authenticated Access for Newer Nissan Platforms
paras.zh: 对较新 Nissan 平台进行身份验证的访问

paras.en: Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. These protections restrict designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop and diagnostic tool receive proper authentication.
paras.zh: 日产开始将安全网关保护纳入 2020 年款的精选北美车辆中。这些保护措施限制指定的双向功能，除非技术人员、车间和诊断工具得到适当的认证。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years. The access applies to vehicles supported by Nissan’s Consult-III plus diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: Autel 多年来一直提供基于 AutoAuth 的 Nissan 安全网关访问。该访问权限适用于日产 Consult-III plus 诊断平台支持的车辆。

paras.en: Nissan introduced its newer web-based Consult 4 diagnostic software for the 2023 Nissan Ariya. The automaker now uses the software on a growing number of newer vehicle platforms.
paras.zh: Nissan 为 2023 款 Nissan Ariya 推出了更新的基于网络的 Consult 4 诊断软件。该汽车制造商现在在越来越多的新型车辆平台上使用该软件。

paras.en: Supporting protected functions required Autel to develop and validate a compatible authorization process. The process works with the vehicles’ newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 支持受保护的功能需要 Autel 开发并验证兼容的授权流程。该过程适用于车辆更新的电子架构。

paras.en: Autel’s new capability expands diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using Consult 4.
paras.zh: Autel 的新功能使用 Consult 4 扩展了支持的 Nissan 车辆的诊断和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: North American Nissan vehicles using Consult 4 include:
paras.zh: 使用 Consult 4 的北美 Nissan 车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder and Armada
paras.zh: - 2025 年及更新款 Nissan Kicks、Murano、Pathfinder 和 Armada

paras.en: Autel issued the expanded capabilities through the Nissan_V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan_ADAS V5.20 software released on Sept. 9.
paras.zh: Autel通过9月9日发布的Nissan_V7.40诊断软件和Nissan_ADAS V5.20软件发布了扩展功能。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and an active AutoAuth account for Nissan access. ADAS calibration also requires applicable Autel software, equipment, targets and accessories.
paras.zh: 访问需要有效的 Autel 软件订阅和有效的 AutoAuth 帐户才能进行 Nissan 访问。 ADAS 校准还需要适用的 Autel 软件、设备、目标和配件。

paras.en: Supported Consult 4 vehicle coverage does not require a separate AutoAuth service tier. Eligible users can obtain the software releases through the standard update process on their Autel tablet.
paras.zh: 支持的 Consult 4 车辆覆盖范围不需要单独的 AutoAuth 服务层。符合条件的用户可以通过 Autel 平板电脑上的标准更新流程获取软件版本。

articles.title: Brake Job: 2020–2026 Buick Encore GX
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: I was recently working on an ASE A5 test-prep article, and we reached the section on parking brakes. Most parking brakes act on the rear wheels, so the test is structured around that arrangement. But some vehicles have parking brakes on the front wheels. I knew that some older Saabs and Datsuns used front-wheel parking brakes. One modern example is the Buick Encore GX.
paras.zh: 我最近正在撰写 ASE A5 测试准备文章，我们到达了有关驻车制动器的部分。大多数驻车制动器作用于后轮，因此测试是围绕这种安排进行的。但有些车辆的前轮装有驻车制动器。我知道一些较旧的萨博和达特桑使用前轮驻车制动器。别克 Encore GX 就是现代的一个例子。

paras.en: On these models, pulling the park-brake switch sends a signal to the Electronic Brake Control Module. The module supplies 12 volts to the apply-control circuits and ground to the release-control circuits, activating the left and right park-brake actuators and applying the brakes.
paras.zh: 在这些型号上，拉动驻车制动开关会向电子制动控制模块发送信号。该模块向应用控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向释放控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活左右驻车制动执行器并应用制动器。

paras.en: Pressing the switch sends a signal to the module to release the brakes. The module supplies 12 volts to the release-control circuits and ground to the apply-control circuits, activating the actuators and releasing the brakes. Depending on the vehicle, the switch may be a push-button style. Pressing it commands the parking brakes to apply or release based on their current position.
paras.zh: 按下开关会向模块发送信号以释放制动器。该模块向释放控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向应用控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活执行器并释放制动器。根据车辆的不同，开关可能是按钮式的。按下它可以命令驻车制动器根据当前位置应用或释放。

paras.en: The parking brake will release automatically if the engine is running, the vehicle is shifted into gear, and the driver attempts to move off. Avoid rapid acceleration while the parking brake is applied to help preserve the parking-brake lining.
paras.zh: 如果发动机正在运转、车辆挂档且驾驶员试图起步，驻车制动器将自动释放。使用驻车制动器时避免快速加速，以帮助保护驻车制动器衬片。

paras.en: The Electronic Brake Control Module, also called the Brake System Control Module, controls the park-brake motor circuits and runs diagnostics to verify that they are operating properly.
paras.zh: 电子制动控制模块，也称为制动系统控制模块，控制驻车制动电机电路并运行诊断以验证它们是否正常运行。

paras.en: To replace the brake pads, the park-brake caliper pistons must be fully retracted. There are two ways to put the parking brake into service mode. The preferred method is to use a scan tool with a service-mode function. If you do not have a compatible scan tool, use this procedure:
paras.zh: 要更换刹车片，驻车制动卡钳活塞必须完全缩回。有两种方法可以将驻车制动器置于维修模式。首选方法是使用具有服务模式功能的扫描工具。如果您没有兼容的扫描工具，请使用以下过程：

paras.en: - Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
paras.zh: - 在发动机关闭的情况下打开点火装置。

paras.en: - Press the accelerator pedal halfway down.
paras.zh: - 将油门踏板踩到一半。

paras.en: - Move the park-brake switch to the release position and hold it for 10 seconds. Release the switch.
paras.zh: - 将驻车制动开关移至释放位置并保持 10 秒钟。松开开关。

paras.en: - Within five seconds, move the switch to the release position again.
paras.zh: - 在五秒钟内，再次将开关移至释放位置。

paras.en: The actuator bolts to the back of the caliper and is not included with a replacement caliper. If you remove the actuator, GM recommends replacing the caliper’s O-ring. Front-wheel parking brakes may be a novelty, but they make an interesting piece of trivia to test your technician friends on.
paras.zh: 执行器用螺栓固定在卡钳的背面，并且不包含在替换卡钳中。如果拆下执行器，GM 建议更换卡钳的 O 形圈。前轮驻车制动器可能是一个新奇事物，但它们是一个有趣的琐事，可以测试您的技术人员朋友。

articles.title: PHINIA Names Gordon Muir Chief Financial Officer
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN) announced the appointment of Gordon Muir as senior vice president and chief financial officer, effective Jan. 1, 2027. Muir succeeds Chris Gropp, current senior vice president and CFO, who will retire March 31, 2027.
paras.zh: PHINIA Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：PHIN）宣布任命 Gordon Muir 为高级副总裁兼首席财务官，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。Muir 接替现任高级副总裁兼首席财务官 Chris Gropp，后者将于 2027 年 3 月 31 日退休。

paras.en: “Gordon played a critical role in PHINIA becoming an independent company in 2023 and has continued to be an important part of our success. He has a deep understanding of our business and brings significant financial expertise, including extensive experience with complex corporate transactions and transformations,” said Brady Ericson, president and chief executive officer of PHINIA. “I am pleased to welcome Gordon to PHINIA’s executive leadership team. He is highly respected across the company and well positioned to step into the CFO role next year,” continued Ericson.
paras.zh: PHINIA 总裁兼首席执行官布雷迪·埃里克森 (Brady Ericson) 表示：“戈登在 PHINIA 于 2023 年成为一家独立公司的过程中发挥了关键作用，并且一直是我们成功的重要组成部分。他对我们的业务有着深入的了解，并带来了丰富的财务专业知识，包括在复杂的企业交易和转型方面的丰富经验。”埃里克森继续说道：“我很高兴欢迎戈登加入 PHINIA 的执行领导团队。他在公司内部受到高度尊重，并且有能力在明年担任首席财务官。”

paras.en: “I would also like to recognize Chris for her significant contributions and dedication to PHINIA. She has played an important role in our success, supporting two acquisitions, driving strong financial performance, and helping position the business for sustainable, long-term growth. Her exceptional global corporate finance and accounting expertise has been invaluable to our organization. Personally, I want to thank Chris for her leadership, outstanding commitment, and partnership throughout this journey,” concluded Ericson.
paras.zh: 埃里克森总结道：“我还要感谢克里斯对 PHINIA 的重大贡献和奉献精神。她在我们的成功中发挥了重要作用，支持了两次收购，推动了强劲的财务业绩，并帮助我们的业务实现了可持续的长期增长。她卓越的全球企业财务和会计专业知识对我们的组织非常宝贵。就我个人而言，我要感谢克里斯在整个过程中的领导、出色的承诺和合作。”

paras.en: “Being part of PHINIA’s foundation and growth path has been an honor. Representing this Company has been an exciting journey, and I am proud to be part of its history and exceptional team,” commented Gropp.
paras.zh: “成为 PHINIA 的基础和发展道路的一部分是一种荣幸。代表这家公司是一段激动人心的旅程，我很自豪能够成为其历史和杰出团队的一部分，”格罗普评论道。

paras.en: Muir joined BorgWarner in 2007 and has worked at PHINIA since its 2023 spinoff. He currently serves as PHINIA’s treasurer, overseeing treasury and investor relations. He has played a key role in the company’s financial strategy and capital markets activities. Muir brings extensive global finance experience, including expertise in treasury, financial strategy and corporate finance.
paras.zh: Muir 于 2007 年加入博格华纳，自 PHINIA 2023 年分拆以来一直在该公司工作。他目前担任 PHINIA 的财务主管，负责监督财务和投资者关系。他在公司的财务战略和资本市场活动中发挥了关键作用。 Muir 带来了丰富的全球金融经验，包括财务、财务战略和企业融资方面的专业知识。

paras.en: He holds a Master of Business Administration from the University of Notre Dame. He also earned a Bachelor of Business Administration in finance and accounting from Grand Valley State University. Additionally, he attended the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School. Muir is also a chartered financial analyst (CFA) and certified public accountant (CPA).
paras.zh: 他拥有圣母大学工商管理硕士学位。他还获得了大谷州立大学财务和会计工商管理学士学位。此外，他还参加了哈佛商学院的高级管理课程。 Muir 也是一名特许金融分析师 (CFA) 和注册会计师 (CPA)。

paras.en: In his new role, Muir will build on the company’s finance culture. He will support the business and advance its long-term strategic objectives through a disciplined financial approach.
paras.zh: 在他的新职位上，缪尔将加强公司的财务文化。他将通过严格的财务方法支持业务并推进其长期战略目标。

articles.title: FORVIA HELLA Wins 2026 CLEPA Innovation Award
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA received the 2026 CLEPA Innovation Award for its Front Phygital Shields (FPS). The European Association of Automotive Suppliers (CLEPA) presents the award annually to recognize innovation among automotive suppliers. The award ceremony took place Nov. 19 in Brussels, Belgium.
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 因其前端物理防护罩 (FPS) 荣获 2026 年 CLEPA 创新奖。欧洲汽车供应商协会 (CLEPA) 每年颁发该奖项以表彰汽车供应商的创新。颁奖典礼于 11 月 19 日在比利时布鲁塞尔举行。

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA developed Front Phygital Shields as integrated modules for the front ends of electric vehicles. The award specifically recognizes the first integration of radar sensing into a headlamp application. The company began series production in 2025 for several projects involving international automotive manufacturers.
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 开发了 Front Phygital Shields 作为电动汽车前端的集成模块。该奖项特别表彰首次将雷达传感集成到前照灯应用中的产品。该公司于 2025 年开始为涉及国际汽车制造商的多个项目进行系列生产。

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA Combines Lighting and Radar Technology
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 结合了照明和雷达技术

paras.en: “With our Front Phygital Shields, we address several major market trends at once: electromobility, automated driving and the desire for a distinctive brand identity. At the same time, they help automotive manufacturers reduce complexity in development and front-end assembly,” says Juan Manuel Mollá, managing director of lighting at FORVIA HELLA. “Receiving the CLEPA Innovation Award confirms the potential of this new product category. My special thanks go to all our colleagues whose innovative thinking and commitment made its development possible.”
paras.zh: “通过我们的 Front Phygital Shields，我们可以同时满足几个主要市场趋势：电动汽车、自动驾驶以及对独特品牌标识的渴望。同时，它们可以帮助汽车制造商降低开发和前端装配的复杂性，”FOVIA HELLA 照明总经理 Juan Manuel Mollá 说道。 “获得 CLEPA 创新奖证实了这一新产品类别的潜力。我特别感谢我们所有的同事，他们的创新思维和承诺使其发展成为可能。”

paras.en: The Front Phygital Shields use the design and functional space created by eliminating traditional radiator grilles in electric vehicles. They combine a wide variety of functions in a single product.
paras.zh: 前物理防护罩采用了通过消除电动汽车中传统散热器格栅而创建的设计和功能空间。它们将多种功能结合在一个产品中。

paras.en: The scalable platform offers different integration levels and customer-specific variants. It can combine lighting technology, decorative design elements and sensors in one module. This approach reduces complexity in development and assembly while combining design and functionality.
paras.zh: 可扩展的平台提供不同的集成级别和客户特定的变体。它可以将照明技术、装饰设计元素和传感器结合在一个模块中。这种方法降低了开发和组装的复杂性，同时结合了设计和功能。

paras.en: Depending on the configuration, the modules can incorporate headlamps, signal lamps and other lighting functions.
paras.zh: 根据配置的不同，模块可以集成前照灯、信号灯和其他照明功能。

paras.en: Additional Features and Weather Protection
paras.zh: 附加功能和天气保护

paras.en: The modules can also integrate radar sensors with heated, radar-transparent covers. These covers protect the sensors from weather and dirt, helping maintain reliable radar performance during severe winter conditions. The integrated heating function helps radar sensors operate reliably in a wide range of weather conditions.
paras.zh: 该模块还可以将雷达传感器与加热的雷达透明盖集成。这些盖子可以保护传感器免受天气和灰尘的影响，有助于在严酷的冬季条件下保持可靠的雷达性能。集成加热功能有助于雷达传感器在各种天气条件下可靠运行。

paras.en: Manufacturers can also use polyurethane in the modules. After minor scratches, the material can partially return to its original shape through heat exposure, including sunlight.
paras.zh: 制造商还可以在模块中使用聚氨酯。轻微划痕后，材料可以通过受热（包括阳光）部分恢复其原始形状。

paras.en: For FORVIA HELLA, this year’s CLEPA Innovation Award marks its fourth consecutive win. In previous years, CLEPA recognized the company for Hella Gutmann Solutions’ Automatic Diagnosis system and its Intelligent Power Distribution Module (iPDM). The organization also recognized FORVIA HELLA’s FlatLight | µMX technology.
paras.zh: 对于 FORVIA HELLA 来说，今年的 CLEPA 创新奖是其连续第四次获奖。前几年，CLEPA 表彰了该公司的 Hella Gutmann Solutions 自动诊断系统及其智能配电模块 (iPDM)。该组织还认可了 FORVIA HELLA 的 FlatLight | µMX 技术。

articles.title: Fleetio Reports $41.6M in Rejected Repair Costs
articles.author: David Sickels

paras.en: Fleetio customers rejected $41.6 million in repair order line items during the H1 ’26, which the company characterized as unnecessary maintenance costs. The total represents a 112% year-over-year (Y/Y) increase in rejected repair costs.
paras.zh: Fleetio 客户在 26 年上半年拒绝了 4160 万美元的维修订单行项目，该公司将其描述为不必要的维护成本。总计表明报废维修成本同比 (Y/Y) 增加了 112%。

paras.en: Fleetio attributed the increase partly to growing adoption of its artificial intelligence (AI) tools and expanded connected maintenance network.
paras.zh: Fleetio 将这一增长部分归因于其人工智能 (AI) 工具的日益普及以及互联维护网络的扩大。

paras.en: During the H1 ’26, Fleetio launched the open beta of its AI Service Advisor and surpassed 80 million repair orders processed through the Fleetio-owned Auto Integrate network since its inception.
paras.zh: 26 年上半年，Fleetio 推出了 AI Service Advisor 的公开测试版，自成立以来，通过 Fleetio 拥有的 Auto Integrate 网络处理的维修订单数量已超过 8000 万个。

paras.en: The company now supports more than 8,500 fleets and more than 8 million assets across its maintenance ecosystem.
paras.zh: 该公司目前在其维护生态系统中支持超过 8,500 个车队和超过 800 万个资产。

paras.en: According to Fleetio, customers maintain preventive maintenance compliance rates above 80%, while fleets with strong inspection compliance experienced a 66% average reduction in reactive maintenance issues.
paras.zh: 据 Fleetio 称，客户的预防性维护合规率保持在 80% 以上，而具有严格检查合规性的车队的反应性维护问题平均减少了 66%。

paras.en: AI adoption also increased during the first half:
paras.zh: 上半年人工智能的采用率也有所增加：

paras.en: - 57% of Fleetio enterprise fleets used AI capabilities.
paras.zh: - 57% 的 Fleetio 企业车队使用了人工智能功能。

paras.en: - Customers used AI to complete $1.05 billion in asset assessments.
paras.zh: - 客户使用人工智能完成了 10.5 亿美元的资产评估。

paras.en: - Fleets resolved maintenance issues an average of three days faster.
paras.zh: - 车队解决维护问题的速度平均加快了三天。

paras.en: - Fleetio said the technology saved an average of 2.5 hours per repair.
paras.zh: - Fleetio 表示，该技术每次维修平均可节省 2.5 小时。

paras.en: One construction services customer increased its automated decision threshold for AI Service Advisor recommendations from $250 to $2,000. Fleetio said the change reflects growing confidence in using AI recommendations to automate maintenance decisions.
paras.zh: 一位建筑服务客户将 AI 服务顾问建议的自动决策门槛从 250 美元提高到 2,000 美元。 Fleetio 表示，这一变化反映出人们对使用人工智能建议自动化维护决策的信心不断增强。

paras.en: Read the full article on fleetequipmentmag.com.
paras.zh: 请在 fancyequipmentmag.com 上阅读完整文章。

articles.title: AutoZone President and CEO Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO, customer satisfaction, AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度部门总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering “WOW! customer service” remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. For professional repair shops, that means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供“哇！客户服务”仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。对于专业维修店来说，这意味着快速交付优质零件、确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

articles.title: Quantum entanglement could thwart hackers and scammers, physicists reveal
articles.author: Larissa G. Capella

paras.en: For the first time, physicists have used quantum entanglement to verify a person's physical location. That could one day make it much harder for hackers to pretend to be somewhere they're not, the team says.
paras.zh: 物理学家第一次使用量子纠缠来验证一个人的物理位置。该团队表示，有一天，这可能会让黑客更难假装在他们不在的地方。

paras.en: In the new study, published Wednesday (Nov. 18) in the journal Nature, researchers at the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) used pairs of entangled photons (particles of light) to confirm that a participant was at a specific spot between two stations on NIST's campus in Boulder, Colorado. The method is called quantum position verification, and this is the first complete demonstration of it.
paras.zh: 在周三（11 月 18 日）《自然》杂志上发表的这项新研究中，美国国家标准与技术研究所 (NIST) 的研究人员使用纠缠光子对（光粒子）来确认参与者位于科罗拉多州博尔德 NIST 园区两个站点之间的特定位置。该方法称为量子位置验证，这是该方法的首次完整演示。

paras.en: If the technology matures, it could help protect health records, stop remote attackers from sending commands to power grids or water treatment plants, block unauthorized stock trades and thwart phishing attacks carried out over phone or video calls, according to a statement.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，如果这项技术成熟，它可以帮助保护健康记录，阻止远程攻击者向电网或水处理厂发送命令，阻止未经授权的股票交易，并阻止通过电话或视频通话进行的网络钓鱼攻击。

paras.en: "It's a totally new application for quantum networks," Shalm said. "You can add another layer of security to these systems that anchors a lot of this digital security to a position."
paras.zh: “这是量子网络的一个全新应用，”沙姆说。 “您可以为这些系统添加另一层安全性，将大量数字安全性固定到某个位置。”

paras.en: Location is a basic layer of security. Banks, power grids and government agencies often limit access to sensitive systems to people who are physically inside a secure building. But classical (nonquantum) ways of proving location remotely, which time how long signals take to travel, can be spoofed by hackers working together. Quantum physics can close that security gap, because a single quantum particle can't be copied.
paras.zh: 位置是安全的基本层。银行、电网和政府机构通常会限制位于安全建筑物内的人员访问敏感系统。但远程证明位置的经典（非量子）方法（即信号传输所需的时间）可能会被黑客共同欺骗。量子物理学可以弥补这一安全差距，因为单个量子粒子无法被复制。

paras.en: "Is this call coming from my bank, or is it coming from someone in North Korea or somewhere else?" Krister Shalm, a quantum physicist at NIST who led the team, told Live Science. "That's really powerful if you can anchor digital security to a physical location."
paras.zh: “这个电话是从我的银行打来的，还是从朝鲜或其他地方打来的？”领导该团队的 NIST 量子物理学家 Krister Shalm 告诉《Live Science》。 “如果你能将数字安全锚定到物理位置，那就真的很强大了。”

paras.en: In the experiment, the team used a technique called ranging, which is similar to the principles behind echolocation, radar and the lidar sensors found in some smartphones. It sends a signal and measures how long it takes for the response to return.
paras.zh: 在实验中，该团队使用了一种称为测距的技术，该技术类似于某些智能手机中的回声定位、雷达和激光雷达传感器背后的原理。它发送信号并测量响应返回所需的时间。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "You can send a signal at the speed of light and measure how long it takes to get back," Shalm told Live Science. "But the problem is, that's the thing that can always be spoofed classically."
paras.zh: “你可以以光速发送信号并测量返回需要多长时间，”沙姆告诉《生活科学》。 “但问题是，这总是可以被经典欺骗的东西。”

paras.en: In the experiment, two trusted stations called "verifiers" sat 640 feet (195 meters) apart, linked by cables and optical fibers running through the hallways of a NIST research building. A "prover," whose location the verifiers wanted to confirm, sat in between.
paras.zh: 在实验中，两个被称为“验证者”的可信站相距 640 英尺（195 米），通过穿过 NIST 研究大楼走廊的电缆和光纤连接起来。验证者想要确认其位置的“证明者”坐在中间。

paras.en: One verifier created pairs of entangled photons — particles so deeply linked that measuring one reveals something about the other, even when they're separated at great distances. The verifier kept one photon from each pair and sent its twin to the prover. At the same time, both verifiers sent random bits of information that were timed to reach the prover at the same moment.
paras.zh: 一名验证者创造了一对纠缠光子——这种粒子紧密相连，即使它们相距很远，测量其中一个也能揭示另一个的一些信息。验证者从每对光子中保留一个光子，并将其双胞胎发送给证明者。同时，两个验证者都发送随机信息，这些信息被定时同时到达证明者。

paras.en: The prover combined the two inputs with a simple math operation and used the result to decide how to measure the photon's polarization — the direction in which its electric field oscillates. The measuring device works much like the filter in polarized sunglasses. A detector then recorded whether the photon made it through the filter, and the prover sent that yes-or-no result back to both verifiers.
paras.zh: 证明者将两个输入与简单的数学运算结合起来，并使用结果来决定如何测量光子的偏振——即其电场振荡的方向。该测量装置的工作原理与偏光太阳镜中的滤光片非常相似。然后探测器记录光子是否通过过滤器，证明者将是或否的结果发送回两个验证者。

paras.en: Because nothing travels faster than light, the round-trip time told the verifiers how far away the prover could be. And because the photon can't be copied, the measurement had to be made in that exact spot.
paras.zh: 因为没有什么比光传播得更快，所以往返时间告诉验证者证明者可能有多远。由于光子无法复制，因此必须在该精确位置进行测量。

paras.en: To confirm that no one cheated, the team ran a loophole-free Bell test, which checks whether particles are more strongly correlated than classical physics allows. If anyone tampers with the photons or the equipment, the test fails. Shalm led one of the first such tests in 2015.
paras.zh: 为了确认没有人作弊，该团队进行了一项无漏洞的贝尔测试，该测试检查粒子之间的相关性是否比经典物理学允许的更强。如果有人篡改光子或设备，测试就会失败。 Shalm 在 2015 年领导了首批此类测试之一。

paras.en: Scientists first proposed position verification in the late 2000s, but the experiments are extremely demanding, Shalm said. Many earlier designs could tolerate losing only a few percent of the photons along the way, which is "just not practical or reasonable" with today's technology. The NIST team relied on superconducting detectors that catch nearly every photon.
paras.zh: 沙姆说，科学家们在 2000 年代末首次提出位置验证，但实验要求极高。许多早期的设计只能容忍沿途损失百分之几的光子，这对于当今的技术来说“不切实际或不合理”。 NIST 团队依靠超导探测器来捕捉几乎所有光子。

paras.en: The surprise, Shalm said, was that the Bell test approach worked at all on the first try. It offers the strongest security of any quantum protocol because it makes very few assumptions about how the equipment works, but it is usually the hardest to pull off. "The sort of gold-plated deluxe version — you were able to do that on the first demonstration of a full protocol," he said.
paras.zh: 沙姆说，令人惊讶的是，贝尔测试方法第一次尝试就奏效了。它提供了所有量子协议中最强的安全性，因为它对设备的工作原理做出了很少的假设，但它通常是最难实现的。 “那种镀金的豪华版本——你可以在完整协议的第一次演示中做到这一点，”他说。

paras.en: The system ran about 250,000 trials per second. Each verification required 30 million to 60 million rounds of signals sent back and forth — roughly two to four minutes of data. Over two days in fall 2024, the team ran 335 verifications, and nearly all of them passed. The prover's location was confirmed within a region about 4.5 times smaller in volume than what a comparable classical method could guarantee, the team said.
paras.zh: 该系统每秒运行约 250,000 次试验。每次验证需要来回发送 3000 万到 6000 万轮信号——大约两到四分钟的数据。 2024 年秋季的两天里，团队进行了 335 次验证，几乎全部通过。研究小组表示，验证者的位置被确认在一个体积比传统方法所能保证的体积小约 4.5 倍的区域内。

paras.en: The experiment proved secure against attackers who shared little or no entanglement of their own. Protecting against attackers with more powerful quantum resources will require longer strings of random bits, the researchers wrote.
paras.zh: 事实证明，该实验对于那些很少或根本没有自己的纠缠的攻击者是安全的。研究人员写道，要防范拥有更强大量子资源的攻击者，将需要更长的随机位串。

paras.en: The initial users of this technology are expected to be data centers, financial backend systems and critical infrastructure like power plants, Shalm said. However, incorporating this technology into cellphones will take significantly longer, as the components are currently too large and expensive.
paras.zh: Shalm 表示，这项技术的最初用户预计将是数据中心、金融后端系统和发电厂等关键基础设施。然而，将这项技术整合到手机中将需要更长的时间，因为目前的组件太大且昂贵。

paras.en: "In terms of a computer analogy, we are much closer to the building-sized computers of the 1950s and 1960s than today's smartphones," he said in an email. "However, with consistent improvement it might be possible in several decades to come up with a compact handheld version of the devices needed for quantum position verification."
paras.zh: 他在一封电子邮件中表示：“就计算机类比而言，我们更接近 20 世纪 50 年代和 1960 年代的建筑物大小的计算机，而不是今天的智能手机。” “然而，通过持续改进，几十年后可能会推出量子位置验证所需设备的紧凑型手持版本。”

paras.en: - 'Really, really weird': Physicists entangle two moving atoms for the first time, validating 'spooky' quantum theory
paras.zh: -“真的，真的很奇怪”：物理学家首次使两个移动的原子纠缠在一起，验证了“怪异”的量子理论

paras.en: - Quantum computing 'lie detector' finally proves these machines tap into Einstein's spooky action at a distance rather than just faking it
paras.zh: - 量子计算“测谎仪”最终证明这些机器能够远距离利用爱因斯坦的怪异行为，而不是仅仅伪造它

paras.en: - Scientists discover simpler way to achieve Einstein's 'spooky action at a distance' thanks to AI breakthrough — bringing quantum internet closer to reality
paras.zh: - 由于人工智能的突破，科学家们发现了实现爱因斯坦“幽灵般的远距离作用”的更简单方法——使量子互联网更接近现实

paras.en: Real-world use may be more than a decade away, Scott Glancy, a NIST physicist and study co-author, said in the statement. To verify that a customer is truly communicating with someone from their bank, high-quality quantum networks must be utilized to share entangled photons between the two parties.
paras.zh: NIST 物理学家兼研究合著者 Scott Glancy 在声明中表示，实际应用可能还需要十多年的时间。为了验证客户是否真正与银行人员进行通信，必须利用高质量的量子网络在双方之间共享纠缠光子。

paras.en: The team already knows how to speed things up. Faster measurement devices could cut each verification from minutes to about a second, according to the study, and low-latency communication links could shrink the verified zone to a single building, even with stations miles apart.
paras.zh: 该团队已经知道如何加快速度。研究表明，更快的测量设备可以将每次验证从几分钟缩短到大约一秒，而低延迟通信链路可以将验证区域缩小到单个建筑物，即使站点相距数英里。

paras.en: "It may not be this year, but I think it's something that we're building towards, and we know the steps that are needed to get there," Shalm said.
paras.zh: 沙尔姆说：“可能不是今年，但我认为这是我们正在努力实现的目标，而且我们知道实现这一目标所需的步骤。”

paras.en: Kavuri, G. A., Zhang, Y., Gookin, A. R., Patra, S., Bienfang, J. C., Fu, H., Alnawakhtha, Y., Reddy, D., V., Mazurek, M. D., Abellán, C., Amaya, W., Mitchell, M. W., Miller, C. A., Mirin, R. P., Stevens, M. J., Glancy, S., Knill, E., & Shalm, L. K. (2026). Quantum position verification with remote untrusted devices. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11247-3
paras.zh: Kavuri, G. A.、Zhang, Y.、Gookin, A. R.、Patra, S.、Bienfang, J. C.、Fu, H.、Alnawakhtha, Y.、Reddy, D.、V.、Mazurek, M. D.、Abellán, C.、Amaya, W.、Mitchell, M. W.、Miller, C. A.、Mirin, R. P.、Stevens, M. J., Glancy, S.、Knell, E. 和 Shalm, L.K. (2026)。使用远程不受信任设备进行量子位置验证。自然。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11247-3

paras.en: Larissa G. Capella is a science writer based in Washington state. She obtained a B.S. in physics and a B.A. in English creative writing in 2024, which enabled her to pursue a career that integrates both disciplines. She reports mainly on environmental, Earth and physical sciences, but is always willing to write about any science that sparks her curiosity. Her work has appeared in Eos, Science News, Space.com, among others.
paras.zh: 拉里萨·G·卡佩拉 (Larissa G. Capella) 是华盛顿州的一位科普作家。她获得了学士学位。物理学学士学位和学士学位2024 年，她获得了英语创意写作博士学位，这使她能够追求融合两个学科的职业。她主要报道环境、地球和物理科学，但总是愿意写任何激发她好奇心的科学。她的作品曾发表在《Eos》、《科学新闻》、《Space.com》等杂志上。

articles.title: Ghostly 'sand body' double burial unearthed at Sutton Hoo
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have discovered a mysterious "sand body" at Sutton Hoo, an Anglo-Saxon cemetery in the U.K. that's famous for an enormous seventh-century ship burial of an early medieval king. The unusual grave does not have any bones but rather ghost-like shapes where a body was once buried.
paras.zh: 考古学家在英国的盎格鲁-撒克逊墓地萨顿胡发现了一个神秘的“沙体”，该墓地因埋葬中世纪早期国王的七世纪巨大船葬而闻名。这座不寻常的坟墓没有任何骨头，而是曾经埋葬过尸体的鬼魂形状。

paras.en: Sand bodies were "burials where the bodies and bones had dissolved away in the acid soil, replaced by hard sand which held the form of the person, not unlike some of the bodies at Pompeii," Angus Wainwright, an archaeologist at the U.K.'s National Trust, said in a statement. These burials have been found at Sutton Hoo in the past, as well as at other Anglo-Saxon sites in the Suffolk area of the U.K.
paras.zh: 英国国家信托基金会的考古学家安格斯·温赖特在一份声明中说，沙尸是“尸体和骨头在酸性土壤中溶解掉的墓葬，取而代之的是保持人形的硬沙，这与庞贝古城的一些尸体没有什么不同。”这些墓葬过去曾在萨顿胡以及英国萨福克地区的其他盎格鲁撒克逊遗址被发现。

paras.en: The new sand burial, which was uncovered at a burial ground called Garden Field at the end of a 2025 dig, features in a four-part documentary created by the television series "Time Team" and archaeological experts with the National Trust and FAS Heritage. Whereas a 2024 excavation unearthed pieces of a bronze bucket used in a cremation ritual, the 2025 excavation was aimed at discovering evidence for the extent of the cemetery, when it was used and whether the people buried there were connected with the occupant of the famous ship burial.
paras.zh: 这个新的沙墓是在 2025 年挖掘结束时在一个名为 Garden Field 的墓地中发现的，由电视连续剧“Time Team”以及国家信托基金会和 FAS Heritage 的考古专家制作的四部分纪录片中进行了专题报道。 2024 年的发掘出土了火葬仪式中使用的青铜桶碎片，而 2025 年的发掘则旨在寻找墓地范围、使用时间以及埋葬在那里的人是否与著名船葬的主人有关的证据。

paras.en: "Until now, archaeologists have focused on the royal burial mounds," Wainwright said. In particular, experts have tried to work out who was buried in the "great ship burial" at Sutton Hoo. That person may have been King Rædwald, who ruled a kingdom in East Anglia and died around A.D. 627. The ship burial also contained an intricate and striking helmet. But the archaeologists are trying to learn more about the everyday East Anglians with the 2025 dig, which "moves the focus to these people and their ancestors and descendants," Wainwright said.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，考古学家一直把注意力集中在皇家墓葬上，”温赖特说。特别是，专家们试图找出萨顿胡“大船墓”中埋葬的是谁。这个人可能是国王雷德瓦尔德 (Rædwald)，他统治着东安格利亚的一个王国，于公元 627 年左右去世。船葬中还发现了一个复杂而引人注目的头盔。但考古学家正试图通过 2025 年的挖掘更多地了解东盎格鲁人的日常情况，这“将焦点转移到这些人及其祖先和后代身上，”温赖特说。

paras.en: During the last week of the month-long excavation, the team unearthed the unusual sand body burial. Accompanying the deceased were grave goods, including beads, tweezers, a knife and a brooch, according to the statement. But directly underneath the sand body, the team found evidence that a second person may have been buried in the same grave.
paras.zh: 在长达一个月的挖掘工作的最后一周，研究小组发现了这个不寻常的沙体埋葬物。声明称，死者的随葬品包括珠子、镊子、刀和胸针。但就在沙体下方，研究小组发现了证据，表明同一个坟墓中可能埋有第二个人。

paras.en: - 1,600-year-old Anglo-Saxon cemetery holds speared man and wealthy woman
paras.zh: - 拥有 1,600 年历史的盎格鲁撒克逊墓地埋葬着被矛刺穿的男人和富有的女人

paras.en: - Anglo-Saxon burial holds an older sister cradling her little brother after they both died 1,400 years ago, possibly of an infectious disease
paras.zh: - 盎格鲁撒克逊墓葬中，一位姐姐抱着她的弟弟，两人于 1,400 年前双双去世，可能死于传染病

paras.en: - Anglo-Saxon children discovered buried with warrior gear in UK — perhaps as a nod to 'the men these children might have become'
paras.zh: - 在英国发现的盎格鲁撒克逊儿童埋藏着战士装备——也许是为了向“这些孩子可能成为的男人”致敬

paras.en: "It was certainly a high point of this latest dig, to find another of these bodies in the Garden Field cemetery," Wainwright said. Experts think the sand bodies and cremations discovered in the burial ground may predate the famous ship burial.
paras.zh: 温赖特说：“在花园场公墓中发现另一具这样的尸体，这无疑是这次最新挖掘的一个高潮。”专家认为，墓地中发现的沙体和火葬可能早于著名的船葬。

paras.en: In the first episode of a four-part Time Team series on Sutton Hoo, which launched on YouTube on Nov. 14, experts found new evidence that the people buried in the Garden Field cemetery were acquiring wealth and increasing their social status — so much so that they buried at least one person with a gold ingot.
paras.zh: 11 月 14 日，《Sutton Hoo》在 YouTube 上推出了由四部分组成的《Time Team》系列节目的第一集，专家们发现了新的证据，表明埋葬在 Garden Field 公墓的人们正在获得财富并提高他们的社会地位，以至于他们埋葬的人中至少有一个人带着金锭。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The team also investigated the possible remains of a dock that was used to build and launch ships into the River Deben and found an unusual fragment of a cremation urn that surprised the archaeologists because it was decorated rather than plain.
paras.zh: 研究小组还调查了一个可能用于建造船只并将船只驶入德奔河的码头遗迹，并发现了一个不寻常的火葬瓮碎片，这让考古学家感到惊讶，因为它经过装饰，而不是朴素的。

paras.en: "Well, it's at Sutton Hoo. Anything can happen," Justin Garner-Lahire, managing director at FAS Heritage, said in the video.
paras.zh: “嗯，这是在萨顿胡。任何事情都有可能发生，”FAS Heritage 董事总经理贾斯汀·加纳-拉希尔 (Justin Garner-Lahire) 在视频中说道。

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Brains of people with PTSD have unique epigenetic marks, study finds
articles.author: Payal Dhar

paras.en: A study of hundreds of brains has revealed molecular differences in people with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) that are not found in individuals without the condition.
paras.zh: 一项针对数百个大脑的研究揭示了创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的分子差异，而这些差异在没有这种疾病的个体中没有发现。

paras.en: These molecular marks also differ from those seen in the brains of people with other conditions, like depression, the research found.
paras.zh: 研究发现，这些分子标记也与患有抑郁症等其他疾病的人大脑中看到的分子标记不同。

paras.en: Our environment and experiences influence how our genes work, affecting which genes can be turned on. Rather than changing genes' underlying code, the environment can trigger what are known as epigenetic changes, which include certain chemicals that attach to DNA molecules and change their structure.
paras.zh: 我们的环境和经历会影响我们基因的运作方式，从而影响哪些基因可以被激活。环境不会改变基因的潜在密码，而是会引发所谓的表观遗传变化，其中包括某些附着在 DNA 分子上并改变其结构的化学物质。

paras.en: One such epigenetic change, called methylation, can work like a "dimmer switch" for genes, or even completely block certain genes from turning on.
paras.zh: 一种称为甲基化的表观遗传变化可以像基因的“调光开关”一样发挥作用，甚至完全阻止某些基因的开启。

paras.en: "These epigenetic features of the brain are important for shaping the way the brain functions," study co-author Frances Champagne, a psychologist at the University of Texas at Austin, told Live Science. "This can give us some insight into why individuals with PTSD develop PTSD, or how [their brains] are different from a healthy brain."
paras.zh: 研究报告的共同作者、德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的心理学家弗朗西斯·香槟（Frances Champagne）告诉《生活科学》杂志：“大脑的这些表观遗传特征对于塑造大脑的功能非常重要。” “这可以让我们深入了解为什么患有创伤后应激障碍的人会患上创伤后应激障碍，或者他们的大脑与健康的大脑有何不同。”

paras.en: In the new study, published Friday (Nov. 20) in the journal Cell Reports, scientists took a close look at DNA methylation in 302 brains that had been donated after death. These included 101 brains from individuals diagnosed with PTSD, 101 from people with major depressive disorder and 100 from people without any diagnosed psychiatric disorders. The researchers also had access to these individuals' medical records.
paras.zh: 在周五（11 月 20 日）《Cell Reports》杂志上发表的这项新研究中，科学家们仔细研究了死后捐赠的 302 个大脑中的 DNA 甲基化情况。其中包括 101 个被诊断患有 PTSD 的人的大脑、101 个来自患有重度抑郁症的人的大脑以及 100 个来自没有任何诊断出的精神疾病的人的大脑。研究人员还可以访问这些人的医疗记录。

paras.en: The team zoomed in on three brain regions: the prefrontal cortex, the amygdala and the hippocampus. The prefrontal cortex handles cognitive functions like planning and decision-making, the amygdala is a major hub for emotional processing, and the hippocampus is key for memory and learning.
paras.zh: 研究小组重点关注了三个大脑区域：前额皮质、杏仁核和海马体。前额叶皮层处理规划和决策等认知功能，杏仁核是情绪处理的主要枢纽，海马体是记忆和学习的关键。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "The goal of our study was to look at the epigenetics of the PTSD brain and ask how [it] is different from that of an individual who does not have PTSD," Champagne said, "or who comparatively has another diagnosis, like major depressive disorder."
paras.zh: 香槟说：“我们研究的目的是观察 PTSD 大脑的表观遗传学，并询问它与没有 PTSD 的人或有其他诊断（例如重度抑郁症）的人有何不同。”

paras.en: Compared to the brains of people without any disorders, the brains of people with PTSD had different patterns of methylation in the prefrontal cortex, in particular. By contrast, in major depressive disorder, the amygdala stood out as a brain region with distinct methylation.
paras.zh: 与没有任何疾病的人的大脑相比，患有创伤后应激障碍的人的大脑在前额皮质中尤其具有不同的甲基化模式。相比之下，在重度抑郁症中，杏仁核是一个具有明显甲基化的大脑区域。

paras.en: Additionally, in depression, the observed differences in methylation tended to affect the same set of genes across different regions of the brain. This was not the case in PTSD, which showed more inconsistencies in terms of which specific genes were involved. The methylation patterns in PTSD also appeared to vary depending on other factors, such as patients' sex, ethnicity and age at which they experienced trauma.
paras.zh: 此外，在抑郁症中，观察到的甲基化差异往往会影响大脑不同区域的同一组基因。创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD) 的情况并非如此，创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD) 在涉及哪些特定基因方面表现出更多的不一致。 PTSD 的甲基化模式似乎也根据其他因素而变化，例如患者的性别、种族和经历创伤的年龄。

paras.en: The study's results serve as a valuable resource, said Seyma Katrinli, an investigator in the Grady Trauma Project, a large PTSD study, at the Emory University School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 埃默里大学医学院格雷迪创伤项目（一项大型创伤后应激障碍研究）的研究员 Seyma Katrinli 表示，这项研究的结果是一种宝贵的资源。

paras.en: Although the findings can't be used to help diagnose PTSD yet, down the line, this area of research could help scientists correlate changes that are measurable in people's blood to changes in the brain, said Katrinli, who was not involved in the new work. Then, blood tests could help guide the diagnosis and treatment of PTSD, she suggested.
paras.zh: 虽然这些发现还不能用于帮助诊断创伤后应激障碍（PTSD），但这一领域的研究可以帮助科学家将人们血液中可测量的变化与大脑的变化联系起来，卡特琳利（没有参与这项新工作）说。她建议，血液检查可以帮助指导创伤后应激障碍的诊断和治疗。

paras.en: That said, the study had limitations. Because the scientists analyzed postmortem brains, they relied on the medical reports rather than assessing the study subjects directly. Additionally, both PTSD and major depressive disorder are associated with substance use, which also causes DNA methylation; this potential confounding factor was not accounted for in the study. .
paras.zh: 也就是说，这项研究有其局限性。因为科学家们分析的是死后的大脑，所以他们依赖于医学报告，而不是直接评估研究对象。此外，创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）和重度抑郁症都与药物滥用有关，这也会导致 DNA 甲基化。该研究并未考虑这一潜在的混杂因素。 。

paras.en: Finally, at this point, there is no way to tell what triggered the observed differences in DNA methylation. The scientists can't say if the variations are a consequence of PTSD, a risk factor for PTSD, or a downstream effect of other things that co-occur with PTSD.
paras.zh: 最后，目前还无法判断是什么引发了观察到的 DNA 甲基化差异。科学家们无法确定这些变化是否是 PTSD 的结果，是 PTSD 的风险因素，还是与 PTSD 同时发生的其他事情的下游影响。

paras.en: The research sets the stage to "help us ask better questions," Champagne said. Her team is now looking to investigate factors — such as sex, the timing of traumatic experiences, or history of substance use — that may be driving the variation within PTSD.
paras.zh: 商鹏飞说，这项研究为“帮助我们提出更好的问题”奠定了基础。她的团队现在正在研究可能导致 PTSD 变异的因素，例如性别、创伤经历的时间或药物使用史。

paras.en: "It's a very exciting foray into epigenetic profiling in the brain," she said.
paras.zh: “这是对大脑表观遗传分析的一次非常令人兴奋的尝试，”她说。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Wylie, D., Arasappan, D., Ross, D., Hyde, T. M., Ressler, K. J., Kleinman, J. E., Weinberger, D. R., Daskalakis, N. P., Nemeroff, C. B., & Champagne, F. A. (2026). DNA methylation profiling of human brain in posttraumatic stress and major depressive disorders indicate specific molecular features. Cell Reports, 118270. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2026.118270
paras.zh: Wylie, D.、Arasappan, D.、Ross, D.、Hyde, T. M.、Ressler, K. J.、Kleinman, J. E.、Weinberger, D. R.、Daskalakis, N. P.、Nemeroff, C. B. 和 Champagne, F. A. (2026)。创伤后应激和重度抑郁症中人脑的 DNA 甲基化分析表明了特定的分子特征。细胞报告，118270。https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2026.118270

paras.en: See how much you know about the most complex organ in the human body with our brain quiz.
paras.zh: 通过我们的大脑测验，看看您对人体最复杂的器官了解多少。

paras.en: Payal Dhar (she/they) is a freelance journalist, writing on science, technology, and society. They cover AI, engineering, materials science, cybersecurity, space, games, online communities, and any shiny new technology that catches their eye. She has written for Science News, Scientific American, Nature, Washington Post, Guardian, Chemical & Engineering News, IEEE Spectrum, and others. They also write science-fiction and fantasty. You can follow her @payaldhar.bluesky.social or read her work at payaldhar.contently.com.
paras.zh: Payal Dhar（她/他们）是一名自由记者，撰写有关科学、技术和社会的文章。他们涵盖人工智能、工程、材料科学、网络安全、太空、游戏、在线社区以及任何吸引他们眼球的闪亮新技术。她曾为《科学新闻》、《科学美国人》、《自然》、《华盛顿邮报》、《卫报》、《化学与工程新闻》、《IEEE Spectrum》等杂志撰稿。他们还写科幻小说和奇幻小说。您可以关注她的@payaldhar.bluesky.social 或在 payaldhar.contently.com 上阅读她的作品。

articles.title: Nine-Pound Eagles Seem to Be Hunting 60-Pound Baboons in Africa—Hinting the Predators May Have Gone After Our Ancestors, Too

paras.en: Eagles are formidable aerial predators capable of taking down animals much larger than themselves, including primates. But scientists have long believed that eagles tend to go after smaller primates, generally weighing less than 30 pounds.
paras.zh: 老鹰是可怕的空中掠食者，能够捕食比自己大得多的动物，包括灵长类动物。但科学家们长期以来一直认为，鹰倾向于捕食较小的灵长类动物，通常体重不到 30 磅。

paras.en: New research suggests otherwise. Scientists have found evidence of Verreaux’s eagles hunting full-grown olive baboons weighing nearly 60 pounds, which they describe in a study published November 18 in the American Journal of Biological Anthropology.
paras.zh: 新的研究表明情况并非如此。科学家们发现了维罗鹰捕猎重达近 60 磅的成年橄榄狒狒的证据，他们在 11 月 18 日发表在《美国生物人类学杂志》上的一项研究中对此进行了描述。

paras.en: The findings add to scientists’ understanding of predator-prey relationships. But they also raise the intriguing new possibility that eagle attacks might have influenced human evolution. Some of our ancestors, such as Australopithecus afarensis, weighed about as much as modern baboons, so it’s plausible that eagles went after them, too, millions of years ago. The threat of these attacks, researchers posit, might have affected how early humans communicated and cooperated with one another.
paras.zh: 这些发现增加了科学家对捕食者与猎物关系的理解。但他们也提出了一个有趣的新可能性：鹰的攻击可能影响了人类的进化。我们的一些祖先，例如南方古猿阿法种，其体重与现代狒狒一样重，因此数百万年前老鹰也追捕过它们，这似乎是合理的。研究人员认为，这些攻击的威胁可能影响了早期人类彼此沟通和合作的方式。

paras.en: In February and March 2025, primatologists went looking for olive baboons on the Ennedi Plateau, a remote area in northeastern Chad filled with sandstone cliffs, gorges and rock formations. They were hoping to collect genetic samples so they could chart the history of the baboons’ movement across Africa.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月和 3 月，灵长类动物学家前往恩内迪高原寻找橄榄狒狒，恩内迪高原是乍得东北部的一个偏远地区，充满了砂岩悬崖、峡谷和岩层。他们希望收集基因样本，以便绘制狒狒在非洲迁徙的历史。

paras.en: But the focus of their expedition took an unexpected turn when they stumbled upon an olive baboon skull with a distinctive hole at the back of one of the eye sockets—clear evidence that a razor-sharp eagle talon had speared the primate’s head. The researchers had noticed Verreaux’s eagles soaring overhead, but it hadn’t occurred to them that the birds might be going after the baboons.
paras.zh: 但当他们偶然发现了一个橄榄色狒狒头骨，其中一个眼窝后面有一个明显的洞时，他们探险的焦点发生了意想不到的转变——这是锋利的鹰爪刺穿灵长类动物头部的明显证据。研究人员注意到维罗的鹰在头顶翱翔，但他们没有想到这些鸟可能会追捕狒狒。

paras.en: During that initial trip, they recovered the remains of nine olive baboons, including eight adult males. Two of the skulls had talon-shaped puncture marks, while one shoulder blade was covered in what appeared to be talon scratch marks. In June 2026, they found another skull and partial skeleton, which also showed signs of eagle predation.
paras.zh: 在第一次旅行中，他们发现了九只橄榄狒狒的遗骸，其中包括八只成年雄性。其中两个头骨上有爪子形状的穿刺痕迹，而一个肩胛骨上覆盖着似乎是爪子划痕的痕迹。 2026年6月，他们发现了另一个头骨和部分骨骼，其中也显示出鹰捕食的迹象。

paras.en: The study authors can’t definitively rule out scavenging. But “the severity of punctures is suggestive of lethal interactions through a killing grip,” they write in the paper.
paras.zh: 研究作者不能明确排除拾荒的可能性。但他们在论文中写道，“刺穿的严重程度表明通过致命的抓握发生了致命的相互作用”。

paras.en: Further supporting the idea that Verreaux’s eagles were actively hunting the baboons, not just scavenging their remains, the scientists noted how groups of baboons responded whenever the birds got close, based on previously published observations. As soon as Verreaux’s eagles came into view, the primates started warning each other with alarm calls and taking cover. The baboons didn’t behave this way when other big birds of prey were nearby, suggesting they viewed the Verreaux’s eagles—which typically max out at about nine pounds—as legitimate threats.
paras.zh: 科学家们根据之前发表的观察结果，指出了每当鸟类靠近时，狒狒群的反应，这进一步支持了维罗鹰正在积极捕猎狒狒，而不仅仅是拾取它们的遗骸的观点。一旦维罗的鹰出现在视野中，灵长类动物就开始用警报声互相警告并寻找掩护。当其他大型猛禽在附近时，狒狒并没有这样的行为，这表明它们将维罗鹰（通常最大重量约为 9 磅）视为合法的威胁。

paras.en: “At first, the idea of eagles hunting adult male baboons seemed to exist on the thin edge of possibility, until it didn’t,” study co-author Nathaniel Dominy, a primatologist at Dartmouth College, says in a statement. “Our skepticism slowly gave way to acceptance. The evidence was convincing.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、达特茅斯学院灵长类动物学家纳撒尼尔·多米尼 (Nathaniel Dominy) 在一份声明中表示：“起初，老鹰猎杀成年雄性狒狒的想法似乎存在于可能性的边缘，直到它不再存在。” “我们的怀疑慢慢被接受。证据令人信服。”

paras.en: The scientists estimate that, when they were alive, the baboons whose remains they initially discovered weighed approximately 49 pounds on average. But the one found in 2026 appears to have been much heavier, possibly weighing as much as 58 pounds. That’s well within the range of early hominin species: “Lucy,” the famous A. afarensis individual who lived in what is now Ethiopia roughly 3.2 million years ago, is believed to have weighed about 62 pounds.
paras.zh: 科学家估计，最初发现的狒狒遗骸在世时平均重约 49 磅。但 2026 年发现的那颗似乎要重得多，可能重达 58 磅。这完全属于早期人类物种的范围：“露西”是著名的阿法种个体，大约 320 万年前生活在现在的埃塞俄比亚，据信体重约为 62 磅。

paras.en: The only known case of an eagle hunting and killing an ancient hominin is the Taung Child, reports Live Science. The A. africanus individual is estimated to have been about 3 at death, and their skull contains puncture marks at the bottom of the eye sockets.
paras.zh: 据《生活科学》报道，​​唯一已知的鹰猎杀古代人类的案例是“汤恩儿童”。据估计，A. africanus 个体死亡时年龄约为 3 岁，其头骨眼窝底部有穿刺痕迹。

paras.en: Scientists know that our ancestors were vulnerable to attacks from ground-based predators like crocodiles and hyenas. But the new findings suggest they might also have needed to be on alert for ambushes from the sky.
paras.zh: 科学家知道，我们的祖先很容易受到鳄鱼和鬣狗等地面掠食者的攻击。但新的发现表明，他们可能还需要警惕来自天空的伏击。

paras.en: That could have affected their behavior. Modern primates that live in areas with predatory eagles tend to move around in large groups made up of various primate species. “That means extra competition for the food—but the benefits of the added protection seem to be worth the cost,” lead author Catherine Hobaiter, a primatologist at the University of St. Andrews in Scotland, tells Live Science’s Owen Jarus.
paras.zh: 这可能会影响他们的行为。生活在有掠食性鹰的地区的现代灵长类动物往往会成群结队地活动，这些群体由各种灵长类动物组成。 “这意味着对食物的额外竞争，但额外保护的好处似乎值得付出的代价，”主要作者、苏格兰圣安德鲁斯大学灵长类动物学家凯瑟琳·霍拜特 (Catherine Hobaiter) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus)。

paras.en: Perhaps our ancestors deployed a similar strategy, learning to cooperate, rather than compete, with other hominin and primate species because they discovered there’s safety in numbers. They might also have evolved other adaptations in response to potential eagle attacks, such as calling out to warn others or living in places where they could easily hide.
paras.zh: 也许我们的祖先也采取了类似的策略，学会与其他古人类和灵长类动物合作，而不是竞争，因为他们发现数量多是安全的。为了应对潜在的鹰袭击，它们还可能进化出其他适应能力，例如大声警告他人或生活在可以轻松隐藏的地方。

paras.en: Scott McGraw, a primatologist at Ohio State University who was not involved with the study, tells the Washington Post’s Meghan Bartels he isn’t surprised by the findings, as birds of prey, commonly called raptors, are “extraordinary predators.”
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州立大学的灵长类动物学家斯科特·麦格劳（Scott McGraw）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《华盛顿邮报》的梅根·巴特尔斯（Meghan Bartels），他对这一发现并不感到惊讶，因为猛禽（通常称为猛禽）是“非凡的掠食者”。

paras.en: “As long as there have been primates, there have been raptors killing and eating them, and that’s been going on for 55 million years,” McGraw adds.
paras.zh: 麦格劳补充道：“自从灵长类动物出现以来，就有猛禽捕食它们，这种情况已经持续了 5500 万年。”

articles.title: An Isolated Group of Amazonian Hunter-Gatherers Made a Rare Request for Help From Outsiders, Raising Concerns About Forest Degradation

paras.en: For decades, the Awá, an Indigenous tribe in the Brazilian Amazon rainforest, has lived in almost complete isolation from the modern world. That changed on November 16, when a group of around 20 men, women and children emerged from the forest’s edge.
paras.zh: 几十年来，巴西亚马逊雨林的土著部落阿瓦人几乎与现代世界完全隔绝。 11 月 16 日，情况发生了变化，当时一群大约 20 名男人、女人和儿童从森林边缘出现。

paras.en: The Awá individuals, some of whom carried spears or wore necklaces and headdresses, made contact with a government agency that supports Indigenous peoples and the Guajajara, a larger, non-isolated Indigenous group that lives adjacent to the Awá. Both reside in Brazil’s Arariboia Indigenous Territory in the northeast state of Maranhão. Guajajara members captured photos and videos of the encounter, which have been shared by the London-based Indigenous advocacy group Survival International.
paras.zh: 阿瓦人中的一些人携带长矛或戴着项链和头饰，他们与支持原住民的政府机构和居住在阿瓦人附近的更大、非孤立的原住民群体瓜贾加拉人取得了联系。两人都居住在巴西东北部马拉尼昂州的阿拉里博亚土著领地。瓜亚加拉成员拍摄了这次遭遇的照片和视频，总部位于伦敦的原住民倡导组织生存国际分享了这些照片和视频。

paras.en: The interaction lasted for several hours, Stephen Gibbs reports for the London Times, though the two groups spoke different languages, rendering communication almost impossible. Near the end, the Guajajara shared yams with the Awá, who took the offering and, smiling, retreated among the trees.
paras.zh: 据《伦敦时报》报道，斯蒂芬·吉布斯报道称，这次互动持续了几个小时，尽管两个群体使用不同的语言，导致沟通几乎不可能。接近尾声时，瓜加加拉人与阿瓦人分享了山药，阿瓦人接受了贡品，微笑着退到树林里。

paras.en: However, Guajajara spokesperson Olimpio Santos Guajajara warns this should not be taken as a heartwarming story but as a worrying sign about the sustainability of the Awá’s voluntary isolation.
paras.zh: 然而，瓜亚加拉发言人奥林皮奥·桑托斯·瓜亚加拉警告说，这不应被视为一个感人的故事，而应被视为对阿瓦人自愿隔离的可持续性的一个令人担忧的迹象。

paras.en: “We were trying to avoid contact with them,” he tells Brazil’s Globo television network, per the London Times. Since the late 1980s, the national government has followed a no-contact policy regarding isolated tribes like the Awá, allowing the Indigenous peoples to remain away from modern society at their discretion. “Unfortunately, today they felt forced to come and make contact,” Santos says.
paras.zh: 据《伦敦时报》报道，他告诉巴西环球电视网：“我们试图避免与他们接触。”自 20 世纪 80 年代末以来，国家政府对阿瓦人等与世隔绝的部落实行非接触政策，允许原住民自行决定远离现代社会。 “不幸的是，今天他们感到被迫前来进行接触，”桑托斯说。

paras.en: Sarah Shenker, head of Survival International’s Brazil office, says the pressures of illicit deforestation, cattle ranching and hunting might be pushing the tribe to its limits, forcing them to emerge from isolation to survive.
paras.zh: 生存国际组织巴西办事处负责人莎拉·申克表示，非法砍伐森林、放牧和狩猎的压力可能将部落推向极限，迫使他们摆脱孤立以求生存。

paras.en: “They’ve shown so clearly for so long that they don’t want contact with outsiders,” she tells the New York Times’ Zane Irwin. “The fact that they’ve come out now does indicate they’ve probably felt forced to. … Because their lives are so intricately related to the forest, it would be impossible to completely separate the pressures on the land.”
paras.zh: “他们已经表现得如此明显，以至于他们不想与外人接触，”她告诉《纽约时报》的赞恩·欧文。 “他们现在出来的事实确实表明他们可能感到被迫。......因为他们的生活与森林有着如此复杂的联​​系，所以不可能完全分离对土地的压力。”

paras.en: The Brazilian government has designated certain swaths of the Amazon, including Arariboia, as protected Indigenous land. But as deforestation and farm development have increased, these small territories are one of the few places still home to the Amazon’s historic hardwoods, Shenker tells the Times.
paras.zh: 巴西政府已指定亚马逊地区的某些地区（包括阿拉里博亚）为受保护的原住民土地。但申克告诉《泰晤士报》，随着森林砍伐和农场开发的增加，这些小地区成为亚马逊地区历史悠久的硬木的少数地区之一。

paras.en: Thanks to conservation efforts and renewed enforcement, deforestation is slowing in Brazil. Still, estimates suggest that nearly 20 percent of the Amazon, which spans several South American countries, has been destroyed since the 1970s, and the forest can’t handle much more.
paras.zh: 由于保护工作和新的执法力度，巴西的森林砍伐正在放缓。尽管如此，据估计，自 20 世纪 70 年代以来，横跨多个南美国家的亚马逊地区近 20% 的面积已被破坏，而森林也无法承受更多的破坏。

paras.en: In recent years, hunters, loggers and ranchers have increasingly encroached upon the Awá territory. They previously cut down over 34 percent of one legally protected Awá reserve. Survival International says the Brazilian government has hardly responded to these intrusions. In its place, a team of Guajajara people known as the Forest Guardians has taken to defending the Arariboia territory, and several members have died during these conflicts.
paras.zh: 近年来，猎人、伐木者和牧场主越来越多地侵占阿瓦领土。他们此前砍伐了受法律保护的 Awá 保护区 34% 以上。生存国际组织表示，巴西政府几乎没有对这些入侵事件做出反应。取而代之的是，一支被称为“森林守护者”的瓜亚加拉人队伍开始保卫阿拉里博亚领土，并有几名成员在这些冲突中丧生。

paras.en: Repeated hunting and deforestation pose significant strain to the Awá way of life. The tribe survives off the forest, hunting wild boar, deer, monkeys and fish, and gathering fruit and honey, according to the Times. The forest is also central to the people’s medicinal and spiritual practices. But this is only possible in an “ever-smaller island of Amazon rainforest, surrounded by destruction,” says Caroline Pearce, director of Survival International, in a statement.
paras.zh: 反复的狩猎和森林砍伐给阿瓦人的生活方式带来了巨大压力。据《泰晤士报》报道，这个部落以森林为生，捕猎野猪、鹿、猴子和鱼，采集水果和蜂蜜。森林也是人们医疗和精神实践的中心。但生存国际组织主任卡罗琳·皮尔斯在一份声明中表示，这只有在“亚马逊雨林中一个越来越小的岛屿上，周围都是破坏”才有可能实现。

paras.en: When the Awá made contact with the Guajajara village, the effects of this habitat loss were clear: Uirá Garcia, an anthropologist at the Federal University of São Paulo who has studied the isolated tribe for 20 years, tells Globo that some members of the group looked “exceptionally thin,” per the London Times. This was particularly concerning given the timing of the encounter in the middle of the Amazon’s rainy season—typically a time of abundance in the forest.
paras.zh: 当阿瓦人与瓜亚加拉村接触时，栖息地丧失的影响显而易见：圣保罗联邦大学的人类学家乌拉·加西亚（Uirá Garcia）对这个与世隔绝的部落进行了 20 年的研究，他告诉环球报，据《伦敦时报》报道，该群体的一些成员看起来“异常瘦弱”。考虑到这次遭遇的时间正值亚马逊雨季中期——通常是森林资源丰富的时期，这一点尤其令人担忧。

paras.en: Experts also worried that contact with the modern world may pose serious health risks to the Awá. They have not received any vaccinations or built immunity to common viruses like influenza, measles and chicken pox, making them vulnerable to any pathogens present in the Guajajara population. Introduced diseases are currently the primary killer of isolated tribal people.
paras.zh: 专家还担心，与现代世界的接触可能会给阿瓦人带来严重的健康风险。他们没有接种任何疫苗，也没有对流感、麻疹和水痘等常见病毒产生免疫力，这使得他们很容易受到瓜亚哈拉人口中存在的任何病原体的影响。外来疾病目前是孤立部落居民的主要杀手。

paras.en: To guard the Awá from further exposure, the Brazilian government agency dedicated to protecting Indigenous peoples has enacted an emergency contingency plan. It includes restricting outsider access to the area surrounding where the group members emerged, the London Times reports.
paras.zh: 为了防止阿瓦河进一步暴露，致力于保护原住民的巴西政府机构制定了一项紧急应急计划。据《伦敦时报》报道，其中包括限制外人进入该组织成员出现的周边地区。

paras.en: Past estimates have put the total Awá population at roughly 450 people—only around 100 of whom still live in complete isolation from the rest of the world, separated into a few small, mobile bands. As one of the globe’s last nomadic hunter-gatherer tribes, they draw intense interest from the scientific community and general public alike. But, Shenker says, the tribe is better off remaining somewhat of a mystery.
paras.zh: 过去的估计显示，阿瓦人的总人口约为 450 人，其中只有约 100 人仍然生活在与世界其他地方完全隔离的环境中，分为几个流动的小群体。作为全球最后的游牧狩猎采集部落之一，他们引起了科学界和公众的强烈兴趣。但是，申克说，这个部落最好保持一定程度的神秘感。

paras.en: “We would rather not have images and not have video footage of the uncontacted Awá,” she tells Steven Grattan from the Associated Press, “when that means that they are living in the way that they choose in their forest, able to get on with their lives, hunting, fishing, gathering.”
paras.zh: “我们宁愿没有与世隔绝的阿瓦人的图像和视频片段，”她告诉美联社的史蒂文·格拉坦，“这意味着他们在森林中以他们选择的方式生活，能够继续他们的生活，狩猎、捕鱼、采集。”

articles.title: One of Hilma af Klint's Amazingly Rare Abstract Paintings Sold for a Record $12.7 Million at Auction. But Should It Have Been on Sale at All?

paras.en: On Thursday, a rare abstract painting by Swedish artist Hilma af Klint sold for a staggering $12.7 million at auction, raking in nearly 16 times its estimated worth. Painted in 1920, Ser III No. 5 is the first of af Klint’s abstract works to go to auction in over three decades, according to a statement from Bukowskis, the Stockholm-based auction house. But some critics say the sale defies the artist’s original intent.
paras.zh: 周四，瑞典艺术家希尔玛·阿夫·克林特 (Hilma af Klint) 创作的一幅罕见的抽象画在拍卖会上以 1,270 万美元的惊人价格售出，几乎是估价的 16 倍。根据斯德哥尔摩拍卖行 Bukowskis 的一份声明，《Ser III No. 5》画于 1920 年，是三十多年来第一幅参加拍卖的 af Klint 抽象作品。但一些评论家表示，这次拍卖违背了艺术家的初衷。

paras.en: Ser III No. 5 epitomizes af Klint’s late-career abstractions, exploring the idea of balance through its black-and-white background broken by a series of colorful, stacked geometric shapes. The painting works on “an intimate scale, steeped in af Klint’s mystical visual language,” Min Chen writes for ArtNet.
paras.zh: Ser III No. 5 集中体现了 af Klint 职业生涯后期的抽象概念，通过黑白背景探索平衡的理念，而黑白背景则被一系列色彩缤纷、堆叠的几何形状所打破。陈敏在 ArtNet 上写道，这幅画“规模亲密，充满了 af Klint 神秘的视觉语言”。

paras.en: “She calls her work a message for humanity. There’s the balance of materialism but also spirituality,” Rachel Villari, author of Hilma af Klint’s Atom and The Tree of Knowledge, explains to NPR’s Rob Schmitz. “She was doing it as a way to convey a message for a future generation, [and] I believe we are that generation now”
paras.zh: “她称自己的作品是给人类的信息。既有物质主义的平衡，也有灵性的平衡，”希尔玛·阿夫·克林特的《原子》和《知识之树》的作者雷切尔·维拉里 (Rachel Villari) 向 NPR 的罗布·施密茨 (Rob Schmitz) 解释道。 “她这样做是为了向下一代传达信息，[并且]我相信我们现在就是那一代人”

paras.en: Af Klint created her first abstract work in 1906 and over the course of her career amassed more than 1,200—but almost none have ever sold. Unlike many of her modern art contemporaries, af Klint refused to show off her works beyond her intimate circle.
paras.zh: Af Klint 于 1906 年创作了她的第一幅抽象作品，在她的职业生涯中积累了 1,200 多幅作品，但几乎没有一幅售出。与许多现代艺术同时代人不同，阿芙·克林特拒绝在她的亲密圈子之外展示她的作品。

paras.en: For af Klint, her work was a way of connecting with a higher power; instead of hanging in a museum or private collection, she hoped her paintings would one day fill the walls of a temple. “For Hilma, this is a holy body of work,” Erik af Klint, the artist’s great grand-nephew and the board chair of the Hilma af Klint Foundation, tells Hyperallergic’s Rhea Nayyar.
paras.zh: 对于 af Klint 来说，她的工作是与更高权力联系的一种方式。她希望自己的画作有一天能挂满寺庙的墙壁，而不是挂在博物馆或私人收藏中。 “对于 Hilma 来说，这是一件神圣的作品，”艺术家的曾孙、Hilma af Klint 基金会董事会主席 Erik af Klint 告诉 Hyperallergic 的 Rhea Nayyar。

paras.en: Throughout her life, af Klint’s work was limited to a small, “spiritually interested audiences,” per the foundation’s website. Upon her death in 1944, af Klint, who never married or had children, bequeathed her collection to her nephew under the condition the public wouldn’t see them for at least 20 years. “The world, she believed, wasn’t ready for them,” Smithsonian’s Ellen Wexler wrote in May.
paras.zh: 根据该基金会的网站，在她的一生中，af Klint 的作品仅限于一小部分“对精神感兴趣的观众”。 1944 年去世后，从未结过婚、也没有孩子的 af Klint 将她的​​藏品遗赠给了她的侄子，条件是公众至少要在 20 年内看不到这些藏品。 “她认为，世界还没有为他们做好准备，”史密森尼的艾伦·韦克斯勒 (Ellen Wexler) 在五月写道。

paras.en: For decades, her works languished in relative obscurity until a 2018 Guggenheim exhibition propelled her into the public eye. Art historians deemed her to be the world’s first abstract artist, reclaiming the title from Wassily Kandinsky, and the 2022 biopic Hilma brought her story to the big screen.
paras.zh: 几十年来，她的作品一直相对默默无闻，直到 2018 年古根海姆展览将她推入公众视野。艺术史学家认为她是世界上第一位抽象艺术家，从瓦西里·康定斯基手中夺回了这一头衔，2022 年的传记片《希尔玛》将她的故事搬上了大银幕。

paras.en: But, even as interest in af Klint’s life and work rose, collectors couldn’t get their hands on any of her abstract pieces. The foundation still owns almost all of her pieces and guards them tightly. “Her spirituality and her mysticism are so appealing to people, but she’s been out of reach for so long,” Louise Wrede, head of Bukowskis’ art department, tells the Wall Street Journal’s Kelly Crow. Erik af Klint, in particular, has resisted calls to share, monetize or sell the work, Hyperallergic reports, believing the art should be available as a complete body of work to those seeking a spiritual experience.
paras.zh: 但是，尽管人们对 af Klint 的生活和作品的兴趣日益浓厚，收藏家却无法获得她的任何抽象作品。基金会仍然拥有她几乎所有的作品，并严密保护它们。 “她的灵性和神秘主义对人们来说非常有吸引力，但她长期以来一直遥不可及，”布考斯基斯艺术部门负责人路易丝·维尔德 (Louise Wrede) 告诉《华尔街日报》的凯利·克劳 (Kelly Crow)。据《Hyperallergic》报道，埃里克·阿夫·克林特（Erik af Klint）尤其拒绝分享、货币化或出售该作品的呼吁，他认为这些艺术应该作为一个完整的作品提供给那些寻求精神体验的人。

paras.en: Ser III No. 5 is one of the few exceptions. In 1992, an entity related to the foundation tried to sell four of Klint’s works to little avail, the Journal reports. In 1995, an unnamed collector purchased two, including Ser III No. 5, which his heirs recently decided to list for auction. Still, the final sticker price likely came as a surprise. Its high-end estimate was $800,000. Af Klint’s previous auction record, set in 2019, was a mere $165,825 for a 1931 watercolor titled The Power of the Spleen.
paras.zh: Ser III No. 5 是少数例外之一。据《华尔街日报》报道，1992 年，与该基金会相关的一个实体试图出售克林特的四件作品，但收效甚微。 1995 年，一位不愿透露姓名的收藏家购买了两本，其中包括 Ser III No. 5，他的继承人最近决定将其挂牌拍卖。尽管如此，最终的标价可能还是令人惊讶。其最高估价为 80 万美元。 Af Klint 之前的拍卖纪录是 2019 年创下的，一幅 1931 年的水彩画《脾脏的力量》仅售出 165,825 美元。

paras.en: Villari tells NPR that af Klint’s resurgence in the artworld—coupled with the inaccessibility of her pieces—likely contributed to the pumped up price: “That makes it even more desirable to people who can afford to buy her work because what would you want more than the impossible painting that you’re not supposed to have or can’t have?”
paras.zh: Villari 告诉 NPR，af Klint 在艺术界的复兴，加上她的作品难以接近，可能导致了价格的上涨：“这使得那些有能力购买她的作品的人更感兴趣，因为除了那些你不应该拥有或不能拥有的不可能的画作之外，你还想要什么呢？”

paras.en: Af Klint first began painting abstracts as a spiritual project. While in art school, she and four other young, female artists formed a group called “the Five,” devoted to spiritual beings they called the High Ones, per Bukowskis. Her first abstract series, The Paintings for the Temple, comprised 193 paintings dated from 1906 to 1913, each a fragment of an ideal spiritual temple.
paras.zh: 阿夫·克林特 (Af Klint) 最初开始将抽象绘画作为一项精神项目。在艺术学校期间，她和其他四位年轻的女性艺术家组成了一个名为“五人”的团体，根据布考斯基的说法，致力于他们称之为“高人”的精神存在。她的第一个抽象系列《圣殿绘画》由 1906 年至 1913 年间的 193 幅绘画组成，每幅都是理想精神圣殿的片段。

paras.en: Experts suggest af Klint wasn’t the only artist behind The Paintings for the Temple. She often worked closely with the other members of the the Five, including Anna Cassel, who is thought to have been painted some of the projects’ pieces.
paras.zh: 专家表示，af Klint 并不是《圣殿绘画》背后的唯一艺术家。她经常与五人组的其他成员密切合作，其中包括安娜·卡塞尔，据信她是该项目的一些作品的画作。

paras.en: Soon, she was introduced to Rudolf Steiner, an Austrian guru who founded the anthroposophy movement, which centers around the idea that the human consciousness can perceive spiritual worlds. In 1920, she began her next project, 85 geometric works including Ser III No. 5 meant to interpret the anthroposophy creed.
paras.zh: 很快，她被介绍给了奥地利大师鲁道夫·施泰纳，他创立了人智学运动，其核心思想是人类意识可以感知精神世界。 1920年，她开始了她的下一个项目，包括Ser III No. 5在内的85幅几何作品，旨在诠释人智学信条。

paras.en: Villari tells NPR that it is hard to understand af Klint’s pieces, including Ser III No. 5 on their own. “I believe that her work should be kept together as a whole, and that they should be shown sequentially,” she says. “I know, from my own research, that looking at her work from beginning to end, you can see that it’s a progression of this message that they’re conveying.”
paras.zh: Villari 告诉 NPR，很难单独理解 Klint 的作品，包括 Ser III No. 5。 “我相信她的作品应该作为一个整体放在一起，并且应该按顺序展示，”她说。 “我知道，根据我自己的研究，从头到尾观察她的作品，你会发现这是他们所传达的信息的一个进展。”

articles.title: Google Workspace Promo Codes: 14% Off for November 2026
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: Google Workspace is that ubiquitous modern business tool that almost feels invisible. We use it every day here at WIRED, whether that's for writing first drafts of articles in Docs, analyzing data in Sheets, or sharing files in Drive. And recently, I've been using the Gemini AI implementation that's built right into these tools, which is handy in all sorts of ways.
paras.zh: Google Workspace 是一种无处不在、几乎看不见的现代商业工具。我们每天在《连线》杂志上都使用它，无论是在文档中撰写文章初稿、在表格中分析数据，还是在云端硬盘中共享文件。最近，我一直在使用内置于这些工具中的 Gemini AI 实现，它在各个方面都很方便。

paras.en: Google Workspace grants access to all kinds of productivity features that can help streamline processes and increase communication within a team or organization. It's not free, but here's the good news: If you're looking at a Workspace account for yourself (or for your team), Google is offering discounts until the end of 2026 using one of the Google Workspace coupon codes below. You can save up to 14 percent on plans for the first three months, whether you're signing up as an individual or as a business. Either way, the Google Workspace promo code down below is what you want to use.
paras.zh: Google Workspace 允许使用各种生产力功能，这些功能有助于简化流程并加强团队或组织内的沟通。它不是免费的，但有个好消息：如果您正在为自己（或您的团队）寻找 Workspace 帐号，Google 将在 2026 年底之前使用下面的 Google Workspace 优惠券代码之一提供折扣。无论您是以个人还是企业身份注册，前三个月的计划均可节省高达 14% 的费用。无论哪种方式，您都可以使用下面的 Google Workspace 促销代码。

paras.en: Save up to 14% Off These Google Workspace Promo Codes 2026
paras.zh: 这些 2026 年 Google Workspace 促销代码可节省高达 14% 的费用

paras.en: There are some notable differences between each Workspace plan – I’ll dig into them in the next section – but all three plans come with access to the full slate of Workspace apps. You get Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Meet, of course, but even the cheapest Starter plan includes basic access to Google’s other apps, such as NotebookLM and Gemini inside the Workspace suite. If you want to save, make sure to click one of the promo codes at the top of this page to secure your discount.
paras.zh: 每个 Workspace 计划之间都有一些显着的差异 - 我将在下一节中深入研究它们 - 但所有三个计划都可以访问完整的 Workspace 应用程序。当然，你可以使用 Gmail、Drive、Calendar 和 Meet，但即使是最便宜的 Starter 套餐也包含对 Google 其他应用程序的基本访问权限，例如 Workspace 套件中的 NotebookLM 和 Gemini。如果您想保存，请务必点击本页顶部的促销代码之一以确保您的折扣。

paras.en: Google offers four different Workspace plans, though only three are relevant for most people. There’s Starter, Standard, and Plus, as well as Enterprise, which is only available if you contact Google’s sales team. There isn’t a minimum number of users on any of the plans, but the bottom three options (Starter, Standard, and Plus) support up to 300 users. If you need more than that, you’ll need an Enterprise plan.
paras.zh: 谷歌提供了四种不同的工作空间计划，但只有三种与大多数人相关。有 Starter、Standard 和 Plus，以及 Enterprise，只有联系 Google 的销售团队才能使用。任何计划都没有最低用户数量限制，但底部的三个选项（Starter、Standard 和 Plus）最多支持 300 个用户。如果您需要更多，则需要企业计划。

paras.en: Although you have access to all the apps regardless of the plan you choose, there are some important differences, particularly between the Starter and Standard plans. Both include secure storage through Google Drive, but Starter comes with 30GB per user while Standard comes with a massive 2TB per user. Plus bumps that up to 5TB per user. Across all plans, storage is in a shared pool, so each additional user adds to the total pool of storage your organization can use.
paras.zh: 尽管无论您选择哪种计划，您都可以访问所有应用程序，但仍存在一些重要差异，特别是在入门计划和标准计划之间。两者都包括通过 Google Drive 的安全存储，但 Starter 为每个用户提供 30GB，而 Standard 为每个用户提供 2TB 的海量存储空间。另外，每个用户的存储容量高达 5TB。在所有计划中，存储都位于共享池中，因此每个额外的用户都会添加到您的组织可以使用的总存储池中。

paras.en: Gemini is also a big difference between Starter and Standard. Although both have access to the Gemini app, Starter only has Gemini in Gmail and Vids. Standard (and Plus) includes Gemini across the full suite, including in Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, Meet, and Chat.
paras.zh: Gemini也是Starter和Standard之间的一个很大的区别。虽然两者都可以访问 Gemini 应用程序，但 Starter 仅在 Gmail 和 Vids 中具有 Gemini。标准版（和增强版）包括整个套件中的 Gemini，包括文档、表格、幻灯片、云端硬盘、会议和聊天。

paras.en: Starter is a great option for anyone just getting started, regardless of whether you’re a freelancer or a small business with a handful of employees. In addition to 30GB per user and limited access to Gemini, Starter comes with a few other limitations. It doesn’t support e-signatures in Docs, nor advanced features of Meet, such as noise cancellation. The bread and butter of Workspace is all here, though. You get a custom domain in Gmail, up to 100 participants in Meet, and the full Google suite of productivity apps.
paras.zh: 对于任何刚刚起步的人来说，Starter 都是一个不错的选择，无论您是自由职业者还是拥有少数员工的小型企业。除了每个用户 30GB 和对 Gemini 的访问受限之外，Starter 还存在一些其他限制。它不支持文档中的电子签名，也不支持 Meet 的高级功能，例如噪音消除。不过，Workspace 的主要功能都在这里。您可以在 Gmail 中获得自定义域，在 Meet 中获得最多 100 名参与者，以及全套 Google 生产力应用程序套件。

paras.en: Standard, as the name suggests, is Workspace proper, and it’s built for teams that need room to grow. That shows up most clearly in storage space, jumping from 30GB to 2TB per user. Standard basically cuts all the red tape on Starter. There aren’t any limitations on Gemini (it’s available across the full suite), Meet features like noise cancellation are available, and you can host up to 150 participants in a Meet call. Standard even comes with expanded access to NotebookLM, Google’s AI-driven note and research tool, with different chat modes and up to 20 generative audio overviews per day.
paras.zh: 顾名思义，标准就是工作空间，它是为需要成长空间的团队而构建的。这在存储空间上表现得最为明显，每个用户的存储空间从 30GB 跃升至 2TB。 Standard 基本上消除了 Starter 上的所有繁文缛节。 Gemini 没有任何限制（整个套件均可用），可以使用降噪等 Meet 功能，并且您可以在 Meet 通话中主持最多 150 名参与者。标准版甚至还可以扩展对 NotebookLM（Google 人工智能驱动的笔记和研究工具）的访问，具有不同的聊天模式和每天最多 20 个生成音频概述。

paras.en: At the top of the range is Plus, which is focused on larger businesses. You don’t get any extra apps with this plan, but you do get 5TB of storage per user, along with up to 500 participants in Meet calls. The real reason to upgrade to Plus is security and admin controls, however. It includes Vault for data retention, along with LDAP access—basically a server for centralized account management, if you aren’t familiar.
paras.zh: 该系列中的顶级产品是 Plus，它专注于大型企业。通过此计划，您不会获得任何额外的应用程序，但每个用户可以获得 5TB 的存储空间，以及最多 500 名 Meet 通话参与者。然而，升级到 Plus 的真正原因是安全性和管理控制。它包括用于数据保留的 Vault 以及 LDAP 访问——如果您不熟悉的话，它基本上是一个用于集中帐户管理的服务器。

paras.en: Most people should use the Standard plan, not only for the large amount of storage space over Starter, but also due to the extra Gemini functionality. If you need to upgrade to Plus down the line, you can. And, more than likely, you’ll have a member of your IT team begging you to do so.
paras.zh: 大多数人应该使用标准计划，不仅因为 Starter 拥有大量存储空间，而且还因为额外的 Gemini 功能。如果您需要升级到 Plus，也可以。而且，很可能您的 IT 团队成员会恳求您这样做。

paras.en: Why Teams Love Using Google Workspace Flows with Google Workspace
paras.zh: 为什么团队喜欢将 Google Workspace Flows 与 Google Workspace 结合使用

paras.en: Google has updated Workspace a lot over the past several months, building in new functionalities via Gemini throughout the suite. But earlier this year, Google announced that it’s bringing all of those functionalities together through Workspace Flows. It’s a no-code automation tool that lets you build automatic workflows; i.e., update a Sheet when there’s a new email in Gmail from a particular address. The interesting thing about Flows, however, is that Gemini is built into it.
paras.zh: 过去几个月，谷歌对 Workspace 进行了多次更新，通过 Gemini 在整个套件中构建了新功能。但今年早些时候，谷歌宣布将通过 Workspace Flows 将所有这些功能整合在一起。它是一个无代码自动化工具，可让您构建自动工作流程；即，当 Gmail 中有来自特定地址的新电子邮件时更新工作表。然而，Flows 的有趣之处在于，Gemini 内置于其中。

paras.en: You can set up basic automations, which is great given how interconnected Google’s Workspace apps already are, but Flows become powerful when you throw Gems into the mix. Gems are AI agents built with Gemini, and you can create them with specific parameters.
paras.zh: 您可以设置基本的自动化，考虑到 Google 的 Workspace 应用程序已经相互关联，这非常好，但是当您将 Gems 加入其中时，Flows 就会变得强大。 Gems 是用 Gemini 构建的 AI 代理，您可以使用特定参数创建它们。

paras.en: Let me give you an example. Say you need a marketing plan, and an employee sends you a draft. You can have a workflow set up with a Gem that’s been trained on the budget, requirements, and tone of the campaign to quickly know if it can be approved or not. Or, you can create a Gem to scan your email, trained on your organization chart and role responsibilities, to notify you whenever you receive an email that has action items for you.
paras.zh: 让我举个例子。假设您需要一份营销计划，一名员工向您发送了一份草稿。您可以使用 Gem 设置工作流程，该 Gem 已接受过预算、要求和营销活动基调方面的培训，以便快速了解是否可以获得批准。或者，您可以创建一个 Gem 来扫描您的电子邮件，并根据您的组织结构图和角色职责进行培训，以便在您收到包含您的操作项目的电子邮件时通知您。

paras.en: Flows give you a way to add a bit of context and reasoning to the often rigid constraints of simple automation systems, and they can save you a lot of time in the process. You may be able to gather customer feedback and put it into Sheets easily, for example, but Gemini can automatically sort, summarize, and categorize that feedback so you know what you should tackle first. Flows are centralized in Workspace, as well; you don’t need to install add-ons or configure anything outside of setting up your Workspace account.
paras.zh: 流程为您提供了一种为简单自动化系统通常严格的约束添加一些上下文和推理的方法，并且它们可以在此过程中为您节省大量时间。例如，您可以轻松收集客户反馈并将其放入表格中，但 Gemini 可以自动对反馈进行排序、总结和分类，以便您知道应该首先解决什么问题。流程也集中在工作区中；除了设置 Workspace 帐户之外，您无需安装附加组件或配置任何内容。

paras.en: Google Workspace Flows is a new tool integrated with Google Workspace. It is powered by Google’s Gemini AI and helps you get tasks done with Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Calendar and Chat. It can fix up emails, make plans, correct sheets, or write a follow-up message. No apps or links are needed.
paras.zh: Google Workspace Flows 是与 Google Workspace 集成的新工具。它由 Google 的 Gemini AI 提供支持，可帮助您通过 Gmail、文档、表格、日历和聊天完成任务。它可以修复电子邮件、制定计划、更正表格或撰写后续消息。不需要应用程序或链接。

Power, Mint ranks highest in overall customer satisfaction among wireless carriers. Its prepaid cell phone plans, with no contracts or early termination fees, appeal to many customers, especially those with basic needs. paras.zh: 得益于演员（兼前股东）Ryan Reynolds 主演的广告，Mint Mobile 已成为最受欢迎的移动运营商之一。根据 J.D. paras.zh: Mint Mobile 老年人优惠：6 GB 每月 15 美元或 6 个月计划 50% 折扣

For seniors who don’t need much data per month, the 6-GB plan is plenty for casual browsing, streaming, app downloads, and emailing. Plus, it includes unlimited talk and texting, which may be more valuable to this age group than doomscrolling on social media.
paras.zh: 虽然 Mint Mobile 不为 55 岁及以上的客户提供特定折扣，但其低成本标准计划应该会吸引任何有预算或只是想减少电话服务费用的人。对于每月不需要太多数据的老年人来说，6 GB 套餐足以满足休闲浏览、流媒体、应用程序下载和电子邮件的需求。此外，它还包括无限的通话和短信，这对于这个年龄段的人来说可能比在社交媒体上滚动更有价值。

paras.en: The 6-GB plan costs $15 a month for three months, plus taxes and fees. Mint plans never require a contract, but you must pay the full $45 upfront. The plan renews for another three months, but the price increases to $25 a month, so it’s $75 plus taxes and fees. It’s still affordable compared with legacy carriers. You don’t have to deal with monthly charges, and there’s no commitment after the three-month term if you wish to cancel. You can switch to a different plan for potential greater savings. Note that Mint doesn’t refund unused months if you cancel outside the seven-day cancellation period (seven days after activation).
paras.zh: 6 GB 计划的费用为每月 15 美元，为期三个月，另加税费。 Mint 计划从不需要合同，但您必须预付 45 美元的全额费用。该计划再续签三个月，但价格上涨至每月 25 美元，因此加上税费为 75 美元。与传统运营商相比，它仍然实惠。您无需支付月费，并且在三个月期限后如果您想取消，也无需做出任何承诺。您可以切换到不同的计划以获得更大的节省。请注意，如果您在 7 天取消期限（激活后 7 天）之外取消，Mint 不会退还未使用的月份。

paras.en: To save more, and if their budgets allow, seniors should consider Mint Mobile’s longer-term plans. While they cost more upfront, they save more in the long run.
