paras.zh: 劳伦斯说：“看到他变得激进，看到他决定，即使失去了所有这些，纪念这些人的方法就是继续战斗：这对我来说才是真正重要的，也是我发现真正有趣和感人的。”

paras.en: “You see Haymitch in the other movies, and Woody does an amazing job portraying him, but people laugh with him,” the director adds. “He’s a drunk, and you just don’t know the history. Now you follow this movie and see all that he went through, how long and hard he fought, all the years he had to escort tributes to the arena and watch them die. But he continued to fight and kept his promise to his girlfriend, his mother, his brother, to Maysilee (portrayed by Grace) and all of them.”
paras.zh: “你在其他电影中看到黑密斯，伍迪对他的描绘非常出色，但人们和他一起笑，”导演补充道。 “他是个酒鬼，你只是不了解这段历史。现在你看这部电影，会看到他所经历的一切，他战斗了多久、多么艰苦，多年来他不得不护送贡品到竞技场并看着他们死去。但他继续战斗，信守了对他的女朋友、他的母亲、他的兄弟、梅西莉（由格蕾丝饰演）和所有人的承诺。”

paras.en: For Ray, filling in that history was the point. “In that first movie, obviously Haymitch is just broken, with a real serious drinking problem and a lot of pain. This was the movie that explained all that, and it was great to do that sort of history retroactively, to say, ‘This explains the behavior you’ve been seeing through all those movies,'” he says. “People know what happened, and the trick is saying, ‘Here’s the part you didn’t know.’ That’s what we were going for here.”
paras.zh: 对于雷来说，填补这段历史才是重点。 “在第一部电影中，显然黑密斯已经崩溃了，有严重的酗酒问题和很多痛苦。这部电影解释了这一切，回顾历史真是太好了，‘这解释了你在所有这些电影中看到的行为，’”他说。 “人们知道发生了什么，而诀窍就是说，‘这是你不知道的部分。’这就是我们想要的。”

paras.en: Telling an Emotional, Brutal Story That Parallels Present Reality
paras.zh: 讲述一个与现实相似的感人而残酷的故事

paras.en: Collins doesn’t write unless she has something to say, and themes have been the foundation of each Hunger Games book. With the original trilogy, she explored the consequences of war for teens. With the prequels, she continues to examine the state of the world.
paras.zh: 科林斯只有在有话要说时才会动笔，而主题一直是每部《饥饿游戏》作品的基础。在最初的三部曲中，她探讨了战争对青少年的影响。在前传中，她继续审视世界的现状。

paras.en: “Look at the themes she’s dealing with now and how relevant they are: there’s a bit of a call to action, this idea of implicit submission, and diving into the use of propaganda to get people to submit. So there are fresh ideas that feel very relevant. There’s meat on the bone,” Lawrence says. “Take this idea of implicit submission. You can look at any government, whether it’s authoritarian, fascist or one that calls itself democratic: as humans, we always agree to be ruled by the few. It’s a bit of a call to action: don’t be apathetic, stand up, voice your beliefs, and don’t expect instant gratification, because change may take time. I feel that’s very relevant now, but it’s also timeless, because people are constantly fighting for their rights. You see it in Hungary, with the ousting of a regime, and in Brazil, where people actually make change. That’s happening now, but it’s also something that’s been happening for thousands of years.”
paras.zh: “看看她现在正在处理的主题以及它们的相关性：有一点号召性用语，这种含蓄服从的想法，以及深入利用宣传来让人们服从。所以有一些感觉非常相关的新鲜想法。有肉在骨头上，”劳伦斯说。 “以隐含服从的想法为例。你可以看看任何政府，无论是独裁政府、法西斯政府还是自称民主的政府：作为人类，我们总是同意由少数人统治。这有点像号召性用语：不要冷漠，站起来，表达你的信仰，不要期望立即得到满足，因为改变可能需要时间。我觉得这现在非常相关，但它也是永恒的，因为人们不断为自己的权利而奋斗。你看在匈牙利，随着政权的倒台，在巴西，人们实际上正在做出改变，但这也是已经发生了数千年的事情。”

paras.en: Ray says he approached both the original film and Sunrise as if they were “true stories.”
paras.zh: 雷说，他对待原版电影和《日出》就好像它们是“真实的故事”一样。

paras.en: “And they’re getting closer and closer to being that, which is the bad news for us as a culture, and the great news for Suzanne Collins, because she has her finger on the pulse of something, and it does feel like a true story. If you think of it that way, you can write it as a screenwriter from a place of complete outrage,” he says.
paras.zh: “他们正越来越接近这种状态，这对我们这个文化来说是个坏消息，但对苏珊·柯林斯来说是个好消息，因为她敏锐地捕捉到了某种趋势，这确实感觉像一个真实的故事。如果你这样想，就可以以一个编剧的身份，带着满腔愤怒来写，”他说。

paras.en: Haymitch’s journey matters now even more given it’s “a time when so many people feel like, ‘What’s the point of trying to make a difference?'” Jacobson says. “It’s a story that is so emotional about how hard it is to try to make a difference. It’s also about how what you set in motion today might not be realized for another generation, and how hard it is to continue to resist and to endure, knowing that the changes you hope for could take 25 years to accomplish.”
paras.zh: 鉴于“现在有这么多人觉得‘努力去改变有什么意义？’”，海米奇的历程现在就显得更加重要了。”雅各布森说，“这是一个非常感人的故事，讲述了想要有所作为是多么困难。它还讲述了你今天所做的事情可能要到下一代才能实现，以及明知你所希望的改变可能需要25年才能实现，却仍要继续抗争和坚持是多么艰难。”

paras.en: Anyone who knows The Hunger Games knows the brutality of the story. “I think an audience that has bought into the concept that a government forces children to kill each other knows they’re coming to see something dark,” Ray says. “I don’t think anybody is going to come away saying, ‘Wow, I was expecting a musical. What the hell is this?'”
paras.zh: 任何了解《饥饿游戏》的人都知道这个故事的残酷性。“我认为，接受政府强迫孩子们自相残杀这一概念的观众，知道他们将要看到的是黑暗的东西，”雷说。“我认为没有人会看完电影后说：‘哇，我还以为这是一部音乐剧呢。这到底是什么鬼东西？’”

paras.en: Even so, certain sequences in Sunrise had to be toned down to keep the film’s PG-13 rating.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，《日出》中的某些片段仍不得不被淡化处理，以保持影片的PG-13分级。

paras.en: “There’s a moment in the book where a character is holding the head of a child, and I thought, ‘We’re never going to be able to do that.’ There were probably three moments in the book where I went, ‘Come on, Suzanne, this is never going to happen.’ And she understands that when we get into the process,” Lawrence says.
paras.zh: “书里有一个情节，一个角色抱着一个孩子的头，我当时想：‘我们永远不可能拍出这样的镜头。’ 书中大概有三处让我觉得：“拜托，苏珊娜，这根本不可能。” 当我们进入拍摄过程时，她就明白了这一点。”劳伦斯说。

paras.en: The story’s emotional darkness stayed intact, and Lawrence says it was “toughest” on Zada, who had to ride that roller coaster on set.
paras.zh: 故事的情感阴郁得以完整保留，劳伦斯表示，对扎达来说最“艰难”的是在片场乘坐过山车。

paras.en: “Whenever we led up to certain days, whether it was a Lenore Dove scene or a Maysilee scene, it was always a little scary for him, because he knew he’d have to sit in those feelings for 10 or 12 hours, basically all day,” he says.
paras.zh: “每当拍摄到某些日子时，无论是莱诺·多夫的场景还是梅西莉的场景，对他来说都总是有点吓人，因为他知道自己必须沉浸在这种情绪中10到12个小时，基本上是一整天。”他说。

paras.en: The Games were filmed first, with the District 12 scenes shot later. “He was so happy to just be happy: going to work convinced he’d never get called in the reaping, having a nice scene in the meadow with Lenore Dove, being in the candy shop. He looked forward to those days,” Lawrence says.
paras.zh: 先拍摄了饥饿游戏的部分，12区的场景是后来拍摄的。“他很高兴能过上快乐的日子：去上班时确信自己永远不会被抽中参加饥饿游戏，在草地上与莱诺尔·多夫（Lenore Dove）一起拍一场美好的戏，在糖果店里。他很期待那些日子。”劳伦斯说。

paras.en: But the darker turns were never far off. “We also had to do things like shoot his and Lenore Dove’s first scene one day and then, because we were in that location, jump to the end the very next day and do that whole scene (readers know the one.) That was tough on Joe. Even when he was happy to be happy, he knew what was coming tomorrow. That weighed on him more than it did on me,” the director says.
paras.zh: 但阴暗的剧情转折从未远离。“我们还不得不做一些这样的事情，比如有一天拍摄他和莱诺尔·多夫的第一场戏，然后，因为我们在那个拍摄地，第二天就直接跳到结尾，拍摄整场戏（读者都知道是哪一场。）这对乔来说很艰难。即使他乐于享受快乐，他也知道明天会发生什么。这对他造成的压力比对我造成的压力更大。”导演说道。

paras.en: Bringing Back Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson Was Always the Plan
paras.zh: 让詹妮弗·劳伦斯、乔什·哈切森和伍迪·哈里森回归一直是我们的计划

paras.en: Though the book and film follow a younger Haymitch, the book’s epilogue, featuring Katniss, Peeta and an older Haymitch, was in the script from the start. “It was such a profound honor to get to write those characters again. It was just pure joy,” Ray says.
paras.zh: 虽然小说和电影都讲述的是年轻时的海米奇，但小说的尾声部分有凯妮丝、皮塔和年长的海米奇出场，这一幕从一开始就在剧本中。“能再次撰写这些角色，我感到莫大的荣幸。这纯粹是一种喜悦。”雷说。

paras.en: “I remember reading the epilogue in the manuscript and thinking, ‘Wow, this is fantastic.’ I found it really moving,” Lawrence says of the trio’s return in the book.
paras.zh: “我记得读到手稿中的尾声时，我心想：‘哇，太棒了。’ 我觉得这真的很感人。”劳伦斯在谈到三人组在书中的回归时说道。

paras.en: “The hope was always to bring them back,” the director says of Harrelson, Hutcherson and Jennifer Lawrence. But because of the secrecy surrounding the book and the adaptation, “We didn’t reach out to them until, I want to say, the day before the announcement. That’s when I called the three of them.”
paras.zh: “我们一直希望他们能回归，”导演谈到哈里森、哈奇森和詹妮弗·劳伦斯时说道。但由于小说和改编电影都处于保密状态，“我们直到宣布的前一天才联系他们。那时我给他们三个人打了电话。”

paras.en: While the team hoped for an immediate yes, they prepared in case scheduling conflicts or other circumstances kept the actors from returning. “We had already tasked ourselves with figuring out how to make the story as fulfilling as possible if it didn’t happen,” Lawrence says.
paras.zh: 虽然团队希望演员们能立即答应，但他们也做好了准备，以防档期冲突或其他情况导致演员无法回归。“我们已经给自己布置了任务，要弄清楚如果他们不回来，该如何让故事尽可能圆满。”劳伦斯说。

paras.en: But there was no need to rethink the epilogue: the actors were “all very excited to return,” he says. “Then it was really just a scheduling question: when can we get the three of them together and out to Germany?” the director says.
paras.zh: 不过，没有必要重新考虑尾声部分：他说，演员们“都非常期待回归”。“然后就真的只是一个档期问题：我们什么时候能把他们三个人凑到一起，然后去德国？”导演说。

paras.en: Francis Lawrence has stayed in touch with the cast, but working together again in the world of The Hunger Games made for an especially meaningful reunion. “I think it was a Wednesday night when they arrived, and I got a text from Jen that she and Josh were having a beer in the hotel bar. I was coming back from set, so I joined, then Nina joined, and our cinematographer, the still photographer, the sound mixer… It’s the same group of people who have been making these movies for 16 years, so we had this great reunion of about 30 of us before costume fittings and all of that.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: No Conversations About More Stories … Yet
paras.zh: 尚无关于更多故事的对话……

paras.en: With two prequel novels and films now out, the question is always whether there are more stories to tell in Panem. The creative team admits they’re just as in the dark as everyone else.
paras.zh: 随着两部前传小说和电影的上映，人们始终关心的是，在帕南是否还有更多故事可以讲述。创作团队承认，他们和其他人一样一无所知。

paras.en: “She only really writes when she has something to say, so I hope she has something she wants to write about in this world, because I would miss it a lot,” Jacobson says.
paras.zh: “她只有在有话要说的时候才会真正动笔，所以我希望她在这个世界上还有想写的东西，因为我会非常想念她的作品。”Jacobson说。

paras.en: Fans have been quick to name the characters they’d love to follow in their early years, with Finnick (portrayed by Sam Claflin) and Johanna (Jena Malone) at the top of the list, along with the first Hunger Games. After Sunrise, Jacobson’s own fascination is Plutarch. “When I realized from this book that Plutarch has been playing a double agent for 25 years by the time you meet him in Catching Fire, that to me is pretty fascinating. How do you pull that off? How could you possibly live that close to such danger? And what compromises did you have to make? He is not a morally clean character at all, so I have a total fascination with him,” she says.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: If the prequels have proved anything, it’s to never say never, a lesson Jacobson says the team learned early. “When we finished the original trilogy of books, we really thought we were done. We’ve never tried to make a movie without a book of hers. We only make her books. We never tried to develop anything that wasn’t based on something she had given us as a book she was going to publish. So when we first got Ballad, all of a sudden it was, ‘Oh my god, we’re coming back to this world.'”
paras.zh: 如果说前传证明了什么，那就是永远不要说“永远不会”，Jacobson表示，这是团队很早就吸取的一个教训。“当我们写完最初的三部曲时，我们真的以为已经大功告成了。我们从未尝试过在没有她的小说的情况下拍摄电影。我们只改编她的书。我们从未尝试过改编任何不以她即将出版的书籍为基础的作品。所以，当我们第一次拿到《叙事曲》时，突然就觉得‘天哪，我们要回到这个世界了’。”

paras.en: “I was so wowed by the way she’s taken us on this journey, and by the amount of things that come together in this movie from all of the books and all of the movies. On the other hand, honestly, you could make this [Sunrise] the first book you’ve ever read, or the first movie you’ve seen. You could start here, make it your jumping-off point, and then go in any order you wanted. So there’s accessibility for everyone.”
paras.zh: “她带领我们踏上这段旅程的方式，以及这部电影中汇集了所有书籍和所有电影中的众多元素，都让我感到非常震撼。另一方面，说实话，您可以把这部《破晓》当作您读过的第一本书，或者看过的第一部电影。您可以从这里开始，把它当作您的起点，然后按照您想要的任何顺序往下看。所以这部电影对每个人来说都很容易理解。”

paras.en: As for future stories, Lawrence and Jacobson are hopeful but note only Collins will know the answer.
paras.zh: 至于未来的故事，劳伦斯和雅各布森都抱有希望，但他们也指出，只有柯林斯才知道答案。

paras.en: “I don’t know if ‘superstitious’ is the right word, but she really does not let on whether or not she’s writing,” Lawrence says of Collins. “If she gets an idea and works on it, she keeps quiet, then turns it in to her publisher, who she trusts immensely, and waits to hear that it’s a publishable book. Only then does she tell us she’s written something.”
paras.zh: “我不知道‘迷信’是不是合适的词，但她真的不会透露自己是否在写作。”劳伦斯谈到柯林斯时说道。“如果她有了灵感并开始创作，她会保持沉默，然后将作品交给她非常信任的出版商，并等待对方告知这是一本可以出版的书。只有到那时，她才会告诉我们她写了什么。”

paras.en: “I have not heard anything. Would I love her to write another book? Yes, I sure would, because I still love the world so much, and I still find there’s so much to learn,” Jacobson says. “Because she digs so deep in terms of both history and philosophy, I hope she still has so much more to say, and I hope she’ll decide to say it in Panem. But I don’t know. We haven’t gotten any winks or nods yet. I hope I get a wink and a nod, but I have gotten no winks, no nods so far.”
paras.zh: “我什么消息都没有听说过。我希望她再写一本书吗？当然希望，因为我仍然非常热爱这个世界，而且我仍然觉得还有很多东西要学。”雅各布森说。“由于她在历史和哲学方面都进行了深入的探索，我希望她还有很多话要说，也希望她能决定在《饥饿游戏》中说出来。但我不知道。我们还没有收到任何暗示。我希望我能得到一个暗示，但到目前为止，我还没有得到任何暗示。”

paras.en: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is now in theaters.
paras.zh: 《饥饿游戏：鸣禽与蛇之歌谣》现已上映。

articles.title: Creator Kennedy Eurich to Launch YouTube Series (Exclusive)
articles.author: Nicole Fell

paras.en: Creator Kennedy Eurich is launching a new digital series on YouTube, The Hollywood Reporter has learned.
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，创作者肯尼迪·尤里希 (Kennedy Eurich) 正在 YouTube 上推出一部新的数字剧集。

paras.en: The variety series, currently titled the Untitled Ken Eurich Project, is set to debut in early 2027 and will be distributed on YouTube and other social media platforms. The show will feature a mix of guests and hidden camera segments. The creator has secured independent financing to the tune of seven figures.
paras.zh: 该综艺系列目前名为“Untitled Ken Eurich Project”，计划于 2027 年初首播，并将在 YouTube 和其他社交媒体平台上发行。该节目将混合嘉宾和隐藏的摄像机片段。创作者已获得七位数的独立融资。

paras.en: Eurich, known to followers as Ken, has nearly 2 million followers on TikTok alone, with much of her content focusing on speaking directly to the audience content. She has a secondary account with over 800K followers on TikTok, with another half a million followers on Instagram.
paras.zh: Eurich（被粉丝称为 Ken）仅在 TikTok 上就有近 200 万粉丝，她的大部分内容都集中在直接与观众对话的内容。她的二级账户在 TikTok 上拥有超过 80 万粉丝，在 Instagram 上还有 50 万粉丝。

paras.en: Like many creators working today, she’s been no stranger to brand deals. She’s partnered with brands like Cetaphil, Redken, Celsius, Coach and Tory Burch and partnered on ads with DoorDash, Popeyes and Torchy’s Tacos. She’s also hosted and done content for Tory Burch’s SS27 runway show and the 2025 Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show.
paras.zh: 和当今许多创作者一样，她对品牌交易并不陌生。她与 Cetaphil、Redken、Celsius、Coach 和 Tory Burch 等品牌合作，并与 DoorDash、Popeyes 和 Torchy's Tacos 合作制作广告。她还主持并制作了 Tory Burch 的 SS27 时装秀和 2025 年维多利亚的秘密时装秀的内容。

paras.en: The creator will allocate a portion of the show’s revenue to animal welfare initiatives through the Dallas-based Camillo Foundation, a private 501(c)(3) grantmaking foundation, according to a release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，创作者将通过总部位于达拉斯的卡米洛基金会（一家私人 501(c)(3) 资助基金会）将该剧的部分收入分配给动物福利计划。

paras.en: Eurich is represented by CAA, OS Talent and Brecheen Feldman Breimer Silver and Thompson.
paras.zh: Eurich 由 CAA、OS Talent 以及 Brecheen Feldman Breimer Silver and Thompson 代理。

articles.title: Nvidia stock plunges 12%, rides longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

paras.en: The last time Wall Street was this down on Nvidia the chipmaker's flagship product was the GeForce graphics processor for high-end PC video games, and markets were reeling from the global financial crisis.
paras.zh: 上次华尔街对英伟达如此低迷时，这家芯片制造商的旗舰产品是用于高端 PC 视频游戏的 GeForce 图形处理器，当时市场正受到全球金融危机的影响。

paras.en: Nvidia shares fell 12% on Friday, sliding for a seventh straight day as investors grew increasingly concerned about life after co-founder Jensen Huang. The stock is poised to close lower for a seventh consecutive week, the longest such stretch since 2008.
paras.zh: 由于投资者越来越担心联合创始人黄仁勋去世后的生活，英伟达股价周五下跌 12%，连续第七天下跌。该股预计将连续第七周收低，这是自 2008 年以来持续时间最长的一次。

paras.en: Shares of Nvidia are down 44% over the period, pushing the company's market cap down by $2.5 trillion. The stock is now trading at around 9.3 times forward earnings, while Advanced Micro Devices is valued at 29 times profit for the next 12 months.
paras.zh: 英伟达股价同期下跌 44%，导致该公司市值缩水 2.5 万亿美元。该股目前的预期市盈率约为 9.3 倍，而 Advanced Micro Devices 未来 12 个月的市盈率为 29 倍。

paras.en: On Friday, Reuters reported that the Securities and Exchange Commission is exploring potential accounting issues at Nvidia, pushing the stock down further.
paras.zh: 周五，路透社报道称，美国证券交易委员会正在探讨英伟达潜在的会计问题，导致该股进一步下跌。

paras.en: Once the most valuable company, now, at a market cap of $3.1 trillion, Nvidia is fourth behind Apple and Microsoft and Alphabet.
paras.zh: Nvidia 曾经是最有价值的公司，现在市值达到 3.1 万亿美元，位居第四，仅次于苹果、微软和 Alphabet。

paras.en: Nvidia is reeling from the removal of Huang, who resigned on Nov. 12, after multiple reported affairs, including one with a Chinese businesswoman who was allegedly a spy.
paras.zh: 英伟达因黄先生被免职而感到不安。黄先生在多起婚外情报道后于 11 月 12 日辞职，其中包括与一名据称是间谍的中国女商人的婚外情。

paras.en: Harvey Jones, Nvidia's newly appointed board chair, said earlier this week that Huang had resigned after "disclosure of personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct, standards and cultural norms."
paras.zh: 英伟达新任命的董事会主席哈维·琼斯本周早些时候表示，黄仁勋在“披露了不符合公司行为准则、标准和文化规范的个人行为”后辞职。

paras.en: But the chipmaker's losing streak started before Nvidia was thrown into crisis as investors worried over the sustainability of the AI buildout, particularly after the midterm elections, and emerging competition in AI chips from Google and AMD.
paras.zh: 但这家芯片制造商的连跌始于英伟达陷入危机之前，因为投资者担心人工智能建设的可持续性，特别是在中期选举之后，以及来自谷歌和 AMD 的人工智能芯片的新兴竞争。

paras.en: Even a better-than-expected earnings report, which included an increase to fiscal 2028 guidance, didn't stem the selling. Interim CEO Colette Kress, the company's longtime CFO, projected revenue growth next fiscal year of 75%, and said that customers aren't going anywhere.
paras.zh: 即使是好于预期的盈利报告（其中包括提高 2028 财年指引）也未能阻止抛售。长期担任公司首席财务官、临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 预计下一财年的收入将增长 75%，并表示客户不会离开任何地方。

paras.en: On Tuesday's earnings call with analysts, Kress signed off by saying, "we've got this." In a company meeting the next day, executives told staff that it was moving its yearly review process, which can come with more stock, from March to December.
paras.zh: 在周二与分析师举行的财报电话会议上，克雷斯最后表示：“我们已经做到了。”在第二天的公司会议上，高管们告诉员工，公司正在将年度审查流程从 3 月推迟到 12 月，这可能会带来更多库存。

paras.en: For investors, one major question is whether Nvidia can continue to innovate and sustain its commanding lead in the AI chip market without its visionary leader. Almost the entire company now is built around the AI trade, a phenomenon that began taking hold just four years ago with the launch of OpenAI's ChatGPT.
paras.zh: 对于投资者来说，一个主要问题是，如果没有远见卓识的领导者，英伟达能否继续创新并维持其在人工智能芯片市场的领先地位。现在几乎整个公司都是围绕人工智能行业建立的，这种现象在四年前随着 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 的推出而开始流行。

paras.en: Before that, Nvidia's primary business was selling graphics cards used for video games. In mid-2008, the last time the stock was this deep into a weekly losing streak, Nvidia was generating less than $1 billion per quarter. Now it pulls in more than $1 billion per day. At the time, the entire market was in freefall due to the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.
paras.zh: 在此之前，英伟达的主要业务是销售用于视频游戏的显卡。 2008 年中期，上一次该股陷入每周如此严重的连续下跌时，英伟达每季度的营收还不到 10 亿美元。现在它每天的收入超过 10 亿美元。当时，由于大萧条以来最严重的金融危机，整个市场直线下跌。

articles.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off

paras.en: As stocks continue their tech-driven sell-off, prediction markets traders are seeing a bleaker outlook for the remainder of the year.
paras.zh: 随着科技股继续遭受科技驱动的抛售，预测市场交易员预计今年剩余时间的前景更加黯淡。

paras.en: On platform Kalshi, speculators place just 6% odds that the S&P 500 will cross 8,000 in 2026. On Oct. 13, those odds were as high as 72%.
paras.zh: 在 Kalshi 平台上，投机者认为标准普尔 500 指数将在 2026 年突破 8,000 点的可能性只有 6%。10 月 13 日，这一可能性高达 72%。

paras.en: Contracts ask traders if the S&P 500 will go above various levels in 2026, and they're resolved using data from S&P Dow Jones Indices.
paras.zh: 合约询问交易者标普 500 指数是否会在 2026 年突破不同水平，他们使用标普道琼斯指数的数据来解决。

paras.en: On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite turned negative for the year as investors continued to dump tech stocks, primarily those with exposure to the artificial intelligence build-out. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and the S&P 500 fell into correction territory, too.
paras.zh: 周五，纳斯达克综合指数今年转为负值，因为投资者继续抛售科技股，主要是那些与人工智能相关的股票。道琼斯工业平均指数和标准普尔 500 指数也陷入调整区间。

paras.en: The S&P 500 has slashed its year-to-date gain to just over 2%.
paras.zh: 标普500指数的年初至今涨幅已降至略高于2%。

paras.en: The Stock Trader's Almanac in a Thursday note broadly agreed that the hopes for a December rally are fading, with the caveat that a "Santa rally" could still appear at the end of the year.
paras.zh: 《股票交易者年鉴》在周四的一份报告中普遍认为，12 月股市上涨的希望正在减弱，但需要注意的是，年底仍可能出现“圣诞老人上涨”。

paras.en: "The market is under pressure and more downside can't be ruled out," the note said.
paras.zh: 报告称：“市场面临压力，不能排除进一步下行的可能性。”

paras.en: The Stock Trader's Almanac sees 2026 following the year-end pattern of 2018, when the Federal Reserve was in a tightening cycle in a midterm year. The Fed is widely expected to hike rates at its December meeting.
paras.zh: 《股票交易者年鉴》预计 2026 年将延续 2018 年的年终模式，当时美联储正处于中期紧缩周期。市场普遍预计美联储将在 12 月会议上加息。

paras.en: In that scenario, the Stock Trader's Almanac thinks more churn is to come. "The low is more likely in mid- to late December than this week."
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，股票交易者年鉴认为将会出现更多的波动。 “与本周相比，低点更有可能出现在 12 月中下旬。”

paras.en: Disclosure: CNBC and Kalshi have a commercial relationship that includes customer acquisition and a minority investment.
paras.zh: 披露：CNBC 和 Kalshi 之间存在商业关系，包括客户获取和少数股权投资。

articles.title: Take-Two shatters sales record as 'GTA VI' launches to massive fanfare

paras.en: Criminal duo Lucia and Jason's blitz through Vice City in "GTA VI" helped Take-Two Interactive, the publisher of the blockbuster game that is now a global cultural phenomenon, rake in nearly $4 billion in first-day sales.
paras.zh: 犯罪二人组露西娅和杰森在《GTA VI》中的罪恶都市闪电战帮助 Take-Two Interactive 发行了这款如今已成为全球文化现象的热门游戏，首日销售额就达到了近 40 亿美元。

paras.en: Take-Two Interactive, the parent company of GTA developer Rockstar Games, is not a household name despite its portfolio of massive hits, including the "Red Dead Redemption" franchise and the "NBA 2K" basketball series.
paras.zh: Take-Two Interactive 是 GTA 开发商 Rockstar Games 的母公司，尽管其产品组合非常热门，包括“Red Dead Redemption”系列和“NBA 2K”篮球系列，但它并不是一个家喻户晓的名字。

paras.en: The game also sold 32.5 million units in pre-release and garnered $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales, Rockstar Games said on Friday. That is nearly five times the roughly $800 million GTA V made on its first day in 2013. It was widely regarded as the best-selling videogame in the first 24 hours.
paras.zh: Rockstar Games 周五表示，该游戏在预发行时还售出 3250 万份，首日零售额达到 37.9 亿美元。这几乎是《GTA V》2013 年首日收入约 8 亿美元的五倍。它被广泛认为是上市后 24 小时内最畅销的视频游戏。

paras.en: Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimated that the company sold 24.5 million copies of GTA VI and $2.36 billion in pre-order revenue.
paras.zh: 分析公司 Sensor Tower 估计，该公司已售出 2450 万份《GTA VI》，预购收入达 23.6 亿美元。

paras.en: Take-Two had stayed tight-lipped about GTA VI demand since it opened for pre-orders in June, limiting commentary to saying demand has been "unprecedented" or "far exceeding expectations."
paras.zh: 自 6 月份开放预订以来，Take-Two 一直对 GTA VI 的需求守口如瓶，评论仅限于称需求“前所未有”或“远远超出预期”。

paras.en: "The title is so widely anticipated, consumers appear very, very excited, and all the press so far has been universally positive, but we still aren't ready to declare victory," CEO Strauss Zelnick said on Take-Two's earnings call earlier this month.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，Take-Two 的首席执行官施特劳斯·泽尔尼克 (Strauss Zelnick) 在 Take-Two 的财报电话会议上表示：“这款游戏受到了广泛的期待，消费者显得非常非常兴奋，迄今为止所有媒体都普遍持积极态度，但我们还没有准备好宣布胜利。”

paras.en: "We tend to avoid claiming success before it occurs," he had said.
paras.zh: “我们倾向于避免在成功发生之前就宣称成功，”他说。

paras.en: Take-Two has shelled out an estimated $1 billion or more in production costs for GTA VI, making it one of the most expensive entertainment projects.
paras.zh: Take-Two 为《GTA VI》花费了估计 10 亿美元或更多的制作成本，使其成为最昂贵的娱乐项目之一。

paras.en: Sensor Tower estimates that the game's promotional trailer, GTA VI "Extended Look", on Netflix in August helped drive a sixfold jump in pre-orders.
paras.zh: Sensor Tower 估计，8 月份在 Netflix 上发布的游戏宣传预告片 GTA VI“Extended Look”帮助推动预订量增长了六倍。

paras.en: In Miami, which Vice City is based on, the city's NBA team celebrated the release on Wednesday with a Vice City-themed match.
paras.zh: 在《罪恶都市》的所在地迈阿密，该市的 NBA 球队于周三举办了一场以《罪恶都市》为主题的比赛来庆祝该游戏的发布。

paras.en: Over the weekend, the company is hosting "GTA VI: The Festival" - a music show with a star-studded line-up that includes Grammy-winning rapper Cardi B, hip hop record producer Metro Boomin and rapper Travis Scott.
paras.zh: 周末，该公司将举办“GTA VI：音乐节”，这是一场众星云集的音乐节目，其中包括格莱美获奖说唱歌手 Cardi B、嘻哈唱片制作人 Metro Boomin 和说唱歌手 Travis Scott。

paras.en: Investors have been waiting to hear from Take-Two about its plans for a PC launch of GTA VI and an online version rollout. The online, multiplayer component of a videogame is crucial in turning the title into a recurring revenue engine.
paras.zh: 投资者一直在等待 Take-Two 透露其推出《GTA VI》的 PC 版和在线版的计划。视频游戏的在线多人游戏部分对于将游戏转变为经常性收入引擎至关重要。

paras.en: Some industry analysts are expecting the PC launch and online mode in 2027.
paras.zh: 一些行业分析师预计 PC 版和在线模式将在 2027 年推出。

paras.en: Brokerage TD Cowen named Take-Two one of its 'Best Ideas' for 2027, with its analyst Doug Creutz upbeat about the company's financial prospects when the game releases online.
paras.zh: 经纪公司 TD Cowen 将 Take-Two 评为 2027 年“最佳创意”之一，其分析师 Doug Creutz 对游戏在线发布后该公司的财务前景表示乐观。

paras.en: "The potential ceiling for GTA VI's long-term recurrent consumer spending performance is very high... 'when' and 'how big' the next GTA Online will be is the most important question for the stock, more so than GTA VI unit sales."
paras.zh: “《GTA VI》长期经常性消费支出表现的潜在上限非常高……对于该股来说，下一个《GTA Online》的‘何时’和‘规模’是最重要的问题，比《GTA VI》的单位销量更重要。”

articles.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to prove Riemann hypothesis, most famous problem in all of math

paras.en: Levent Alpöge, a mathematician and employee at artificial intelligence company Anthropic, claimed on Friday to have proven the most famous problem in all of mathematics using an LLM.
paras.zh: 人工智能公司 Anthropic 的数学家兼员工 Levent Alpöge 周五声称，他已经利用法学硕士证明了所有数学中最著名的问题。

paras.en: “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Alpöge wrote in a statement posted on his website.
paras.zh: “我相信我与克劳德合作，发现了黎曼猜想的证明，”阿尔波格在其网站上发布的一份声明中写道。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis was first proposed in 1859 by the mathematician Bernhard Riemann. It claims that the locations of the prime numbers along the number line, which appear random at first blush, are actually determined by an intricate, meaningful order.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想最早由数学家伯恩哈德·黎曼于 1859 年提出。它声称素数沿数轴的位置乍一看似乎是随机的，但实际上是由复杂的、有意义的顺序决定的。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The conjecture has since become the North Star for the entire field of number theory, and is the most famous open problem in math. It’s one of the few open problems on which the Clay Mathematics Institute has placed a million-dollar bounty. Progress toward solving the Riemann hypothesis was so rare that most top experts spent little of their time actually working on it, because there was no obvious path to proving Riemann’s guess. The first chink in the problem’s armor appeared in October, when one of the proofs in OpenAI’s massive dump of math results made significant progress on making sense of the primes.
paras.zh: 该猜想从此成为整个数论领域的北极星，并且是数学中最著名的开放问题。这是克莱数学研究所悬赏百万美元的少数几个开放问题之一。解决黎曼猜想的进展非常罕见，以至于大多数顶级专家很少花时间实际研究它，因为没有明显的途径来证明黎曼的猜测。这个问题的第一个漏洞出现在 10 月份，当时 OpenAI 大量数学结果中的一个证明在理解素数方面取得了重大进展。

paras.en: Now the long struggle appears over. Alpöge posted his Claude proof coded in the programming language Lean, which verifies the mathematical correctness of each argument. Issues can arise in Lean, but it shouldn’t take long for experts to verify whether the hypothesis is properly coded, and if the proof is correct.
paras.zh: 现在，漫长的斗争似乎结束了。 Alpöge 发布了用 Lean 编程语言编码的 Claude 证明，它验证了每个论点的数学正确性。精益中可能会出现问题，但专家很快就会验证假设是否正确编码以及证明是否正确。

paras.en: If that happens, it will cap off a year in which AI’s mathematical capabilities ascended from unreliable college student to a superhuman force, leaving no part of the discipline undisrupted. The announcement comes just a day after Anthropic's record-breaking debut on the stock market.
paras.zh: 如果这种情况发生，人工智能的数学能力将在这一年中从不可靠的大学生提升到超人的力量，学科的任何部分都将受到干扰。该公告是在 Anthropic 破纪录地上市后一天发布的。

paras.en: Alpöge says his proof confirms the “Generalized Riemann Hypothesis,” a gargantuan expansion on Riemann’s initial guess that undergirds the entire mathematical universe with untold hidden structure. There is no superlative strong enough for how this would transform mathematics, instantly unlocking a deluge of truths contingent upon the ambitious conjecture.
paras.zh: 阿尔波格说，他的证明证实了“广义黎曼假设”，这是对黎曼最初猜测的巨大扩展，用难以言喻的隐藏结构支撑着整个数学宇宙。对于这将如何改变数学，立即解开取决于雄心勃勃的猜想的大量真理，没有足够的最高级的说法。

paras.en: “If the proof is correct and understood, this completes a dictionary between different branches of math where the connections were only partial,” says Hector Pasten, a mathematician at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile. “Something like a Rosetta Stone.”
paras.zh: 智利天主教大学数学家赫克托·帕斯滕 (Hector Pasten) 表示：“如果证明正确且易于理解，这就完成了不同数学分支之间的字典，而这些分支之间的联系只是部分的。” “就像罗塞塔石碑一样。”

paras.en: The work could open whole new areas of research. "If true, even from a first high level scan of the summary of the proposed argument, it is very plausible to me that the new ideas in the proof will open up brand new avenues of thinking in number theory and have an immense impact beside the obviously extremely influential result in itself," says mathematician Carlo Pagano, a professor at Concordia University and a visiting researcher at Google DeepMind.
paras.zh: 这项工作可以开辟全新的研究领域。康考迪亚大学教授、谷歌 DeepMind 访问研究员、数学家卡洛·帕加诺 (Carlo Pagano) 表示：“如果这是真的，即使从对所提出的论证的摘要进行第一次高层次扫描来看，证明中的新想法将开辟数论中全新的思维途径，并且除了其本身具有明显极其影响力的结果之外，还会产生巨大的影响，这对我来说是非常合理的。”

paras.en: Alpöge’s statement is elegiac—recognizing the sense of grief many mathematicians are feeling—but also optimistic. “It is natural to feel that this is an end, in my case a loss of a principal guiding light,” he wrote, “but what I saw during the course of progress so amazed me that I believe it is one dawn across science of something far greater.”
paras.zh: 阿尔波格的声明是挽歌——承认许多数学家所感受到的悲伤——但也很乐观。他写道：“很自然地感觉这是一个终结，对我来说，失去了主要的指路明灯，但我在进步过程中所看到的一切让我如此惊讶，以至于我相信这是科学界的一个黎明，预示着更伟大的事情。”

paras.en: The Anthropic mathematician has been the subject of headlines since he tweeted a Claude-generated solution to the famous Jacobian conjecture in July, kicking off math’s unprecedented summer. He was central to September’s Navier-Stokes controversy involving OpenAI, when NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster implied that the company had stolen his and Alpöge’s work.
paras.zh: 自从七月在推特上发布了克劳德提出的著名雅可比猜想的解决方案以来，这位人择数学家一直成为头条新闻，拉开了数学史无前例的夏天的序幕。他是 9 月份涉及 OpenAI 的纳维-斯托克斯争议的核心人物，当时纽约大学数学家 Tristan Buckmaster 暗示该公司窃取了他和 Alpöge 的工作成果。

paras.en: The Riemann result, if correct, will echo far beyond mathematics. It doesn’t have any immediate real-world applications—it won’t upend global banking or make the internet run faster. But after a year of watching LLMs surpass one math benchmark after another, there is no more staggering achievement it could possibly reach. A machine may have just solved a problem that the smartest people on the planet all agreed they were nowhere close to figuring out. As MIT mathematician Andrew Sutherland once put it to me: “An AI that can prove the Riemann hypothesis is not one I’d want to meet. If that happens, mathematicians having jobs will be the least of our problems.”
paras.zh: 黎曼结果如果正确的话，其影响将远远超出数学范围。它没有任何直接的现实应用程序——它不会颠覆全球银行业或使互联网运行得更快。但经过一年的观察，法学硕士超越了一个又一个数学基准，它不可能达到更令人震惊的成就。机器可能刚刚解决了地球上最聪明的人都认为他们还远远没有解决的问题。正如麻省理工学院数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰（Andrew Sutherland）曾经对我说的那样：“我不想遇到能够证明黎曼假设的人工智能。如果发生这种情况，数学家的工作问题将是我们最不关心的问题。”

paras.en: “This is indeed an historic moment,” Sutherland told me today after he had independently compiled Alpöge’s result in Lean. “The world has changed… I know there will be a wide range of reactions in our community, but to me this is a human triumph, and a day for celebration.”
paras.zh: “这确实是一个历史性的时刻，”萨瑟兰今天在独立编译了 Alpöge 在精益方面的结果后告诉我。 “世界已经改变……我知道我们的社区会有各种各样的反应，但对我来说，这是人类的胜利，也是值得庆祝的一天。”

paras.en: It’s worth celebrating, Sutherland says, the human work behind the development of Lean and LLMs—and, for that matter, the millennia of mathematical achievements upon which today’s advance rests. But processing the earthshaking reality of what has occurred “is going to take some time.”
paras.zh: 萨瑟兰说，值得庆祝的是，精益和法学硕士发展背后的人类工作，以及今天的进步所依赖的数千年的数学成就。但处理已经发生的惊天动地的现实“需要一些时间”。

paras.en: “There is much work to be done to understand the mathematical details of the proof,” he says. “And I can’t wait to dig into them. But perhaps the single most important step in the proof was building a machine that can think.”
paras.zh: “要理解证明的数学细节，还有很多工作要做，”他说。 “我迫不及待地想深入研究它们。但也许证明中最重要的一步是建造一台能够思考的机器。”

paras.en: This is a breaking news story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 这是突发新闻报道，将会更新。

articles.title: AI just solved the ‘real’ Navier-Stokes problem

paras.en: It looks like Anthropic employee Levent Alpöge was not satisfied with one blockbuster math proof today. Right after Alpöge’s announcement of a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis—math’s most famed open problem—has come the news that he and New York University professor Tristan Buckmaster believe they have closed a controversial loophole in OpenAI’s September solution of another million-dollar problem.
paras.zh: 看来 Anthropic 员工 Levent Alpöge 对今天的一项重大数学证明并不满意。就在 Alpöge 宣布黎曼猜想（数学最著名的开放问题）的证明得到证明后，有消息称，他和纽约大学教授 Tristan Buckmaster 相信他们已经堵住了 OpenAI 9 月份解决另一个百万美元问题的一个有争议的漏洞。

paras.en: The Navier-Stokes equations, dating back to the early- to mid-19th century, model how fluids swirl and eddy. In September OpenAI proved that the equations “blow up,” meaning they occasionally claim that a fluid’s speed becomes infinite—something real fluids cannot do.
paras.zh: 纳维-斯托克斯方程可以追溯到 19 世纪早期到中期，它模拟了流体如何旋转和涡流。 In September OpenAI proved that the equations “blow up,” meaning they occasionally claim that a fluid’s speed becomes infinite—something real fluids cannot do.

paras.en: But while the September solution technically satisfied the conditions for the Clay Mathematics Institute’s $1-million prize, many experts were left unsatisfied with how it did so. OpenAI’s proof imagined an unrealistic, finely tuned force that “stirs” the liquid in just the right way to produce infinite velocity—an approach many consider a loophole in the wording of the problem.
paras.zh: 尽管 9 月份的解决方案在技术上满足了克莱数学研究所 100 万美元奖金的条件，但许多专家对其实现方式并不满意。 OpenAI 的证明设想了一种不切实际的、经过微调的力，以正确的方式“搅拌”液体以产生无限的速度——许多人认为这种方法是问题措辞中的漏洞。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The proof was also the subject of controversy because Buckmaster claimed it was a deliberate attempt on the part of OpenAI to scoop his and Alpöge’s progress on the problem. Buckmaster publicly aired his suspicions that the company even stole his user data in its mad race to beat him to the punch. (OpenAI denied allegations of foul play, and early reports suggest the company’s proof may have taken a different route to the solution than Buckmaster and Alpöge’s work.)
paras.zh: 该证明也引起了争议，因为巴克马斯特声称这是 OpenAI 故意企图抢占他和 Alpöge 在该问题上的进展。巴克马斯特公开表示怀疑，该公司甚至在疯狂的竞赛中窃取了他的用户数据，以抢先一步。 （OpenAI 否认了犯规行为的指控，早期的报告表明该公司的证明可能采取了与 Buckmaster 和 Alpöge 的工作不同的途径来解决问题。）

paras.en: Now the pair claims to have taken back the lead on the problem, closing the loophole OpenAI left open and providing the solution to Navier-Stokes that experts have long sought.
paras.zh: 现在，这对搭档声称已在这一问题上重新夺回领先地位，堵住了OpenAI留下的漏洞，并提供了专家们苦苦寻觅的纳维-斯托克斯方程解。

paras.en: On Mastodon at 8:37 A.M. EST this morning, Buckmaster posted a dense, artificial-intelligence-aided proof and noted that the write-up was unpolished because, “after last time,” he and Alpöge “couldn’t risk waiting” because of concerns over getting scooped. In the rush, the two also did not release the certificate of the result. In the report, they claimed it would be released soon.
paras.zh: 上午 8:37 在 Mastodon 上美国东部时间今天早上，巴克马斯特发布了一份密集的人工智能辅助证明，并指出该文章未经修饰，因为“在上次之后”，他和阿尔波格“不能冒险等待”，因为担心被抢先报道。仓促间，两人也没有公布成绩证明。他们在报告中声称很快就会发布。

articles.title: What the Riemann hypothesis proof really means about AI and the future

paras.en: In the latest “huge if true” news to come out of AI’s ongoing conquest of mathematics, earlier today American mathematician and Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge posted a claim on his personal website that is already reverberating around the globe.
paras.zh: 今天早些时候，美国数学家兼人类学家 Levent Alpöge 在他的个人网站上发布了人工智能不断征服数学的最新消息，该消息已经在全球引起反响。

paras.en: “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Alpöge wrote. He also included a Claude-generated proof written in Lean, a programming language used to confirm that the supporting math is logically consistent and correct; other mathematicians are racing to independently verify Alpöge’s work, with preliminary and informal responses already emerging that the proof is indeed correct.
paras.zh: “我相信我已经与克劳德合作，发现了黎曼猜想的证明，”阿尔波格写道。他还提供了克劳德用 Lean 编写的证明，Lean 是一种编程语言，用于确认支持的数学在逻辑上是一致且正确的；其他数学家正在竞相独立验证 Alpöge 的工作，初步和非正式的反应已经出现，证明证明确实是正确的。

paras.en: But what would this actually mean for the rest of us? Would proof of the Riemann hypothesis make our computers faster, our online transactions more or less secure or our digital lives fundamentally different? The answers are murkier than you might expect.
paras.zh: 但这对我们其他人来说实际上意味着什么呢？黎曼假设的证明会让我们的计算机变得更快，我们的在线交易或多或少安全，或者我们的数字生活从根本上不同吗？答案比你想象的更加模糊。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Proposed some 167 years ago by mathematician Bernhard Riemann, the Riemann hypothesis has been widely considered one of the greatest unsolved mysteries of math. It concerns the distribution of prime numbers (numbers divisible only by themselves and 1) and an unproven—apparently until today—assumption about the almost mystical layers of numerical order that underpin them. The question of its veracity is also one of seven “Millennium Prize Problems” posed in 2000 by the Clay Mathematics Institute—resolving it would net a $1-million prize.
paras.zh: 黎曼假设由数学家 Bernhard Riemann 于大约 167 年前提出，被广泛认为是数学中最大的未解之谜之一。它涉及素数（只能被自身和 1 整除的数字）的分布，以及一个未经证实的——显然直到今天——关于支撑它们的几乎神秘的数字顺序层的假设。其真实性问题也是克莱数学研究所 2000 年提出的七大“千年奖问题”之一——解决该问题将获得 100 万美元的奖金。

paras.en: But the biggest implications for a solution won’t be monetary. Alpöge’s proof is technically for the “generalized Riemann hypothesis,” or GRH, which is a bigger, broader and more powerful application of Riemann’s initial insight to a much wider class of mathematical functions related to the primes. Proving it true, as my colleague Joseph Howlett explains, would cascade through all of math, in a flash revealing that many of the elaborate interlocking assumptions built on its presumed bedrock veracity are, in fact, true. Algorithms used in arcane realms like computational number theory and the study of algebraic number fields could see immediate improvements. These gains could even, eventually, lead to potential benefits for practical applications, but such advances would be invisible to most people.
paras.zh: 但解决方案的最大影响并不是金钱方面的。从技术上讲，阿尔波格的证明是为了“广义黎曼假设”（GRH），它是黎曼最初洞察力对与素数相关的更广泛的数学函数的更大、更广泛和更强大的应用。正如我的同事约瑟夫·豪利特（Joseph Howlett）所解释的那样，证明这一点是正确的，将贯穿所有数学，瞬间揭示出许多建立在假定的基础准确性之上的精心设计的连锁假设实际上是正确的。用于计算数论和代数数域研究等神秘领域的算法可以立即得到改进。这些成果甚至可能最终为实际应用带来潜在的好处，但这种进步对大多数人来说是看不见的。

paras.en: Many have wondered how this could affect cryptography. Prime numbers are essential to RSA, a widely used public-key cryptographic scheme whose security depends on the difficulty of factoring enormous numbers into their original prime factors. Given this technology, you might think that proving GRH and being able to precisely map patterns of primes would threaten the security of online banking, encrypted communications and other digital infrastructure.
paras.zh: 许多人想知道这会如何影响密码学。素数对于 RSA 至关重要，RSA 是一种广泛使用的公钥加密方案，其安全性取决于将大量数字分解为其原始素数因子的难度。鉴于这项技术，您可能会认为证明 GRH 并能够精确映射素数模式将威胁到网上银行、加密通信和其他数字基础设施的安全。

paras.en: But it wouldn’t—not directly. Determining whether a number is prime—an obvious application of GRH—isn’t the same as finding which primes serve as factors for the gargantuanly unwieldy numbers underpinning RSA and other encryption systems. GRH would improve mathematicians’ understanding of the former but wouldn’t provide a known shortcut for the latter. So, for now, your encrypted financial transactions and online secrets are presumably safe from direct cracking via some GRH-derived method.
paras.zh: 但它不会——不会直接。确定一个数字是否是素数（GRH 的一个明显应用）与查找哪些素数充当支撑 RSA 和其他加密系统的庞大笨重数字的因子不同。 GRH 将提高数学家对前者的理解，但不会为后者提供已知的捷径。因此，目前，您的加密金融交易和在线机密可能不会通过某种 GRH 派生方法直接破解。

paras.en: In fact, the most consequential impacts of Alpöge’s claim (if verified) wouldn’t really concern prime numbers—or math—at all. Instead they would signal AI’s emerging capacity for profoundly superhuman scientific discoveries.
paras.zh: 事实上，阿尔波格的说法（如果得到证实）最重要的影响根本不会真正涉及素数或数学。相反，它们将标志着人工智能正在出现的超越人类科学发现的能力。

paras.en: For many experts, this milestone isn’t necessarily something to celebrate. As one prominent mathematician ominously told Howlett for a different story earlier this year, an AI that can prove the Riemann hypothesis would be something so powerful and potentially disruptive that he’d prefer to never meet it.
paras.zh: 对于许多专家来说，这个里程碑并不一定值得庆祝。正如今年早些时候一位著名数学家在另一则故事中不祥地告诉霍利特的那样，能够证明黎曼假设的人工智能将是一种非常强大且具有潜在破坏性的东西，以至于他宁愿永远不会遇到它。

paras.en: That’s because the problem, even in its nongeneralized form, is so ferociously complex that it’s resisted more than 150 years of effort to solve it by some of humanity’s best and brightest minds. “Proving” GRH doesn’t seem to be something that just takes more computation—novel techniques and ideas are probably required. So a large language model achieving it, even with considerable help and guidance from an expert such as Alpöge, would be the strongest evidence yet that the latest AI models can do much more than merely explain existing theorems or aid mathematicians in developing proofs. It would mean that they can, in fact, leverage the extant corpus of human thought to generate and rigorously establish genuinely new knowledge—in a manner that humans seemingly cannot.
paras.zh: 这是因为这个问题，即使是非一般化的形式，也非常复杂，以至于人类一些最优秀、最聪明的头脑花了 150 多年的时间才解决这个问题。 “证明”GRH 似乎并不只是需要更多的计算——可能需要新颖的技术和想法。因此，即使有像 Alpöge 这样的专家的大量帮助和指导，实现这一目标的大型语言模型也将成为迄今为止最有力的证据，证明最新的人工智能模型可以做的不仅仅是解释现有定理或帮助数学家开发证明。事实上，这意味着他们可以利用现有的人类思想库来生成并严格建立真正的新知识——以人类似乎无法做到的方式。

paras.en: The implications extend far beyond number theory. Mathematics underpins much of theoretical physics, engineering, computer science and other scientific disciplines, so an AI capable of proving GRH today could, tomorrow, help researchers tackle problems in those fields that might otherwise be beyond reach. This would be a new way of doing science, with AI systems moving from tools that assist in calculations and experiments to autonomous scientists capable of executing entire lines of theoretical investigation.
paras.zh: 其影响远远超出了数论。数学是理论物理、工程学、计算机科学和其他科学学科的基础，因此今天能够证明 GRH 的人工智能明天可以帮助研究人员解决这些领域中原本无法解决的问题。这将是一种新的科学研究方式，人工智能系统将从协助计算和实验的工具转变为能够执行整个理论研究的自主科学家。

paras.en: Whether humans could or would even understand the ultimate results of such potential AI-generated advances remains an open question.
paras.zh: 人类是否能够或什至会理解人工智能带来的这种潜在进步的最终结果仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: For ordinary people, then, today’s news isn’t really about prime numbers at all—or any sudden, wrenching shift in daily life. Instead it’s about a future, perhaps imminent, if not immediate, in which machines supersede the capacities of human beings for making fundamental intellectual discoveries.
paras.zh: 那么，对于普通人来说，今天的新闻根本不是关于质数的，也不是关于日常生活中任何突然的、痛苦的变化的。相反，它是关于一个未来，即使不是立即，也可能是迫在眉睫的，在这个未来中，机器将取代人类做出基本智力发现的能力。

articles.title: The Book Lover’s Gift Guide
articles.author: Science News Staff

paras.en: Science News staff devoured books of all kinds this year, on topics ranging from ecology and evolution to the human brain and mathematics. We covered it all — even a cookbook! These 10 titles rose to the top of our 2026 reading list and could make great gifts for the book lovers in your life. — Anna Mattson, Assistant Editor
paras.zh: 今年《科学新闻》的工作人员阅读了各种书籍，主题从生态学和进化论到人脑和数学。我们涵盖了这一切——甚至包括一本食谱！这 10 本书跻身我们 2026 年阅读清单的榜首，可以作为送给您生活中的图书爱好者的绝佳礼物。 — 安娜·马特森，助理编辑

paras.en: Big thinkers will love Huge Numbers, a fascinating look into the study of large numbers. “When I think of big numbers, I usually think of a 1 with a lot of zeroes tacked on the end. But the reality is much more complex than I ever imagined,” says senior physics writer Emily Conover. The book, among Conover’s favorites of the year, “provided me with a new appreciation of our number system and the creative ways mathematicians have expanded it to express ever-larger numbers,” she says. “Plus, contemplating unfathomably large figures makes my own concerns seem insignificant.”
paras.zh: 伟大的思想家一定会喜欢《巨数》，这是对大数研究的引人入胜的研究。 “当我想到大数字时，我通常会想到末尾有很多零的 1。但现实比我想象的要复杂得多，”资深物理作家 Emily Conover 说道。这本书是康诺弗今年最喜欢的书之一，“让我对我们的数字系统以及数学家扩展它以表达更大数字的创造性方式有了新的认识，”她说。 “此外，考虑到深不可测的大数字，我自己的担忧就显得微不足道了。”

paras.en: Staff writer Erin Garcia de Jesús’ favorite book of 2026, The Creatures’ Guide to Caring, will strike a chord with new parents. “Between sleepless nights and poopy diapers, there’s not much to laugh about in the early days of parenting. But I found plenty of humor (and plenty to be grossed out about) in The Creatures’ Guide to Caring,” Garcia de Jesús says. “It’s the perfect book to make anyone, parent or otherwise, feel better that we’re not the only animals struggling with our offspring.”
paras.zh: 专职作家艾琳·加西亚·德·赫苏斯 (Erin Garcia de Jesús) 2026 年最喜欢的书《生物关爱指南》将引起新父母的共鸣。 “在不眠之夜和大便尿布之间，在养育孩子的早期日子里，没有什么可笑的。但我在《生物护理指南》中发现了很多幽默（也有很多令人恶心的内容），”加西亚·德·赫苏斯说。 “这是一本完美的书，可以让任何人，无论是父母还是其他人，都感觉更好，因为我们不是唯一与我们的后代作斗争的动物。”

paras.en: Adventure seekers will lose themselves in the mesmerizing ecosystems at the heart of Bogland, biomedical sciences writer Aimee Cunningham’s favorite book of the year. Ecologist Merritt R. Turetsky immerses readers in these waterlogged landscapes that are often overlooked and underestimated. “I am firmly on team boglands after reading about the beauty and wonder of these ecosystems,” Cunningham says.
paras.zh: 寻求冒险的人将会迷失在博格兰中心迷人的生态系统中，博格兰是生物医学作家艾米·坎宁安 (Aimee Cunningham) 年度最喜欢的一本书。生态学家梅里特·R·图雷茨基 (Merritt R. Turetsky) 让读者沉浸在这些经常被忽视和低估的淹水景观中。 “在了解了这些生态系统的美丽和奇迹后，我坚定地支持沼泽地团队，”坎宁安说。

paras.en: Senior writer Meghan Rosen’s favorite book of 2026 is perfect for anyone interested in — or wary of — health and wellness culture. Morbid exposes the lack of science behind a lot of antiaging advice, such as eating like centenarians do and taking “antiaging” supplements. “Turns out, a lot of it is just plain bunk,” Rosen says. “Skeptical readers will enjoy Newman’s takedowns, which go down smoothly with a healthy dose of humor.”
paras.zh: 资深作家梅根·罗森 (Meghan Rosen) 在 2026 年最喜欢的一本书非常适合任何对健康和保健文化感兴趣或持谨慎态度的人。病态暴露了许多抗衰老建议背后缺乏科学依据，例如像百岁老人那样饮食和服用“抗衰老”补充剂。 “事实证明，其中很多只是纯粹的废话，”罗森说。 “持怀疑态度的读者会喜欢纽曼的驳斥，这些驳斥会带着健康的幽默顺利进行。”

paras.en: Senior neuroscience writer Laura Sanders’ pick for 2026 is a must-read for any expecting mother, new mother or person looking to learn about how pregnancy and motherhood impact the body. “A Mother’s Brain reads like a scientific love letter to moms, who all too often get overlooked,” she says. Author and neuroscientist Susana Carmona “covers the nascent field of matrescence in lively, vivid chapters. And along the way, she convincingly argues that the maternal brain is compelling, wondrous and still mysterious,” Sanders says.
paras.zh: 资深神经科学作家劳拉·桑德斯 (Laura Sanders) 为 2026 年所做的选择是任何准妈妈、新妈妈或想要了解怀孕和母性如何影响身体的人的必读之作。 “《母亲的大脑》读起来就像一封写给妈妈们的科学情书，她们经常被忽视，”她说。作家兼神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳“以生动活泼的章节讲述了女性发育的新兴领域。一路走来，她令人信服地认为，母性大脑是引人注目的、奇妙的，而且仍然是神秘的，”桑德斯说。

paras.en: Those who listen to true crime podcasts or wish spooky season lasted all year long will enjoy Exhumed, an exploration of the lore and medical practices leading up to the 19th century New England vampire panic. “Thanks to Mahnke’s gripping prose, I felt like I was in the middle of the action. It was hard to lay the book down,” assistant editor Anna Mattson wrote in her online review. Mattson notes that Exhumed, her favorite read of 2026, is littered with bizarre facts that would be perfect for invigorating dull conversations.
paras.zh: 那些收听真实犯罪播客或希望全年持续幽灵季节的人会喜欢《Exhumed》，该剧探索了导致 19 世纪新英格兰吸血鬼恐慌的传说和医疗实践。 “多亏了马恩克扣人心弦的散文，我感觉自己就身处其中。很难放下这本书，”助理编辑安娜·马特森在她的在线评论中写道。马特森指出，《挖掘》是她 2026 年最喜欢的读物，书中充满了离奇的事实，非常适合激发枯燥的对话。

paras.en: For the anthropologist in your life, try The Story of Stories — a deep dive into how technological upheavals have shaped storytelling throughout history. The author provides what Sanders describes as scattershot history lessons in her online review: “Ashton has a knack for pulling out memorable bits from historical records, scientific studies and other sources for readers.”
paras.zh: 对于您生活中的人类学家，请尝试《故事中的故事》——深入探讨技术变革如何塑造历史上的故事讲述。作者在她的在线评论中提供了桑德斯所描述的漫无目的的历史教训：“阿什顿有能力从历史记录、科学研究和其他来源中为读者提取令人难忘的片段。”

paras.en: Conover couldn’t pick just one favorite. For people who enjoy getting creative in the kitchen, she recommends Happy Snacking, Don’t Die! “This cookbook provides such a joyful how-to on foraging and eating wild plants,” Conover says. “It helped me see my plant neighbors in a whole new light. And I got to make some tasty treats to share with my family as well.”
paras.zh: 科诺弗无法仅选出最喜欢的一项。对于喜欢在厨房发挥创意的人，她推荐快乐零食，别死！ “这本食谱提供了如何寻找和食用野生植物的有趣方法，”科诺弗说。 “它帮助我以全新的视角看待我的植物邻居。而且我还必须制作一些美味佳肴与家人分享。”

paras.en: Tyrant Lizard Queen is the only work of fiction on our list. But it’s rooted in real science, and stars a Tyrannosaurus rex. Author Riley Black “offers an empathetic look at a real-life creature that experienced hunger and pain, much like the animals that surround us today,” says Science News Explores assistant editor Aaron Tremper, who chose the book as his favorite of 2026. “Black’s penchant for story makes for a thrilling read that fans of Jurassic Park and King Kong can get behind.”
paras.zh: 暴君蜥蜴女王是我们名单上唯一的小说作品。但它植根于真实的科学，主角是霸王龙。 《科学新闻探索》助理编辑亚伦·特伦珀 (Aaron Tremper) 表示，作者莱利·布莱克“对经历过饥饿和痛苦的现实生物进行了感同身受的观察，就像我们今天周围的动物一样。”他选择这本书作为自己 2026 年的最爱。“布莱克对故事的热爱使得这本惊心动魄的读物值得《侏罗纪公园》和《金刚》的粉丝们追捧。”

paras.en: And for those interested in bioethics, we suggest picking up Every Living Creature. Author and physician Joshua D. Mezrich offers a comprehensive look at the field of xenotransplantation, through the stories of courageous doctors and patients who helped make it possible. “At times, the story can feel like a whirlwind, whisking readers across decades and from lab to lab and surgery to surgery,” Rosen wrote in her online review. “But at its core, Every Living Creature is a book about hope.”
paras.zh: 对于那些对生物伦理​​学感兴趣的人，我们建议选择《每种生物》。作家兼医生约书亚·D·梅兹里奇 (Joshua D. Mezrich) 通过帮助异种移植成为可能的勇敢医生和患者的故事，全面介绍了异种移植领域。罗森在她的在线评论中写道：“有时，这个故事感觉就像一阵旋风，带读者穿越几十年，从一个实验室到另一个实验室，从一个手术到另一个手术。” “但从本质上讲，《每一个生物》都是一本关于希望的书。”

articles.title: An El Niño amped by climate change has California bracing for the worst
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: In parts of California, public officials are going door-to-door, warning residents to get ready. The state has strategically stockpiled sandbags, pumps and generators. Debris has been fished out to clear storm drains, seepage blankets shore up aging levees and dams, and wire mesh cages hold back precariously placed boulders.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州的部分地区，政府官员正在挨家挨户地警告居民做好准备。该州战略性地储备了沙袋、水泵和发电机。残骸被打捞出来以清理雨水沟，防渗毯支撑着老化的堤坝和水坝，铁丝网笼挡住了摇摇欲坠的巨石。

paras.en: What is expected to be the strongest El Niño on record is already pounding the state with giant waves. The fury of this year’s El Niño is being unleashed around the globe as well, from inundating Florida with floods to exacerbating drought in the Amazon. And much more is still to come, forecasts show, with the peak of the climate phenomenon expected to arrive between November 2026 and January 2027.
paras.zh: 预计有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象已经给该州带来巨浪。今年的厄尔尼诺现象也在全球范围内蔓延，佛罗里达州被洪水淹没，亚马逊地区干旱加剧。预测显示，还有更多的事情发生，气候现象的顶峰预计将在 2026 年 11 月至 2027 年 1 月之间到来。

paras.en: Californians know all too well the threat. El Niño has historically brought relentless rainfall to the state, flooding cities and triggering landslides.
paras.zh: 加州人非常清楚这一威胁。厄尔尼诺现象历来给该州带来了持续不断的降雨，淹没城市并引发山体滑坡。

paras.en: State officials learned a lot about preparedness and emergency water management from previous El Niños — particularly the strong event that spanned the winter of 1997–1998. But this year’s event is likely to be even more challenging, a “Super” El Niño superimposed on the backdrop of global climate change.
paras.zh: 州政府官员从之前的厄尔尼诺现象（尤其是 1997 年至 1998 年冬季的强烈厄尔尼诺现象）中学到了很多有关防备和紧急用水管理的知识。但今年的事件可能更具挑战性，在全球气候变化的背景下叠加了“超级”厄尔尼诺现象。

paras.en: Climate change has made water management in California more complicated than it was just 30 years ago — as it has elsewhere around the world, says environmental scientist Letitia Grenier, the director of water policy at the Public Policy Institute of California, a nonprofit, nonpartisan think tank based in San Francisco.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州公共政策研究所是一家位于旧金山的非营利性、无党派智库，环境科学家、水政策主任莱蒂蒂亚·格雷尼尔 (Letitia Grenier) 表示，气候变化使加利福尼亚州的水管理比 30 年前更加复杂，世界其他地方也是如此。

paras.en: In 1997, California’s overall climate was much drier; El Niño brought a big, long rainy season that spanned the state, Grenier says. But now, “it’s just so humid. The air is warmer, so it can hold more water.”
paras.zh: 1997年，加州整体气候更加干燥；格雷尼尔说，厄尔尼诺现象给全州带来了一场漫长而漫长的雨季。但现在，“太潮湿了。空气更温暖，所以可以容纳更多的水。”

paras.en: That waterlogged atmosphere means that even without El Niño, there’s been less of a distinct rainy season in California, and more rapid flip-flop between intense episodes of rain dumped on the ground followed by periods of heat and dryness. “It’s these strange, erratic patterns that we’ve never seen before,” she says. And the state is bracing for how the Super El Niño will clash with this new climate normal.
paras.zh: 这种浸水的气氛意味着，即使没有厄尔尼诺现象，加州也不会出现明显的雨季，并且在强降雨倾倒在地面上和随后的炎热和干燥时期之间的快速变化。 “这些奇怪、不稳定的模式是我们以前从未见过的，”她说。该州正在准备应对超级厄尔尼诺现象将如何与这种新的气候常态发生冲突。

paras.en: A climate event becomes a household name
paras.zh: 气候事件成为家喻户晓的名字

paras.en: 1997 was the year that the term “El Niño” shot to global fame. It was the most powerful El Niño in recorded history, and the first to be scientifically monitored in real time, continuously tracked by satellites and breathlessly reported on by news outlets. El Niño’s rise to household name status was even cemented in pop culture by an appearance on Saturday Night Live, in a classic sketch by comedian Chris Farley.
paras.zh: 1997年是“厄尔尼诺”一词蜚声全球的一年。这是有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，也是第一次受到科学实时监测、卫星持续跟踪和新闻媒体密切报道的厄尔尼诺现象。厄尔尼诺现象家喻户晓的地位甚至通过喜剧演员克里斯·法利在《周六夜现场》的经典小品中的出现而在流行文化中得到了巩固。

paras.en: But the event was no laughing matter. It caused global devastation during its brief reign. El Niño events form as westward-blowing trade winds over the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean weaken, allowing warm water to accumulate at the surface. Those waters can then release massive amounts of heat to the atmosphere, altering the position of the Pacific jet stream and helping to disrupt global weather patterns.
paras.zh: 但这件事可不是闹着玩的。它在其短暂的统治期间造成了全球性的破坏。厄尔尼诺现象是由于东部热带太平洋上空向西吹的信风减弱而形成的，使得温暖的海水在海面积聚。然后，这些水域会向大气释放大量热量，改变太平洋急流的位置，并有助于扰乱全球天气模式。

paras.en: In 1997–1998, global temperatures spiked by 1.5 degrees Celsius on average. Along with the torrential rains in California, the event brought brutal drought to Southeast Asia and deadly summer floods to central Europe and Peru. Record-breaking floods also hit East Africa, which in turn triggered a surge in mosquito-borne Rift Valley fever. The oceans were so warm that 16 percent of the world’s reefs died.
paras.zh: 1997年至1998年，全球气温平均上升1.5摄氏度。除了加利福尼亚州的暴雨之外，这一事件还给东南亚带来了严重的干旱，并给中欧和秘鲁带来了致命的夏季洪水。破纪录的洪水也袭击了东非，进而引发了蚊媒裂谷热的激增。海洋非常温暖，导致世界上 16% 的珊瑚礁死亡。

paras.en: In all, the El Niño–related weather extremes were linked to more than 22,000 fatalities around the world, including nearly 200 in the United States, and an estimated $5.7 trillion in global economic losses.
paras.zh: 总之，与厄尔尼诺现象相关的极端天气导致全球超过 22,000 人死亡，其中美国有近 200 人死亡，全球经济损失估计达 5.7 万亿美元。

paras.en: Not every El Niño is equally intense, or impacts weather in quite the same way. “There’s a lot of variability event to event,” says Washington, D.C.–based climate scientist Tom Di Liberto, of the nonprofit climate news organization Climate Central.
paras.zh: 并非每次厄尔尼诺现象都同样强烈，或者以完全相同的方式影响天气。 “事件与事件之间存在很多变化，”华盛顿特区非营利性气候新闻组织气候中心的气候科学家汤姆·迪·利伯托 (Tom Di Liberto) 说。

paras.en: But there is a general overall pattern to how El Niño tends to affect weather around the planet, Di Liberto says. For example, there tend to be more tropical cyclones in the Pacific Ocean, and fewer in the Atlantic — a pattern also observed in 2026.
paras.zh: 但迪·利伯托说，厄尔尼诺现象如何影响地球各地的天气有一个总体模式。例如，太平洋上的热带气旋往往较多，而大西洋上的热带气旋较少——2026 年也观察到了这种模式。

paras.en: El Niño also tends to flatten and accelerate the Pacific jet stream, shifting its flow southward, says Mike Anderson, California’s state climatologist for the Department of Water Resources, who is based in Sacramento. And that has historically meant that a conveyor belt of back-to-back moisture-loaded storms is set on a collision course with the U.S. West Coast.
paras.zh: 加州萨克拉门托水资源部气候学家迈克·安德森表示，厄尔尼诺现象还会使太平洋急流变平并加速，使其气流向南移动。从历史上看，这意味着连续的潮湿风暴传送带将与美国西海岸发生碰撞。

paras.en: The El Niño rapidly strengthened during the summer of 2026. As westerly trade winds weakened, warm waters accumulated in the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, raising both ocean temperatures and the sea level height (shown in this animation). Red and white colors indicate the highest sea level. Beginning in April and intensifying through November, the El Niño event generated Kelvin waves, massive swells that sweep eastward along the equator toward the Americas.
paras.zh: 2026 年夏季，厄尔尼诺现象迅速增强。随着西风信风减弱，东部热带太平洋积聚暖水，导致海洋温度和海平面高度升高（如动画所示）。红色和白色表示最高海平面。从 4 月开始，到 11 月，厄尔尼诺现象不断加剧，产生了开尔文波，即沿赤道向东席卷美洲的巨大海浪。

paras.en: The 1997–1998 El Niño revealed just how devastating that pattern could be in California.
paras.zh: 1997-1998 年的厄尔尼诺现象揭示了这种模式对加利福尼亚州的破坏力有多大。

paras.en: As much as 30 centimeters inundated parts of the state during the month of February 1998 alone. Storm winds and high surf pounded the coast, while rivers swelled and overtopped their banks. Flooding from the “Groundhog Day Storm” destroyed some 1,700 homes in Bay Area cities Palo Alto and Menlo Park. On February 6 near Rio Nido, about 100 kilometers from San Francisco, a forested hillside suddenly crumbled, sending a wall of mud rushing down the mountain. It destroyed about 30 homes.
paras.zh: 仅 1998 年 2 月，该州部分地区就被淹没了 30 厘米。暴风和巨浪冲击着海岸，河水上涨，淹没了河岸。 “土拨鼠日风暴”引发的洪水摧毁了湾区城市帕洛阿尔托和门洛帕克的约 1,700 所房屋。 2月6日，距离旧金山约100公里的里约尼多河附近，一片森林覆盖的山坡突然崩塌，一道泥墙从山上冲下。它摧毁了大约30所房屋。

paras.en: Landslides also threatened homes and lives in Southern California.
paras.zh: 山体滑坡还威胁到南加州的房屋和生命。

paras.en: On February 23, then 25-year-old Jenifer Segraves and her fiancé Glenn Flook were living in an apartment on Laguna Canyon Road, in the city of Laguna Beach. The heavy rains had saturated the neighborhood’s steep hillsides, making the terrain unstable.
paras.zh: 2月23日，当时25岁的詹妮弗·塞格雷夫斯和她的未婚夫格伦·弗洛克住在拉古纳海滩市拉古纳峡谷路的一套公寓里。大雨浸透了附近陡峭的山坡，使地形变得不稳定。

paras.en: “We lived up against a hill in the canyon, so there were stairs up to our apartment,” Segraves says now. “They became like a waterfall. I remember my fiancé carrying me up the stairs because there was so much water.” Segraves called her father, Gary Segraves, in a panic, asking for help. Then, the slope behind the building failed, the apartment flooded and she and Flook fled into the rushing mud.
paras.zh: “我们住在峡谷里的一座小山上，所以有楼梯通往我们的公寓，”塞格雷夫斯现在说。 “它们变得像瀑布一样。我记得我的未婚夫抱着我走上楼梯，因为水太多了。”塞格雷夫斯惊慌失措地打电话给她的父亲加里·塞格雷夫斯寻求帮助。然后，大楼后面的斜坡塌陷，公寓被淹，她和弗洛克逃进了汹涌的泥浆中。

paras.en: “We were strong enough to get out, but we were waist-high in mud,” Segraves said. “[My dad] almost drowned getting to us.” All three took shelter at a neighbor’s house, where they showered and hunkered down to wait out the rain.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯说：“我们的体力足够强大，可以出去，但我们陷在齐腰深的泥浆里。” “[我爸爸]来找我们时差点被淹死。”三人都在邻居家避难，在那里洗澡并蹲下来等待雨停。

paras.en: Around midnight on February 24, the second mudslide arrived.
paras.zh: 2月24日午夜左右，第二次泥石流来临。

paras.en: The neighbor’s “whole house went down,” Segraves says. She escaped through a second-floor window, but her fiancé fell through the floor and was knocked out. He didn’t make it out.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯说，邻居的“整个房子都倒塌了”。她从二楼的窗户逃了出来，但她的未婚夫却从地板上掉了下来，被撞晕了。他没有弄清楚。

paras.en: Gary Segraves, meanwhile, was swept down the hillside and landed in a pile of rubble against a rocky cliff. Battered and missing his glasses, he looked around and saw what looked like a doll.
paras.zh: 与此同时，加里·塞格雷夫斯被冲下山坡，落在岩石悬崖上的一堆瓦砾中。他的眼镜被打坏了，不见了，他环顾四周，看到了一个看起来像洋娃娃的东西。

paras.en: He reached for the little form — and discovered that it was a baby, very cold but alive. Somehow, the 9-month-old had survived being swept out of her crib from a nearby home. The little girl “wouldn’t have survived if he hadn’t picked her up,” Segraves says.
paras.zh: 他伸手去拿那个小东西——发现那是一个婴儿，很冷，但还活着。不知何故，这个9个月大的孩子从附近的婴儿床上被扫了出来，幸免于难。塞格雷夫斯说，如果他没有把这个小女孩抱起来，她就不会活下来。

paras.en: The havoc wreaked across California by the event 30 years ago cast a stark light on the desperate need to expand waterways, maintain infrastructure and coordinate emergency services, Grenier says. “An engineering system can only work as well as its capacity.”
paras.zh: 格雷尼尔说，30 年前的事件给加州造成了严重破坏，这清楚地表明了扩大水道、维护基础设施和协调紧急服务的迫切需要。 “工程系统只有发挥其能力才能发挥作用。”

paras.en: Much of the state’s infrastructure is deteriorating. An October 13 report by the California state auditor noted that the condition of dams and levees across the state “remains a high-risk issue,” with some 57 dams in the state in poor or unsatisfactory condition. “Poorly maintained dams and levees continue to pose a risk to public safety,” the report said.
paras.zh: 该州的大部分基础设施正在恶化。加州审计员 10 月 13 日的一份报告指出，全州水坝和堤坝的状况“仍然是一个高风险问题”，该州约有 57 座水坝状况不佳或不令人满意。报告称：“维护不善的水坝和堤坝继续对公共安全构成威胁。”

paras.en: California’s water management system was also originally designed specifically to simply shunt excess water away from residential areas, rather than try to capture the water or help it infiltrate into aquifers, Grenier says. But that system worked for a different climate, one that wasn’t so prone to “weather whiplash” — wild, sudden swings between extremely wet and extremely dry conditions.
paras.zh: 格雷尼尔说，加州的水管理系统最初也是专门设计的，只是为了将多余的水从住宅区分流出去，而不是试图捕获水或帮助其渗入含水层。但该系统适用于不同的气候，这种气候不太容易出现“天气波动”——极端潮湿和极端干燥条件之间剧烈、突然的波动。

paras.en: Alongside punishing, drenching back-to-back storms called atmospheric rivers, the state has also experienced frequent episodes of drought, including two recent severe events, one lasting from 2012 to 2016 and another from 2021 to 2025.
paras.zh: 除了被称为“大气河流”的连续降雨风暴外，该州还频繁发生干旱，包括最近发生的两起严重干旱，一次持续时间为 2012 年至 2016 年，另一次持续时间为 2021 年至 2025 年。

paras.en: Those years of drought, dwindling snow and pumping too much water from aquifers have dramatically depleted the state’s subsurface water stores. And the heavy rains don’t necessarily help; the torrents of water mostly run off across the surface instead of infiltrating soils to reach the underground aquifer.
paras.zh: 那些年的干旱、积雪减少以及从含水层抽取过多的水已经严重耗尽了该州的地下水储备。大雨不一定有帮助；水流大多从地表流走，而不是渗入土壤到达地下含水层。

paras.en: Such hydroclimate whiplash isn’t unique to California by any means. It’s a global problem, and it’s becoming more common. A small increase in air temperatures can give a big boost to the atmosphere’s capacity to hold water vapor, increasing that capacity by about 7 percent for every 1 degree C of temperature increase. All of that water vapor has contributed to an increase in extreme precipitation events around the globe since the mid-20th century.
paras.zh: 无论如何，这种水文气候冲击并不是加州独有的。这是一个全球性问题，而且变得越来越普遍。气温的小幅上升可以大大提高大气容纳水蒸气的能力，温度每升高 1 摄氏度，水蒸气的容纳能力就会增加约 7%。自20世纪中叶以来，所有这些水蒸气都导致了全球极端降水事件的增加。

paras.en: Precipitation is just half of the problem. Rising air temperatures also make the air “thirstier,” causing it to draw even more moisture out of vegetation, soil and surface bodies of water during drier periods — which makes the land more vulnerable to severe drought and wildfire.
paras.zh: 降水只是问题的一半。气温上升也会使空气“更加干燥”，导致在干旱时期从植被、土壤和地表水体中吸收更多水分，从而使土地更容易遭受严重干旱和野火的影响。

paras.en: It’s now clear that these hydrodynamic shifts have been increasing the frequency of weather whiplash events around the world over the last 75 years or so, scientists reported in 2025. And that whiplash is likely to increase as the world warms more.
paras.zh: 科学家在 2025 年报告称，现在很明显，在过去 75 年左右的时间里，这些水动力变化一直在增加世界各地天气鞭打事件的频率。而且，随着世界变暖，这种鞭打事件可能会增加。

paras.en: Months before reaching peak intensity, the 2026–2027 Super El Niño has begun making its presence known. The Amazon is suffering under intense heat and drought, priming the region for wildfires and pushing the forest closer to a worrisome possible fate: a transition from tropical forest to savanna grasslands. Fires have also begun blazing across Southeast Asia, while heavy rains began inundating the Horn of Africa in October. Arriving on the heels of severe drought, that one-two punch could devastate the region’s crops and pasturelands.
paras.zh: 在达到峰值强度的几个月前，2026-2027 年的超级厄尔尼诺现象已经开始为人所知。亚马逊地区正遭受酷热和干旱，导致该地区发生野火，并使森林更接近令人担忧的可能命运：从热带森林过渡到稀树草原。东南亚地区也开始发生大火，十月份大雨开始淹没非洲之角。严重干旱之后到来的一两击可能会摧毁该地区的农作物和牧场。

paras.en: In California, the first harbingers of the arrival of the Super El Niño appeared in early September. Heavy surf pounded the coastline. Regions from San Francisco to Los Angeles saw record high tides by late October that flooded city streets and battered coastlines and seawalls, even as the skies remained clear.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，超级厄尔尼诺现象的第一个预兆出现在九月初。猛烈的海浪冲击着海岸线。十月底，从旧金山到洛杉矶的地区出现了创纪录的高潮，尽管天空仍然晴朗，但洪水淹没了城市街道，摧毁了海岸线和海堤。

paras.en: The waves were amped up by an unfortunate trifecta: higher sea levels due to climate change; a lunar cycle that exerted its maximum pull on the tides; and an El Niño–linked phenomenon called Kelvin waves.
paras.zh: 不幸的三重影响加剧了海浪：气候变化导致海平面上升；对潮汐施加最大拉力的月球周期；以及一种与厄尔尼诺现象有关的现象，称为开尔文波。

paras.en: Kelvin waves are massive, slow-moving swells of warm ocean water, part of the complicated interplay between wind and water that produces the El Niño Southern Oscillation, the overall weather pattern that includes El Niño and counterpart La Niña events, says Josh Willis, an oceanographer at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳美国宇航局喷气推进实验室的海洋学家乔什·威利斯说，开尔文波是温暖海水中巨大、缓慢移动的波浪，是风和水之间复杂相互作用的一部分，产生了厄尔尼诺南方涛动，整体天气模式包括厄尔尼诺和对应的拉尼娜事件。

paras.en: As prevailing west-blowing winds weaken over the tropical eastern Pacific, Willis says, water normally pushed west by the winds instead sloshes back eastward. Kelvin waves have historically given a boost to sea levels along the U.S. West Coast of as much as 30 centimeters. This year, that impact could be larger, researchers reported September 30 in a preprint study posted on EarthArXiv.org. Computer model simulations suggest that the risk of the risk of extreme sea levels could be 10 times higher during this El Niño year than during previous events, for coastlines from Alaska all the way to Chile.
paras.zh: 威利斯说，随着热带东太平洋盛行的西吹风减弱，通常被风推向西面的海水反而会向东回流。历史上，开尔文波曾导致美国西海岸海平面上升多达 30 厘米。研究人员于 9 月 30 日在 EarthArXiv.org 上发布的预印本研究报告称，今年这种影响可能会更大。计算机模型模拟表明，从阿拉斯加一直到智利的海岸线，今年厄尔尼诺现象发生的极端海平面风险可能比以往事件高出十倍。

paras.en: Then, by late October, the Santa Ana winds arrived: Hot, dry gusts blowing down the mountains toward the coast, fanning wildfires in Southern California. The fires scarred the landscape, denuding it of vegetation, roots that helped stabilize and fortify the soil. Such loosened soil is more likely to become mobilized into a debris flow during heavy rains.
paras.zh: 然后，到了十月底，圣安娜风袭来：炎热、干燥的阵风从山上吹向海岸，助长了南加州的野火。大火烧毁了土地，剥夺了植被和有助于稳定和强化土壤的根系。在大雨期间，这种松散的土壤更有可能变成泥石流。

paras.en: Those rains are now on the way. By mid-November, researchers began tracking storms headed for California. The peak of El Niño is expected to arrive by late November or early December and persist through February or March.
paras.zh: 那些雨现在正在路上。到 11 月中旬，研究人员开始追踪前往加利福尼亚州的风暴。预计厄尔尼诺现象的高峰期将在11月底或12月初到来，并持续到2月或3月。

paras.en: Segraves, after surviving nearly 30 years ago, says she is aware that another El Niño is coming. But she hasn’t been following the news closely. She’s placed herself on a news diet since her ordeal. She refused to speak to media for years, or even read the coverage about her own story.
paras.zh: 塞格雷夫斯在近 30 年前幸存下来后说，她意识到另一场厄尔尼诺现象即将到来。但她并没有密切关注这一消息。自从经历了磨难之后，她就开始关注新闻。她多年来拒绝接受媒体采访，甚至拒绝阅读有关她自己故事的报道。

paras.en: “Everyone wanted to talk to me and I just wanted to be left alone,” she says. Staying away from the news “freed me from all that. It changed my view on life. I take each day as it comes.”
paras.zh: “每个人都想和我说话，而我只想一个人呆着，”她说。远离新闻“让我摆脱了这一切。它改变了我对生活的看法。我接受每一天。”

paras.en: But, she adds, one lesson has stayed with her. “I swore I would never live on a cliff again.”
paras.zh: 但是，她补充道，有一个教训让她铭记在心。 “我发誓我再也不会住在悬崖上了。”

articles.title: The libido drug women want is testosterone
articles.author: Jamie Ducharme

paras.en: These days, Jessica Yih spends a lot of time talking to women about testosterone. Interest is “coming from all directions,” says the University of California, Irvine Health urologist. A major source: women who hope testosterone can boost the female libido. Only about a decade ago, women looking for libido treatments had few medical options — even though women of all ages struggle with low sexual desire.
paras.zh: 这些天，Jessica Yih 花了很多时间与女性谈论睾丸激素。加州大学欧文分校健康中心的泌尿科医生表示，人们的兴趣“来自四面八方”。主要来源：希望睾丸激素能够增强女性性欲的女性。仅在大约十年前，寻求性欲治疗的女性几乎没有医疗选择——尽管所有年龄段的女性都在与性欲低下作斗争。

paras.en: Some non-hormonal treatments are now available, but the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has yet to approve a female testosterone product, despite years of research suggesting it can boost sexual function and desire among postmenopausal women. Female testosterone products are approved in countries including the United Kingdom and Australia.
paras.zh: 现在已经有了一些非激素治疗方法，但美国食品和药物管理局尚未批准女性睾酮产品，尽管多年的研究表明它可以增强绝经后女性的性功能和性欲。女性睾酮产品在英国和澳大利亚等国家获得批准。

paras.en: Not many studies have looked at testosterone’s effects on libido in premenopausal women, but preliminary data in that area are also promising, according to a 2026 research review in The Journal of Sexual Medicine that Yih coauthored. “I have seen it change people’s lives,” Yih says. The hormone seems to make the female brain more receptive to sexual stimuli; it also promotes physical effects that enhance sexual pleasure, such as increased blood flow to the genitals. Right now, American women interested in these potential benefits have to look for them off-label. But that may change. In September, the FDA held a public meeting on testosterone use among menopausal women, “with the goal of informing future research and potential drug development in this area,” says Kaveeta Vasisht, the FDA’s associate commissioner for women’s health.
paras.zh: 没有多少研究关注睾酮对绝经前女性性欲的影响，但根据 Yih 与人合着的《性医学杂志》2026 年的一篇研究评论，该领域的初步数据也很有希望。 “我看到它改变了人们的生活，”Yih 说。这种激素似乎能让女性大脑更容易接受性刺激。它还可以促进增强性快感的身体效果，例如增加生殖器的血流量。目前，对这些潜在益处感兴趣的美国女性必须在标签外寻找它们。但这可能会改变。今年 9 月，FDA 召开了一次关于更年期女性睾酮使用情况的公开会议，“目的是为该领域的未来研究和潜在药物开发提供信息”，FDA 女性健康副专员 Kaveeta Vasisht 表示。

paras.en: The hormone has a rocky regulatory past. In 2004, an FDA advisory panel unanimously voted against approving a testosterone patch for women, citing a lack of safety data. There are still outstanding questions on that front, Yih says—like how, if at all, long-term use affects risk of conditions such as breast cancer and heart disease. Then, in 2011, a pair of Phase III trials found that testosterone therapy didn’t significantly outperform a placebo — a benchmark the FDA looks for when deciding whether to approve a new drug. That’s not to say testosterone didn’t work, says Tami Rowen, an ob-gyn at UC San Francisco. Rather, it seemed that hype about the hormone was so strong that study participants went in with sky-high expectations, leading even the placebo group to report benefits. The treatment was a “victim of its own success,” Rowen says.
paras.zh: 这种激素的监管历史坎坷。 2004年，FDA顾问小组一致投票反对批准女性睾酮贴片，理由是缺乏安全数据。 Yih 表示，这方面仍然存在一些悬而未决的问题，比如长期使用会如何影响乳腺癌和心脏病等疾病的风险。然后，在 2011 年，两项 III 期试验发现，睾酮疗法并没有明显优于安慰剂——这是 FDA 在决定是否批准新药时寻找的基准。加州大学旧金山分校的妇产科医生塔米·罗文 (Tami Rowen) 表示，这并不是说睾酮不起作用。相反，似乎对这种激素的炒作是如此强烈，以至于研究参与者抱着极高的期望，甚至导致安慰剂组也报告了其好处。罗文说，这种治疗方法是“其自身成功的受害者”。

paras.en: Interest hasn’t let up, though. By one estimate, the U.S. female prescription rate for all uses rose from 0.4 out of every 1,000 women in 2018, to 1.8 out of every 1,000 women in 2026. That’s an increase of nearly 400 percent. With so much buzz, the potential placebo effect remains “the biggest problem with testosterone right now,” Rowen says.
paras.zh: 不过，人们的兴趣并没有减弱。据估计，美国女性所有用途的处方率从 2018 年的每 1,000 名女性 0.4 例上升到 2026 年的每 1,000 名女性 1.8 例。增幅接近 400%。罗文说，尽管如此，潜在的安慰剂效应仍然是“目前睾丸激素的最大问题”。

paras.en: Another outstanding question, Yih says, is whether using testosterone long-term increases the risk of breast cancer and heart disease.
paras.zh: Yih表示，另一个悬而未决的问题是，长期使用睾酮是否会增加患乳腺癌和心脏病的风险。

paras.en: Women seeking a libido boost do have non-hormonal options. In 2015, the FDA approved Addyi, the first treatment for low libido in premenopausal women. The drug seemingly raises levels of neurotransmitters that promote sexual desire while tamping down those that block it. A competitor, Vyleesi, hit shelves in 2019. Then, last year, regulators expanded Addyi’s use to postmenopausal women younger than 65. An international group of experts, including Rowen, issued recommendations for treating low female libido in 2025 in Sexual Medicine Reviews. Psychological therapies and Addyi are backed by the strongest evidence, the group found.
paras.zh: 寻求增强性欲的女性确实有非激素选择。 2015年，FDA批准了Addyi，这是第一个治疗绝经前女性性欲低下的药物。这种药物似乎会提高促进性欲的神经递质水平，同时抑制那些阻碍性欲的神经递质。其竞争对手 Vyleesi 于 2019 年上架。去年，监管机构将 Addyi 的使用范围扩大到 65 岁以下的绝经后女性。包括 Rowen 在内的国际专家组在《性医学评论》中于 2025 年发布了治疗女性性欲低下的建议。研究小组发现，心理疗法和 Addyi 得到了最有力的证据支持。

paras.en: Rowen currently has her eye on in-development products including Lybrido. The drug, which is slated to enter a Phase III clinical trial in Europe, aims to rev sex drive in the brain and enhance physical arousal. The demand for new treatments is there, Rowen says. “Women deserve better than placebo.”
paras.zh: Rowen 目前关注的是包括 Lybrido 在内的正在开发的产品。该药物计划在欧洲进入 III 期临床试验，旨在加速大脑的性欲并增强身体的兴奋。罗文说，对新疗法的需求是存在的。 “女性应该得到比安慰剂更好的东西。”

articles.title: CERN scientists finally find evidence of a particle decay so rare it took 40 years to detect

paras.en: CERN scientists finally find evidence of a particle decay so rare it took 40 years to detect
paras.zh: CERN 科学家终于找到了粒子衰变的证据，这种衰变非常罕见，以至于花了 40 年才发现

paras.en: - Scientists at CERN have found the first evidence of an incredibly rare particle decay after more than 40 years of searching, detecting a process expected to occur just once in every 10 billion beauty particles. The breakthrough could help physicists explore a mysterious microscopic realm where unknown particles and forces may be hiding.
paras.zh: - 经过 40 多年的探索，欧洲核子研究组织 (CERN) 的科学家们首次发现了极其罕见的粒子衰变的证据，并检测到预计每 100 亿个美丽粒子中只会发生一次的过程。这一突破可以帮助物理学家探索一个神秘的微观领域，那里可能隐藏着未知的粒子和力量。

paras.en: After more than four decades of searching, physicists at CERN have finally found evidence of an extraordinarily rare particle decay that occurs only about once in every 10 billion beauty particles. The long-awaited result could help scientists investigate a largely unexplored realm of physics where unknown particles and forces of nature may exist.
paras.zh: 经过四十多年的探索，欧洲核子研究中心的物理学家终于找到了一种极其罕见的粒子衰变的证据，这种衰变大约每 100 亿个美丽粒子中只发生一次。期待已久的结果可以帮助科学家研究一个很大程度上尚未探索的物理领域，其中可能存在未知的粒子和自然力。

paras.en: The evidence comes from the upgraded LHCb experiment at CERN's Large Hadron Collider (LHC). Researchers at the University of Manchester played important roles in the international effort, contributing to the advanced technology that made the measurement possible.
paras.zh: 证据来自 CERN 大型强子对撞机 (LHC) 升级后的 LHCb 实验。曼彻斯特大学的研究人员在国际努力中发挥了重要作用，为使测量成为可能的先进技术做出了贡献。

paras.en: The elusive process, called 'Bd to mu mu', has a statistical significance of 3.2 sigma. That is strong enough to qualify as evidence, but physicists will need additional data before they can officially declare a discovery. Even so, the finding marks a major milestone in a search that has lasted more than 40 years.
paras.zh: 这个难以捉摸的过程被称为“Bd to mu mu”，具有 3.2 sigma 的统计显着性。这足以作为证据，但物理学家在正式宣布一项发现之前还需要更多数据。即便如此，这一发现仍然标志着长达 40 多年的搜寻工作的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: It also creates new opportunities to test the Standard Model, the leading scientific framework describing fundamental particles and how they interact. By examining this exceptionally rare decay in greater detail, researchers hope to uncover subtle clues that could eventually point toward physics beyond our current understanding.
paras.zh: 它还创造了测试标准模型的新机会，标准模型是描述基本粒子及其相互作用的领先科学框架。通过更详细地研究这种极其罕见的衰变，研究人员希望发现微妙的线索，这些线索最终可能指向超出我们目前理解的物理学。

paras.en: Why Rare Particle Decays Could Reveal New Physics
paras.zh: 为什么罕见粒子衰变可以揭示新物理学

paras.en: The LHCb experiment specializes in studying particles that contain beauty quarks. These are heavier relatives of the up and down quarks that make up much of the ordinary matter around us.
paras.zh: LHCb 实验专门研究含有美夸克的粒子。这些是构成我们周围大部分普通物质的上夸克和下夸克的较重亲戚。

paras.en: When particles collide inside the Large Hadron Collider, enormous numbers of beauty quarks are produced. However, they survive for only about one and a half trillionths of a second before decaying into other particles.
paras.zh: 当粒子在大型强子对撞机内碰撞时，会产生大量的美夸克。然而，它们在衰变成其他粒子之前只能存活约万亿分之一秒。

paras.en: Scientists study these transformations because they may reveal the influence of particles that cannot be directly observed at the collider. By measuring exactly how frequently different decays occur, physicists can search for unexpected effects that might indicate previously unknown physics.
paras.zh: 科学家研究这些转变，因为它们可能揭示在对撞机上无法直接观察到的粒子的影响。通过准确测量不同衰变发生的频率，物理学家可以寻找意想不到的效应，这些效应可能表明以前未知的物理现象。

paras.en: Particularly rare decays offer an important advantage. Because they happen so infrequently, their rates can be especially sensitive to contributions from undiscovered particles. Even small differences between predicted and observed decay rates could provide valuable evidence of new forces or particles.
