paras.zh: 特别罕见的衰变提供了一个重要的优势。由于它们发生的频率非常低，因此它们的发生率对未被发现的粒子的贡献特别敏感。即使预测的衰变率与观测到的衰变率之间存在微小差异，也可以提供新的力或粒子的宝贵证据。

paras.en: The newly observed signal involves a process known as 'Bd to mu mu'. During this decay, a particle containing a beauty quark transforms into two muons, which are heavier relatives of electrons.
paras.zh: 新观察到的信号涉及一个称为“Bd to mu mu”的过程。在衰变过程中，含有美夸克的粒子转变为两个μ子，它们是电子的较重亲戚。

paras.en: According to theoretical predictions, this transformation should occur only about once in every 10 billion beauty particles. Despite decades of investigation, no individual experiment had previously produced convincing evidence that it occurs.
paras.zh: 根据理论预测，这种转变大约每 100 亿个美容粒子中只会发生一次。尽管进行了数十年的调查，但之前没有任何一项单独的实验能够提供令人信服的证据来证明这种情况的发生。

paras.en: The upgraded LHCb experiment has now achieved a statistical significance of 3.2 sigma. Although this meets the standard for reporting evidence, particle physicists generally require a significance of five sigma before announcing a confirmed discovery.
paras.zh: 升级后的 LHCb 实验现已达到 3.2 sigma 的统计显着性。尽管这符合报告证据的标准，但粒子物理学家在宣布已确认的发现之前通常需要 5 西格玛的显着性。

paras.en: Professor Chris Parkes, Head of the Department of Physics and Astronomy at the University of Manchester, led the international LHCb collaboration during construction of its major upgrade. He also oversaw the collaboration's approval of the new findings.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特大学物理与天文学系系主任 Chris Parkes 教授在大型强子对撞机重大升级建设过程中领导了国际合作。他还监督了合作对新发现的批准。

paras.en: He explained: "The upgraded LHCb was a major undertaking -- a fifteen-year design and construction project from a 1900 international member collaboration.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“升级后的大型强子对撞机是一项重大任务——由 1900 名国际成员合作完成的为期 15 年的设计和建造项目。

paras.en: "The UK made the largest national contribution to the project, pioneering new technologies that have made today's result possible, where we probe nature at a new scale. But this is also just the start; we are planning the construction of an experiment that will exploit the capabilities of the next-generation High Luminosity LHC, probing physics at an even smaller scale."
paras.zh: “英国为该项目做出了最大的国家贡献，开创了新技术，使今天的结果成为可能，我们以新的规模探索自然。但这也只是开始；我们正在计划建设一个实验，将利用下一代高光度大型强子对撞机的能力，在更小的规模上探索物理学。”

paras.en: Parkes, who became a Fellow of the Royal Society earlier this year in recognition of his contributions to LHCb, offered a memorable comparison to illustrate just how improbable the decay is.
paras.zh: 帕克斯今年早些时候成为英国皇家学会会员，以表彰他对大型强子对撞机的贡献，他提供了一个令人难忘的比较来说明这种衰变的可能性有多么小。

paras.en: "This decay is remarkably unlikely; the chance of it happening is roughly like going on a romantic date and, on your very first try, finding the one perfect match for you among everyone on Earth."
paras.zh: “这种衰退的可能性非常小；它发生的可能性大致就像去一次浪漫的约会，并且在你第一次尝试时，就在地球上的每个人中找到了一个最适合你的人。”

paras.en: Advanced LHC Detectors Make the Breakthrough Possible
paras.zh: 先进的大型强子对撞机探测器使突破成为可能

paras.en: Detecting such an uncommon event requires instruments capable of following the movements of particles with extraordinary accuracy.
paras.zh: 检测这种不寻常的事件需要能够以极高的精度跟踪粒子运动的仪器。

paras.en: One of the most important components of the upgraded LHCb experiment is a silicon pixel detector developed with major contributions from researchers in the United Kingdom. Called the Vertex Locator, it measures the paths of particles generated during collisions inside the collider.
paras.zh: 升级后的大型强子对撞机实验最重要的组成部分之一是由英国研究人员做出重大贡献开发的硅像素探测器。称为顶点定位器，它测量对撞机内碰撞期间生成的粒子的路径。

paras.en: Positioned just five millimeters from the LHC beams, the detector allows researchers to determine precisely where particles originate and where they subsequently decay.
paras.zh: 该探测器距离大型强子对撞机光束仅五毫米，使研究人员能够精确确定粒子的起源位置以及随后衰变的位置。

paras.en: Dr. Stefano De Capua, who directed detector construction at the University of Manchester, described the extensive collaboration behind the technology.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特大学探测器建设负责人 Stefano De Capua 博士描述了该技术背后的广泛合作。

paras.en: "We worked with nearly 90 UK companies to construct this detector and trained the next generation of scientists and engineers on the novel technologies we are using. It is these detectors that we use to locate where the beauty meson was produced and pinpoint where it decayed into two muons."
paras.zh: “我们与近 90 家英国公司合作建造了这款探测器，并就我们正在使用的新技术对下一代科学家和工程师进行了培训。我们正是利用这些探测器来定位美介子的产生位置，并精确定位它衰变成两个 μ 子的位置。”

paras.en: The wider LHCb upgrade also allows the experiment to gather information at up to five times its previous rate. This greater capacity, together with improvements in tracking technology, is helping physicists identify events that were previously too difficult to measure reliably.
paras.zh: 更广泛的大型强子对撞机升级还允许实验以高达之前五倍的速度收集信息。这种更大的容量，加上跟踪技术的改进，正在帮助物理学家识别以前难以可靠测量的事件。

paras.en: Beyond confirming an exceptionally rare particle process, the result could help scientists investigate what they call the 'Zeptoverse'.
paras.zh: 除了证实异常罕见的粒子过程之外，这一结果还可以帮助科学家研究他们所谓的“Zeptoverse”。

paras.en: This name refers to an almost unimaginably small scale, measured in zeptometers. A single zeptometer is just a billionth of a trillionth of a meter. Physicists suspect that effects from currently unknown particles and forces could become apparent when nature is examined at these extreme scales.
paras.zh: 这个名字指的是一个几乎难以想象的小尺度，以泽米为单位测量。一个 zeptometer 仅为一万亿分之一米的十亿分之一。物理学家怀疑，当在这些极端尺度上研究自然时，当前未知的粒子和力的影响可能会变得明显。

paras.en: For now, the new measurement agrees with the Standard Model. Researchers have not found evidence that the established theory is wrong, but increasingly precise measurements could reveal deviations that current experiments cannot yet detect.
paras.zh: 目前，新的测量结果与标准模型一致。研究人员尚未找到证据表明既定理论是错误的，但越来越精确的测量可能会揭示当前实验尚无法检测到的偏差。

paras.en: Such differences would be especially significant because they could indicate where the Standard Model stops providing a complete explanation of the physical world.
paras.zh: 这种差异尤其重要，因为它们可以表明标准模型在哪里停止提供对物理世界的完整解释。

paras.en: Professor Conor Fitzpatrick of the University of Manchester, who serves as Deputy Physics Coordinator of the international LHCb collaboration, emphasized the importance of finally obtaining the long-sought signal.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特大学教授康纳·菲茨帕特里克（Conor Fitzpatrick）担任国际大型强子对撞机合作物理副协调员，他强调了最终获得长期寻求的信号的重要性。

paras.en: "There has been a more than forty year long search by physicists worldwide to observe this decay. It is a golden channel to observe the effects of new physics from beyond our current knowledge.
paras.zh: “全世界的物理学家为了观察这种衰变进行了四十多年的探索。这是从我们现有知识之外观察新物理学影响的黄金通道。

paras.en: "The results from this experiment are expanding our understanding of nature at its most fundamental level. We are excited to have finally seen this elusive signal and looking forward to the future discoveries that will come from our data."
paras.zh: “这项实验的结果正在扩大我们对自然最基本层面的理解。我们很高兴终于看到了这个难以捉摸的信号，并期待着我们的数据未来的发现。”

paras.en: What Comes Next for CERN's Particle Research?
paras.zh: CERN 粒子研究的下一步是什么？

paras.en: The upgraded LHCb experiment is expected to continue gathering a substantially larger collection of measurements into the early 2030s. With more data, physicists should be able to determine the frequency of this rare decay with much greater precision.
paras.zh: 升级后的 LHCb 实验预计将在 2030 年代初继续收集更多的测量数据。有了更多的数据，物理学家应该能够更精确地确定这种罕见衰变的频率。

paras.en: Researchers are also planning another major upgrade that could increase data collection rates by an additional factor of ten. This would improve their ability to investigate extremely rare particle processes and search for the effects of unknown particles at even smaller distance scales.
paras.zh: 研究人员还计划进行另一项重大升级，将数据收集率提高十倍。这将提高他们研究极其罕见的粒子过程并在更小的距离尺度上寻找未知粒子影响的能力。

paras.en: Professor Brian Cox, a particle physicist at the University of Manchester who did not participate in the experiment, highlighted how improvements in scientific instruments can lead to important advances in understanding nature.
paras.zh: 曼彻斯特大学粒子物理学家布莱恩·考克斯教授没有参与该实验，他强调了科学仪器的改进如何能够为理解自然带来重要进展。

paras.en: "This is an important result and a beautiful example of how science advances. We upgrade our instruments, and we see nature in greater detail. Occasionally we see something we don't understand, and then progress is made. We cannot know whether this progress will be incremental or genuinely world-changing -- that's science! LHCb is a major scientific success."
paras.zh: “这是一个重要的结果，也是科学进步的一个绝佳范例。我们升级了仪器，从而能够更细致地观察自然。有时我们会看到一些我们不明白的东西，然后就取得了进步。我们无法知道这种进步是渐进的还是真正能改变世界的——这就是科学！LHCb是一项重大的科学成就。”

paras.en: The experiment receives funding from the Science and Technology Facilities Council, which operates within UK Research and Innovation. The UK LHCb collaboration brings together scientists from ten universities across the United Kingdom and the STFC Rutherford Appleton Laboratory.
paras.zh: 该实验获得了科学技术设施委员会的资助，该委员会在英国研究与创新部门内运作。英国 LHCb 合作汇集了来自英国十所大学和 STFC 卢瑟福阿普尔顿实验室的科学家。

paras.en: Although the newly detected decay has not yet revealed any unknown particles or forces, it gives physicists a powerful new way to search for them. After more than 40 years of effort, an extraordinarily elusive process is finally becoming accessible to detailed study, potentially bringing researchers closer to understanding some of the universe's deepest mysteries.
paras.zh: 尽管新检测到的衰变尚未揭示任何未知的粒子或力，但它为物理学家提供了一种强大的新方法来寻找它们。经过 40 多年的努力，一个极其难以捉摸的过程终于可以进行详细研究，有可能使研究人员更进一步了解宇宙中一些最深层的奥秘。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Manchester. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由曼彻斯特大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Scientists turn Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks for future lunar bases

paras.en: Scientists turn Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks for future lunar bases
paras.zh: 科学家将月球尘埃变成乐高积木，用于未来的月球基地

paras.en: - Scientists have found a way to 3D-print Moon dust into LEGO-like bricks, raising the possibility of building lunar bases using materials already on the Moon. The experimental blocks still need to be strengthened, but the technology could transform how humans construct permanent settlements beyond Earth.
paras.zh: - 科学家们找到了一种将月球尘埃 3D 打印成乐高积木的方法，提高了使用月球上现有材料建造月球基地的可能性。实验区块仍需要加强，但这项技术可以改变人类在地球之外建造永久定居点的方式。

paras.en: Building permanent bases on the Moon could become much easier if astronauts can turn the material beneath their feet into construction supplies. Researchers at the University of Arkansas have demonstrated a method for 3D printing simulated lunar dust into interlocking, LEGO-like bricks. The approach could eventually allow NASA to produce building materials directly on the Moon, reducing the amount of equipment and supplies that must be transported from Earth.
paras.zh: 如果宇航员能够将脚下的材料转化为建筑材料，那么在月球上建造永久基地可能会变得容易得多。阿肯色大学的研究人员展示了一种将模拟月球尘埃 3D 打印成互锁的乐高积木的方法。这种方法最终可能使美国宇航局能够直接在月球上生产建筑材料，从而减少必须从地球运输的设备和物资的数量。

paras.en: The study, published in NPJ Advanced Manufacturing, was led by first author Cole McCallum, who was an undergraduate student at the University of Arkansas when the research was conducted. Wan Shou, an assistant professor of mechanical engineering at the university, served as senior author.
paras.zh: 这项研究发表在《NPJ Advanced Manufacturing》上，由第一作者科尔·麦卡勒姆 (Cole McCallum) 领导，他在进行研究时还是阿肯色大学的本科生。该大学机械工程系助理教授万寿担任高级作者。

paras.en: To manufacture the bricks, the team used a 3D printing technique known as laser powder bed fusion. The process begins by spreading a thin layer of powder across a flat surface. A concentrated light source heats the particles until they fuse together, a process called sintering. The printing platform then moves downward, allowing another layer of powder to be added and fused. Repeating these steps gradually produces a solid three-dimensional object.
paras.zh: 为了制造这些砖块，该团队使用了一种称为激光粉末床熔融的 3D 打印技术。该过程首先在平坦的表面上铺上一层薄薄的粉末。集中光源加热颗粒直至它们融合在一起，这一过程称为烧结。然后打印平台向下移动，允许添加并熔化另一层粉末。重复这些步骤逐渐产生一个实体的三维物体。

paras.en: Unlike Earth's soil, lunar regolith contains no organic material. Instead, it is made up of sharp, irregular fragments produced by billions of years of impacts from asteroids, micrometeorites, and other debris striking the Moon. Because actual lunar material is difficult to obtain, the researchers worked with a commercially available substitute called Lunar Highlands Regolith Simulant (LHS-1). This material is designed to resemble samples brought back by NASA's Apollo missions during the 1960s and early 1970s.
paras.zh: 与地球土壤不同，月球风化层不含有机物质。相反，它是由小行星、微陨石和其他撞击月球的碎片数十亿年撞击产生的尖锐、不规则碎片组成。由于实际的月球材料很难获得，研究人员使用了一种名为月球高地风化层模拟物（LHS-1）的市售替代品。这种材料的设计类似于 20 世纪 60 年代和 1970 年代初 NASA 阿波罗任务带回的样本。

paras.en: Turning Moon Dust Into Bricks Without Added Binders
paras.zh: 在不添加粘合剂的情况下将月球尘埃变成砖块

paras.en: Previous efforts to 3D print structures from lunar regolith have relied on additional substances called binders to hold the particles together. Although these materials can improve the strength of printed objects, they introduce a major logistical challenge: the binders would need to be delivered from Earth.
paras.zh: 之前利用月球风化层 3D 打印结构的努力依赖于称为粘合剂的附加物质来将颗粒固定在一起。尽管这些材料可以提高印刷物体的强度，但它们带来了重大的后勤挑战：粘合剂需要从地球运送。

paras.en: The University of Arkansas team demonstrated a different approach. Using a relatively low-power light source, they became the first researchers to directly fuse simulated lunar regolith into interlocking, reconfigurable construction blocks without adding a binding agent. Instead of relying on another material to hold the structure together, the lunar dust particles bond directly with one another.
paras.zh: 阿肯色大学团队展示了一种不同的方法。他们使用相对低功率的光源，成为第一批在不添加粘合剂的情况下将模拟月球风化层直接融合成互锁、可重构结构块的研究人员。月球尘埃颗粒不是依靠另一种材料将结构固定在一起，而是直接相互结合。

paras.en: "There's nothing else it's binding to. The regolith powder is binding to itself," McCallum said.
paras.zh: “它没有与其他任何东西结合。风化层粉末与自身结合，”麦卡勒姆说。

paras.en: The team produced small bricks measuring a few centimeters across, including pieces shaped like crosses and the letter H. Their interlocking designs allow the blocks to fit together in a manner similar to LEGO pieces, potentially making it possible to assemble larger structures from individual printed components.
paras.zh: 该团队生产了几厘米宽的小积木，包括形状像十字架和字母 H 的积木。它们的联锁设计允许这些积木以类似于乐高积木的方式组装在一起，从而有可能从单个印刷组件组装更大的结构。

paras.en: However, the experimental bricks are not yet ready for demanding construction applications. Compared with objects manufactured using binders, the blocks made entirely from simulated lunar regolith contain more internal pores and have lower structural strength.
paras.zh: 然而，实验砖尚未准备好用于要求苛刻的建筑应用。与使用粘合剂制造的物体相比，完全由模拟月球风化层制成的块体内部孔隙较多，结构强度较低。

paras.en: "These structures we're making can be self-supported," McCallum said. "But I would be hesitant to say our process could be used for something that's supporting other loads at this moment yet."
paras.zh: “我们正在建造的这些结构可以自我支撑，”麦卡勒姆说。 “但我不太愿意说我们的流程目前可以用于支持其他负载的东西。”

paras.en: Challenges Ahead for Building Lunar Bases
paras.zh: 建造月球基地面临的挑战

paras.en: Before this technology can be considered for actual construction on the Moon, several important questions must be answered. Shou explained that scientists still need to determine how the printing process would behave under the Moon's low-gravity conditions and in a vacuum. The strength and durability of the finished bricks must also be improved to make them suitable for practical applications.
paras.zh: 在考虑将这项技术用于月球上的实际建设之前，必须回答几个重要问题。寿解释说，科学家仍然需要确定印刷过程在月球低重力条件和真空中的表现。成品砖的强度和耐用性还必须提高，以使其适合实际应用。

paras.en: Despite these challenges, Shou believes the technique could eventually offer an efficient way to manufacture construction components and larger structures for permanent lunar settlements. The ability to produce interlocking bricks from locally available material could be especially valuable as NASA works toward establishing a sustained human presence on the Moon.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些挑战，寿相信该技术最终可以提供一种有效的方法来制造永久月球定居点的建筑部件和大型结构。随着美国宇航局致力于在月球上建立人类的持续存在，利用当地可用的材料生产联锁砖的能力可能特别有价值。

paras.en: How Undergraduate Research Helped Drive the Discovery
paras.zh: 本科生研究如何帮助推动发现

paras.en: For McCallum, the lunar construction project was also an opportunity to gain valuable scientific experience early in his education. Originally from Little Rock, Arkansas, he joined Shou's laboratory during the early stages of his undergraduate studies at the University of Arkansas.
paras.zh: 对于麦卡勒姆来说，月球建设项目也是他在早期教育中获得宝贵科学经验的机会。他来自阿肯色州小石城，在阿肯色大学本科学习的早期阶段就加入了寿的实验室。

paras.en: "He had this really strong belief that undergrads should get involved more with research," McCallum said.
paras.zh: “他坚信本科生应该更多地参与研究，”麦卡勒姆说。

paras.en: McCallum graduated in May with two degrees, one in mechanical engineering and another in physics. His academic achievements also earned him a place in the inaugural class of Lafayette Fellows, a competitive program that selected just 30 students from a pool of more than 3,400 applicants. Established to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the United States, the fellowship supports students pursuing master's degrees in France.
paras.zh: 麦卡勒姆于五月毕业，获得两个学位，一个是机械工程学位，另一个是物理学学位。他的学术成就还为他赢得了首届拉斐特研究员的一席之地，这是一个竞争性项目，从 3,400 多名申请者中仅选拔了 30 名学生。该奖学金是为了纪念美国成立 250 周年而设立的，旨在支持学生在法国攻读硕士学位。

paras.en: He is now studying aerospace engineering in Toulouse at the Institut Supérieur de l'Aéronautique et de l'Espace, also known as ISAE-SUPAERO, which ranks among France's leading aerospace engineering institutions.
paras.zh: 他现在在图卢兹的 Institut Supérieur de l'Aéronautique et de l'Espace（也称为 ISAE-SUPAERO）学习航空航天工程，该学院是法国领先的航空航天工程机构之一。

paras.en: Although his current studies have taken him in a different direction from the additive manufacturing research he conducted in Shou's laboratory, McCallum credits the experience with helping him develop essential research skills. Working through experimental difficulties and learning from unsuccessful attempts gave him a valuable foundation for future scientific work.
paras.zh: 尽管他目前的研究方向与他在寿实验室进行的增材制造研究不同，但麦卡勒姆认为这段经历帮助他发展了基本的研究技能。克服实验困难并从失败的尝试中学习为他未来的科学工作奠定了宝贵的基础。

paras.en: "It helps you refine and overcome all the problems you have as a researcher. There are a lot of mistakes that I made the first time through," he said. "It was really nice to have a head start on everyone else and make those mistakes early."
paras.zh: “它可以帮助你完善和克服作为研究人员遇到的所有问题。我第一次犯了很多错误，”他说。 “能够领先于其他人并尽早犯这些错误真是太好了。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Arkansas. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由阿肯色大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Cole McCallum, Youwen Liang, Nahid Tushar, Ben Xu, Bo Zhao, Hao Zeng, Wan Shou. Additive manufacturing of lunar regolith for reconfigurable building blocks toward lunar habitation. npj Advanced Manufacturing, 2026; DOI: 10.1038/s44334-026-00111-x
paras.zh: - Cole McCallum、Youwen Liang、Nahid Tushar、Ben Xu、Bo Zhu、Hao Zeng、Wan Shou。月球风化层的增材制造，用于构建月球居住的可重构构件。 npj 先进制造，2026； DOI：10.1038/s44334-026-00111-x

articles.title: Keto diet slashes liver fat by 67% in just 4 months

paras.en: Keto diet slashes liver fat by 67% in just 4 months
paras.zh: 生酮饮食在短短 4 个月内将肝脏脂肪减少 67%

paras.en: - A new clinical trial found that the ketogenic diet dramatically outperformed Mediterranean and low-fat diets in reducing liver fat and improving metabolic health, even when participants lost similar amounts of weight. After just four to five months, about half of those following keto no longer met the criteria for prediabetes, while their liver fat dropped by an average of 67%.
paras.zh: - 一项新的临床试验发现，即使参与者减轻了相似的体重，生酮饮食在减少肝脏脂肪和改善代谢健康方面也显着优于地中海饮食和低脂饮食。仅仅四到五个月后，大约一半的生酮饮食者不再符合糖尿病前期的标准，而他们的肝脏脂肪平均下降了 67%。

paras.en: A ketogenic diet may offer significant health benefits beyond weight loss, according to a new clinical trial that compared three popular approaches to eating. Researchers found that people following a very low-carbohydrate, high-fat diet experienced substantially greater reductions in liver fat than those eating Mediterranean or low-fat diets, even though all three groups lost similar amounts of weight.
paras.zh: 一项比较三种流行饮食方法的新临床试验表明，生酮饮食除了减肥之外还可能带来显着的健康益处。研究人员发现，与那些吃地中海或低脂肪饮食的人相比，遵循极低碳水化合物、高脂肪饮食的人的肝脏脂肪减少幅度要大得多，尽管三组人的体重减轻程度相似。

paras.en: The results were especially striking for people with prediabetes. After just four to five months on a ketogenic (or "Keto") diet, approximately half of the participants no longer met the diagnostic criteria for the condition. The findings, published in the journal Cell Metabolism, suggest that the types of foods people eat can influence metabolic health in ways that extend beyond the number of pounds they lose.
paras.zh: 对于糖尿病前期患者来说，结果尤其引人注目。经过生酮（或“Keto”）饮食四到五个月后，大约一半的参与者不再符合该病症的诊断标准。发表在《细胞代谢》杂志上的研究结果表明，人们吃的食物类型对代谢健康的影响远远超出了他们减掉的体重。

paras.en: "We know weight loss can improve metabolic health in people who are obese," says Samuel Klein, the study's corresponding author at Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis, Missouri. "Our data suggest that if you have high liver fat content and prediabetes, reducing carbohydrate intake can have important therapeutic effects on metabolism beyond just weight loss alone."
paras.zh: “我们知道减肥可以改善肥胖者的代谢健康，”密苏里州圣路易斯华盛顿大学医学院的该研究通讯作者塞缪尔·克莱因说。 “我们的数据表明，如果您的肝脏脂肪含量较高且患有糖尿病前期，那么减少碳水化合物的摄入量不仅可以减轻体重，还可以对新陈代谢产生重要的治疗作用。”

paras.en: Comparing Keto, Mediterranean, and Low-Fat Diets
paras.zh: 比较生酮饮食、地中海饮食和低脂饮食

paras.en: An estimated 40% of American adults have obesity, a condition associated with increased risks of type 2 diabetes, fatty liver disease, and other health problems. Doctors frequently recommend dietary changes to help patients lose weight and improve their metabolic health, which refers to how effectively the body manages energy, blood sugar, and fats.
paras.zh: 据估计，40% 的美国成年人患有肥胖症，这种疾病与 2 型糖尿病、脂肪肝和其他健康问题的风险增加有关。医生经常建议改变饮食习惯，以帮助患者减肥并改善代谢健康，代谢健康指的是身体如何有效地管理能量、血糖和脂肪。

paras.en: Three commonly recommended approaches are low-carbohydrate diets, low-fat diets, and Mediterranean diets. Although each can support weight loss, researchers have been uncertain whether one offers additional metabolic advantages when the amount of weight lost is roughly the same.
paras.zh: 三种常用的推荐方法是低碳水化合物饮食、低脂肪饮食和地中海饮食。尽管每一种都可以支持减肥，但研究人员不确定当减重量大致相同时，其中一种是否能提供额外的代谢优势。

paras.en: These eating patterns differ substantially in their nutritional makeup. Low-carbohydrate approaches, including Atkins and ketogenic diets, restrict carbohydrate consumption, while low-fat diets may obtain as much as 70% of their calories from carbohydrates. The Mediterranean diet emphasizes plant foods such as vegetables, nuts, and olive oil, along with moderate amounts of fish and dairy. Ketogenic diets, meanwhile, can include considerable amounts of fat from animal products, including saturated fat.
paras.zh: 这些饮食模式的营养成分有很大不同。低碳水化合物方法，包括阿特金斯饮食和生酮饮食，限制碳水化合物的消耗，而低脂饮食可能从碳水化合物中获取多达 70% 的热量。地中海饮食强调植物性食物，如蔬菜、坚果和橄榄油，以及适量的鱼类和乳制品。与此同时，生酮饮食可能包含大量来自动物产品的脂肪，包括饱和脂肪。

paras.en: To compare their effects, Klein and his colleagues recruited 42 adults with obesity, prediabetes, and fatty liver disease. Prediabetes occurs when blood sugar levels rise above the normal range but have not yet reached the threshold for type 2 diabetes. Fatty liver disease involves excess fat accumulating inside liver cells, which can interfere with the body's ability to regulate metabolism.
paras.zh: 为了比较它们的效果，Klein 和他的同事招募了 42 名患有肥胖、糖尿病前期和脂肪肝疾病的成年人。当血糖水平高于正常范围但尚未达到 2 型糖尿病的阈值时，就会发生糖尿病前期。脂肪肝疾病涉及肝细胞内积聚过多的脂肪，这会干扰身体调节新陈代谢的能力。

paras.en: A Controlled Clinical Trial With Similar Weight Loss
paras.zh: 类似减肥效果的对照临床试验

paras.en: Participants were randomly assigned to follow one of three diets: ketogenic, Mediterranean, or a low-fat diet emphasizing plant-based foods. To ensure that participants followed their assigned eating plans, the research team supplied all their meals and arranged weekly consultations with a dietitian.
paras.zh: 参与者被随机分配遵循三种饮食之一：生酮饮食、地中海饮食或强调植物性食物的低脂饮食。为了确保参与者遵循指定的饮食计划，研究小组为他们提供了所有膳食，并安排每周与营养师进行咨询。

paras.en: The diets had sharply different proportions of carbohydrates and fat. In the ketogenic group, carbohydrates accounted for just 4% of daily calories, while fat supplied 73%. The Mediterranean group received 50% of its calories from carbohydrates and 35% from fat. The plant-forward group consumed 70% of its calories from carbohydrates and 15% from fat.
paras.zh: 这些饮食中碳水化合物和脂肪的比例截然不同。在生酮组中，碳水化合物仅占每日卡路里的 4%，而脂肪则占 73%。地中海地区的人 50% 的卡路里来自碳水化合物，35% 来自脂肪。素食组70%的热量来自碳水化合物，15%来自脂肪。

paras.en: Researchers adjusted calorie intake individually so that participants across all three groups lost approximately 10% of their starting body weight. Reaching this target took about four to five months.
paras.zh: 研究人员单独调整了卡路里摄入量，使所有三组的参与者都减掉了大约 10% 的起始体重。达到这个目标大约需要四到五个月的时间。

paras.en: By the end of the intervention, every group had experienced meaningful reductions in body fat and improvements in insulin sensitivity. Insulin is the hormone that helps move sugar from the bloodstream into cells, where it can be used for energy. Greater insulin sensitivity makes it easier for the body to maintain healthy blood sugar levels.
paras.zh: 干预结束时，每组的体脂均显着减少，胰岛素敏感性得到改善。胰岛素是一种激素，有助于将糖从血液转移到细胞中，并在细胞中用作能量。更高的胰岛素敏感性使身体更容易维持健康的血糖水平。

paras.en: However, the similarities between the groups largely ended there.
paras.zh: 然而，这些群体之间的相似之处基本上就到此为止了。

paras.en: The ketogenic diet produced the largest improvements in several important indicators of liver function and metabolic health.
paras.zh: 生酮饮食对肝功能和代谢健康的几个重要指标产生了最大的改善。

paras.en: Participants following keto experienced an average 67% reduction in liver fat, compared with a 45% reduction in both the Mediterranean and low-fat groups. Because the groups lost comparable amounts of weight, the difference suggests that carbohydrate restriction may influence liver fat through mechanisms beyond weight loss alone.
paras.zh: 服用生酮的参与者的肝脏脂肪平均减少了 67%，而地中海组和低脂组的肝脏脂肪减少了 45%。由于各组的体重减轻量相当，因此差异表明碳水化合物限制可能通过超越体重减轻的机制影响肝脏脂肪。

paras.en: To investigate these effects, the researchers collected blood samples repeatedly over a 24-hour period, allowing them to observe changes in hormones involved in energy metabolism.
paras.zh: 为了研究这些影响，研究人员在 24 小时内反复采集血液样本，以便观察与能量代谢相关的激素的变化。

paras.en: The ketogenic group showed the greatest increase in glucagon, a hormone that helps regulate the body's energy supply and promotes the reduction of fat stored in the liver. Participants on keto also experienced the largest decrease in insulin levels, another change that can help reduce liver fat accumulation.
paras.zh: 生酮组的胰高血糖素增加最多，胰高血糖素是一种有助于调节身体能量供应并促进减少肝脏中储存的脂肪的激素。服用酮类药物的参与者的胰岛素水平也出现了最大程度的下降，这是另一个有助于减少肝脏脂肪积累的变化。

paras.en: One result was particularly unexpected. Despite getting nearly three-quarters of their calories from fat, the keto participants did not show an increase in blood fat or cholesterol levels during the study.
paras.zh: 其中一项结果尤其出人意料。尽管近四分之三的卡路里来自脂肪，但酮类参与者在研究期间并未表现出血脂或胆固醇水平增加。

paras.en: "The most surprising finding was that participants in the ketogenic diet group didn't experience an increase in blood fat or cholesterol levels despite consuming the most fat," says Max Petersen, the study's first author at Washington University School of Medicine.
paras.zh: “最令人惊讶的发现是，生酮饮食组的参与者尽管消耗了最多的脂肪，但血脂或胆固醇水平并未增加，”该研究的第一作者、华盛顿大学医学院的马克斯·彼得森说。

paras.en: Half of Keto Participants No Longer Had Prediabetes
paras.zh: 一半的酮参与者不再患有糖尿病前期

paras.en: The benefits extended beyond liver fat. After the weight-loss intervention, approximately 50% of participants assigned to the ketogenic diet no longer met the criteria for prediabetes. By comparison, that milestone was reached by 29% of those on the Mediterranean diet and just 7% of those following the low-fat, plant-forward diet.
paras.zh: 其好处不仅仅限于肝脏脂肪。减肥干预后，大约 50% 接受生酮饮食的参与者不再符合糖尿病前期的标准。相比之下，采用地中海饮食的人中有 29% 达到了这一里程碑，而采用低脂植物性饮食的人中只有 7% 达到了这一里程碑。

paras.en: These differences are notable because prediabetes signals an elevated risk of developing type 2 diabetes. Bringing blood sugar levels below the prediabetes threshold is an important improvement, although it does not necessarily mean the condition has been permanently reversed.
paras.zh: 这些差异非常显着，因为糖尿病前期预示着患 2 型糖尿病的风险升高。将血糖水平降低到糖尿病前期阈值以下是一项重要的改善，尽管这并不一定意味着病情已得到永久逆转。

paras.en: The findings also highlight a potentially important distinction in weight management: losing weight and improving metabolic health are closely connected, but they are not necessarily the same thing. The composition of a diet may affect how the body handles blood sugar, stores fat, and responds to hormones, even when weight loss is similar.
paras.zh: 研究结果还强调了体重管理中一个潜在的重要区别：减肥和改善代谢健康密切相关，但它们不一定是同一件事。饮食的成分可能会影响身体处理血糖、储存脂肪和对激素的反应，即使减肥效果相似。

paras.en: Researchers emphasize the growing importance of understanding these effects as powerful new obesity treatments become more widely available. GLP-1 medications, which act on hormone pathways involved in appetite and blood sugar regulation, have transformed the treatment of obesity by helping many patients achieve substantial weight loss.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，随着强大的新肥胖治疗方法变得越来越广泛，了解这些影响变得越来越重要。 GLP-1 药物作用于与食欲和血糖调节有关的激素途径，通过帮助许多患者实现大幅减肥，改变了肥胖的治疗方法。

paras.en: "GLP-1-based medications have revolutionized the therapy of obesity. We now have a very effective pharmacotherapy for achieving significant weight loss," Petersen says. "But in addition, our study shows that the specific composition of the diet can give you added benefits."
paras.zh: “基于 GLP-1 的药物彻底改变了肥胖的治疗方法。我们现在拥有一种非常有效的药物疗法，可以显着减轻体重，”Petersen 说。 “但除此之外，我们的研究表明，饮食的特定成分可以给你带来额外的好处。”

paras.en: Although the trial was relatively small and lasted only four to five months, its carefully controlled design offers evidence that dietary composition can play an important role in metabolic health. Longer studies involving more participants will be needed to determine whether the benefits persist and how different diets compare over time.
paras.zh: 尽管该试验规模相对较小，仅持续四到五个月，但其精心控制的设计提供了证据，证明膳食成分可以在代谢健康中发挥重要作用。需要涉及更多参与者的更长期研究来确定这些益处是否持续存在以及不同饮食随着时间的推移如何进行比较。

paras.en: The research was supported by the National Institutes of Health and the Foundation for Barnes-Jewish Hospital.
paras.zh: 该研究得到了美国国立卫生研究院和巴恩斯犹太医院基金会的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by Cell Press. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由 Cell Press 提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Max C. Petersen, Gordon I. Smith, Sarah S. Farabi, Hector H. Palacios, Mahalakshmi Shankaran, Marc K. Hellerstein, Bruce W. Patterson, Samuel Klein. Effect of diet macronutrient content on the cardiometabolic response to weight loss: A randomized clinical trial. Cell Metabolism, 2026; 38 (10): 2006 DOI: 10.1016/j.cmet.2026.07.020
paras.zh: - Max C. Petersen、Gordon I. Smith、Sarah S. Farabi、Hector H. Palacios、Mahalakshmi Shankaran、Marc K. Hellerstein、Bruce W. Patterson、Samuel Klein。饮食常量营养素含量对减肥心脏代谢反应的影响：一项随机临床试验。细胞代谢，2026； 38（10）：2006 DOI：10.1016/j.cmet.2026.07.020

articles.title: There's an impostor hiding in the Hyades star cluster. Can you spot it?
articles.author: Jamie Carter

paras.en: For years I looked at Taurus and saw something perfectly sensible. There was the Hyades, the big V-shaped cluster that forms the bull's face, with Aldebaran, noticeably brighter and more orange than the other stars, the dominant star. Every diagram reinforced the arrangement — Aldebaran was the eye of Taurus, the Hyades made the face, and in my head they became one object.
paras.zh: 多年来，我观察金牛座，看到了一些非常明智的东西。毕宿星团是一个巨大的 V 形星团，形成了公牛的脸，而毕宿五则是占主导地位的恒星，比其他恒星明显更亮、更橙色。每一张图表都强化了这种安排——毕宿五是金牛座的眼睛，毕星团是金牛座的脸，在我的脑海里，它们成了一个物体。

paras.en: Then I discovered that Aldebaran has nothing to do with the Hyades. I remember going outside afterward and looking again, half expecting the deception to become obvious now that I knew. It didn't. Aldebaran still looked completely at home among the other stars. The difference is hidden in the one dimension our eyes judge poorly when we look into space — depth. Aldebaran is about 65 light-years away, while the Hyades are roughly 150 light-years distant. The orange eye of Taurus is a foreground star that happens to lie almost exactly along our line of sight toward the Hyades.
paras.zh: 后来我发现毕宿五和毕星团没有任何关系。我记得事后我走到外面，再次看了看，一半期待着现在我知道了，欺骗会变得显而易见。事实并非如此。毕宿五在其他恒星中看起来仍然完全自在。这种差异隐藏在我们观察太空时眼睛判断不佳的一个维度——深度。毕宿五距离我们大约 65 光年，而毕星团距离我们大约 150 光年。金牛座的橙色眼睛是一颗前景恒星，它恰好位于我们朝向毕宿星团的视线上。

paras.en: This fact exposes one of the most convincing tricks in stargazing. The night sky looks flat, and our brains are extremely willing to believe it. But it has incredible depth — and when you can see parts of the night sky in 3D, that's when you begin to appreciate that you're not looking at a flat map. Instead, you begin to see our cosmic neighborhood as it really is. By appreciating depth, you learn its geography.
paras.zh: 这一事实揭示了观星中最令人信服的技巧之一。夜空看起来是平坦的，我们的大脑极其愿意相信它。但它具有令人难以置信的深度 - 当您可以以 3D 形式看到部分夜空时，您就会开始意识到您看到的并不是一张平面地图。相反，你开始看到我们宇宙邻居的真实面目。通过欣赏深度，你可以了解它的地理。

paras.en: Taurus is now easy to find from the Northern Hemisphere during the evening. Once it's dark, look east for a small, tight knot of stars — the Pleiades open cluster (M45) — and then look nearby for a much larger V-shaped arrangement. That V is the Hyades, with unmistakably orange Aldebaran apparently sitting on one arm. Aldebaran's name is derived from the Arabic Al Dabarān, meaning "the follower," because it appears to trail the Pleiades across the night sky.
paras.zh: 现在晚上从北半球很容易找到金牛座。天黑后，向东寻找一小颗紧密的恒星——昴宿星团疏散星团（M45）——然后在附近寻找更大的 V 形排列。那个V是毕宿星团，一只手臂上显然有橙色的毕宿五。毕宿五的名字源自阿拉伯语 Al Dabarān，意思是“追随者”，因为它似乎尾随昴宿星团穿过夜空。

paras.en: The Hyades is a real physical group of stars — an open cluster — that formed together and moves through our galaxy together. About 153 light-years away, the Hyades is the nearest open star cluster to Earth. The name means "the rainmakers" because their rising and setting times in the ancient Greek sky coincided with wet weather. The stars in the Hyades are of a similar age — and mostly sun-like stars, or similar — so astronomers can tell that they all formed together in the same nebula.
paras.zh: 毕星团是一个真实的物理恒星群——一个疏散星团——它们一起形成并一起穿过我们的银河系。毕星团距离地球约 153 光年，是距离地球最近的疏散星团。这个名字的意思是“造雨者”，因为它们在古希腊天空中的升起和落下时间与潮湿的天气一致。毕宿星团中的恒星年龄相似，而且大多是类似太阳的恒星，因此天文学家可以看出它们都是在同一个星云中一起形成的。

paras.en: Orange-red star Aldebaran — the 14th-brightest star in the night sky — is the interloper, sitting less than half as far away from the sun. If you could somehow view the neighborhood from another part of the Milky Way, the familiar arrangement would fall apart. Aldebaran would no longer sit conveniently in the bull's face, and Taurus itself would stop looking like a bull.
paras.zh: 橙红色恒星毕宿五（Aldebaran）是夜空中第 14 颗最亮的恒星，它是闯入者，距离太阳不到一半。如果你能以某种方式从银河系的另一部分观察这个街区，熟悉的安排就会崩溃。毕宿五将不再方便地坐在公牛的脸上，金牛座本身也将不再看起来像公牛。

paras.en: Constellations aren't objects in the same sense as a planet or star cluster. They are merely views. Even stars that appear almost side by side can be separated by enormous distances. Our entire view of the night sky is a line-of-sight, 2D phenomenon — so all the patterns we see are an illusion.
paras.zh: 星座与行星或星团不是同一意义上的物体。它们只是观点。即使是几乎并排出现的恒星也可能相距很远。我们对夜空的整个看法是一种视线、二维现象——所以我们看到的所有图案都是幻觉。

paras.en: Start with Aldebaran and the Hyades using only unaided eyes. Once you have the V, remind yourself of the distances — roughly 65 light-years for Aldebaran and 150 for the Hyades — and try to imagine pulling the orange star toward you while leaving the rest of the cluster behind. Stargazing like this can be much harder than it sounds. Even the brains of seasoned stargazers are hard-wired to find patterns of stars — constellations — and they rarely practice seeing stars at their correct distances.
paras.zh: 从毕宿五和毕星团开始，只用肉眼观察。一旦你有了 V，提醒自己距离——毕宿五大约 65 光年，毕星团大约 150 光年——并尝试想象将橙色恒星拉向你，同时将星团的其余部分抛在后面。像这样的观星比听起来要困难得多。即使是经验丰富的观星者的大脑也天生能够找到星星的模式（星座），而且他们很少练习在正确的距离观察星星。

paras.en: Binoculars are worth using for the Hyades because the cluster is broad, so low magnification suits it well. Binoculars show many additional stars, but that's not really the point. Knowing what you're looking at changes the observation more than magnification does.
paras.zh: 毕星团值得使用双筒望远镜，因为星团很宽，所以低放大倍率非常适合它。双筒望远镜显示出许多额外的星星，但这并不是重点。知道你所看到的东西比放大倍数更能改变观察结果。

paras.en: Trying to see the night sky in 3D is best done one constellation at a time, but I warn you — it makes you suspicious of everything. Next time you trace Orion, Cassiopeia or Auriga, you'll always be wondering which stars are nearby and which merely look that way. Looking up the distances and working it all out for yourself is an eye-opening experience.
paras.zh: 试图以 3D 方式观看夜空最好一次只看一个星座，但我警告你——这会让你对一切产生怀疑。下次当你追踪猎户座、仙后座或御夫座时，你总会想知道哪些星星就在附近，哪些只是看起来那样。仰望远方并亲自解决这一切是一次令人大开眼界的体验。

paras.en: Learning constellations gets you around the sky in a basic sense, but learning how to dismantle them and put them back together is when you begin to know the night sky as it really is.
paras.zh: 学习星座可以让你在基本意义上游览天空，但学习如何拆解它们并将它们重新组合起来才是你开始了解夜空的真实面目。

paras.en: Stargazer's corner: November 20-26, 2026
paras.zh: 观星者专区：2026年11月20日至26日

paras.en: This week is dominated by the moon. The moon is already waxing when the week begins and becomes the full Beaver Moon — a supermoon — on Nov. 24. That means progressively brighter evening skies and increasingly poor conditions for faint galaxies, nebulae and other low-contrast objects. Aldebaran and the main Hyades stars are bright enough to see from suburban skies even under strong moonlight, so you don't need to travel somewhere properly dark. Swapping your view from 2D to 3D takes only a little imagination. However, that could change in the few nights around the full moon — particularly on Nov. 23, when the waxing gibbous moon will move close to the nearby Pleiades, its strong light reducing the number of faint stars visible around them. Use binoculars to find some of its hundreds of stars.
paras.zh: 本周主要是月亮。当这一周开始时，月亮已经开始上弦，并在 11 月 24 日成为海狸满月（超级月亮）。这意味着夜晚的天空会逐渐明亮，而微弱的星系、星云和其他低对比度天体的生存条件会越来越差。即使在强烈的月光下，毕宿五和毕星团的主星也足够明亮，从郊区的天空中也能看到，所以你不需要去一个完全黑暗的地方。只需一点点想象力即可将视图从 2D 切换到 3D。然而，这种情况可能会在满月前后的几个夜晚发生变化，尤其是在 11 月 23 日，当盈凸月将靠近附近的昴宿星团时，其强烈的光线会减少周围可见的微弱恒星的数量。使用双筒望远镜寻找其中数百颗恒星中的一些。

paras.en: I'm a stargazer and not at all interested in Greek mythology, but it sometimes helps to know a few basic ancient myths when finding constellations. A good example is the constellation Cepheus. It's named after a king of Ethiopia, husband of Cassiopeia and father of Andromeda — all three of which are close by in the northern sky right now. Look west after dark, away from the bright moon, to find the Summer Triangle — Vega, Deneb and Altair — which by now is sinking into the west. From Deneb, look north for a distinctive five-star pattern resembling a child's drawing of a house, with a square base and pointed roof. That's Cepheus. Its brightest star is Alderamin, about 49 light-years away, which marks one corner of the "house."
paras.zh: 我是一个观星者，对希腊神话一点也不感兴趣，但有时在寻找星座时了解一些基本的古代神话会有所帮助。仙王座就是一个很好的例子。它以埃塞俄比亚国王、卡西奥佩娅的丈夫和仙女座的父亲的名字命名——这三者现在都在北方天空附近。天黑后向西看，远离明亮的月亮，找到夏季大三角——织女星、天津四和牛郎星——它现在正在向西下沉。从天津四向北看，可以看到独特的五星级图案，类似于儿童画的房子，有方形底座和尖顶屋顶。那是仙王座。它最亮的恒星是奥德拉明星，距我们约 49 光年，它标志着“房子”的一个角落。

paras.en: Jamie is an experienced science and travel journalist, stargazer and eclipse chaser who writes about exploring the night sky, solar and lunar eclipses, the Northern Lights, moon-gazing, astro-travel, astronomy and space exploration. He is the editor of WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com, author of A Stargazing Program For Beginners, co-author of The Eclipse Effect, and a senior contributor at Forbes.
paras.zh: 杰米是一位经验丰富的科学和旅行记者、观星者和日食追踪者，撰写有关探索夜空、日食和月食、北极光、观月、天体旅行、天文学和太空探索的文章。他是 WhenIsTheNextEclipse.com 的编辑、《A Stargazing Program For Beginners》的作者、《The Eclipse Effect》的合著者以及《福布斯》的高级撰稿人。

articles.title: Trouble at Mars: NASA's Perseverance rover, Odyssey orbiter halt science work due to glitches
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: Two of NASA's Mars explorers are sidelined by glitches at the moment.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的两名火星探测器目前因故障而缺席。

paras.en: The Perseverance rover and Mars Odyssey orbiter have stood down from science work due to technical problems, NASA announced on Thursday (Nov. 19).
paras.zh: 美国宇航局周四（11 月 19 日）宣布，由于技术问题，毅力号火星车和火星奥德赛轨道器已停止科学研究工作。

paras.en: Perseverance has been sidelined by an antenna issue, and the venerable Odyssey is dealing with a balky reaction wheel. NASA hopes both can get back to work at Mars by the end of November.
paras.zh: 毅力号因天线问题而被搁置，而古老的奥德赛号则面临着不稳定的反应轮问题。 NASA 希望两人能够在 11 月底之前重返火星工作。

paras.en: Perseverance landed inside Mars' Jezero Crater in February 2021, tasked with assessing the area's potential to support past life and with collecting dozens of samples for future return to Earth.
paras.zh: 毅力号于 2021 年 2 月降落在火星的杰泽罗陨石坑内，任务是评估该地区支持过去生命的潜力，并收集数十个样本以供将来返回地球。

paras.en: It has done all this and more. The Perseverance team has determined that Jezero hosted a potentially habitable lake billions of years ago. And the car-sized rover has found a wealth of complex organic compounds in Martian rock, some of which might themselves be signs of life (though assessing this hypothesis fully will likely require bringing Perseverance's samples to Earth for analysis, scientists stress).
paras.zh: 它已经做到了这一切以及更多。毅力号团队已经确定，杰泽罗在数十亿年前存在一个可能适合居住的湖泊。汽车大小的漫游车在火星岩石中发现了大量复杂的有机化合物，其中一些本身可能就是生命的迹象（科学家强调，充分评估这一假设可能需要将毅力号的样本带到地球进行分析）。

paras.en: In addition, Perseverance just set a new distance record for off-Earth driving, rolling past the mark set by its smaller cousin, NASA's Opportunity rover (28.06 miles, or 45.16 kilometers).
paras.zh: 此外，毅力号刚刚创下了离地行驶的新距离记录，超过了其较小的表弟美国宇航局机遇号火星车创下的纪录（28.06 英里，或 45.16 公里）。

paras.en: Perseverance broke that record on Oct. 11. Just 19 days later, however, the mission team noticed a problem: The rover's main UHF downlink radio — which it uses to send information home to Earth, via data-relay satellites in Mars orbit — failed to send its usual "heartbeat" pings to the main computer.
paras.zh: 毅力号于 10 月 11 日打破了这一记录。然而，仅仅 19 天后，任务团队就注意到了一个问题：漫游车的主要 UHF 下行链路无线电（用于通过火星轨道上的数据中继卫星将信息发送到地球）未能将其通常的“心跳”ping 发送到主计算机。

paras.en: Perseverance detected this problem autonomously and reacted as it was programmed to do: The six-wheeled robot switched to its backup UHF radio and went into a protective "safe mode," shutting down all non-essential systems.
paras.zh: “毅力”自主检测到了这个问题，并按照编程的方式做出反应：六轮机器人切换到备用超高频无线电并进入保护性“安全模式”，关闭所有非必要系统。

paras.en: The rover team recovered Perseverance from safe mode but soon noticed another issue: "The backup UHF radio was transmitting at about half of its expected power output," NASA officials wrote in an update on Thursday.
paras.zh: 火星车团队将毅力号从安全模式恢复，但很快注意到另一个问题：“备用超高频无线电的发射功率约为其预期功率输出的一半，”美国宇航局官员在周四的更新中写道。

paras.en: Perseverance's handlers have stopped using that backup radio as well; the rover is now communicating with Earth directly (without the help of relay orbiters), sending signals to NASA's Deep Space Network dishes via its high-gain antenna.
paras.zh: 毅力号的操作人员也已停止使用备用无线电；火星车现在直接与地球通信（无需中继轨道飞行器的帮助），通过其高增益天线向美国宇航局的深空网络天线发送信号。

paras.en: This pathway features lower data rates, and the mission team wants to prioritize the delivery of diagnostic information. So they've paused Perseverance's science work, which includes observations by its various cameras.
paras.zh: 该路径的数据速率较低，任务团队希望优先考虑诊断信息的传递。因此，他们暂停了毅力号的科学工作，其中包括通过其各种相机进行的观察。

paras.en: The glitch may be disappointing to devoted Perseverance fans, many of whom have already noticed that the mission website hasn't uploaded any new raw images since Nov. 7. But there's no reason to panic, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 这一故障可能会让“毅力”号的忠实粉丝感到失望，他们中的许多人已经注意到该任务网站自 11 月 7 日以来就没有上传任何新的原始图像。但据 NASA 称，没有理由惊慌。

paras.en: "The rover is stable and communicating with the team," agency officials wrote in Thursday's update. "The team is hopeful the rover could return to science by the end of November, and NASA will provide further updates in the future as the team works the issue."
paras.zh: 该机构官员在周四的更新中写道：“火星车很稳定，并与团队保持联系。” “该团队希望火星车能够在 11 月底之前返回科学领域，而 NASA 将在该团队解决这个问题时提供进一步的更新。”

paras.en: Mars Odyssey loses another reaction wheel
paras.zh: 火星奥德赛失去了另一个反应轮

paras.en: Mars Odyssey's problem may be more serious: The orbiter, which arrived at the Red Planet in October 2001, recently lost the use of one of its reaction wheels.
paras.zh: 火星奥德赛号的问题可能更为严重：这架于 2001 年 10 月抵达这颗红色星球的轨道飞行器最近失去了其中一个反作用轮的功能。

paras.en: Odyssey has four reaction wheels, which help the spacecraft maintain its orientation in space. Three of the four must be functional to do this job, and Odyssey already lost a reaction wheel in 2013.
paras.zh: 奥德赛有四个反作用轮，帮助航天器在太空中保持方向。四个轮中的三个必须能够正常工作才能完成这项工作，奥德赛已经在 2013 年失去了一个反作用轮。

paras.en: This latest issue cropped up on Nov. 4, when Odyssey went into safe mode. The orbiter stayed in this protective posture until Nov. 6 while mission team members diagnosed and dealt with the problem. They've made some progress, at one point getting the faulty wheel to move when commanded.
paras.zh: 这个最新问题是在 11 月 4 日 Odyssey 进入安全模式时出现的。轨道飞行器一直保持这种保护姿势，直到 11 月 6 日任务团队成员诊断并处理该问题。他们已经取得了一些进展，一度让有故障的轮子在接到命令时移动。

paras.en: "Further testing is being conducted to confirm whether the wheel is recoverable," NASA officials wrote in Thursday's update.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局官员在周四的更新中写道：“正在进行进一步测试，以确认轮子是否可以回收。”

paras.en: Though it has been out of safe mode for two weeks, Odyssey still has not resumed its science or data-relay work. (The orbiter has long helped NASA's Mars surface craft send information home to Earth.)
paras.zh: 尽管奥德赛已经脱离安全模式两周了，但它仍然没有恢复其科学或数据中继工作。 （该轨道飞行器长期以来一直帮助美国宇航局的火星表面飞行器将信息发送回地球。）

paras.en: "The goal is for Odyssey to return to science and relay operations at the conclusion of these tests and analysis during the last week of November, and NASA will provide future updates on status and timeline as the team learns more," agency officials wrote in the update.
paras.zh: 该机构官员在更新中写道：“奥德赛的目标是在 11 月最后一周完成这些测试和分析后返回科学和中继操作，随着团队了解更多信息，NASA 将提供未来的状态和时间表更新。”

paras.en: If the reaction wheel, isn't recoverable, Odyssey's days are numbered. The mission team will have to orient the orbiter solely using its thrusters, and Odyssey has enough hydrazine fuel left to do this for a just month or two, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 如果反作用轮无法恢复，奥德赛的日子就屈指可数了。据美国宇航局称，任务团队必须仅使用推进器来确定轨道飞行器的方向，而奥德赛号还剩下足够的联氨燃料，足以维持一两个月的时间。

paras.en: Odyssey's mission has been a rousing success, no matter what happens with the reaction wheel. The orbiter has operated at Mars longer than any other spacecraft, and it has made a number of important scientific contributions.
paras.zh: 无论反作用轮发生什么情况，奥德赛的任务都取得了令人振奋的成功。该轨道飞行器在火星上运行的时间比任何其他航天器都长，并且做出了许多重要的科学贡献。

paras.en: "Odyssey created the first global maps detailing the composition of the Martian surface, which have become foundational for Mars geologists," NASA officials wrote in Thursday's update.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局官员在周四的更新中写道：“奥德赛绘制了第一张详细描述火星表面构成的全球地图，这已成为火星地质学家的基础。”

paras.en: "The orbiter's surface maps have also played a key role in identifying hazards at landing sites, spotting locations of scientific interest for landers and rovers to explore, and mapping water molecules in the top 3 feet (1 meter) of the surface, including buried ice that could be useful to the first astronauts on Mars."
paras.zh: “轨道飞行器的表面地图在识别着陆点的危险、发现着陆器和漫游车探索的科学兴趣位置以及绘制表面 3 英尺（1 米）的水分子地图方面也发挥了关键作用，其中包括可能对火星上第一批宇航员有用的埋冰。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: GTA hasn't gone to space (yet), but these sci-fi games can offer you a life of crime among the stars
articles.author: Fran Ruiz

paras.en: GTA 6 has only just come out, and it's already taken the world by storm and positioned itself as one of the greatest games of all time. Great news for gamers, but what about sci-fi fans?
paras.zh: GTA 6 刚刚问世，就已经风靡全球，并将自己定位为有史以来最伟大的游戏之一。对于游戏玩家来说是个好消息，但对于科幻迷来说呢？

paras.en: To this day, Rockstar Games sadly hasn't embraced sci-fi with any of its open-world games (save for those UFO Easter eggs). It doesn't seem likely they'll journey to the stars anytime soon — you can't really do cutting societal satire about space — but that doesn't mean there aren't GTA-adjacent sci-fi adventures set in outer space.
paras.zh: 遗憾的是，直到今天，Rockstar Games 还没有在其任何开放世界游戏中融入科幻元素（除了 UFO 复活节彩蛋）。他们似乎不太可能很快就踏上星际之旅——你不能真正对太空进行尖锐的社会讽刺——但这并不意味着没有与《侠盗猎车手》相邻的以外太空为背景的科幻冒险。

paras.en: The frustrating thing is that no one has exactly cracked that pitch yet. Non-linear games set in outer space tend to be either too ambitious, like No Man's Sky, or too focused on specific experiences like space combat, like Star Wars: Squadrons.
paras.zh: 令人沮丧的是，目前还没有人完全破解这一难题。以外太空为背景的非线性游戏往往要么过于雄心勃勃，如《无人深空》，要么过于专注于特定体验，如太空战斗，如《星球大战：中队》。

paras.en: The end result is a roster of great sandboxes that let us journey to different star systems, but no game that dares to explore a criminal fantasy with the level of depth and opportunities seen in the last few Rockstar games.
paras.zh: 最终的结果是一系列出色的沙盒，让我们可以前往不同的恒星系统，但没有任何一款游戏敢于探索犯罪幻想，其深度和机会与过去几款 Rockstar 游戏中的水平相同。

paras.en: With new hardware powering far more complex open-world games, it's only a matter of time before "GTA in space" is a real thing. For now, there are some space games that let us explore sci-fi worlds, roleplaying as criminals and outlaws amongst the stars.
paras.zh: 随着新硬件为更加复杂的开放世界游戏提供支持，“太空 GTA”成为现实只是时间问题。目前，有一些太空游戏可以让我们探索科幻世界，扮演星际中的罪犯和亡命之徒。

paras.en: Massive space RPGs like Starfield and The Outer Worlds 2 offer vast playgrounds you can explore and redefine through your actions. The lawful path is the obvious choice if you'd like to save the galaxy, but a life of crime awaits those who tire of the heroics.
paras.zh: 《Starfield》和《The Outer Worlds 2》等大型太空角色扮演游戏提供了广阔的游乐场，您可以通过自己的行动来探索和重新定义。如果你想拯救银河系，合法的道路是显而易见的选择，但那些厌倦了英雄事迹的人将面临犯罪的生活。

paras.en: Starfield even has a "new game plus" mechanic baked into the player's journey, encouraging experimentation and living different lives, so if you stick with the divisive space RPG, the criminal life is all but unavoidable. And in traditional Bethesda fashion, you're not rushed to the next "main" objective, so if you want to become the most dangerous space criminal in the Settled Systems, you'll be supported by the mechanics and systems. You can always get back to saving the galaxy when you feel like it.
paras.zh: 《Starfield》甚至在玩家的旅程中加入了“新游戏+”机制，鼓励尝试和过不同的生活，所以如果你坚持玩分裂的太空角色扮演游戏，犯罪生活几乎是不可避免的。在传统的贝塞斯达风格中，你不会急于下一个“主要”目标，所以如果你想成为定居系统中最危险的太空罪犯，你将得到机制和系统的支持。当你愿意的时候，你可以随时回去拯救银河系。

paras.en: The Outer Worlds 2 is another option if you want to become a star-surfing scoundrel. It might not be as absurdly expansive as Starfield, but Obsidian's whole deal has always been freedom of choice and roleplaying, so you can bet this humorous sequel also lets the protagonist become a bit of an a-hole. The main story already sets you in a collision course with corporate interests, too. Like in Mass Effect and other classic space RPGs, it's your choice to be either a goody-two-shoes or an edgy maniac, and I won't lie: the second option is usually more entertaining.
paras.zh: 如果你想成为一名星际冲浪恶棍，《天外世界 2》是另一个选择。它可能不像《Starfield》那样广阔得荒谬，但黑曜石的整个交易一直是选择和角色扮演的自由，所以你可以打赌这个幽默的续集也会让主角变得有点混蛋。主要故事也已经让你陷入了与企业利益的冲突之中。就像《质量效应》和其他经典太空角色扮演游戏一样，你可以选择成为双鞋高手或前卫狂人，我不会撒谎：第二种选择通常更有趣。

paras.en: Last but not least, there's a third game that also has enough going on to support a GTA-inspired fantasy in outer space: No Man's Sky.
paras.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，还有第三款游戏也有足够的内容来支持受 GTA 启发的外太空幻想：《无人深空》。

paras.en: It's grown so much over the years that its original space exploration premise has been buried by content like fully customizable space stations, actual cities and towns with alien NPCs, gigantic kaiju-like beasts, and... fishing. The endless free updates have pushed the roleplaying aspects deeper, as Hello Games are really making it the "forever" space game.
paras.zh: 多年来，它的发展如此之快，以至于其最初的太空探索前提已经被完全可定制的空间站、有外星 NPC 的真实城镇、巨大的怪兽般的野兽以及……钓鱼等内容所掩盖。无尽的免费更新将角色扮演方面推向了更深层次，因为 Hello Games 真正使其成为“永远的”太空游戏。

paras.en: Most importantly though, you can be the greatest bad guy the virtually infinite universe has ever seen, controlling entire pirate fleets and firing on (or stealing) every spaceship that you come across. It might be a bit aimless for some, but if you love a "forever game" then NMS can be the biggest space-set criminal sim ever created.
paras.zh: 但最重要的是，你可以成为几乎无限的宇宙中最伟大的坏人，控制整个海盗舰队并向你遇到的每艘宇宙飞船开火（或窃取）。对于某些人来说，这可能有点漫无目的，但如果您喜欢“永远的游戏”，那么 NMS 可能是有史以来最大的太空犯罪模拟游戏。

paras.en: Though it took too long, Star Wars has gotten really close to cracking the GTA formula in outer space in a shameless enough way. 2024's Star Wars Outlaws is, to this date, the closest thing we've received to a space-set sandbox directly inspired by Rockstar's huge hits.
paras.zh: 尽管花了太长时间，《星球大战》已经非常接近以一种足够无耻的方式破解外太空的 GTA 公式了。迄今为止，2024 年的《星球大战亡命之徒》是我们收到的最接近太空沙盒的作品，直接受到 Rockstar 热门作品的启发。

paras.en: By letting us fully embrace the Han Solo-like scoundrel fantasy, Massive Entertainment delivered a Star Wars adventure that's all about breaking the law. Hell, they even got a wanted system in there that has protagonist Kay Vess dodging stormtroopers and rival criminal factions like you would in Vice City.
paras.zh: 通过让我们充分拥抱汉·索罗式的恶棍幻想，Massive Entertainment 打造了一场充满违法行为的星球大战冒险之旅。天啊，他们甚至还有一个通缉系统，让主角凯维斯躲避冲锋队和敌对犯罪派系，就像在《罪恶都市》中一样。

paras.en: Star Wars Outlaws' take on GTA isn't just about the surface-level gameplay and open structure; it also understands much of its playful tone, moral ambiguity, and stressful rhythm. Jumping between several medium-sized maps set on different planets and spaceship sections breaks up the experience a little, so it never quite reaches that level of seamless immersion, but if anyone wants to do a focused version of GTA in space in the future, Massive's attempt is the one game that got at least halfway there.
paras.zh: 《星球大战：亡命之徒》对 GTA 的诠释不仅仅在于表面的游戏玩法和开放式结构；它也能理解其中的大部分俏皮语气、道德模糊性和紧张的节奏。在不同行星和宇宙飞船部分的几张中型地图之间跳转会稍微破坏体验，因此它永远无法完全达到那种无缝沉浸的水平，但如果有人想在未来制作一款专注于太空的 GTA 版本，Massive 的尝试是一款至少达到了一半的游戏。

paras.en: Before we go (and before you go back to playing GTA VI), we should remember the daring video games that, for a variety of reasons, never got to realize their visions of a crime-oriented space adventure.
paras.zh: 在我们离开之前（以及在你回去玩 GTA VI 之前），我们应该记住那些大胆的电子游戏，由于各种原因，它们从未实现过以犯罪为导向的太空冒险的愿景。

paras.en: Remember Star Wars 1313 and Visceral Games' cancelled project? It's hard not to spot some of their DNA surviving in Outlaws. As Luke Skywalker wisely said before noping out, "No one's ever really gone." Lucasfilm loves that, and it extends to binned video games too, thankfully. Even the elusive Battlefront 3 is back from the dead now.
paras.zh: 还记得《星球大战 1313》和 Visceral Games 取消的项目吗？很难不发现他们的一些 DNA 仍然存在于《亡命之徒》中。正如卢克·天行者在退出之前明智地说的那样：“没有人真正消失过。”卢卡斯影业喜欢这一点，值得庆幸的是，它也扩展到了视频游戏。就连难以捉摸的《前线 3》现在也起死回生了。

paras.en: Bethesda also had something going at some point with "Prey 2", a bounty hunter action game set in a cyberpunk-ish alien world. Before it was canned, it dropped one of the coolest CG game trailers ever made and teased us with a Blade Runner-esque future long before Cyberpunk hit our consoles.
paras.zh: Bethesda 也曾在《Prey 2》中做过一些事情，这是一款以赛博朋克风格的外星世界为背景的赏金猎人动作游戏。在它被封存之前，它发布了有史以来最酷的 CG 游戏预告片之一，并在《赛博朋克》登陆我们的游戏机之前就用《银翼杀手》式的未来来戏弄我们。

paras.en: Looking at the future, Ubisoft's Beyond Good & Evil 2 wants to go big and lawless, potentially iterating on Star Wars Outlaws and other open-world crime sims. But years after its announcement and many mind-boggling development news updates, it's hard to believe it's really ever coming out. Maybe the "Before GTA VI" meme can morph into "Before BG&E2" now that Rockstar's masterpiece is finally out.
paras.zh: 展望未来，育碧的《超越善恶 2》想要走向规模化、无法无天，可能会重复《星球大战：亡命之徒》和其他开放世界犯罪模拟游戏。但在它宣布和许多令人难以置信的开发新闻更新多年后，很难相信它真的会问世。既然 Rockstar 的杰作终于问世，也许“Before GTA VI”模因可以演变成“Before BG&E2”。

paras.en: Ultimately, Rockstar is Rockstar. A one-of-a-kind megastudio with nearly unlimited resources. Trying to replicate GTA does — either on Earth or among the stars — would be an Icarus flight in the making for most studios. There are some GTA-flavored space adventures out there, as we've shown, but we're still waiting for the one. Something that matches the deep storytelling, complete freedom, and cheeky tone of Rockstar's iconic series.
paras.zh: 归根结底，Rockstar 就是 Rockstar。一个独一无二的大型工作室，拥有几乎无限的资源。对于大多数工作室来说，尝试复制《侠盗猎车手》——无论是在地球上还是在星际间——都将是一场伊卡洛斯飞行。正如我们已经展示的那样，有一些 GTA 风格的太空冒险，但我们仍在等待。与 Rockstar 标志性系列的深刻故事讲述、完全自由和厚颜无耻的基调相匹配。

paras.en: OK, I gotta get out of here, I'm too hip for this, I gotta play GTA VI some more.
paras.zh: 好吧，我得离开这里了，我太时髦了，我得再玩一下 GTA VI。

paras.en: Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.
paras.zh: 杰森和露西娅一直都知道形势对他们不利。但当一次轻松的得分出现问题时，他们发现自己身处美国最阳光明媚的地方的最黑暗的一面，卷入了一场席卷莱奥尼达州的犯罪阴谋——如果他们想活下去，就被迫比以往更加依赖彼此。

paras.en: Fran Ruiz is our resident Star Wars guy. His hunger for movies and TV series is only matched by his love for video games. He got a BA of English Studies, focusing on English Literature, from the University of Malaga, in Spain, as well as a Master's Degree in English Studies, Multilingual and Intercultural Communication. On top of writing features and other longform articles for Space.com since 2021, he is a frequent collaborator of VG247 and other gaming sites. He also serves as associate editor over at Star Wars News Net and its sister site, Movie News Net.
paras.zh: 弗兰·鲁伊斯是我们的星球大战常驻人员。他对电影和电视剧的渴望与他对电子游戏的热爱相匹配。他在西班牙马拉加大学获得英语研究学士学位，主修英国文学，以及英语研究、多语言和跨文化交流硕士学位。自 2021 年以来，他除了为 Space.com 撰写专题文章和其他长篇文章外，还经常与 VG247 和其他游戏网站合作。他还担任星球大战新闻网及其姊妹网站电影新闻网的副编辑。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Origami and solar arrays
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode of SpaceMinds, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with Thomas Sinn, the CEO of Dcubed, at Space Tech Expo Europe. They discuss the company’s new $30 million funding round, how to think of solar arrays like origami and the increasing power demands required for space.
paras.zh: 在这一集中的 SpaceMinds 中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 在欧洲航天科技博览会上与 Dcubed 首席执行官 Thomas Sinn 进行了交谈。他们讨论了该公司新一轮 3000 万美元的融资、如何考虑折纸等太阳能电池阵列以及太空所需不断增长的电力需求。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Space Inventor
paras.zh: 本集由 Space Inventor 赞助

From modules to mini constellations of payload centric fleets, Space Inventor uniquely adapts to achieve your mission and to always – Make Space for Progress.
paras.zh: 丹麦制造的卫星是先锋与合作伙伴的终极结合——大胆的创新与绝对的可靠性相结合。从模块到以有效载荷为中心的微型星座，Space Inventor 能够以独特的方式实现您的使命，并始终——为进步创造空间。

paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。
