paras.zh: - 皮尤研究中心的一份新报告显示，到 2035 年，穆斯林将超过基督徒，成为全球最大的宗教群体。

paras.en: - The Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden announced that Fiona, the famous 9-year-old hippo, has died after failing to pass a hat she ingested more than a week ago. (via WVXU)
paras.zh: - 辛辛那提动物园和植物园宣布，著名的 9 岁河马菲奥娜 (Fiona) 因未能传递一周多前吞下的帽子而死亡。 （通过WVXU）

paras.en: - Mayor Zohran Mamdani signed a bill yesterday banning New York City's 160-year-old horse-drawn carriage industry. Animal rights activists have fought for decades to end the practice. (via Gothamist)
paras.zh: - 市长 Zohran Mamdani 昨天签署了一项法案，禁止纽约市拥有 160 年历史的马车行业。动物权利活动人士几十年来一直在为结束这种做法而奋斗。 （来自哥谭主义者）

articles.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers little results
articles.author: Franco Ordoñez

paras.en: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers little results
paras.zh: 特朗普大肆宣扬与习近平和普京的会面，但收效甚微

paras.en: President Trump touted his recent trip to Asia where he met with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin during a White House press conference Friday, saying the U.S. took the stage from a position of strength.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在周五的白宫新闻发布会上宣传了他最近的亚洲之行，他在亚洲之行中会见了中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔普京，并表示美国以强势地位登上了舞台。

paras.en: "The United States entered this trip from a position of unmatched economic and diplomatic strength," he said, though the historic summit between the three countries yielded few tangible results.
paras.zh: 他说：“美国以无与伦比的经济和外交实力参加这次访问，”尽管这三个国家之间的历史性峰会没有取得什么具体成果。

paras.en: But Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues, such as continuing to discuss reducing nuclear risks.
paras.zh: 但特朗普除了就一些问题（例如继续讨论减少核风险）发表团结声明外，几乎没有透露会议的实际结果。

paras.en: Trump, flanked by Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio, gave a wide-ranging opening statement that veered from recounting his trip and who he met with to asides about Iran, the U.S. Federal Reserve, his quest for a Nobel Peace Prize and domestic manufacturing.
paras.zh: 特朗普在副总统万斯和国务卿马可·卢比奥的陪同下发表了内容广泛的开场白，内容从叙述他的行程和会见的人转向谈论伊朗、美联储、他对诺贝尔和平奖的追求和国内制造业。

paras.en: Trump also said he and Chinese President Xi were agreeing to "joint guardrails" amid the race to develop artificial intelligence, a notable acknowledgement about the risks involved.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，他和中国国家主席习近平同意在人工智能开发竞赛中“联合护栏”，这是对所涉及风险的明显承认。

paras.en: Trump, who said Xi also likes his term "super intelligence" rather than artificial, said, "Problem is, it may be too super. So, President Xi and I agree that we're going to do some joint guardrails, the two of us."
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，习近平也喜欢他的术语“超级智能”，而不是人工智能，他说，“问题是，它可能太超级了。所以，习主席和我同意，我们将做一些联合护栏，我们两个。”

paras.en: Trump added that he would continue to push for the construction of data centers in the U.S.
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，他将继续推动美国数据中心的建设。

paras.en: "Make them pay your community, but take advantage. Don't shut them off. And there's always somebody else in this country. But if it's not this country, there's somebody else outside. And we're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country. We're not going to allow that to happen," Trump said.
paras.zh: “让他们向你的社区付费，但要利用他们。不要将他们拒之门外。这个国家总有其他人。但如果不是这个国家，外面也会有其他人。我们不会允许我们的公司在我们国家之外建立数据中心。我们不会允许这种情况发生，”特朗普说。

paras.en: Trump said he only wants "older chips" from the U.S. to be sold to China, in the wake of the Nvidia scandal. "We want only older chips, and we don't mind if none go, but only older. You have to understand, China makes chips too, and if we're not going to sell them, they'll make them themselves," he said.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，在英伟达丑闻发生后，他只希望将美国的“旧芯片”出售给中国。 “我们只想要较旧的芯片，我们不介意没有，但只是较旧的。你必须明白，中国也生产芯片，如果我们不打算出售它们，他们就会自己生产，”他说。

paras.en: Vance and Rubio both spoke before the president took questions, with the vice president saying he missed the president and Rubio, who was on the trip with Trump, also recounting the highlights from overseas.
paras.zh: 在总统提问之前，万斯和卢比奥都发表了讲话，副总统表示他想念总统，而与特朗普同行的卢比奥也讲述了海外的精彩片段。

paras.en: Trump did not formally take questions while in China at the end of his trip, though it's typically expected on presidential foreign trips. Putin did hold a press conference before leaving the country.
paras.zh: 特朗普在中国之行结束时没有正式回答问题，尽管通常在总统出访时都会这样做。普京在离开该国之前确实举行了新闻发布会。

paras.en: Ahead of the press conference, Trump said he will be discussing the historic meetings in China as well as trade agreements reached during the earlier part of the trip in the Philippines, where he arrived for the tail end of a summit with South Asian leaders.
paras.zh: 在新闻发布会之前，特朗普表示，他将讨论在中国举行的历史性会议以及在菲律宾之行的早期阶段达成的贸易协定，他抵达菲律宾是为了与南亚领导人举行峰会的尾声。

paras.en: Trump, Xi and Putin, who command the world's largest nuclear arsenals, gathered at a lakeside resort in Shenzhen, China, where they sat around a large round wooden table to discuss nuclear proliferation, Iran and global relations.
paras.zh: 掌握着世界上最大核武库的特朗普、习近平和普京聚集在中国深圳的一个湖畔度假胜地，围坐在一张大圆木桌旁，讨论核扩散、伊朗和全球关系。

paras.en: While the displays of power were prominent, the talks offered few signs that either Xi or Putin was prepared to make significant concessions to Trump.
paras.zh: 尽管权力的展示很明显，但会谈中几乎没有迹象表明习近平或普京准备向特朗普做出重大让步。

paras.en: "The trip enabled the president to bask in the glow of great power amity after a really bruising election outcome here at home," Suzanne Maloney, vice president and director of the foreign policy program at the Brookings Institution, said of Trump. "He wanted the optics of this direct engagement with Presidents Xi and Putin as a sort of validation of his own standing as a historical figure. And I think the photo op provided that."
paras.zh: 布鲁金斯学会副总裁兼外交政策项目主任苏珊娜·马洛尼在谈到特朗普时表示：“在国内选举结果惨重之后，这次访问使总统能够沐浴在大国友好的光芒中。” “他希望通过与习主席和普京总统的直接接触来证明他自己作为历史人物的地位。我认为这张照片提供了这一点。”

articles.title: Somali community leaders bristle at broad blame even as youth gang violence surges from Minnesota to Maine

paras.en: Somali community members in Minnesota pushed back Thursday against blaming the broader Somali American population as law enforcement officials warned of a surge in youth gang violence.
paras.zh: 周四，明尼苏达州的索马里社区成员反对将责任归咎于更广泛的索马里裔美国人，因为执法官员警告称，青年帮派暴力激增。

paras.en: Members of the Somali community and law enforcement leaders met to discuss gang-related crimes in the Twin Cities, KSTP 5 Eyewitness News reported Thursday.
paras.zh: 据 KSTP 5 目击者新闻周四报道，索马里社区成员和执法领导人开会讨论双子城与帮派有关的犯罪问题。

paras.en: Ramsey County Sheriff Bob Fletcher estimates there are about a dozen Somali gangs involving roughly 300 young people in the metro area out of an estimated 1,000 to 2,000 total gang members across the region.
paras.zh: 拉姆西县警长鲍勃·弗莱彻 (Bob Fletcher) 估计，该地区大约有 1,000 至 2,000 名帮派成员，其中大都市区约有 12 个索马里帮派，涉及约 300 名年轻人。

paras.en: Fletcher said many gang members who do get arrested ultimately continue participating in "the gang life."
paras.zh: 弗莱彻说，许多被捕的帮派成员最终仍继续参与“帮派生活”。

paras.en: "Well, many of them are [arrested]. I mean, we’ve arrested probably 100 of those 300," Fletcher told KSTP 5 Eyewitness News. "Many of them cycle out. Just because you arrest them doesn’t mean they’re not going to continue to participate in the gang life."
paras.zh: “嗯，他们中的许多人[被捕]。我的意思是，我们已经逮捕了这 300 人中的大约 100 人，”弗莱彻告诉 KSTP 5 目击者新闻。 “他们中的许多人骑自行车离开了。仅仅因为你逮捕了他们，并不意味着他们不会继续参与帮派生活。”

paras.en: The Ramsey County Sheriff's Office did not respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment Friday.
paras.zh: 拉姆齐县治安官办公室周五没有回应福克斯新闻数字频道的置评请求。

paras.en: However, some people at the community meeting said the Somali community in the Twin Cities metro area is being singled out unfairly.
paras.zh: 然而，社区会议上的一些人表示，双城都会区的索马里社区受到了不公平的对待。

paras.en: Abdirizak Bihi, a Somali American social activist, said Thursday that "we cannot arrest our way" into fixing youth crime, KSTP 5 Eyewitness News reported.
paras.zh: 据 KSTP 5 目击者新闻报道，索马里裔美国社会活动家阿卜迪里扎克·比希 (Abdirizak Bihi) 周四表示，“我们无法通过逮捕”来解决青少年犯罪问题。

paras.en: "I’m concerned. I’m a father," Bihi said. "We cannot arrest our way into solving this problem for any youth.
paras.zh: “我很担心。我是一名父亲，”比希说。 “我们不能阻止任何年轻人解决这个问题。

paras.en: "Of course, anyone who commits a crime, we have laws."
paras.zh: “当然，任何人犯罪，我们都有法律。”

paras.en: Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension Superintendent Drew Evans suggested that preventing gang violence can be "difficult to measure," CBS News reported Thursday.
paras.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻周四报道，明尼苏达州刑事逮捕局局长德鲁·埃文斯表示，防止帮派暴力可能“难以衡量”。

paras.en: "What a meeting like this does is it brings (the) community together in a way to really understand what the drivers of violence are to begin with," Evans said. "Prevention is always going to be difficult to measure. You're not going to be able to prove the negative if something didn't occur."
paras.zh: 埃文斯说：“像这样的会议的作用是将社区聚集在一起，以真正了解暴力的驱动因素是什么。” “预防总是很难衡量。如果没有发生什么事情，你就无法证明消极的一面。”

paras.en: The tensions in the Twin Cities mirror similar struggles in other U.S. cities with large Somali American populations, where local officials and community leaders are also grappling with spikes in youth gun violence and debates over how to confront it.
paras.zh: 双子城的紧张局势与其他拥有大量索马里裔美国人的美国城市的情况相似，当地官员和社区领袖也在努力应对青少年枪支暴力激增的问题，并就如何应对这一问题展开辩论。

paras.en: In Lewiston, Maine, police reported 35 gun-related incidents this year, including 22 that involved juveniles, Fox News previously reported in October. The city houses a large population of Somali refugees and refugees from other African nations.
paras.zh: 据福克斯新闻此前 10 月份报道，缅因州刘易斯顿今年警方报告了 35 起枪支相关事件，其中 22 起涉及青少年。该市居住着大量索马里难民和来自其他非洲国家的难民。

paras.en: "I don’t feel safe. I fear for my life," Mohamed Muhumed, a Lewiston teenager, previously told Fox News Digital. "I saw someone get punched in the middle of the sidewalk over there. It’s crazy."
paras.zh: “我感觉不安全。我担心自己的生命安全，”刘易斯顿少年穆罕默德·穆罕默德此前告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。 “我看到有人在那边的人行道中间被打了一拳。这太疯狂了。”

paras.en: Maine Immigrant and Refugee Services Executive Director Rilwan Osman and his team unveiled a Voices Against Gun Violence program in June, which included daily workshops and community discussions throughout the month as part of a broader effort to address youth gun violence in the city, WGME reported June 1.
paras.zh: 据 WGME 6 月 1 日报道，缅因州移民和难民服务执行主任 Rilwan Osman 及其团队于 6 月推出了“反对枪支暴力之声”计划，其中包括整个月的每日研讨会和社区讨论，作为解决该市青少年枪支暴力问题的更广泛努力的一部分。

paras.en: "We are asking people to pledge that they can talk about gun violence at home in their communities, at school, outside their school," Osman said, according to WGME.
paras.zh: 据 WGME 报道，奥斯曼表示：“我们要求人们承诺，他们可以在家里、社区、学校、校外谈论枪支暴力。”

paras.en: The Minnesota BCA announced in an Oct. 19 news release that more than 40 law enforcement agencies agreed to "use an existing investigative model to coordinate efforts and strengthen collaboration in addressing gang and group violence." The plan also "employs county-based quick reaction teams for specialized and rapid uniformed patrol and investigative response when criminal activity occurs," according to the agency.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州 BCA 在 10 月 19 日的新闻稿中宣布，40 多个执法机构同意“利用现有的调查模式来协调努力并加强合作，解决帮派和群体暴力问题”。该机构表示，该计划还“在犯罪活动发生时，雇用县级快速反应小组，进行专门、快速的制服巡逻和调查反应”。

paras.en: When reached for comment about its efforts to address gang-related crime in Minnesota, the BCA referred Fox News Digital to its Oct. 19 news release.
paras.zh: 当我们联系 BCA 询问其解决明尼苏达州帮派相关犯罪的努力时，BCA 向 Fox News Digital 推荐了其 10 月 19 日发布的新闻稿。

paras.en: Former state Trooper John Nagel told Fox News Digital in October that some Minnesota Democrats have their "heads in the sand" and hindered law enforcement from stopping Somali American gang-linked violence in the state before it escalated.
paras.zh: 前州警约翰·内格尔 (John Nagel) 10 月份告诉福克斯新闻数字频道 (Fox News Digital)，一些明尼苏达州民主党人“把头埋在沙子里”，阻碍执法部门阻止该州与美国索马里帮派有关的暴力事件升级。

paras.en: "They're being restrained by politicians, people that are trying soft on crime, people that are trying to send somebody other than a police officer to take care of issues, and it's not working," Nagel said at the time.
paras.zh: 内格尔当时表示：“他们受到政客、试图软弱打击犯罪的人、试图派警察以外的人来处理问题的人的限制，但这不起作用。”

paras.en: Police in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, previously said an Oct. 2 shooting outside Aerie Stadium at Eden Prairie High School's homecoming was connected to Somali gang activity.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州伊甸草原警方此前表示，10 月 2 日伊甸草原高中返校节期间在 Aerie 体育场外发生的枪击事件与索马里帮派活动有关。

paras.en: About 84,000 Somali individuals live in the Minneapolis-St. Paul area, PBS News reported in December 2025.
paras.zh: 大约有 84,000 名索马里人居住在明尼阿波利斯-圣路易斯。据 PBS 新闻 2025 年 12 月报道，圣保罗地区。

paras.en: Rep. Tom Emmer, R-Minn., sent a letter to U.S. Attorney Daniel Rosen July 23 flagging concerns about the "alarming rise" of Somali gang violence in the North Star State.
paras.zh: 明尼苏达州众议员汤姆·埃默 (Tom Emmer) 7 月 23 日致信美国检察官丹尼尔·罗森 (Daniel Rosen)，表达了对北极星州索马里帮派暴力“惊人增长”的担忧。

paras.en: "I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again. If you won’t assimilate, then get the hell out of here. First it was an estimated $9 billion in fraud. Now it’s out-of-control violence," Emmer said in a statement. "These Somali gangs have shot up high school graduations and assaulted players on opposing basketball teams with tire irons. It’s absolute madness, and something must be done."
paras.zh: 埃默在一份声明中表示：“我以前说过，现在还会再说一遍。如果你不肯同化，那就赶紧离开这里。首先，这是估计价值 90 亿美元的欺诈行为。现在，这是失控的暴力。” “这些索马里团伙袭击了高中毕业生，并用轮胎熨斗袭击了对方篮球队的球员。这绝对是疯狂的，必须采取一些措施。”

paras.en: In Columbus, Ohio, police announced the arrests, indictments or convictions of 21 BL-800 gang members in February 2024, WOSU 89.7 NPR News reported.
paras.zh: 据 WOSU 89.7 NPR 新闻报道，俄亥俄州哥伦布市警方于 2024 年 2 月宣布逮捕、起诉或定罪 21 名 BL-800 帮派成员。

paras.en: Det. Eric Clouse said that the "BL" in the gang's name initially stood for "Bantu Life" or "Bantu Love" in reference to Somalia's Bantu ethnic community, according to the outlet.
paras.zh: 检测。据该媒体报道，埃里克·克劳斯表示，该团伙名称中的“BL”最初代表“班图生活”或“班图爱情”，指的是索马里的班图族社区。

paras.en: Fox News' Paul Steinhauser contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的Paul Steinhauser为本报道提供了资料。

articles.title: Firecracker Colts owner has America in a trance today, Sophie Cunningham buys protection & CBS's Jenny Dell!

paras.en: 'Nightcaps' is a daily column that catches you up on the biggest sports, news and culture stories you may have missed while pretending to do work at your desk. It runs Monday-Friday on OutKick.com.
paras.zh: “Nightcaps”是一个每日专栏，为您提供在假装在办公桌前工作时可能错过的最大的体育、新闻和文化故事。它于周一至周五在 OutKick.com 上运行。

paras.en: This is it, folks. The final Friday before Thanksgiving. The final Friday before Black Friday, if that's even a thing anymore. The final weekend before a holiday week — our first since Labor Day.
paras.zh: 就是这样，伙计们。感恩节前的最后一个星期五。黑色星期五之前的最后一个星期五，如果这还存在的话。假期周前的最后一个周末——这是我们自劳动节以来的第一个周末。

paras.en: Been a while. We've worked our tails off the past few months to get back here. Sure, the stock market is collapsing all around us and our portfolios are cooked, but it's still a FRIDAY.
paras.zh: 已经有一段时间了。过去几个月我们竭尽全力才回到这里。当然，我们周围的股市正在崩溃，我们的投资组合也已经熟透了，但今天仍然是星期五。

paras.en: Cheer up, buttercup. We've got FOOTBALL tonight, tomorrow, Sunday and Monday. We've got Thanksgiving Eve. We've got Thanksgiving. We've got Black Friday. And then, we've got another weekend!
paras.zh: 加油，毛茛。今晚、明天、周日和周一我们都有足球比赛。我们有感恩节前夕。我们过感恩节了我们迎来了黑色星期五。然后，我们还有另一个周末！

paras.en: Who has it better than us right now? Nobody. Let's roll.
paras.zh: 现在谁比我们过得更好？没有人。让我们滚吧。

paras.en: Welcome to a Friday Nightcaps — the one where Colts owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon put the internet in a trance during an otherwise horrific Thursday Night Football game.
paras.zh: 欢迎来到周五睡帽赛——小马队老板卡莉·伊尔赛-戈登在一场原本可怕的周四橄榄球之夜比赛中让互联网陷入了恍惚状态。

paras.en: Lordy, that was bad. It might've just been the worst TNF I've ever seen, and buddy, that is a LONG list.
paras.zh: 老天，那太糟糕了。这可能是我见过的最糟糕的 TNF，伙计，这是一个很长的清单。

paras.en: What else? I've got Sophie Cunningham buying her friends some protection, USC football communications girl Katie Ryan checks in, and with the big day in six days, I'd like to get a pulse on everyone's best turkey recipes this year.
paras.zh: 还有什么？我让索菲·坎宁安 (Sophie Cunningham) 给她的朋友们买了一些保护，南加州大学橄榄球通讯女孩凯蒂·瑞安 (Katie Ryan) 来了，六天后就是重要的一天，我想了解一下今年每个人最好的火鸡食谱。

paras.en: I've done the same one for six years now. Not saying I'm in the market to switch it up, but I'd like to see what else is out there.
paras.zh: 六年来我一直在做同样的事情。并不是说我要在市场上进行切换，但我想看看还有什么。

paras.en: OK, grab you some cajun seasoning, a bottle of Italian dressing, and a 12-pound bird, and settle in for a Friday 'Cap!
paras.zh: 好吧，给你拿一些卡真调味料、一瓶意大利调料和一只 12 磅重的鸟，然后准备一瓶周五的帽子！

paras.en: I can't get over this Carlie Irsay-Gordon
paras.zh: 我无法忘记这个卡莉·厄赛-戈登

paras.en: That's basically my recipe, by the way. It's simple, and it's never steered me wrong.
paras.zh: 顺便说一句，这基本上就是我的食谱。这很简单，而且它从来没有误导我。

paras.en: I inject the bird with Italian dressing. I then rub her down with a mixture of creole seasoning (the green bottle on every shelf in America), black pepper, cayenne pepper and garlic powder. I usually tone down the pepper and cayenne based on my audience. If you like it spicy, by all means, go for it.
paras.zh: 我给鸟注射了意大利调料。然后我用克里奥尔调味料（美国每个货架上都有的绿色瓶子）、黑胡椒、辣椒和大蒜粉的混合物给她擦身。我通常会根据观众的喜好淡化胡椒和辣椒的用量。如果你喜欢吃辣的话，无论如何，就去吃吧。

paras.en: But that's it. You mix those things together (1 cup creole, 1/4 cup black pepper, 2 TBSPs garlic power, 1/8 cup cayenne) however you'd like, and it'll create a sort of paste. Slather it all over the bird, stick her in the fridge overnight, and then fry her up the next day.
paras.zh: 但仅此而已。你可以将这些东西混合在一起（1 杯克里奥尔酒、1/4 杯黑胡椒、2 汤匙大蒜粉、1/8 杯辣椒粉），无论你喜欢什么，它都会形成一种糊状物。把它涂在鸟身上，把它放在冰箱里过夜，然后第二天再把它煎起来。

paras.en: By all means, though, I'd love to hear what you all do. Again, I'm open to calling an audible this year if something sticks out.
paras.zh: 但无论如何，我很想听听你们都做了什么。再次强调，如果有什么问题，我愿意今年召开一次听证会。

paras.en: Now, let's get this Friday class started with the lunatic Colts owner who stands on the sidelines during every single game and takes notes about how truly horrible her team is.
paras.zh: 现在，让我们从疯狂的小马队老板开始这个周五的课程，他在每场比赛中都站在场边，记录她的球队有多么可怕。

paras.en: Sophie Cunningham is already in the giving spirit!
paras.zh: 索菲·坎宁安 (Sophie Cunningham) 已经充满了奉献精神！

paras.en: What do we think Carlie Irsay-Gordon is writing down? Seriously. If you sat through that horrible game last night, what do YOU think she wrote down?
paras.zh: 我们认为卡莉·厄赛-戈登写下了什么？严重地。如果你昨晚看完了那场可怕的比赛，你认为她会写下什么？

paras.en: - Daniel Jones STINKS. Why did we pay this guy? (UPDATE ON THIS ONE: DANNY DIMES HAS BEEN RELEASED!)
paras.zh: - 丹尼尔琼斯很臭。我们为什么付钱给这个人？ （此更新：丹尼·迪姆斯已被释放！）

paras.en: - I can't believe we haven't fired this coach yet.
paras.zh: - 我不敢相信我们还没有解雇这位教练。

paras.en: - Try to remember receivers' names for next week's game because I have no idea who these guys are.
paras.zh: - 尝试记住下周比赛的接球手的名字，因为我不知道这些人是谁。

paras.en: - Why does he keep taking Jonathan Taylor off the field?
paras.zh: - 为什么他总是把乔纳森·泰勒带下场？

paras.en: - Why are those Texans uniforms so ugly?
paras.zh: - 为什么德州人的队服这么难看？

paras.en: - Do we call anything other than screen passes?
paras.zh: - 除了屏幕通行证之外，我们还称之为其他什么吗？

paras.en: - Why are we attempting a 60-yard field goal that this guy is never going to make?
paras.zh: - 为什么我们要尝试这个家伙永远不会投进的 60 码射门？

paras.en: I can't get enough of Carlie just invading the sidelines for every single game and standing right behind the coach. How absolutely miserable must that be? Could you imagine your boss just standing behind your desk all day watching your every move?
paras.zh: 我对卡莉每场比赛都闯入场边并站在教练身后感到受不了。那该是多么悲惨啊？你能想象你的老板整天站在你的办公桌后面监视你的一举一动吗？

paras.en: I used to have a boss like that way back in the day.
paras.zh: 当年我也曾有过这样的老板。

paras.en: Every time we saw him coming towards us, we'd let out an audible groan. We couldn't help it. He was too dumb to ever figure out we were groaning about him.
paras.zh: 每次看到他向我们走来，我们都会发出一声可听见的呻吟声。我们无能为力。他太笨了，根本不知道我们在抱怨他。

paras.en: OK, let's keep this class moving and check in with Sophie Cunningham, who is currently groaning at all the unprotected sex her friends have been having lately:
paras.zh: 好吧，让我们继续这堂课，并与索菲·坎宁安（Sophie Cunningham）进行交流，她目前正在为她的朋友们最近发生的所有无保护性行为而抱怨：

paras.en: So, Sophie is going viral today for that above TikTok in which she vows to buy her friends condoms this holiday season because they're having too many kids, too fast.
paras.zh: 今天，索菲因上述 TikTok 的内容而走红，她在视频中发誓要在这个假期给朋友们买安全套，因为他们生孩子太多，生得太快。

paras.en: Not sure how that's going to play with Sophie's base, but, to be fair, she also says it's great to have kids and we need more babies in the world. So, she plays both sides of the fence here pretty well.
paras.zh: 不知道这对苏菲的基地会有什么影响，但公平地说，她也说有孩子真是太好了，我们世界上需要更多的婴儿。所以，她在这里的两面都打得很好。

paras.en: It did get me thinking ... how old were you when you realized all your friends now had kids? One of my college buddies just had his first kid a few weeks ago, making him the third of our old college suit (shoutout to 1008!) to have kids. I was the first, by a mile. But I also got married before any of them because I'm from the south and that's what we do down here.
paras.zh: 这确实让我思考……当你意识到你所有的朋友现在都有孩子时，你多大了？我的一个大学好友几周前刚刚生下了他的第一个孩子，这使他成为我们旧大学套装中第三个有孩子的人（向 1008 致敬！）。我是第一个，领先一英里。但我也先于他们结婚，因为我来自南方，而这就是我们在这里所做的。

paras.en: Most of my old college friends still don't have kids, though. But I'm also a guy, and I feel like that's normal. My wife's friends, on the other hand? My goodness. They all have at least three kids by now and have been married for 15 years. It's insane.
paras.zh: 不过，我的大多数大学老朋友仍然没有孩子。但我也是个男人，我觉得这很正常。另一方面，我妻子的朋友呢？天哪。他们现在都至少有三个孩子，并且已经结婚 15 年了。太疯狂了。

paras.en: OK, let's rapid-fire this Friday class into a big weekend of FOOTBALL! First up? Al Michaels had another rough game last night (not that he was given a ton to work with), and the internet let him know about it.
paras.zh: 好的，让我们把周五的课程快速打造成一个精彩的足球周末吧！首先？艾尔·迈克尔斯昨晚又打了一场艰难的比赛（并不是说他有很多工作要做），互联网让他知道了这件事。

paras.en: I wrote about Al's rough outing this morning. If you'd like to get into the weeds further, feel free to click here when the final bell rings here in a bit.
paras.zh: 我今天早上写了艾尔的艰难郊游。如果您想进一步深入了解，请在最后的铃声响起后随时单击此处。

paras.en: Unsurprisingly, you all had plenty to say about it.
paras.zh: 毫不奇怪，你们对此都有很多话要说。

paras.en: Pleazzze AL..time to GOOOOOOOOOOOO.....THANKS
paras.zh: 请AL..时间去GOOOOOOOOOOO......谢谢

paras.en: It's been abundantly clear to everyone that watches football that Al Michaels is washed-up at 82, and I would argue that he's been dreadful for a least the past 5 years.
paras.zh: 每个观看足球比赛的人都非常清楚，阿尔·迈克尔斯已经 82 岁了，他已经精疲力尽了，而且我认为他至少在过去 5 年里一直表现得很糟糕。

paras.en: That blocked kick was boring, along with the whole game. Would the critics out there rather listen to Tony Romo find some ridiculous way to inject Josh Allen into a blocked kick? If you can't be real, go kick your grandpa for being slow. Leave Al alone.
paras.zh: 那次被阻挡的踢球很无聊，整场比赛也很无聊。那里的批评家会愿意听托尼·罗莫找到一些荒谬的方式将乔什·艾伦注入阻挡踢球吗？如果你不诚实，就去踢你爷爷的慢动作吧。别管阿尔了。

paras.en: Thoughts on Al Michaels at 82? Again, last night's game was just horrible, so I can't knock him too much for falling asleep at the wheel. But it ain't like it was the first time, either.
paras.zh: 对 82 岁高龄的艾尔·迈克尔斯有何感想？再说一次，昨晚的比赛实在是太糟糕了，所以我不能因为他在方向盘上睡着而对他造成太大的打击。但这也不是第一次了。

paras.en: OK, that's it for today — and this week. Good work, everyone. On the way out, here's OutKick legend Jenny Dell with USC football communications czar, Katie Ryan.
paras.zh: 好的，今天和本周就是这样。干得好，大家。离开时，OutKick 传奇人物珍妮·戴尔 (Jenny Dell) 与南加州大学橄榄球通讯主管凯蒂·瑞安 (Katie Ryan) 在一起。

articles.title: Americans don’t have to choose between our AI future and ripping off copyright owners

paras.en: One of the biggest court battles over artificial intelligence (AI) is putting an age-old legal principle to the test — and raising important questions about the Trump administration's AI policy.
paras.zh: 关于人工智能 (AI) 的最大法庭斗争之一是对一项古老的法律原则进行检验，并对特朗普政府的人工智能政策提出重要问题。

paras.en: Several news organizations, including The New York Times, are suing OpenAI and Microsoft for using millions of newspaper articles to train AI systems. The newspapers argue that the tech firms violated basic copyright protections. The tech firms contend that training their models on those articles qualifies as "fair use," a longstanding principle that allows copyrighted material to be used in certain ways without permission from or compensation to the copyright owner.
paras.zh: 包括《纽约时报》在内的多家新闻机构正在起诉 OpenAI 和微软使用数百万篇报纸文章来训练人工智能系统。报纸认为科技公司违反了基本的版权保护。科技公司认为，根据这些文章训练他们的模型符合“合理使用”，这是一项长期存在的原则，允许在未经版权所有者许可或不向版权所有者提供补偿的情况下以某些方式使用受版权保护的材料。

paras.en: The Department of Justice (DOJ) has sided squarely with OpenAI's position — breaking with the administration's previously more balanced stance on the issue. The DOJ filed a statement of interest embracing an extreme vision of fair use that would grant AI companies virtually unfettered access to copyrighted material for commercial training, without obtaining permission from or compensating the creators whose works fuel these systems.
paras.zh: 美国司法部 (DOJ) 完全支持 OpenAI 的立场——打破了政府此前在该问题上较为平衡的立场。美国司法部提交了一份利益声明，拥护合理使用的极端愿景，该声明将允许人工智能公司几乎不受限制地获取受版权保护的材料以进行商业培训，而无需获得其作品为这些系统提供动力的创作者的许可或对其进行补偿。

paras.en: This expansive interpretation threatens to turn a narrow copyright exception into a blanket exemption for the world's most powerful and profitable industries.
paras.zh: 这种宽泛的解释有可能将狭隘的版权例外变成对世界上最强大、最赚钱的行业的全面豁免。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Those concerns deserve consideration. But the DOJ's aggressive arguments in the brief depart from more measured guidance elsewhere in the administration. The White House's official AI framework acknowledges valid arguments on both sides of the copyright debate.
paras.zh: 这些担忧值得考虑。但司法部在简报中的激进论点与政府其他部门更加谨慎的指导背道而驰。白宫的官方人工智能框架承认版权争论双方的有效论点。

paras.en: Likewise, the Carolina Principles for Emerging Technologies, adopted by G20 ministers at the Commerce Department's recent Innovation Ministerial, recognize that the intersection of AI and copyright poses "complex legal and policy questions." The principles note the "essential role" of copyright protections in supporting creators and call for respecting IP as a pillar of G20 AI policy.
paras.zh: 同样，二十国集团部长们在商务部最近举行的创新部长级会议上通过的《卡罗莱纳新兴技术原则》承认人工智能和版权的交叉带来了“复杂的法律和政策问题”。这些原则指出了版权保护在支持创作者方面的“重要作用”，并呼吁将尊重知识产权作为 G20 人工智能政策的支柱。

paras.en: The DOJ statement also overlooks how its stance could favor larger AI companies over smaller firms and startups. Several AI startups have argued that paying for the material they use provides more reliable access to training material, reduces legal uncertainty and improves models. Other companies have emerged to aggregate copyrights and make licensing easier.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的声明还忽视了其立场如何有利于大型人工智能公司，而不是小型公司和初创公司。几家人工智能初创公司认为，为他们使用的材料付费可以更可靠地获取培训材料，减少法律不确定性并改进模型。其他公司已经出现，以聚合版权并使许可变得更容易。

paras.en: It's particularly problematic for large AI companies to complain about paying for access to copyrighted materials. They are among the best positioned to pay for those materials, and doing so would help develop the kind of licensing markets they claim are lacking.
paras.zh: 对于大型人工智能公司来说，抱怨付费访问受版权保护的材料尤其成问题。他们是支付这些材料费用的最佳人选，这样做将有助于开发他们声称缺乏的许可市场。

paras.en: And even if national security were a legitimate justification, the government could not simply disregard property rights. The Constitution and other laws require just compensation when private property is taken for public use, and intellectual property rights are still property rights. Letting AI firms appropriate creators' IP without permission or compensation would be akin to letting data center builders seize private land without paying fair value.
paras.zh: 即使国家安全是一个合法的理由，政府也不能简单地忽视财产权。宪法和其他法律要求私有财产被公共使用时必须得到公正的补偿，而知识产权仍然是财产权。让人工智能公司在未经许可或不予补偿的情况下侵占创作者的知识产权，就像让数据中心建设者在不支付公平价值的情况下夺取私人土地一样。

paras.en: If courts adopt the DOJ's position that fair use protects AI developers in virtually all circumstances, it would reduce incentives to create new works. Copyrights encourage creative work by assuring writers, artists and other creators that their work can't be easily stolen or copied. Licensing those rights allows creators to earn a living and underpins over $1 trillion in U.S. economic activity.
paras.zh: 如果法院采纳司法部的立场，即合理使用几乎在所有情况下都能保护人工智能开发者，这将减少创作新作品的动力。版权通过向作家、艺术家和其他创作者保证他们的作品不会被轻易窃取或复制来鼓励创造性工作。获得这些权利的许可可以让创作者谋生并支撑超过 1 万亿美元的美国经济活动。

paras.en: Weaker copyrights could result in fewer human-created books, articles, research papers, films and songs. Ironically, that could eventually leave AI systems with fewer and lower-quality materials to train on – a scenario that serves no one's interests.
paras.zh: 版权较弱可能会导致人类创作的书籍、文章、研究论文、电影和歌曲减少。具有讽刺意味的是，这最终可能会让人工智能系统使用更少、质量更低的材料进行训练——这种情况不符合任何人的利益。

paras.en: All of this is why the Trump administration would be wise to follow its own AI framework and let the court system evaluate AI copyright disputes case by case, rather than arguing for unfettered fair use exceptions.
paras.zh: 所有这些就是为什么特朗普政府明智地遵循自己的人工智能框架，让法院系统逐案评估人工智能版权纠纷，而不是主张不受约束的合理使用例外。

paras.en: The DOJ's reasoning is that requiring a copyright license for material used in AI training would impose high costs on AI developers. It claims those costs could make it harder for small companies to compete and hamper U.S. AI leadership and national security.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的理由是，要求人工智能培训中使用的材料获得版权许可会给人工智能开发人员带来高昂的成本。它声称这些成本可能会使小公司更难竞争并阻碍美国人工智能的领导地位和国家安全。

paras.en: Policymakers also have a role to play. One promising bill is the bipartisan CLEAR Act. Introduced in February by California Democrat Sen. Adam Schiff and Utah Republican Sen. John Curtis, the CLEAR Act would require AI developers to publicly disclose the copyrighted works used in each new generative-AI model's training dataset.
paras.zh: 政策制定者也可以发挥作用。一项有前途的法案是两党共同通过的 CLEAR 法案。加州民主党参议员亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff) 和犹他州共和党参议员约翰·柯蒂斯 (John Curtis) 在 2 月提出的 CLEAR 法案将要求人工智能开发人员公开披露每个新的生成人工智能模型的训练数据集中使用的受版权保护的作品。

paras.en: The proposal would not settle whether any particular training practice qualifies as fair use. But it would give creators more information about whether their work helped train an AI system, enabling them to pursue appropriate compensation or other remedies when they believe their rights have been violated.
paras.zh: 该提案不会解决任何特定培训实践是否符合合理使用的问题。但这将为创作者提供更多关于他们的工作是否有助于训练人工智能系统的信息，使他们能够在认为自己的权利受到侵犯时寻求适当的赔偿或其他补救措施。

paras.en: That kind of targeted reform offers a useful model for copyright enforcement in the age of AI. Rather than treating licensing as an obstacle to innovation, policymakers should foster a market where AI developers can efficiently license copyrighted material while respecting creators' rights.
paras.zh: 这种有针对性的改革为人工智能时代的版权执法提供了有用的模式。政策制定者不应将许可视为创新的障碍，而应培育一个市场，让人工智能开发者能够有效地许可受版权保护的材料，同时尊重创作者的权利。

paras.en: AI innovation is vital to America's future. But America's creative industries still depend on strong copyright protections. Policymakers need to promote both.
paras.zh: 人工智能创新对美国的未来至关重要。但美国的创意产业仍然依赖于强有力的版权保护。政策制定者需要促进两者。

articles.title: Denmark to expel Russian diplomat over alleged Moscow link to attempted killing of rapper
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies in Copenhagen

paras.en: Denmark’s foreign minister has said Russia’s defence attache in Copenhagen would be expelled after Moscow was suspected of being behind an attempted killing of a US-Ukrainian rapper.
paras.zh: 丹麦外交部长表示，俄罗斯驻哥本哈根武官将被驱逐，原因是莫斯科涉嫌策划杀害一名美国-乌克兰说唱歌手的幕后黑手。

paras.en: “We have just summoned the Russian ambassador to the ministry of foreign affairs and notified him of the government’s decision to expel the Russian defence attache from Denmark,”, Lars Løkke Rasmussen told a news conference. The expulsion will happen within seven days.
paras.zh: 拉斯穆森在新闻发布会上表示：“我们刚刚召见了俄罗斯驻外交部大使，并通知他政府决定将俄罗斯武官驱逐出丹麦。”驱逐将在七天内进行。

paras.en: “We are saying this very clearly: we have exposed you,” he added.
paras.zh: “我们非常明确地说：我们已经暴露了你，”他补充道。

paras.en: Danish police said they had averted an attempt by Russian intelligence services to kill the US-Ukrainian rapper Kyivstoner in September before a planned performance in Denmark.
paras.zh: 丹麦警方表示，他们阻止了俄罗斯情报部门在 9 月份计划在丹麦演出之前杀害美籍乌克兰说唱歌手基夫斯托纳的企图。

paras.en: Rasmussen also said that Denmark was considering suspending Schengen visas to Russians.
paras.zh: 拉斯穆森还表示，丹麦正在考虑暂停向俄罗斯人发放申根签证。

paras.en: “We have launched work at the European level to further tighten the rules governing access of Russian nationals to Europe,” he said. “We are now stepping up our efforts towards a halt to all non-essential visas.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们已在欧洲层面开展工作，进一步收紧俄罗斯国民进入欧洲的规则。” “我们现在正在加紧努力，停止所有非必要签证。

paras.en: “The strongest response Denmark can give is not to waver and to support Ukraine. And we fully intend to continue supporting Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “丹麦能给出的最强烈回应就是坚定不移地支持乌克兰。我们完全打算继续支持乌克兰。”

paras.en: Police thwarted the alleged plot when they arrested three men with links to the Danish criminal underworld shortly before Kyivstoner, whose real name is Albert Viktorovich Vasiliev, was due to perform at a concert on 25 September, which was then cancelled, officials said. Vasiliev holds US and Ukrainian nationality.
paras.zh: 官员称，在基辅斯托纳（真名阿尔伯特·维克托罗维奇·瓦西里耶夫）原定于 9 月 25 日举行的一场音乐会上演出前不久，警方逮捕了三名与丹麦黑社会有联系的男子，挫败了这一阴谋。瓦西里耶夫拥有美国和乌克兰国籍。

paras.en: Rasmus Kieffer-Kristensen, the head of Denmark’s national security and intelligence service, said: “It is our clear assessment that the assassination attempt was planned by the Russian intelligence services.”
paras.zh: 丹麦国家安全和情报部门负责人拉斯穆斯·基弗-克里斯滕森表示：“我们明确评估，这次暗杀企图是由俄罗斯情报部门策划的。”

paras.en: According to prosecutors, the suspects were driving towards the concert venue north of Copenhagen with two loaded pistols and two knives when police arrested them at about 9.55pm, five minutes before the concert was due to begin. A fourth suspect was arrested later that evening, police said.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，嫌疑人当时正携带两支上膛的手枪和两把刀开车前往哥本哈根北部的音乐会场地，警方于晚上 9 点 55 分左右将他们逮捕，此时距离音乐会开始还有五分钟。警方称，第四名嫌疑人当晚晚些时候被捕。

paras.en: One of the suspects had bought a ticket to the concert, according to the charges.
paras.zh: 指控称，其中一名嫌疑人购买了一张音乐会门票。

paras.en: The suspects are charged under Section 108 of Denmark’s criminal code, which covers assisting a foreign intelligence service, as well as attempted murder. They denied wrongdoing in court, the broadcaster DR reported.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人根据丹麦刑法第 108 条受到指控，其中包括协助外国情报部门以及谋杀未遂。据广播公司 DR 报道，他们在法庭上否认有不当行为。

paras.en: Kieffer-Kristensen said: “A Russian assassination attempt is not something we’ve seen in Denmark before, and that gives me an impression of an increasingly aggressive and risk-taking Russia.
paras.zh: 基弗-克里斯滕森表示：“我们以前在丹麦从未见过俄罗斯的暗杀企图，这给我的印象是俄罗斯越来越具有侵略性和冒险精神。

paras.en: “We believe that the case is important for understanding the threat that Denmark faces from Russia.”
paras.zh: “我们认为此案对于了解丹麦面临的来自俄罗斯的威胁非常重要。”

articles.title: Misty-eyed Burnham gambles on closer ties with EU as he throws down gauntlet to Tories and Reform
articles.author: Peter Walker Senior political correspondent

paras.en: Several sentences into a slightly convoluted answer about where UK-EU relations might go next, Andy Burnham abruptly changed tack. “The important point is that the Britain of today and the EU of today is not the one of 2016,” he said. “Life has moved on in so many ways.”
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）在回答了有关英国与欧盟关系下一步可能走向何方的问题后，用了几句话，然后突然改变了策略。 “重要的一点是，今天的英国和今天的欧盟已经不是 2016 年的了，”他说。 “生活在很多方面都在继续发展。”

paras.en: This is undoubtedly true. But Burnham’s political gamble on closer ties with Brussels hinges on the assumption that most British voters feel this way as well.
paras.zh: 这无疑是事实。但伯纳姆对与布鲁塞尔建立更密切关系的政治赌博取决于大多数英国选民也有这种感觉的假设。

paras.en: Seeking to push his deal on food checks, emissions trading and a new youth exchange scheme, Burnham was at first in full consumer politics mode, saying it would bring cheaper food – with a namecheck for Tesco, Asda and other supermarket chains – as well as lower electricity costs and a claimed 0.5% boost to overall growth.
paras.zh: 为了推动他在食品检查、排放交易和新的青年交换计划方面的协议，伯纳姆一开始完全进入了消费者政治模式，称这将带来更便宜的食品——特易购、阿斯达和其他连锁超市的名字——以及更低的电力成本，并声称对整体增长有0.5%的提振。

paras.en: But as the Brussels press conference went on, the prime minister became more misty-eyed, particularly in describing the youth exchange scheme as a gift to a generation stripped of choices by the 2016 referendum and then Covid. “Hope is a word,” he intoned. “And it starts now.”
paras.zh: 但随着布鲁塞尔新闻发布会的继续，总理的眼眶变得更加湿润，尤其是在将青年交流计划描述为送给因 2016 年公投和随后的新冠疫情而被剥夺选择的一代人的一份礼物时。 “希望就是一个词，”他吟诵道。 “现在就开始了。”

paras.en: For all that Burnham is a skilled political salesman, his oratory is backed up with some helpful political context, matched with cooperative allies.
paras.zh: 尽管伯纳姆是一位熟练的政治推销员，但他的演讲有一些有用的政治背景作为支持，并与合作盟友相匹配。

paras.en: To begin with, not only politics but polling results are now different. A new constituency-level survey released on Friday showed that of 394 constituencies estimated to have voted leave in 2016, voters in 274 of them would back rejoining the EU – including Burnham’s Makerfield seat.
paras.zh: 首先，现在不仅政治不同，民调结果也不同。周五发布的一项新的选区级调查显示，估计 2016 年投票脱欧的 394 个选区中，其中 274 个选区的选民支持重新加入欧盟，其中包括伯纳姆的梅克菲尔德席位。

paras.en: Standing alongside the UK prime minister in the venue, Ursula von der Leyen, the European Commission president, and António Costa, the European Council president, at times resembled proud parents, beaming at every positive phrase.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩和欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔站在英国首相旁边，有时像骄傲的父母一样，对每一个积极的话语都露出笑容。

paras.en: They, of course, began work when the EU reset was the personal project of one Keir Starmer. His name was not mentioned on Friday, and it is undeniable that Brussels finds life easier dealing with a UK leader who is both bold and popular.
paras.zh: 当然，他们是在欧盟重置成为凯尔·斯塔默（Keir Starmer）的个人项目时开始工作的。周五没有提及他的名字，不可否认的是，布鲁塞尔发现与一位既大胆又受欢迎的英国领导人打交道会更轻松。

paras.en: Speaking to British reporters later in the day, Burnham openly challenged political opponents to rebuff a plan that, he said, could add 0.5% annual growth to the economy in the long term – more, he said, than any other single intervention.
paras.zh: 当天晚些时候，伯纳姆在接受英国记者采访时公开挑战政治对手，要求他们拒绝一项计划，他说，从长远来看，该计划可能会给经济带来 0.5% 的年增长率 — — 他说，这比任何其他单一干预措施都要多。

paras.en: “Why would anybody turn their back on that?” he said, with particular focus on Nigel Farage, who was, soon after Burnham spoke, hosting a retaliatory press conference of his own, 10 minutes’ walk from the EU building.
paras.zh: “为什么有人会拒绝这样做呢？”他说，特别关注奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage），伯纳姆讲话后不久，他就在距欧盟大楼 10 分钟步行路程处举办了自己的报复性新闻发布会。

paras.en: Even with the tight timing – Farage had to delay his event as the summit timetable slipped – the Reform UK leader drew a decent crowd of reporters. But there will be a sense in No 10 that beyond Farage, most of the formidable Brexit forces of 2016 have melted away.
paras.zh: 尽管时间紧迫——随着峰会时间表的推迟，法拉奇不得不推迟他的活动——这位改革英国领导人吸引了大批记者。但第 10 号将会有一种感觉，除了法拉奇之外，2016 年英国脱欧的大部分强大力量已经消散。

paras.en: Kemi Badenoch, who has been advised by her team to talk more about the economy and less about Brexit, spent the day on a visit in Essex. The Conservatives did send out a condemnatory press release about the EU deal, but it focused more on Burnham “reopening the divisions of the past” than the specifics.
paras.zh: 凯米·巴德诺克 (Kemi Badenoch) 的团队建议她多谈论经济，少谈论英国脱欧，她花了一天时间访问了埃塞克斯。保守党确实发布了一份关于欧盟协议的谴责性新闻稿，但它更多地关注伯纳姆“重新开启过去的分歧”，而不是具体细节。

paras.en: More trenchant was a statement from Stay Out, the recently formed Brexit purity group, which floated its argument that rejoining the EU would cost the UK £750m a week.
paras.zh: 更为尖锐的是最近成立的脱欧纯粹组织“Stay Out”的一份声明，该组织提出了重新加入欧盟将使英国每周损失 7.5 亿英镑的论点。

paras.en: For all that the dominance of vote leave alumni in Stay Out gives the campaign the slight air of a historic battle re-enactment society, Burnham cannot ignore them. A resonant sidenote of the summit was how he was happy to talk about the specifics of the deal, but not much beyond that.
paras.zh: 尽管脱欧派校友在“留出局”中占据主导地位，给竞选活动带来了历史性战役重演社会的一丝气氛，但伯纳姆不能忽视他们。峰会的一个引起共鸣的旁注是，他很高兴谈论该协议的具体细节，但除此之外没有太多。

paras.en: While it was the PM himself who provoked a debate about a future in which the UK rejoined the EU, the brakes were firmly on in regard to any discussion of such ideas.
paras.zh: 尽管是首相本人引发了关于英国重新加入欧盟的未来的辩论，但对此类想法的任何讨论都被坚决踩住了。

paras.en: Pre-summit talk of possible closer future links with Brussels was replaced by much vaguer language about mutual “brainstorming” on what would come next, with UK officials saying any progress could be months in the making.
paras.zh: 峰会前关于未来可能与布鲁塞尔建立更密切联系的讨论被关于下一步行动的相互“集思广益”的更加模糊的语言所取代，英国官员表示，任何进展可能需要几个月的时间才能取得。

paras.en: Another sign of the caution embedded within Burnham’s ambition was the lineup of UK cabinet ministers who watched as the prime minister, von der Leyen and Costa arrived on Friday morning.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆雄心壮志中所蕴含的谨慎态度的另一个迹象是，英国内阁部长的阵容，他们目睹了首相冯德莱恩和科斯塔于周五早上抵达。

paras.en: Alongside those you might expect – Ed Miliband, the foreign secretary, John Healey, the chancellor, and Jonathan Reynolds, the business secretary – was Anneliese Midgley, a close ally of Burnham who has the job of chief whip, No 10’s liaison with Labour MPs.
paras.zh: 除了你可能想到的那些人——外交大臣埃德·米利班德、财政大臣约翰·希利和商务大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹——之外，还有安妮莉丝·米奇利，她是伯纳姆的亲密盟友，担任首席党鞭、与工党议员的10号联络人。

paras.en: She was there because a bill setting into UK law the new EU deal will be presented to parliament next week. Most Labour MPs agree with Burnham that the world has changed since 2016. But, as with the voters, he needs to bring them along with him.
paras.zh: 她在那里是因为一项将新的欧盟协议纳入英国法律的法案将于下周提交给议会。大多数工党议员都同意伯纳姆的观点，即自 2016 年以来世界已经发生了变化。但是，与选民一样，他需要让他们跟随他的脚步。

articles.title: Spain frees wealthy US-sought activist on bail as Irish police raid Dublin home
articles.author: Timothy Pratt

paras.en: In a blur of events surrounding the Trump administration’s effort to extradite James “Fergie” Chambers, Spain released the wealthy US activist and donor on bail even as Irish police raided a Dublin house owned by Chambers and his partner, Stella Schnabel, acting on a request from US authorities.
paras.zh: 在围绕特朗普政府引渡詹姆斯“菲姬”钱伯斯的努力的模糊事件中，西班牙释放了这位富有的美国活动人士和捐助者的保释，尽管爱尔兰警方应美国当局的要求突袭了钱伯斯及其伴侣斯特拉施纳贝尔在都柏林拥有的一处房屋。

paras.en: Chambers’s case is the first known instance of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money-laundering charge in the criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 钱伯斯的案件是已知的第一起美国因涉嫌支持哈马斯而寻求引渡公民的案件，这一指控显然与支持引渡请求和向帮助加沙巴勒斯坦人的组织捐款的刑事诉讼中的国际洗钱指控有关。

paras.en: Speaking outside Madrid’s Aranjuez prison upon his release on Friday, Chambers called the charges against him “baseless”, adding that his release was “hopefully the first step in recognizing that internationally”.
paras.zh: 周五获释后，钱伯斯在马德里阿兰胡埃斯监狱外发表讲话，称对他的指控“毫无根据”，并补充说，他的获释“希望是国际社会承认这一点的第一步”。

paras.en: Chambers also said: “Spain is a country that has stood on the right side of this most important issue of our time, that has stood on the right side of the genocide, and where this is some reason and some justice.”
paras.zh: 钱伯斯还表示：“西班牙是一个在我们这个时代最重要的问题上站在正确一边的国家，在种族灭绝问题上站在了正确的一边，这是有道理的，也是正义的。”

paras.en: An appeals court ordered the conditional release on Friday due to issues surrounding the legally required US translation of the extradition request’s core documents into Spanish, first reported on by the Guardian. He had been detained since 10 July, when Spanish authorities arrested him in Ibiza.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》首先报道，上诉法院于周五下令有条件释放，原因是美国法律要求将引渡请求的核心文件翻译成西班牙语存在问题。自 7 月 10 日西班牙当局在伊维萨岛逮捕他以来，他一直被拘留。

paras.en: The order asserts that the translation issues cause “a diminishment, at least for the time being, in the solidity or foundation of the extradition request”.
paras.zh: 该命令声称，翻译问题导致“至少暂时削弱引渡请求的可靠性或基础”。

paras.en: Chambers’s release follows a separate decision on Thursday by the three-judge panel at the high court tasked with deciding on the extradition to pause the proceedings in order to evaluate the impact of the alterations the US made to the original, machine-made translation of the extradition request into Spanish.
paras.zh: 周四，高等法院负责决定引渡的三名法官小组做出了暂停诉讼程序的单独决定，以评估美国对引渡请求的机器翻译的西班牙语原始翻译的影响。钱伯斯获释。

paras.en: The Guardian detailed four examples of the alterations on 7 November and the US admitted to tampering with the translation, calling them “substantial [and] inadvertent” on 17 November – and citing the same four examples. Chambers’s defense team has asserted for weeks that there are as many as 30 such alterations.
paras.zh: 《卫报》在 11 月 7 日详细介绍了四个修改示例，美国在 11 月 17 日承认篡改了翻译，称其为“重大且无意的”，并引用了同样的四个示例。钱伯斯的辩护团队数周以来一直坚称此类改动多达 30 处。

paras.en: The changes introduced prejudicial notions with specific legal implications that in turn wound up in the Spanish prosecutor’s report on the case, Aitor Martínez, a member of Chambers’s defense team, told the Guardian earlier this week. The judges must consider the prosecutor’s report in deciding on the extradition request.
paras.zh: 钱伯斯辩护团队成员艾托·马丁内斯本周早些时候告诉《卫报》，这些变化引入了具有具体法律影响的偏见观念，这些观念最终出现在西班牙检察官关于此案的报告中。法官在决定引渡请求时必须考虑检察官的报告。

paras.en: The high court was expected to rule on the extradition this week, following a 13 November hearing. But as of Thursday’s decision, the deadline has been extended indefinitely as the judges evaluate the translation, including a 345-page report submitted by the defense team that identifies 30 “incriminating changes” Trump administration officials made to a translation prepared by DeepL, “an AI-first translation platform”, according to its website.
paras.zh: 高等法院预计将于 11 月 13 日举行听证会后于本周就引渡作出裁决。但截至周四的决定，截止日期已无限期延长，因为法官正在评估翻译，其中包括辩护团队提交的一份 345 页的报告，其中确定了特朗普政府官员对 DeepL（“人工智能优先翻译平台”）准备的翻译所做的 30 个“有罪的更改”，据 DeepL 网站称。

paras.en: The decision also gives the prosecutor an opportunity to address the issue in writing, after dismissing it in the 13 November hearing by referring to “supposed translation errors”.
paras.zh: 该决定还让检察官有机会以书面形式解决该问题，此前检察官在 11 月 13 日的听证会上以“所谓的翻译错误”为由驳回了该问题。

paras.en: Chambers’s views and donations to progressive and humanitarian projects have been extensively profiled in US media, including his controversial public comments on Israel and Gaza. A week after the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks on Israel, he posted on X about Israel’s response: “Stop calling it ‘collective punishment’/There’s nothing to be ‘punished’ for/No faction of the Palestinian resistance, Hamas or other, has done *anything* wrong/It’s simply genocide/Like it has been.”
paras.zh: 钱伯斯对进步和人道主义项目的观点和捐款已在美国媒体上得到广泛报道，包括他对以色列和加沙有争议的公开评论。 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击以色列一周后，他在 X 上发布了以色列的回应：“别再称其为‘集体惩罚’/没有什么可‘惩罚’的/巴勒斯坦抵抗运动的任何派别，哈马斯或其他人，都没有做错*任何事情/这只是种族灭绝/就像过去一样。”

paras.en: The heir to $250m from his family’s business, Cox Enterprises, is being sought in extradition because of such views, his defense team has asserted throughout the case.
paras.zh: 他的辩护团队在整个案件中坚称，由于这种观点，家族企业考克斯企业 (Cox Enterprises) 2.5 亿美元的继承人正在被引渡。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Irish Garda Síochána, acting on a request from US authorities, raided a Dublin house owned by Chambers and Schnabel on Wednesday, destroying the front door and removing electronic items and other possessions, according to their attorney in Ireland, Ciarán Mulholland.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据钱伯斯和施纳贝尔在爱尔兰的律师 Ciarán Mulholland 称，爱尔兰警察局应美国当局的要求，于周三突袭了钱伯斯和施纳贝尔在都柏林拥有的一处房屋，摧毁了前门，拿走了电子产品和其他财物。

paras.en: Schnabel, who is five months pregnant, said: “It is difficult to see this raid as anything other than a desperate fishing expedition by the US authorities to find evidence to bolster their case against Fergie.”
paras.zh: 怀孕五个月的施纳贝尔说：“很难将这次突袭视为美国当局的一次绝望的捕鱼探险，目的是寻找证据来支持他们对菲姬的指控。”

paras.en: The attorney told the Guardian that the raid was the result of a “mutual legal assistance” request from the US – and that such a request “wouldn’t give [the Garda Síochána] permission to kick in the doors of someone’s dwelling in Ireland”.
paras.zh: 该律师告诉《卫报》，这次突袭是美国提出的“司法协助”请求的结果，而这样的请求“不会允许[爱尔兰警察局]允许踢开某人在爱尔兰的住所的门”。

paras.en: “It’s unusual for the Irish state to be acting in such a clandestine manner,” Mulholland said. He has asked authorities to produce a search warrant and an itemized list of what was taken. “My fear is that whatever was taken has been put on a plane and taken to the US,” he added.
paras.zh: “爱尔兰政府以如此秘密的方式行事是不寻常的，”穆赫兰说。他要求当局出示搜查令和被盗物品的详细清单。 “我担心的是，无论被带走的东西都已经被装上飞机并带到了美国，”他补充道。

paras.en: “This [extradition case] shows the complete disregard for due process … that the Trump administration seems to have,” Mulholland said.
paras.zh: “这起（引渡案）表明特朗普政府似乎完全无视正当程序，”穆赫兰说。

articles.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations

paras.en: Warning: this story contains graphic content
paras.zh: 警告：此故事包含令人不适的内容

paras.en: French authorities are investigating disgraced actor GÃ©rard Depardieu and the author Michel Houellebecq over "allegations of a sexual nature", a source with knowledge of the investigation says.
paras.zh: 据了解调查情况的消息人士称，法国当局正在对名誉扫地的演员热拉尔·德帕迪约和作家米歇尔·维勒贝克进行“性指控”调查。

paras.en: The confirmation comes after reports in French media that the two were accused of being involved in a "gang rape" on the set of the film Thalasso in 2018 by an actress.
paras.zh: 法国媒体报道称，两人被指控在 2018 年电影《海水浴》片场被一名女演员“轮奸”，此消息得到证实。

paras.en: The source told the BBC that a judicial investigation was launched after a complaint was filed in May 2025.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉 BBC，2025 年 5 月提出投诉后，司法调查启动。

paras.en: Depardieu has already separately been convicted of unrelated sexual assaults. The BBC has contacted Depardieu's lawyers and Houellebecq, an acclaimed French author and occasional actor, for comment.
paras.zh: 德帕迪约已因不相关的性侵犯罪被单独定罪。 BBC 已联系德帕迪约的律师和法国著名作家兼演员维勒贝克请其置评。

paras.en: The actress, who has not been named publicly, accused Depardieu of penetration without consent and Houellebecq of forcing her to perform oral sex, in an interview with Mediapart, a French investigative site which first reported the allegations.
paras.zh: 这位未公开姓名的女演员在接受最先报道这些指控的法国调查网站 Mediapart 的采访时，指控德帕迪约未经同意进行插入，并指责维勒贝克强迫她进行口交。

paras.en: She told the outlet that none of this had been written into the script, and that she experienced "profound humiliation" and "unspeakable shame".
paras.zh: 她告诉媒体，这些都没有写进剧本，她经历了“深深的羞辱”和“无法形容的耻辱”。

paras.en: French law stipulates as of 2025 that all sexual acts performed without consent constitute rape.
paras.zh: 法国法律规定，自2025年起，所有未经同意进行的性行为均构成强奸。

paras.en: The film's director, Guillaume Nicloux, has been accused of being complicit because he was said to have filmed the incident, Mediapart and AFP report. The BBC has contacted his agent and the Paris prosecutor's office for comment.
paras.zh: 据 Mediapart 和法新社报道，该片导演纪尧姆·尼克鲁被指控为同谋，因为据说他拍摄了这一事件。 BBC 已联系他的经纪人和巴黎检察官办公室征求评论。

paras.en: Nicloux told Mediapart that the scene had been improvised and he had not intervened as he had not observed "any constraints, verbal or physical opposition, or even discomfort".
paras.zh: 尼克鲁告诉 Mediapart，这一场景是即兴创作的，他没有进行干预，因为他没有观察到“任何限制、口头或身体上的反对，甚至是不适”。

paras.en: The site published production documents showing footage of the scene had been destroyed.
paras.zh: 该网站发布的制作文件显示，现场的镜头已被销毁。

paras.en: The actress told the outlet that she had told friends, her agent and others involved in the film's production in Normandy about the incident at the time, but only filed the complaint after other women accused Depardieu of sexual misconduct.
paras.zh: 这位女演员告诉媒体，她当时已将这件事告诉了朋友、她的经纪人和诺曼底参与电影制作的其他人，但只是在其他女性指控德帕迪约性行为不端后才提出投诉。

paras.en: The Asterix and Obelix star will next week find out whether he will stand trial for allegedly raping another actress, Charlotte Arnould.
paras.zh: 这位《阿斯特里克斯与奥贝利克斯》的主演将于下周得知他是否会因涉嫌强奸另一位女演员夏洛特·阿诺德而受审。

paras.en: On Monday, Depardieu dropped his appeal against a separate conviction for two counts of sexual assault during another film shoot, for which he was handed an 18-month suspended sentence.
paras.zh: 周一，德帕迪约撤销了对另一项电影拍摄期间两项性侵犯罪的单独定罪的上诉，他因此被判处 18 个月缓刑。

paras.en: Several other women have made allegations against the 77-year-old in the media.
paras.zh: 其他几位女性也在媒体上对这位 77 岁的老人提出指控。

paras.en: If you have been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, details of help and support in the UK are available at BBC Action Line
paras.zh: 如果您受到本文中提出的任何问题的影响，请访问 BBC Action Line，获取英国帮助和支持的详细信息

articles.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues

paras.en: Anthropic's shares have dropped back towards their initial price after a soaring first day on the stock market, as a wider tech sell-off deepens.
paras.zh: 随着更广泛的科技股抛售加深，Anthropic 的股价在股市首日飙升后已回落至初始价格。

paras.en: The fall in tech stocks continued to weigh on markets through Friday, with the S&P 500 down about 2.8% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average down more than 1% by mid-afternoon.
paras.zh: 截至周五，科技股的下跌继续给市场带来压力，标准普尔 500 指数下跌约 2.8%，道琼斯工业平均指数下午中旬下跌超过 1%。

paras.en: Both US indexes touched correction territory, a point where they are trading at 10% or more down from a recent high.
paras.zh: 两个美国指数均触及修正区间，较近期高点下跌 10% 或更多。

paras.en: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index also fell more than 4% by afternoon trading as shares in major tech companies continued to fall.
paras.zh: 由于主要科技公司的股价继续下跌，以科技股为主的纳斯达克综合指数在下午交易中也下跌了 4% 以上。

paras.en: The speed at which AI investment has been growing - with more than $1 trillion spent in the last year alone by a small handful of major tech companies - has led to ongoing concerns of a financial bubble. Questions are being raised over whether those investments will pay off, and when.
paras.zh: 人工智能投资的增长速度——仅去年一年，少数主要科技公司就花费了超过 1 万亿美元——引发了人们对金融泡沫的持续担忧。人们质疑这些投资是否会以及何时会获得回报。

paras.en: Despite a positive first day of trading, Anthropic's shares fell on Friday, dropping at one point by more than 12% to about $85, close to its initial public offering (IPO) price of $83.
paras.zh: 尽管首日交易表现良好，但 Anthropic 股价周五下跌，一度下跌 12% 以上，至 85 美元左右，接近其 83 美元的首次公开募股 (IPO) 价格。

paras.en: The artificial intelligence (AI) company's introduction to the Nasdaq stock exchange on Thursday was a crucial test for the industry and was largely seen as a success, with trading starting at $111.50.
paras.zh: 这家人工智能 (AI) 公司周四在纳斯达克证券交易所上市，对整个行业来说是一次至关重要的考验，在很大程度上被视为成功，交易起始价为 111.50 美元。

paras.en: The maker of the Claude chatbot raised a record $81bn in its initial public offering (IPO), but its share price moved significantly in the first day of trading.
paras.zh: Claude 聊天机器人的制造商在首次公开募股 (IPO) 中筹集了创纪录的 810 亿美元资金，但其股价在首日交易中大幅波动。

paras.en: The shares peaked at $115 on Thursday, before easing to end the day up 17% at $97.17.
paras.zh: 该股周四最高触及 115 美元，随后回落，最终上涨 17%，至 97.17 美元。

paras.en: Analysts said volatility was to be expected in the first days or even weeks of Anthropic's trading, as the company was the first frontier AI firm to go public so had no direct peers.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，预计 Anthropic 交易的头几天甚至几周内会出现波动，因为该公司是第一家上市的前沿人工智能公司，因此没有直接的同行。

paras.en: Some have also noted the similarities with Elon Musk's SpaceX, which at the time of its debut in June was the largest IPO on record. Shares in the rocket and AI company experienced large swings in its first few weeks of trading.
paras.zh: 一些人还指出了与埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 的相似之处，后者在 6 月份首次亮相时是有记录以来最大的 IPO。这家火箭和人工智能公司的股价在交易的头几周经历了大幅波动。

paras.en: Most tech companies see their shares fall after hitting the stock market, often after reporting quarterly results for the first time.
paras.zh: 大多数科技公司的股价在上市后都会下跌，通常是在首次报告季度业绩后。

paras.en: But many, including Meta, Amazon and Google, have gone on to become the largest and most profitable corporations in the world.
paras.zh: 但包括 Meta、亚马逊和谷歌在内的许多公司已经成为世界上最大、最赚钱的公司。

paras.en: Ed Moya, a strategist at market intelligence firm AlphaSense, said Anthropic's blockbuster IPO did not appear to have restored confidence in the broader AI market.
paras.zh: 市场情报公司 AlphaSense 策略师 Ed Moya 表示，Anthropic 的重磅 IPO 似乎并未恢复人们对更广泛的人工智能市场的信心。

paras.en: While AI demand was still very strong, Moya told the BBC that investors were trying to answer the question of how much were they willing to pay for that growth.
paras.zh: 尽管人工智能需求仍然非常强劲，但莫亚告诉 BBC，投资者正在试图回答这样的问题：他们愿意为这种增长付出多少代价。

paras.en: "As we've gone through the past past few weeks, it seems that there's been more risks that have surfaced," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“过去几周，似乎出现了更多风险。”

paras.en: "Right now you're starting to see Wall Street is trying to shift from rewarding growth at any price, to demanding stronger cash flow and a clearer path to profitability."
paras.zh: “现在你开始看到华尔街正试图从以任何价格奖励增长转向要求更强劲的现金流和更清晰的盈利途径。”

paras.en: Shares in some of the largest US tech companies also fell on Friday as the market sell off continued.
paras.zh: 随着市场继续抛售，美国一些最大科技公司的股价周五也下跌。

paras.en: Nvidia shares had plunged by more than 11% by the afternoon, while Musk's firms SpaceX and Tesla had both fallen by more than 6%.
paras.zh: 截至下午，英伟达股价暴跌超过 11%，而马斯克旗下的 SpaceX 和特斯拉股价均下跌超过 6%。

paras.en: Meta was down more than 5% and Amazon was down more than 3.5%, while Apple and Alphabet experienced smaller falls.
paras.zh: Meta 下跌超过 5%，亚马逊下跌超过 3.5%，而苹果和 Alphabet 跌幅较小。

paras.en: Europe's main stock markets - which contain fewer tech stocks - also took a hit.
paras.zh: 科技股较少的欧洲主要股市也受到了打击。

paras.en: Germany's Dax index closed down 2.6%, France's CAC 40 was down 1.9% and the UK's FTSE 100 ended trading 1% lower.
paras.zh: 德国 Dax 指数收盘下跌 2.6%，法国 CAC 40 指数下跌 1.9%，英国 FTSE 100 指数收盘下跌 1%。

paras.en: Earlier on Friday, tech-heavy Asian markets saw steep falls.
paras.zh: 周五早些时候，以科技股为主的亚洲市场大幅下跌。

paras.en: South Korea's Kospi and Japan's Nikkei 225 indexes closed down about 5%, with shares in memory chip makers Sk Hynix, Kioxia and Tokyo Electron, and other tech firms such as Samsung Electronics, seeing losses.
paras.zh: 韩国 Kospi 指数和日本日经 225 指数收盘下跌约 5%，存储芯片制造商 Sk Hynix、Kioxia 和 Tokyo Electron 以及三星电子等其他科技公司的股价均下跌。

paras.en: Taiwan's stock market dropped about 6% on Friday, taking the weekly fall to more than 17% and what was reported to be its biggest weekly fall since 1990.
paras.zh: 台湾股市周五下跌约 6%，周跌幅超过 17%，据报道为 1990 年以来最大单周跌幅。

articles.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

paras.en: Donald Trump has said he will ban US companies from building AI data centres overseas, threatening a "tremendous tax" for tech firms who do so.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将禁止美国公司在海外建设人工智能数据中心，并威胁要对这样做的科技公司征收“巨额税”。

paras.en: "We're going to keep it all in this country," the US president said, while providing little detail on the potential policy he said others in his cabinet were hearing about for the first time.
paras.zh: 这位美国总统表示，“我们将把这一切保留在这个国家”，但他并没有提供有关潜在政策的细节，他说内阁中的其他人是第一次听说这一政策。

paras.en: Data centres were a central issue in the midterm elections earlier in November, with many Democratic candidates promising tougher regulation on their construction.
paras.zh: 数据中心是 11 月初中期选举的核心问题，许多民主党候选人承诺对其建设进行更严格的监管。

paras.en: Tech giants including Meta and Google have entered agreements to build data centres overseas. It remains unclear how such a policy would be enforced if it was brought in.
paras.zh: Meta 和谷歌等科技巨头已签订在海外建设数据中心的协议。目前尚不清楚如果引入这样的政策将如何执行。

paras.en: "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centres outside of our country," Trump told reporters in a press briefing following his return from his trip to Asia.
paras.zh: 特朗普从亚洲之行回国后在新闻发布会上对记者表示：“我们不会允许我们的公司在我国境外建立数据中心。”

paras.en: "Because China will take all of them, and we're not allowing that to happen."
paras.zh: “因为中国将把它们全部拿走，我们不会允许这种情况发生。”

paras.en: But whether that idea will become policy remains unclear.
paras.zh: 但这一想法是否会成为政策仍不清楚。

paras.en: "I don't know if that's a breaking story, but I haven't even said that to my people. But I'm telling them now, they're here," he said.
paras.zh: “我不知道这是否是一个重大新闻，但我什至没有对我的人民说过这些。但我现在告诉他们，他们就在这里，”他说。

paras.en: Trump floated the policy after saying the US was leading on data centre construction, and he would not allow China to beat the US when it came to AI - which he calls super intelligence, or SI.
paras.zh: 特朗普在提出这项政策时表示，美国在数据中心建设方面处于领先地位，他不会允许中国在人工智能（他称之为超级智能，SI）方面击败美国。

paras.en: It also follows an announcement earlier this week that would restrict the export of advanced computer chips and who can access the computing power provided by them.
paras.zh: 此前，本周早些时候还宣布限制先进计算机芯片的出口以及谁可以使用其提供的计算能力。

paras.en: Washington on Monday announced firms would require a licence to buy advanced chips, so US officials can monitor whether they are being used to serve Chinese companies or they are being smuggled into China.
paras.zh: 华盛顿周一宣布，企业购买先进芯片需要获得许可证，以便美国官员可以监控这些芯片是否被用来为中国公司服务，或者是否被走私到中国。

paras.en: The move will impact South East Asian countries that have invested heavily in data centres, as Chinese companies seek to rent computing power from overseas.
paras.zh: 由于中国公司寻求从海外租用计算能力，此举将影响在数据中心方面投入巨资的东南亚国家。

paras.en: Data centres are crucial to the AI boom. The vast warehouse-style buildings house the advanced computer chips and servers that are needed to run AI programmes such as Claude and ChatGPT.
paras.zh: 数据中心对于人工智能的繁荣至关重要。巨大的仓库式建筑容纳了运行 Claude 和 ChatGPT 等人工智能程序所需的先进计算机芯片和服务器。

paras.en: As of April there were about 3,000 data centres across the US, with another 1,500 in various stages of approval and construction, according to the Pew Research Centre.
paras.zh: 根据皮尤研究中心的数据，截至 4 月份，全美约有 3,000 个数据中心，另有 1,500 个处于审批和建设的不同阶段。

paras.en: Many of them are built in rural areas, and concerns about issues including noise pollution and energy consumption helped drive Democratic candidates promising tougher rules on data centre construction to wins on 3 November.
paras.zh: 其中许多建在农村地区，对噪音污染和能源消耗等问题的担忧促使承诺对数据中心建设采取更严格规定的民主党候选人在 11 月 3 日获胜。

paras.en: "You ought to take advantage of the the data centres. Make them pay you, make them pay your community, but take advantage don't shut them off," Trump said.
paras.zh: “你应该利用数据中心。让他们付钱给你，让他们付钱给你的社区，但要利用，不要关闭它们，”特朗普说。

paras.en: "We have a lot of places that want them badly, and they're great places. They have energy and they have everything. They're tremendous assets."
paras.zh: “我们有很多地方都非常需要他们，而他们都是很棒的地方。他们有活力，他们拥有一切。他们是巨大的资产。”

paras.en: Canada has made moves to step in to offer itself as an alternative location for these sites, with less local pushback against projects so far.
paras.zh: 加拿大已采取行动介入，将自己作为这些地点的替代地点，到目前为止，当地对项目的抵制较少。

paras.en: Large tech firms - often called AI hyperscalers due to the size of their investments in AI - have also been branching out.
paras.zh: 大型科技公司——因其在人工智能领域的投资规模而通常被称为人工智能超大规模企业——也一直在进行扩张。

paras.en: In September Google announced a â¬13bn ($15bn: Â£11bn) investment in AI infrastructure in Finland, which included funding for three data centres.
paras.zh: 9 月，谷歌宣布对芬兰的人工智能基础设施投资 130 亿欧元（150 亿美元：110 亿英镑），其中包括为三个数据中心提供资金。

paras.en: Last month, building work for two of those centres was halted due to concerns over the clearance of more than 300 hectares of forest.

A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. articles.title: ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach Earns Numerous OEM Certifications
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: ProColor Collision announced that ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach earned collision repair certifications from General Motors, FCA, Hyundai and Kia. The certifications expand the shop’s OEM repair capabilities and reflect the team’s commitment to safe, high-quality repairs for customers throughout the Grand Strand.
The achievements come months after the shop earned Honda and Acura OEM certifications, marking progress for the South Carolina location.

Manufacturer collision repair certifications require shops to meet standards for technician training, specialized tools and equipment, facility capabilities and OEM-approved repair procedures. By investing in these programs, ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach is expanding its ability to repair a wider range of vehicles to manufacturer specifications.

“We’re incredibly proud of what our team has accomplished in such a short amount of time,” said Evan Anderson, co-owner of ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach. “We haven’t even been open a full year, so earning these certifications is a major milestone for us. It reflects the work our team has put in from day one to build a shop our customers can trust.”

Located at 7794 Highway 544, the 6,850-square-foot facility was purpose-built with advanced repair technology and modern equipment to support a full range of collision repair services. Co-owners Evan Anderson and John Masetti continue to invest in the training, technology and capabilities needed to serve drivers throughout the Myrtle Beach community.

“It’s exciting to see the Myrtle Beach team continue expanding what they can offer their customers,” said Nicky Woerner, vice president of sales and operations for ProColor Collision USA. “These certifications reflect an ongoing investment in the training, equipment and expertise needed to deliver safe, manufacturer-approved repairs and set the shop up for continued success.”

As the first ProColor Collision location in South Carolina, ProColor Collision Myrtle Beach continues to grow its capabilities while establishing itself as a trusted collision repair provider in the region.

articles.title: Champion It Forward Receives $50,000 Donation from LKQ
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Champion It Forward, a newly formed nonprofit dedicated to creating opportunities for the next generation of collision repair professionals, announced a $50,000 gift from LKQ Corporation to support the organization’s mission and emerging workforce development programs.

LKQ is a founding member of Champion It Forward. Its early investment will support flagship programs designed to strengthen the collision repair workforce by increasing access to mentorship and apprenticeship programs, reducing financial barriers of entry and developing scholarship programs for aspiring collision repair professionals.

“America’s drivers depend on an automotive repair industry that is staffed with talented, highly skilled professionals, and developing the next generation of that workforce is critical,” said Mark Scafati, board member of Champion It Forward and vice president of sales and marketing for North America for LKQ. “Champion It Forward has created an opportunity for companies throughout our industry to come together around that shared responsibility. LKQ is proud to contribute $50,000 to support its mission and help more individuals discover, pursue and succeed in rewarding careers in collision repair.”

articles.title: Collision Consulting provides consumer handout on new Washington claims handling rules
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: New claims handling rules in Washington State have prompted Collision Consulting to update a consumer handout that outlines how to manage auto claims in the state.
The changes went into effect Oct. 18, and are extensive.

Consumer Consulting, an appraisal and investigations company owned by Jeff Butler, states that the new rules give claimants stronger rights to inspections, written explanations, data transparency, and prompt responses.
The handout provides consumers eight rights they have while managing an auto claim.
It starts with the right to choose a repair facility.

“The insurer may not unreasonably deny your chosen repair facility’s estimate,” the handout states. “If it pays less, it must promptly disclose all reasons, explain the policy basis for rejecting the estimate or invoice, and document the decision in its claim file.”

The handout adds that consumers do not have to accept a photo-only estimate when the damage is disputed. It states that if a virtual inspection was used and there’s a disagreement over the amount of loss, the consumer can request an in-person inspection.
“The insurer must conduct its in-person inspection within five business days, unless another time is agreed,” the handout states.

Supplements and final invoices also now have a five-business day response requirement, the handout states. It adds that the insurance company is required to respond in writing to both the claimant and the repair facility with its determination of covered amounts. Rejected items must be tied to applicable policy language, the facts of the loss, or both.
Insurance companies also must explain in writing how labor and material costs and repair processes were determined, at claimant request, the handout states.

“If it relies on a database, survey, estimating system, or benchmark for labor or material pricing, request the data date, geographic source, and the businesses that supplied the cost data,” the handout adds. “A reasonable investigation may not rely solely on a database.”

Consumers also can request to be included in all insurance communication with the repair shop, the handout states. It adds that the insurer must allow claim information by email, mail, fax, or in-person delivery.
The insurance company also is responsible for the accuracy of its evaluation and must consider newly discovered loss-related damage.

“Estimates prepared by the insurer must be made by a competent person with relevant expertise, training, and experience to evaluate your damaged vehicle, and the insurer is responsible for the accuracy of its repair documentation and evaluations,” the handout states. “The insurer must consider additional loss-related damage discovered by the claimant or repair facility.”
Additionally, an investigation must not solely rely upon databases.

First-party insureds may request portions of their claim file, including estimates, notes, reports, photographs, and communications, the handout states. The insurance company has 15 business days to provide the requested documents.
Claims investigations generally must be completed within 30 calendar days or the insurer must provide written reasons and continued 30-day updates.
Lastly, the handout also gives details on the right-to-appraisal law that was passed last year.
“Under RCW 48.18.620, every automobile insurance policy with first-party physical damage coverage must include a Right to Appraisal,” the handout says.
The document gives steps on how consumers can use the right-to-appraisal:
- “Each party selects a competent and disinterested appraiser within 10 days.
- “Appraisers independently evaluate the actual cash value and amount of loss.
- “If the appraisers disagree, they select a neutral umpire.
- “If they cannot agree on an umpire, the Washington State Insurance Commissioner appoints one.
- “Any agreement by two of the three (either both appraisers or one appraiser and the umpire) is binding.
- “The appraisal process must be completed within 30 days.”

articles.title: California insurance department holding AI use public workshop, launches survey
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The California Department of Insurance (CDI) will hold a public workshop on Dec. 15 and is conducting an industry survey to help establish consumer safeguards for using artificial intelligence in insurance, according to a CDI press release.

CDI invites consumers, insurance companies, researchers, technology developers, advocates, and the public to help shape how emerging technologies are used within the nation’s largest insurance market.

CDI says input from its “Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (RUAI) Survey” and upcoming workshop will inform future regulatory and policy considerations to protect consumers while supporting responsible innovation. CDI says it is surveying a representative sample: “California-admitted insurance companies or groups that wrote at least $250 million in annual California premiums during 2025, selected California-admitted InsurTech companies, and selected insurance companies and groups that transact insurance business through managing general agents.” Survey responses are due by Dec. 30.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “AI and other advanced analytical technologies are increasingly being used across the insurance industry to support claims processing, fraud detection, customer service, underwriting support, and operational decision-making,” the release states. “While these tools can improve efficiency and enhance customer experiences, they also present risks when not properly designed, tested, monitored, governed, and overseen.
“Without appropriate safeguards, AI systems may produce inaccurate outcomes, compromise sensitive personal information, reduce transparency, or amplify unfair bias and discrimination.”
Commissioner Ricardo Lara adds that “consumers should never be left wondering whether an algorithm, rather than a fair and accountable process, determined their outcome.”

During the workshop, participants are encouraged to share their experiences, concerns, and recommendations regarding transparency, fairness, privacy, human oversight, accountability, and insurer responsibility for technologies supplied by third-party vendors. It begins at 10 a.m. For more information and to register, click here.

The release notes that the workshop won’t focus on specific regulatory text, and the invitation is not a Notice of Proposed Action. CDI says that any future formal regulatory proposal would include a separate public process and additional opportunities for public comment.

articles.title: Allstate planning round of layoffs in restructuring with AI push
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: P&C Specialist reports Allstate plans to lay off up to 10% of its employees under a company restructuring “aimed at streamlining operations in an AI-driven efficiency push.”

Sources didn’t confirm the exact number; however, they said up to 10% of Allstate’s workforce could be affected, according to the article. The company’s 2025 annual report states that it employs 53,000.

“Layoffs hit across the organization, including at unit National General and in customer service, underwriting, legal, inside sales, casualty, design, human resources, information technology, claims and support, said sources, who asked not to be named, discussing internal issues,” the article states. “The cuts are not tied to individual performance but stem from broader organizational realignment at Allstate, they said.”
Allstate hasn’t commented on the reported layoffs.
In its Nov. 5 Q3 earnings call, Allstate CEO Tom Wilson said the company will launch a personal agentic assistant (PAA) next year, which it has been working on for a year.

“The advent of personal agentic assistants, or PAAs, gives us the opportunity to serve consumers who prefer to have a machine to handle their transactions, such as Muse, Spark, Dot, you go down the list,” he said. “The introduction of PAAs creates opportunity for Allstate, given our capabilities, and an upcoming launch of our own personal agentic assistant that is focused on protection.

“To thrive in this world of highly sophisticated agents, you need sophisticated pricing, since they’re likely going to do more price comparisons. Secondly, some consumers may still have a brand preference or want a local agent, so we have a broad set of opportunities for them. When ALLIE [Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem] is fully deployed, and the PAAs have expanded their capabilities, this will give customers straight-through processing on servicing claims… Its value proposition includes more accurate pricing, given our insurance expertise, than the general-purpose PAAs will have.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Allstate began designing and building ALLIE several years ago, according to Wilson, who noted in the call that “like most companies, we are using AI to do an increasing amount of coding.”

In Q3, Allstate used AI to write over 12 million lines of code — 3.6 times higher than in Q1, Wilson said. P&C Specialist reported that Allstate also uses AI to generate or review nearly 10 million outbound claim emails annually.
In Q2, Wilson explained that ALLIE uses agentic AI “to improve customer value, lower cost, and increase growth.”
P&C Specialist notes that Allstate’s P&C unit underwriting profit fell 30.1% in Q3 to $2.02 billion from Q3 2025.

“The latest cuts follow several rounds of workforce reductions carried out under the carrier’s ‘Transformative Growth Plan,’ which was launched in 2019 to reshape distribution, introduce lower-cost products, and streamline claim processing,” P&C Specialist reports. “In one of the larger downsizings, the insurer cut 3,800 jobs in September 2020. The carrier is also overhauling its exclusive agency network of about 6,000 agents by three operating models based on agency size, staffing, and local presence.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The article notes “a broader trend across the personal lines insurance industry” regarding layoffs.

“USAA has conducted multiple rounds of layoffs in recent months, with the latest affecting at least 400 employees across its IT department,” the article states. “In October, GEICO cut about 100 employees, most of them in its Florida legal department. Farmers Insurance laid off at least 370 employees in June.”

P&C Specialist also reported in September that Allstate plans to shift “routine” customer service away from agents and into “a new service infrastructure” that includes phone, digital self-service tools, centralized service teams, and agentic AI.
In May, State Farm changed its compensation and benefits package for 19,000 agents, with some saying it would substantially reduce their earnings.

articles.title: CREF Awards Deliver $475K to Collision Schools
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) announced that 71 collision schools will receive a combined $475,000 through its 2026 Benchmark Awards program. Recipients were announced at CREF’s Benchmark Awards Breakfast held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas during the 2026 SEMA Show.

Schools were selected through CREF’s 2026 Collision School Career Readiness Benchmark Awards program, which provides financial assistance to help collision education programs overcome budgetary limitations and prepare students for careers. Benchmark Awards can be used, in line with the award category, to enhance program capabilities, attract new students or fuel innovative approaches to collision education.

These funds will help instructors strengthen programs, invest in tools and equipment, and provide hands-on training and technical skills. Based on current enrollment figures, the investments are expected to benefit more than 3,580 students this year, with improvements continuing to support future classes.

“Congratulations to the 2026 Benchmark Award recipients,” said Brenda Hogen, chair of CREF. “The Collision Repair Education Foundation is incredibly grateful to our industry partners whose generosity makes these awards possible year after year. Their continued investment demonstrates a shared commitment to strengthening collision education and ensuring that the next generation of repair professionals has the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in our industry. I also want to recognize the dedicated instructors who take the time to apply for these awards, demonstrating their determination to provide students with the best possible education despite the challenges they face.
