articles.title: NTN Holds Community Spirit & Engagement Event
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.

Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.

In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.

NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.

The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.

articles.title: Mitchell 1 Adds QuickSpecs Feature for Faster Repair Lookup
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Mitchell 1 has added a “QuickSpecs” feature in its ProDemand repair information, aimed at helping technicians look things up faster.

“When technicians need specification information, they need it immediately,” said Cami Hermann, marketing director for Mitchell 1. “QuickSpecs helps eliminate unnecessary scrolling and table hunting so users can get directly to the information they need and keep repairs moving. The enhancement is part of Mitchell 1’s broader effort to streamline technician workflow and improve efficiency throughout the repair process.”

With added integration with 1Search Plus navigation, QuickSpecs now displays only the information directly related to the search entered by the user. For example, if a technician searches for “lug nut torque,” the system immediately surfaces the matching torque specifications instead of requiring users to scroll through large tables or unrelated information, the company said.

Mitchell 1 says it also redesigned the Common Specs Quick Link experience with a cleaner accordion-style layout Instead of searching through one long table, users can jump directly to the section they need.
QuickSpecs currently supports 2015-2026 vehicles at launch, and Mitchell 1 says it expects to add coverage for 1995-2014 vehicles by the end of 2026.

articles.title: AutoZone’s Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO of customer satisfaction at AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering strong customer service remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. That means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供强大的客户服务仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。这意味着快速交付优质零件，确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

articles.title: Sonic Tools USA Relaunches Next S15 13-Drawer Toolbox
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Sonic Tools USA has relaunched its Next S15 toolbox, a 13-drawer storage unit with a load capacity of more than one ton. The toolbox can scale from a mobile service cart to a full-capacity tool center for technicians, shops and fleets.
The Next S15 measures 46.5 inches high, 65 inches wide and 26 inches deep. It includes molded bumpers, integrated side pockets, two spray can holders and a paper roll holder.

According to the company, the toolbox uses ball-bearing drawer slides with soft-close technology and provides full-extension access on all 13 drawers. An advanced drawer-blocking system provides anti-tilt protection. A stainless steel worktop with integrated side pockets comes standard for shop use and tire maintenance operations.
Applications range from compact quick-service carts to large-format storage for high-volume service and tire repair facilities, the company said.

The relaunch includes a redesigned foam insert system. Two medium foam inserts can combine to form one large insert to accommodate growing tool sets. Existing foam inserts transfer directly into the S15, allowing users to maintain their current layouts without rebuilding configurations, the company said.

articles.title: DRiV Announces Joint Venture With XGM
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: DRiV announced a joint venture with XGM Corporation Limited (XGM), an international manufacturer of automotive components. The joint venture expands DRiV’s ride-control offerings across both branded and private-label products. Retail partners across North America can now source a broader selection of private-label products through a streamlined channel. This gives retailers greater operational speed and flexibility.
paras.zh: DRiV 宣布与国际汽车零部件制造商 XGM Corporation Limited (XGM) 成立合资企业。该合资企业将 DRiV 的驾乘控制产品扩展到品牌和自有品牌产品。北美各地的零售合作伙伴现在可以通过简化的渠道采购更广泛的自有品牌产品。这为零售商提供了更高的运营速度和灵活性。

paras.en: DRiV Expands Private-Label Ride-Control Offerings
paras.zh: DRiV 扩展自有品牌行驶控制产品

paras.en: “Our customers want more choice without complexity,” said Joseph Saoud, vice president and general manager of the Americas at DRiV. “This joint venture lets us add a broader private-label range alongside the brands they already trust, with the speed and pricing to compete, and all of it through the DRiV relationship they already have.”
paras.zh: DRiV 美洲区副总裁兼总经理 Joseph Saoud 表示：“我们的客户希望有更多选择，但又不复杂。” “这家合资企业让我们能够在他们已经信任的品牌之外添加更广泛的自有品牌产品，并通过速度和价格进行竞争，而这一切都是通过他们已经拥有的 DRiV 关系实现的。”

paras.en: “By combining our manufacturing capabilities with DRiV’s customer access, product engineering and technical support, we’re creating new opportunities to serve customers with greater scale, responsiveness and speed,” said Edwin Jiang, legal representative & executive director at XGM. “This joint venture positions us to support DRiV’s continued growth and deliver high-quality ride-control solutions that meet the evolving needs of the North American market.”
paras.zh: XGM 法人代表兼执行董事 Edwin Jiang 表示：“通过将我们的制造能力与 DRiV 的客户访问、产品工程和技术支持相结合，我们正在创造新的机会，以更大的规模、更快的响应能力和速度为客户提供服务。” “这家合资企业使我们能够支持 DRiV 的持续增长，并提供高质量的驾乘控制解决方案，以满足北美市场不断变化的需求。”

paras.en: Partnership Expands Distribution Options
paras.zh: 合作伙伴关系扩大了分销选择

paras.en: Retail partners can access these expanded private-label ride-control offerings through existing distribution and fulfillment channels. The expanded offerings complement DRiV’s branded portfolio and support a more comprehensive approach to category management.
paras.zh: 零售合作伙伴可以通过现有的分销和履行渠道获得这些扩展的自有品牌驾驶控制产品。扩展后的产品补充了 DRiV 的品牌产品组合，并支持更全面的品类管理方法。

articles.title: Continental Names Head of Commercial Specialty Tires Americas
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Continental appointed Ashok Vedanayagam as head of Commercial Specialty Tires Americas. He will oversee earthmoving, material handling and port operations tire segments across North and South America.
paras.zh: 大陆集团任命 Ashok Vedanayagam 为美洲商用特种轮胎主管。他将负责北美和南美的土方工程、物料搬运和港口运营轮胎业务。

paras.en: His background includes more than two decades in leadership roles. He has worked across commercial truck tire and passenger and light truck tire businesses in multiple regions.
paras.zh: 他拥有二十多年的领导经验。他曾在多个地区的商用卡车轮胎以及乘用车和轻型卡车轮胎业务部门工作过。

paras.en: “Ashok’s extensive experience in sales, marketing, and international business leadership makes him exceptionally well qualified for this role,” said Renato Sarzano, senior vice president, Commercial Tires Americas, Continental. “His proven ability to build strong customer relationships, develop high-performing teams, and deliver results across both consumer and commercial markets will be invaluable as we continue to strengthen our Commercial Specialty Tires business throughout the Americas.”
paras.zh: “阿肖克在销售、营销和国际业务领导力方面的丰富经验使他非常适合担任这一职位，”大陆集团商用轮胎美洲区高级副总裁雷纳托·萨尔扎诺 (Renato Sarzano) 表示。 “随着我们继续加强整个美洲的商用特种轮胎业务，他在建立牢固的客户关系、培养高绩效团队以及在消费者和商业市场取得成果方面的能力得到了证实，这将是非常宝贵的。”

paras.en: Continental said the appointment supports its focus on customers in the Americas through products, industry expertise and operational execution.
paras.zh: 大陆集团表示，此次任命将通过产品、行业专业知识和运营执行来支持其对美洲客户的关注。

articles.title: TWG Names Kevin Valenzuela Data Specialist
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: The Wheel Group (TWG), a designer, developer and distributor of aftermarket wheels, tires, accessories and off-road brands, recently announced the hiring of Kevin Valenzuela. He joins the company as its new product data specialist. The company said Valenzuela brings extensive experience in automotive aftermarket catalog management, product data and technical support.
paras.zh: The Wheel Group (TWG) 是一家售后市场车轮、轮胎、配件和越野品牌的设计、开发商和分销商，最近宣布聘用 Kevin Valenzuela。他加入公司担任新产品数据专家。该公司表示，巴伦苏埃拉在汽车售后市场目录管理、产品数据和技术支持方面拥有丰富的经验。

paras.en: The Wheel Group Adds Aftermarket Data Experience
paras.zh: The Wheel Group 增加售后数据体验

paras.en: Most recently, Valenzuela served as a data analyst at Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive). There, he supported product strategy, competitive analysis, pricing, market research and catalog accuracy. His work included application validation, digital asset management and ensuring product information aligned with industry standards.
paras.zh: 最近，Valenzuela 在 Advanced Innovative Technology Corp. (TrakMotive) 担任数据分析师。在那里，他负责支持产品策略、竞争分析、定价、市场研究和目录准确性。他的工作包括应用程序验证、数字资产管理以及确保产品信息符合行业标准。

paras.en: Prior to that, Valenzuela spent nearly three years as a data support specialist focused on catalog management. He oversaw product and application data across multiple product lines. He worked extensively with ACES and PIES standards, product fitment validation, new product introductions and catalog development. His work supported major retailers and distribution platforms.
paras.zh: 在此之前，Valenzuela 担任了近三年的数据支持专家，专注于目录管理。他负责监督多个产品线的产品和应用数据。他广泛从事 ACES 和 PIES 标准、产品装配验证、新产品介绍和目录开发方面的工作。他的工作为主要零售商和分销平台提供支持。

paras.en: Valenzuela also brings a technical foundation from his earlier career with NCR Corp., where he held several technical and implementation support roles. Combined with his hands-on automotive experience, this background gives him an understanding of the automotive industry’s technical and practical sides, TWG said.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 还从他早期在 NCR Corp. 的职业生涯中获得了技术基础，他在该公司担任过多个技术和实施支持职务。 TWG 表示，结合他在汽车领域的实践经验，这种背景使他能够了解汽车行业的技术和实践方面。

paras.en: Valenzuela to Support Product Data and Catalog Management
paras.zh: Valenzuela 支持产品数据和目录管理

paras.en: In his new role at The Wheel Group, Valenzuela will help strengthen product data accuracy, catalog management and application information. His work will span the company’s growing portfolio of brands. His experience will support TWG’s efforts to improve product information, enhance digital resources and provide reliable, comprehensive product data. These efforts will serve customers and distribution partners.
paras.zh: Valenzuela 在 The Wheel Group 担任新职务后，将帮助加强产品数据准确性、目录管理和应用信息。他的工作将涵盖公司不断增长的品牌组合。他的经验将支持 TWG 改进产品信息、增强数字资源并提供可靠、全面的产品数据的努力。这些努力将为客户和分销合作伙伴服务。

paras.en: “Accurate product information is essential to our business and to the experience we deliver to our customers,” said Joe Podlovits, vice president of Marketing and National Accounts at The Wheel Group. “Kevin brings valuable aftermarket experience and a strong understanding of catalog management and industry standards. We’re excited to have him on board and look forward to the contributions he’ll make as we continue to grow our brands and capabilities.”
paras.zh: “准确的产品信息对于我们的业务以及我们为客户提供的体验至关重要，”The Wheel Group 营销和国民账户副总裁 Joe Podlovits 表示。 “凯文带来了宝贵的售后经验以及对目录管理和行业标准的深刻理解。我们很高兴他加入，并期待他在我们继续发展我们的品牌和能力的过程中做出贡献。”

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Opens First Store in King of Prussia
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Advance Auto Parts opened its first store in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, expanding access to parts, tools and expertise for local drivers and automotive professionals. The company marked the opening of the store at 125 W. Dekalb Pike with a ribbon-cutting ceremony alongside local officials and representatives from Central Montco Technical High School who were on site to accept a donation for the school’s automotive technology program.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 在宾夕法尼亚州普鲁士国王开设了第一家商店，为当地驾驶员和汽车专业人士提供了更多零件、工具和专业知识。该公司为庆祝位于 125 W. Dekalb Pike 的商店开业举行了剪彩仪式，当地官员和中央 Montco 技术高中的代表在现场接受了学校汽车技术项目的捐款。

paras.en: The donation will help students gain hands-on experience, training and career opportunities through the school’s automotive technology programs. Skilled automotive technicians continue to be in high demand, with approximately 70,000 openings projected annually through 2034, according to U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
paras.zh: 此次捐赠将帮助学生通过学校的汽车技术项目获得实践经验、培训和职业机会。根据美国劳工统计局的数据，熟练的汽车技术人员的需求量仍然很高，预计到 2034 年，每年大约有 70,000 个职位空缺。

paras.en: “We’re excited to bring Advance Auto Parts to King of Prussia and open our first store in the community,” said Eli Rosa, regional vice president, Advance Auto Parts. “In addition to serving local customers, this market hub will help strengthen support for professional technicians and nearby shops across the area. We’re proud to mark the occasion by supporting Central Montco Technical High School and the programs that help students prepare for automotive technician careers.”
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 区域副总裁 Eli Rosa 表示：“我们很高兴将 Advance Auto Parts 带到普鲁士国王，并在社区开设我们的第一家商店。” “除了服务当地客户外，这个市场中心还将有助于加强对整个地区的专业技术人员和附近商店的支持。我们很自豪能够通过支持中央蒙特科技术高中和帮助学生为汽车技术人员职业生涯做好准备的计划来纪念这一时刻。”

paras.en: “We appreciate Advance Auto Parts’ support of career and technical education,” said Craig Robinson, administrative director at Central Montco Technical High School. “This donation helps support the hands-on learning experiences that are at the core of our automotive technology program and gives students opportunities to build skills they’ll use long after graduation.”
paras.zh: “我们感谢 Advance Auto Parts 对职业和技术教育的支持，”中央 Montco 技术高中行政总监 Craig Robinson 说道。 “这笔捐款有助于支持作为我们汽车技术项目核心的实践学习体验，并为学生提供培养毕业后长期使用的技能的机会。”

paras.en: The new store also serves as a market hub – a centralized facility designed to improve parts availability and same-day fulfillment across a network of stores, enhancing hard parts coverage for professional customers, Advance Auto Parts said.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts 表示，新店还充当市场中心，这是一个集中设施，旨在提高整个商店网络的零部件可用性和当日履行率，从而提高专业客户的硬件零部件覆盖率。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

paras.en: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.
paras.zh: UAC 成立于 1988 年，总部位于德克萨斯州曼斯菲尔德，设计和供应汽车空调组件，从压缩机和冷凝器到蒸发器、干燥器、软管组件和电气零件，并有工厂审核流程和内部验证团队的支持。 NMG 最近选择 UAC 作为其一般维修业务的主要空调供应商，这一决定不仅取决于 UAC 与 NMG 团队一起计划、培训和投资的意愿，还取决于其产品目录的质量。 UAC 由首席执行官 Francisco Coll 和首席执行官 Sophia Coll Crowley 以及业务开发副总裁 Luke Masters 领导。

paras.en: Founded in 1975 by Dennis Marshall and based in Yaphank, New York, Precision International supplies more than 3,000 transmission kits and nearly 10,000 parts and components to rebuilders worldwide. The company is ISO 9001 certified and a five-time consecutive General Motors Supplier of the Year. Precision International is led by Tina Parente, President, with Frank Miller, Executive Vice President, and John Sollazzo, Vice President of Sales and Marketing.
paras.zh: Precision International 由丹尼斯·马歇尔 (Dennis Marshall) 于 1975 年创立，总部位于纽约州雅芬克 (Yaphank)，为全球重建商提供 3,000 多种变速箱套件和近 10,000 个零部件。该公司已通过 ISO 9001 认证，并连续五次荣获通用汽车年度供应商称号。 Precision International 由总裁 Tina Parente、执行副总裁 Frank Miller 以及销售和营销副总裁 John Sollazzo 领导。

paras.en: “Both companies share forecasts with us, solve problems before they reach a customer, and measure their success by whether our shops win the job,” said Tim Cox, EVP of Supply Chain, NexaMotion Group. “That is when a supplier relationship stops being a transaction and becomes a competitive advantage for everyone it touches.”
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group 供应链执行副总裁 Tim Cox 表示：“两家公司都与我们分享预测，在问题到达客户之前解决问题，并通过我们的商店是否赢得这份工作来衡量他们的成功。” “那时供应商关系不再是一种交易，而是成为它所接触的每个人的竞争优势。”

paras.en: NMG said it will present the Vendor of the Year award annually. UAC and Precision International products are available through NMG’s business brands and sales representatives.
paras.zh: NMG 表示将每年颁发年度供应商奖。 UAC 和 Precision International 产品可通过 NMG 的商业品牌和销售代表购买。

articles.title: Rare swarm of asteroids from the solar system’s youth found trailing Neptune around the sun
articles.author: Abha Jain

paras.en: Astronomers using the Vera C. Rubin Observatory have discovered two ancient Trojan asteroids trailing Neptune — the first new ones to be spotted in 15 years.
paras.zh: 使用维拉·C·鲁宾天文台的天文学家发现了两颗尾随海王星的古老特洛伊小行星，这是 15 年来首次发现的新小行星。

paras.en: The findings, published Oct. 15 in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, could improve our understanding of the early solar system while reinforcing the Rubin Observatory's potential to unearth new cosmic objects during its brisk scans of the sky.
paras.zh: 这一发现于 10 月 15 日发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上，可以增进我们对早期太阳系的了解，同时增强鲁宾天文台在快速扫描天空时发现新宇宙物体的潜力。

paras.en: Trojan asteroids are icy, rocky bodies that dwell in a planet's vicinity but don't orbit it. Instead, these asteroids orbit the sun, following the same path as the planet. Trojan asteroids exist in distinct swarms roughly 60 degrees ahead of and behind the planet. At these points, called Lagrange points 4 and 5 (L4 and L5), respectively, the gravitational tugs of the sun and the planet balance each other, essentially "locking" the asteroids in position, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 特洛伊小行星是冰冷的岩石天体，居住在行星附近，但不绕行星运行。相反，这些小行星绕太阳运行，遵循与行星相同的路径。特洛伊小行星以不同的群存在于行星前后约 60 度的位置。据 NASA 称，在这些点，分别称为拉格朗日点 4 和 5（L4 和 L5），太阳和行星的引力相互平衡，基本上将小行星“锁定”在适当的位置。

paras.en: However, very few Trojans actually hang around for billions of years. Such asteroids are likely planetary building block remnants from the solar system's infancy, and detecting them in the outer solar system can be challenging.
paras.zh: 然而，很少有特洛伊木马能够真正存活数十亿年。此类小行星很可能是太阳系初期的行星构件残余物，在太阳系外层探测它们可能具有挑战性。

paras.en: Jupiter's Trojans are the most famous; the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center notes that an incredible 15,000 of these objects have been discovered so far. But some other planets, including Neptune, also host Trojans. In fact, a 2005 study suggested that Neptune has up to 10 times more Trojans than Jupiter. Until now, though, astronomers have spotted only 28 Neptunian Trojans, with just two of these being long-term L5 members.
paras.zh: 木星的特洛伊木马是最著名的。国际天文学联合会小行星中心指出，迄今为止已发现的此类天体数量达到令人难以置信的 15,000 个。但包括海王星在内的其他一些行星也有特洛伊木马。事实上，2005 年的一项研究表明，海王星上的特洛伊木马数量是木星的 10 倍。不过，到目前为止，天文学家只发现了 28 个海王星特洛伊木马，其中只有两个是长期 L5 成员。

paras.en: There are two reasons why it's difficult to detect these rocks. First, the Neptunian Trojans are extremely faint. More critically, for nearly 15 years, the Trojan population's position in the sky relative to Earth has overlapped with the central region of the Milky Way. Consequently, bright background stars have made it nearly impossible to discern the tiny, faint asteroids, Megan Schwamb, the study's first author and a researcher who focuses on how planets and their building blocks form and evolve at Queen's University Belfast, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 检测这些岩石之所以困难有两个原因。首先，海王星特洛伊人极其微弱。更关键的是，近15年来，特洛伊族群在天空中相对于地球的位置已经与银河系的中心区域重叠。因此，明亮的背景恒星使得人们几乎不可能辨别微小而微弱的小行星，该研究的第一作者、贝尔法斯特女王大学研究行星及其构件如何形成和演化的研究人员梅根·施瓦姆在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: However, from 2025 onward, the L5 group's position has moved — albeit extremely slowly — away from the galactic plane. This has made the population slightly easier to observe. At the same time, the Rubin Observatory started scanning the entire Southern Hemisphere sky with the world's largest digital camera.
paras.zh: 然而，从 2025 年开始，L5 集团的位置已经远离银河平面，尽管速度非常缓慢。这使得观察人群稍微容易一些。与此同时，鲁宾天文台开始用世界上最大的数码相机扫描整个南半球的天空。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Rubin is pretty uniquely suited to being excellent at discovering Neptune Trojans," study co-author Kathryn Volk, a scientist at the Planetary Science Institute in Arizona, told Live Science in an email. "The on-sky density of these objects is not particularly high, so having a large field of view helps a lot!" (Rubin has a field of view equivalent to seven full moons, according to the observatory's website.) This, along with the observatory's excellent vision — which allows it to detect objects 100 billion times dimmer than Venus — enabled the discovery of the new Trojans.
paras.zh: “鲁宾非常适合发现海王星特洛伊木马，”该研究的合著者、亚利桑那州行星科学研究所的科学家凯瑟琳·沃尔克在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》。 “这些物体在天空中的密度并不是特别高，因此拥有大视野会很有帮助！” （据天文台网站称，鲁宾的视野相当于七个满月。）这一点，再加上天文台出色的视力（使其能够探测到比金星暗 1000 亿倍的物体），使得新特洛伊木马的发现成为可能。

paras.en: The new Trojan observations form part of the Rubin Science Validation Survey, a three-month-long test run that was held in mid-2025 prior to the start of the observatory's flagship decade-long Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), which is now underway. By chance, the Science Validation Survey encompassed the part of the sky containing Neptune's L5 Trojans, leading to the asteroids being photographed within three weeks of the survey's start.
paras.zh: 新的特洛伊观测是鲁宾科学验证调查的一部分，这是一项为期三个月的测试，于 2025 年中期进行，之前该天文台长达十年的旗舰时空遗产调查 (LSST) 正在进行中。一次偶然的机会，科学验证调查覆盖了包含海王星 L5 特洛伊小行星的天空部分，导致在调查开始后三周内拍摄到了这些小行星的照片。

paras.en: Following the discoveries, the researchers created computer models to determine the asteroids' orbits. These simulations revealed that the duo will continue to tag behind Neptune for a billion years. The results suggest that the asteroids' trajectories have been stable for several billion years, which means the asteroids may have been traversing these routes from the time of the early solar system. The researchers also found a third object in Rubin's data, but it had a stable orbit in only some of their simulations, leading them to classify it as a candidate Trojan rather than a confirmed one.
paras.zh: 根据这些发现，研究人员创建了计算机模型来确定小行星的轨道。这些模拟表明，这对二人组将继续跟随海王星十亿年。结果表明，小行星的轨道数十亿年来一直保持稳定，这意味着小行星可能从太阳系早期就沿着这些路线移动。研究人员还在鲁宾的数据中发现了第三个物体，但它仅在一些模拟中具有稳定的轨道，导致他们将其归类为候选特洛伊木马，而不是已确认的特洛伊木马。

paras.en: However, the two confirmed Trojans likely didn't form in place alongside Neptune. The simulations showed that the asteroids' orbits are highly tilted, just like those of the previously discovered L5 asteroids — suggesting that Neptune captured these objects as they were hurtling past.
paras.zh: 然而，这两个已证实的特洛伊木马很可能不是在海王星旁边形成的。模拟显示，这些小行星的轨道高度倾斜，就像之前发现的 L5 小行星一样，这表明海王星在这些物体飞驰而过时捕获了它们。

paras.en: Determining the properties of both the Jovian and Neptunian Trojan asteroids will help researchers understand what happened during the solar system's infancy, when the giant planets are believed to have migrated to their present-day positions, Volk said.
paras.zh: 沃尔克说，确定木星和海王星特洛伊小行星的特性将有助于研究人员了解太阳系婴儿期发生的事情，当时人们相信这些巨型行星已经迁移到了现在的位置。

paras.en: Schwamb expects the LSST to unveil many more of the hypothesized Neptunian Trojans, especially because it will survey this same patch of the sky repeatedly over the next several months.
paras.zh: 施万布预计 LSST 将揭示更多假设的海王星特洛伊木马，特别是因为它将在未来几个月内反复勘察同一片天空。

paras.en: Schwamb, M. E., Bernardinelli, P. H., Volk, K., Murtagh, J., 林 H. W. 省. L., Rivkin, A. S., Chandler, C. O., Jones, R. L., Benecchi, S. D., Jurić, M., Kurlander, J. A., Greenstreet, S., Wilson, A., West, M., & Lyttle, R. R. (2026). NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory’s first view of the Neptune Trojan L5 (Trailing) cloud: Two new long-term stable Trojans. The Astrophysical Journal Letters, 1010(2), L36. https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aead9a
paras.zh: Schwamb, M. E.、Bernardinelli, P. H.、Volk, K.、Murtagh, J.、林 H. W. 省。 L.、Rivkin, A. S.、Chandler, C. O.、Jones, R. L.、Benecchi, S. D.、Jurić, M.、Kurlander, J. A.、Greenstreet, S.、Wilson, A.、West, M. 和 Lyttle, R. R. (2026)。 NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin 天文台对海王星特洛伊木马 L5（尾随）云的首次观察：两个新的长期稳定特洛伊木马。天体物理学杂志快报，1010(2)，L36。 https://doi.org/10.3847/2041-8213/aad9a

paras.en: Abha Jain is a freelance science writer. She did a masters degree in biology, specializing in neuroscience, from the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru, India, and is almost through with a bachelor's degree in archaeology from the University of Leicester, UK. She's also a self-taught space enthusiast, and so loves writing about topics in astronomy, archaeology and neuroscience.
paras.zh: 艾卜哈·贾恩 (Abha Jain) 是一位自由科学作家。她在印度班加罗尔的印度科学研究所获得了生物学硕士学位，专攻神经科学，并且即将获得英国莱斯特大学的考古学学士学位。她也是一位自学成才的太空爱好者，因此喜欢撰写有关天文学、考古学和神经科学主题的文章。

articles.title: Voyager 1 stops sending science data ahead of its light-day milestone — but NASA has a plan
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: NASA has confirmed that its Voyager 1 spacecraft has reached a record-breaking 1 light-day from Earth — but new milestones come with old problems.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 证实，其航行者一号航天器已经达到了破纪录的距离地球 1 光日的距离，但新的里程碑也伴随着老问题。

paras.en: On Nov. 14, the Voyager mission team discovered that the nearly 50-year-old space probe had stopped sending science data back to Earth, according to NASA — a problem that the team had to deal with as recently as 2024. As of Thursday (Nov. 19), the team had not resolved the problem.
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，11 月 14 日，航海者号任务团队发现，这个已有近 50 年历史的太空探测器已停止向地球发送科学数据——该团队直到 2024 年才不得不处理这个问题。截至周四（11 月 19 日），该团队尚未解决该问题。

paras.en: But they did detect a "carrier" signal that is used to ferry science and engineering information from Voyager 1 to Earth, confirming that the probe is still powered up and pointed in the right direction.
paras.zh: 但他们确实检测到了一个“载波”信号，该信号用于将科学和工程信息从旅行者一号传送到地球，确认探测器仍然通电并指向正确的方向。

paras.en: "We have an anomaly that is not unseen before," Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager, said at a NASA news conference Thursday, adding that she is "confident" that the science data will continue flowing again soon.
paras.zh: 航行者号项目经理苏珊娜·多德 (Suzanne Dodd) 在美国宇航局周四的新闻发布会上表示：“我们遇到了以前从未见过的异常​​情况。”她补充说，她“有信心”科学数据将很快再次继续流动。

paras.en: Using the carrier signal, the team confirmed that the probe had reached its latest distance milestone of 1 light-day from Earth, or roughly 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers) away, Wednesday (Nov. 18). At this distance, which no human-made object had ever reached before, it takes a full 24 hours for radio signals traveling at the speed of light to get from Earth to Voyager 1 and vice versa. (The spacecraft's twin probe, Voyager 2, is expected to reach its own light-day in 2035.)
paras.zh: 利用载波信号，该团队确认探测器已于周三（11 月 18 日）达到距地球 1 光日的最新距离里程碑，即距地球约 161 亿英里（259 亿公里）。在这个距离上，以前没有人造物体达到过，以光速传播的无线电信号从地球到航行者一号需要整整 24 小时，反之亦然。 （该航天器的双探测器 Voyager 2 预计将在 2035 年达到自己的光日。）

paras.en: This incredible distance, coupled with the spacecraft's five-decade-old hardware, makes troubleshooting problems on the probe extremely arduous, Dodd explained.
paras.zh: 多德解释说，这个令人难以置信的距离，再加上航天器已有五年历史的硬件，使得探测器上的故障排除变得极其困难。

paras.en: "It takes two days to diagnose anything with the spacecraft — so we can't do anything fast, and the data rates are very low," she said. "We are in a realm where we're going to see more anomalies with Voyager, just due to the distance and the age."
paras.zh: “用航天器诊断任何事情都需要两天的时间——所以我们不能快速做任何事情，而且数据速率非常低，”她说。 “由于距离和年龄的原因，我们将在航行者号上看到更多异常现象。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: According to NASA, the current glitch likely stems from Voyager's onboard computer, which is responsible for collecting data from its science instruments and transmitting it back to Earth in a readable format. The team encountered a similar problem in November 2023 that prevented Voyager 1 from sharing science data until engineers solved the issue in June 2024. The mission team is approaching this new glitch the same way they solved the previous one, NASA wrote in a blog post.
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局称，当前的故障可能源于航行者号的机载计算机，该计算机负责从科学仪器中收集数据并以可读格式将其传输回地球。该团队在 2023 年 11 月遇到了类似的问题，导致航行者 1 号无法共享科学数据，直到工程师在 2024 年 6 月解决了这个问题。NASA 在一篇博客文章中写道，任务团队正在以解决前一个问题的方式解决这个新问题。

paras.en: If the fix succeeds, Voyager 1 will continue transmitting data from its two remaining science instruments — a magnetometer, which measures magnetic fields in interstellar space, and a plasma wave detector, which measures charged particles in the interstellar medium. To conserve power on the aging spacecraft, the mission team shut off some of Voyager's instruments earlier this year while powering other, more efficient ones in a "Big Bang" maneuver that should keep the probe alive through at least 2027.
paras.zh: 如果修复成功，航海者一号将继续从其剩余的两个科学仪器传输数据——磁力计，用于测量星际空间中的磁场，以及等离子体波探测器，用于测量星际介质中的带电粒子。为了节省老化航天器的电力，任务团队在今年早些时候关闭了航行者号的一些仪器，同时为“大爆炸”机动中的其他更高效的仪器提供动力，这将使探测器至少保持到 2027 年。

paras.en: However, it's only a matter of time before Voyager 1 runs out of juice and closes its mechanical eyes to the cosmos. After that, it will continue drifting through interstellar space indefinitely, carrying a Golden Record of images, music and information about life on Earth. In the meantime, Voyager will continue learning everything it can about the strange environment of the interstellar medium — the space between stars, where only Voyagers 1 and 2 have ever been before.
paras.zh: 然而，航行者一号耗尽能量并关闭其对宇宙的机械眼只是时间问题。此后，它将继续无限期地在星际空间中漂流，携带着有关地球生命的图像、音乐和信息的黄金唱片。与此同时，航海家号将继续尽其所能地了解星际介质（恒星之间的空间）的奇怪环境，此前只有航海家号和航海家二号曾经去过那里。

paras.en: Voyager 1 officially reached interstellar space in 2012, after transforming our views of Jupiter, Saturn and other solar system bodies. For more about the probe's incredible discoveries, check out our collection of Voyager 1's iconic photos.
paras.zh: 航海者一号于 2012 年正式抵达星际空间，改变了我们对木星、土星和其他太阳系天体的看法。有关探测器令人难以置信的发现的更多信息，请查看我们的航行者 1 号标志性照片集。

paras.en: See how well you know our planetary neighborhood with our solar system quiz!
paras.zh: 通过我们的太阳系测验来看看您对我们的行星邻居有多了解！

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: 'I would want to know my horse's backstory': Live Science readers share which animals they'd want to speak with
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: Recently, University of California, Berkeley ethologist Julie Elie used artificial intelligence (AI) and behavioral experiments to decode the different vocalizations of zebra finches (Taeniopygia guttata), bringing scientists one step closer to talking to animals.
paras.zh: 近日，加州大学伯克利分校动物行为学家朱莉·埃利（Julie Elie）利用人工智能（AI）和行为实验解码了斑胸草雀（Taeniopygia guttata）的不同发声，使科学家距离与动物对话又近了一步。

paras.en: Birds are just some of many animals that experts hope to understand and communicate with. Scientists are also deciphering the clicks and calls of sperm whales and humpback whales. Some animals, like cats, can change their meows depending on what they're seeking from their owners, such as food or attention.
paras.zh: 鸟类只是专家们希望了解并与之交流的众多动物中的一部分。科学家们还在破译抹香鲸和座头鲸的咔哒声和叫声。有些动物，比如猫，可以根据它们从主人那里寻求什么来改变它们的叫声，比如食物或关注。

paras.en: In the wake of Elie's new findings, Live Science asked its readers what animal they would want to talk to if they could.
paras.zh: 在埃利的新发现之后，《生活科学》杂志询问读者，如果可以的话，他们想与哪种动物交谈。

paras.en: Over 550 people voted in our poll, with 54% picking dog. The next-largest voting group, 28% of respondents, chose cat.
paras.zh: 超过 550 人参与了我们的民意调查，其中 54% 的人选择了狗。第二大投票群体（28% 的受访者）选择了猫。

paras.en: The comments reflected the obvious trend of readers wanting to speak to their pets. One commenter wrote, "Cats, simply because I've had more of them as pets over the decades than anything else. I don't think spiders would be interesting conversationalists, I'm unlikely to encounter whales here in the middle of North America, and dogs that I meet on my daily walks are only invested in the canine treats I carry."
paras.zh: 这些评论反映出读者想要与他们的宠物交谈的明显趋势。一位评论者写道：“猫，只是因为几十年来我养的宠物比其他任何东西都多。我不认为蜘蛛会是有趣的健谈者，我不太可能在北美中部遇到鲸鱼，而我每天散步时遇到的狗只会投资于我携带的狗粮。”

paras.en: Another reader said we'd never be able to understand our pets even if we could communicate with them. "Unfortunately you would have to experience the world through your nose to truly understand what they experience. To understand what a dog is thinking you would have to 'be' a dog. A problem with communicating with any non-human being, whether it be octopi, whale, cat or extra terrestrial. It seems to be a human thing that people can't just sit, observe and interpret the world around them as it is. Everything needs to be explained!"
paras.zh: 另一位读者表示，即使我们可以与宠物交流，我们也永远无法理解它们。 “不幸的是，你必须通过鼻子体验这个世界，才能真正理解它们所经历的事情。要理解狗在想什么，你就必须‘成为’一只狗。与任何非人类沟通存在问题，无论是章鱼、鲸鱼、猫还是外星人。人们不能只是坐下来观察和解释周围的世界，这似乎是人类的事情。一切都需要解释！”

paras.en: Not everyone chose cats and dogs, though. One reader wrote, "I would want to know my horse's backstory."
paras.zh: 不过，并不是每个人都选择猫和狗。一位读者写道：“我想知道我的马的背景故事。”

paras.en: Several other commenters mentioned octopuses, with one commenter saying, "I’m disappointed that octopi weren't included on the list. I've read that they are incredibly intelligent, interact with humans and are able to think and plan. Also they can shape shift and change color and patterns. I love my dogs but I don't imagine they are capable of matching the observations and conversations octopi might have."
paras.zh: 其他几位评论者提到了章鱼，其中一位评论者说：“我对章鱼没有被列入名单感到失望。我读到它们非常聪明，能够与人类互动，能够思考和计划。它们还可以改变形状、改变颜色和图案。我爱我的狗，但我不认为它们能够与章鱼可能进行的观察和对话相匹配。”

paras.en: Do you agree or disagree with these readers? Let us know in the comments!
paras.zh: 您同意还是不同意这些读者的观点？请在评论中告诉我们！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。

articles.title: This Philosopher Was One of the First People to Donate His Body to Science. Nearly 200 Years Later, Researchers Are Still Learning From It

paras.en: As a young man, English philosopher Jeremy Bentham vowed to donate his body to science, becoming one of the first people on record to make such a declaration. And he made good on his promise. After Bentham died at age 84, his remains were publicly dissected, then transformed into an “auto-icon”—a lifelike display featuring his skeleton dressed in one of his suits, which has been preserved by the University College London (UCL) ever since.
paras.zh: 英国哲学家杰里米·边沁（Jeremy Bentham）年轻时发誓要将自己的遗体捐献给科学，成为有记录以来最早做出这一声明的人之一。他兑现了他的诺言。边沁 84 岁去世后，他的遗体被公开解剖，然后变成了一个“汽车图标”——一个栩栩如生的展示，展示了他穿着一套西装的骨架，此后一直由伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 保存。

paras.en: Now, nearly two centuries later, Bentham’s body is still yielding new scientific insights.
paras.zh: 现在，近两个世纪过去了，边沁的身体仍在产生新的科学见解。

paras.en: UCL researchers recently revisited Bentham’s remains, using computed tomography (CT) scanning to create a detailed, 3D model of his mummified head. They share the process and their findings in a short film called Bentham Revealed.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学学院的研究人员最近重新审视了边沁的遗骸，使用计算机断层扫描 (CT) 扫描创建了他木乃伊头部的详细 3D 模型。他们在一部名为“Bentham Revealed”的短片中分享了这一过程和他们的发现。

paras.en: Born in 1748 in London, Bentham was a precocious child who enrolled at Oxford University at just 12 years old. Though he trained as a lawyer, he ultimately devoted his life to philosophy and writing. Bentham became best known as the founder of utilitarianism, a philosophy built around the idea that the best actions are those that produce the greatest happiness for the greatest number of people.
paras.zh: 边沁 1748 年出生于伦敦，是一个早熟的孩子，年仅 12 岁就进入牛津大学。尽管他接受过律师培训，但他最终将一生奉献给了哲学和写作。边沁因功利主义的创始人而闻名，功利主义的哲学建立在这样的理念之上：最好的行动是为最大多数人带来最大幸福的行动。

paras.en: He applied this principle to a wide range of issues, advocating for prison reform, animal welfare, women’s rights, the decriminalization of homosexuality and the abolition of slavery—positions that were considered radical in 18th- and 19th-century Britain. His ideas inspired the founding of UCL, which opened to students in 1826.
paras.zh: 他将这一原则应用于广泛的问题，倡导监狱改革、动物福利、妇女权利、同性恋非刑罪化和废除奴隶制——这些立场在 18 世纪和 19 世纪的英国被认为是激进的。他的想法启发了伦敦大学学院的成立，该学院于 1826 年向学生开放。

paras.en: But perhaps Bentham’s most radical act was his decision to donate his body to science. In his will, he bequeathed his corpse to his friend, British physician Thomas Southwood Smith, and asked him to arrange a public dissection of his body. Smith obliged, tasking anatomist Richard Dugard Grainger with carrying out the procedure five days after Bentham’s death in June 1832, according to a university statement. Smith then created the auto-icon, which he kept at his house until 1850, when he donated it to UCL. It’s currently on view at UCL’s student center.
paras.zh: 但也许边沁最激进的行为是他决定将自己的遗体捐献给科学。在他的遗嘱中，他将自己的尸体遗赠给了他的朋友、英国医生托马斯·索斯伍德·史密斯，并要求他安排对他的尸体进行公开解剖。根据一份大学声明，史密斯在 1832 年 6 月边沁去世五天后，责成解剖学家理查德·杜加德·格兰杰 (Richard Dugard Grainger) 执行手术。史密斯随后创作了这个自动图标，并将其一直保留在自己的家里，直到 1850 年他将其捐赠给伦敦大学学院。目前它正在伦敦大学学院的学生中心展出。

paras.en: Bentham coined the term auto-icon himself, defining it as “self image” or “self representation.” He hoped to inspire others to follow suit. “He imagined a future where people were making auto-icons to keep their dead relatives around,” Tannis Davidson, who led the recent research and serves as a curator at UCL's Grant Museum of Zoology, tells Live Science’s Tom Metcalfe.
paras.zh: 边沁自己创造了“自动偶像”这个词，将其定义为“自我形象”或“自我表现”。他希望激励其他人效仿。 “他想象了一个未来，人们会制作汽车图标来让死去的亲人留在身边，”最近这项研究的领导者、伦敦大学学院格兰特动物学博物馆馆长坦尼斯·戴维森告诉《生活科学》的汤姆·梅特卡夫。

paras.en: Smith tried to preserve Bentham’s head for the auto-icon, but his efforts ultimately failed, leading him to commission a wax replica instead. Bentham’s real head was displayed at the feet of the auto-icon for years, until it was stolen and held ransom for several days in 1975. After that, it was stashed away for safe keeping.
paras.zh: 史密斯试图为汽车偶像保留边沁的头部，但他的努力最终失败了，导致他委托制作蜡像复制品。边沁的真实头像在汽车图标脚下展示了多年，直到 1975 年被盗并被勒索了几天赎金。此后，它被藏起来以确保安全。

paras.en: Bentham requested that his head be preserved in “the New Zealand manner.” He was referring to the preserved heads, or mokomokai, of the Māori, New Zealand’s indigenous inhabitants.
paras.zh: 边沁要求以“新西兰方式”保存他的头颅。他指的是新西兰原住民毛利人保存完好的头颅，或称为 mokomokai。

paras.en: - Starting in the late 18th century, tattooed, decapitated and dried mokomokai became collector’s items in Britain. Since 2003, the government of New Zealand has mandated that such remains be repatriated.
paras.zh: - 从 18 世纪末开始，纹身、斩首和风干的 mokomokai 在英国成为收藏品。自2003年以来，新西兰政府强制要求将这些遗骸遣返。

paras.en: Bentham’s head is still used for research today. The team’s recent CT scans revealed that Bentham was missing several teeth and had advanced arthritis in his lower jaw, which likely caused excruciating pain. His tooth problems aren’t particularly surprising, given that the importance of regular dental hygiene was not yet widely understood. “Dentistry 200 years ago was a very different kettle of fish than it is today,” Davidson tells Live Science.
paras.zh: 边沁的头颅至今仍用于研究。该团队最近的 CT 扫描显示，边沁缺失了几颗牙齿，下颌患有晚期关节炎，这可能会导致极度疼痛。鉴于定期牙齿卫生的重要性尚未得到广泛认识，他的牙齿问题并不特别令人惊讶。 “200 年前的牙科与今天的牙科完全不同，”戴维森告诉《生活科学》杂志。

paras.en: It’s not clear whether Bentham knew about the arthritis in his jaw, but he was fully aware of his dental issues. He confided in an 1830 letter that he had “never been fond of having my teeth [extracted], but I have more than once submitted to the momentary torment to rid myself of the enduring one.” Bentham also described some of his home remedies, writing in another 1830 letter about heating a knitting needle, then applying it directly to an exposed nerve.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚边沁是否知道他下巴的关节炎，但他完全意识到自己的牙齿问题。他在 1830 年的一封信中透露，他“从来不喜欢[拔掉]牙齿，但我不止一次地忍受暂时的折磨，以摆脱持久的牙齿。”边沁还描述了他的一些家庭疗法，在另一封 1830 年的信中写道，加热一根织针，然后将其直接应用于裸露的神经。

paras.en: The recent investigation also sheds light on Smith’s attempts to preserve Bentham’s head for the auto-icon. He appears to have removed most of Bentham’s brain, but he left behind some of the dura mater, the thick, outermost membrane. Additionally, he drilled a hole through the top of Bentham’s skull, which was meant to attach it to the auto-icon using a metal rod. Smith also added highly detailed glass eyes—complete with an anatomically correct optic nerve—to the preserved head.
paras.zh: 最近的调查还揭示了史密斯试图为汽车偶像保留边沁头部的情况。他似乎切除了边沁的大部分大脑，但留下了一些硬脑膜，即最外层的厚膜。此外，他还在边沁的头骨顶部钻了一个孔，目的是使用金属棒将其连接到自动图标上。史密斯还在保存下来的头部上添加了高度精细的玻璃眼睛，以及解剖学上正确的视神经。

paras.en: One of the team’s primary goals was to learn more about the mummification process, according to Bentham Revealed. They also hoped the CT imagery might serve as a baseline for monitoring the head’s condition over time and determining how best to preserve it.
paras.zh: 据边沁透露，该团队的主要目标之一是更多地了解木乃伊化过程。他们还希望 CT 图像可以作为监测头部长期状况并确定如何最好地保存头部的基线。

paras.en: But, beyond that, they say the model of Bentham’s head could prove useful to a wide range of professionals, from healthcare providers and archaeologists to museum specialists. For example, a 3D-printed replica of Bentham’s skull could one day support teaching, research and conservation efforts.
paras.zh: 但除此之外，他们表示边沁的头部模型可能对从医疗保健提供者、考古学家到博物馆专家等广泛的专业人士有用。例如，边沁头骨的 3D 打印复制品有一天可以支持教学、研究和保护工作。

paras.en: And what would Bentham himself have thought of this modern study of his remains? That’s something the team seriously considered before embarking on the project, given the ethical sensitivities around studying human remains
paras.zh: 边沁本人会对他遗骸的现代研究有何看法？考虑到研究人类遗骸的伦理敏感性，这是团队在开始该项目之前认真考虑的事情

paras.en: Given his beliefs about scientific inquiry and the specific directives in his will, Bentham likely would have “strongly approved,” Tim Causer, a philosopher who leads the university’s Bentham Project, says in the statement.
paras.zh: 领导该大学边沁项目的哲学家蒂姆·考瑟（Tim Causer）在声明中表示，考虑到边沁对科学探究的信念以及遗嘱中的具体指示，边沁可能会“强烈支持”。

paras.en: “Bentham was of the view that you can’t advance knowledge without experimentation and observation,” Causer adds.
paras.zh: “边沁认为，如果没有实验和观察，就无法增进知识，”考瑟补充道。

articles.title: See the Rare Baby Rhinoceros Born at England's Chester Zoo, an Adorable Boost for Its Vulnerable Species

paras.en: A zoo in England is welcoming an enormous new baby: a greater one-horned rhino. Video footage captured the moment of the calf’s birth at Chester Zoo on October 11, and since then, animal care teams have delighted in watching the baby grow.
paras.zh: 英国的一家动物园正在迎来一只巨大的新生婴儿：一头更大的独角犀牛。视频片段捕捉到了 10 月 11 日切斯特动物园小牛出生的那一刻，从那时起，动物护理团队就很高兴地看着小宝宝长大。

paras.en: “The new calf is gorgeous, big and active,” Emma Evison, team manager for rhinos at Chester Zoo, tells Smithsonian magazine. “Every step of the process so far has been brilliant … and it’s a pleasure to see the calf becoming more confident and curious.”
paras.zh: 切斯特动物园犀牛团队经理艾玛·埃维森 (Emma Evison) 告诉《史密森尼》杂志：“这头新生的小犀牛非常漂亮、体型庞大且活跃。” “到目前为止，这个过程的每一步都非常出色……很高兴看到小牛变得更加自信和好奇。”

paras.en: It will be a few years before the calf gets its namesake horn, but otherwise, newborn greater one-horned rhinos “come out as almost perfect miniatures of their parents,” Evison says. Their skin folds into plates in a way that resembles a coat of armor, and learning how to inhabit their bulky bodies takes some time.
paras.zh: 埃维森说，小犀牛要过几年才能长出同名的角，但除此之外，新生的大独角犀“几乎是父母的完美缩影”。它们的皮肤以类似于盔甲的方式折叠成板，学习如何居住在它们庞大的身体中需要一些时间。

paras.en: “For the first few days, young rhinos have to work out how their legs are supposed to operate,” she adds. “There’s a bit of wobbliness.”
paras.zh: “在最初的几天里，小犀牛必须弄清楚它们的腿应该如何运作，”她补充道。 “有一点不稳定。”

paras.en: The baby is healthy, though its sex and weight haven’t yet been announced. Greater one-horned rhino calves are typically around 99 pounds, per a statement from the zoo, and by the time it’s an adult, the animal will be about six feet tall at the shoulder.
paras.zh: 婴儿很健康，但性别和体重尚未公布。根据动物园的一份声明，大独角犀牛幼崽通常重约 99 磅，当它成年时，肩高约为 6 英尺。

paras.en: The birth marks the fourth calf born to parents Asha and Beni at Chester Zoo. But after siring the calf, Beni died earlier this year from a sudden illness. “It’s lovely to know that his legacy lives on through this calf,” Tom Garland, assistant manager of the rhino team at Chester Zoo, says in the statement. And Asha “has been a brilliant mum to all her youngsters,” he adds. This most recent pregnancy lasted 15 months.
paras.zh: 这也是切斯特动物园父母阿莎和贝尼生下的第四只小牛。但在生下小牛后，贝尼于今年早些时候因突发疾病去世。切斯特动物园犀牛队助理经理汤姆·加兰在声明中表示：“很高兴知道他的遗产通过这头小牛得以延续。”他补充道，阿莎“对她所有的孩子来说都是一位出色的妈妈”。最近一次怀孕持续了 15 个月。

paras.en: Tracking a rhinoceros pregnancy isn’t an easy task. With such thick skin, rhinos are tough targets for ultrasound machines. But caretakers were able to follow Asha’s reproductive cycle by measuring fertility- and pregnancy-related hormones—like estrogen and progesterone—in her dung.
paras.zh: 追踪犀牛怀孕并不是一件容易的事。由于皮肤如此厚，犀牛成为超声波机器的棘手目标。但看护人员能够通过测量阿莎粪便中与生育和怀孕相关的激素（如雌激素和黄体酮）来跟踪阿莎的生殖周期。

paras.en: This technique also showed them when Asha was ready to breed, allowing them to safely introduce her to Beni. Rhinos are typically solitary animals outside the mating season, so knowing when they can come together is helpful for zoo scientists hoping to increase their population.
paras.zh: 这项技术还向他们展示了阿莎何时准备好繁殖，从而使他们能够安全地将她介绍给贝尼。犀牛在交配季节之外通常是独居动物，因此了解它们何时可以聚集在一起对于希望增加犀牛数量的动物园科学家很有帮助。

paras.en: Greater one-horned rhinos once lived throughout the northern region of the Indian subcontinent. But at the start of the 20th century, after widespread habitat loss and relentless hunting driven in part by demand for their horns, only about 200 were left in the wild.
paras.zh: 大独角犀牛曾经生活在印度次大陆的北部地区。但到了 20 世纪初，由于对角的需求导致栖息地大面积丧失和无情的狩猎，野生动物只剩下约 200 只。

paras.en: Thanks to decades of conservation efforts and strict protections, the rhinos have come back from the edge of extinction, with some 4,000 of them now living in the wetlands, forests and grasslands of northern India and Nepal.
paras.zh: 经过几十年的保护努力和严格保护，犀牛已经从灭绝的边缘复活，目前约有4000头犀牛生活在印度北部和尼泊尔的湿地、森林和草原上。

paras.en: The species remains vulnerable to extinction, however, and the animals still face risks. Between January 2021 and December 2024, poachers killed nine greater one-horned rhinos in India, and another four were killed in Nepal, Spoorthy Raman reported for Mongabay last year. Many of the wild rhinos are concentrated in only a few national parks, a distribution that “makes them vulnerable to illness and environmental changes,” Mark Brayshaw, the Chester Zoo’s head of mammals, says in the statement. Though the rhinos have more conservation guardrails than they once did, he notes, “they still need people to love and protect them.”
paras.zh: 然而，该物种仍然容易灭绝，动物仍然面临风险。据《Spoorthy Raman》去年为 Mongabay 报道，2021 年 1 月至 2024 年 12 月期间，偷猎者在印度杀死了 9 头大独角犀，在尼泊尔又杀死了 4 头。切斯特动物园哺乳动物负责人马克·布雷肖(Mark Brayshaw)在声明中表示，许多野生犀牛只集中在几个国家公园内，这种分布“使它们容易受到疾病和环境变化的影响”。他指出，尽管犀牛比以前有了更多的保护护栏，“它们仍然需要人们爱护和保护它们。”

paras.en: Chester Zoo belongs to a breeding project across Europe that’s working to conserve the rhino species. And this calf is a key part of that effort, since it belongs to a genetically valuable lineage.
paras.zh: 切斯特动物园属于欧洲各地的一个繁殖项目，致力于保护犀牛物种。这头小牛是这项努力的关键部分，因为它属于具有遗传价值的血统。

paras.en: “Asha is an important rhino, because her genetic line is not over-represented in this population,” Evison says. Even though her species has seen recent success in the wild, “you don’t know what might happen down the line, so it’s important to have that insurance population of healthy individuals in human care.”
paras.zh: “阿莎是一头重要的犀牛，因为她的遗传系在这个种群中并没有过多，”埃维森说。尽管她的物种最近在野外取得了成功，“你不知道接下来会发生什么，所以让人类照顾的健康个体的保险群体很重要。”

paras.en: “Every birth is important for the future of this species,” Garland says in the statement, “and it’s wonderful to see another healthy arrival.”
paras.zh: 加兰在声明中说：“每一次出生对于这个物种的未来都很重要，很高兴看到另一个健康的到来。”

articles.title: Harvard Returns Two Skulls Likely Belonging to Enslaved Individuals, More Than 150 Years After They Were Taken From Brazil for Eugenics Studies

paras.en: More than a century and a half after their remains were removed from Brazil, sent to the United States and used in eugenics studies at Harvard University, the skulls of two people of African descent have finally returned to Brazil.
paras.zh: 在两个非洲人后裔的遗体被从巴西运回美国并用于哈佛大学优生学研究一个半世纪后，两个非洲人后裔的头骨终于回到了巴西。

paras.en: Last week, the Brazilian government formally repatriated the remains from Harvard’s Peabody Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology, marking the transfer with official ceremonies in the cities of Rio de Janeiro and Salvador, according to a statement. The skulls were carried aboard flights in padded boxes inside reinforced suitcases by Brazilian diplomats, concluding a four-year recovery campaign, the Guardian’s Tiago Rogero reports.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，上周，巴西政府正式从哈佛大学皮博迪考古与民族学博物馆归还了遗骸，并在里约热内卢和萨尔瓦多举行了官方仪式，标志着这一转移。据《卫报》的蒂亚戈·罗杰罗报道，巴西外交官将这些头骨装在加固手提箱内的软垫盒子里带上飞机，结束了为期四年的恢复行动。

paras.en: “The repatriation of human remains represents a fundamental step towards recognizing the memory, history and dignity of the Black population of our country,” Brazil’s minister of human rights and citizenship, Janine Mello, said at the ceremony, according to the Art Newspaper’s Gabriella Angeleti. “More than a century after they were taken from Brazil, these remains will return to the country to receive the dignified treatment to which they are entitled, in a process built on respect for memory, religious traditions and the communities involved.”
paras.zh: 据《艺术报》的加布里埃拉·安杰莱蒂报道，巴西人权和公民事务部长珍妮·梅洛在仪式上表示：“遗骸的归还代表着向承认我国黑人的记忆、历史和尊严迈出了根本性的一步。” “在从巴西被带走一个多世纪后，这些遗骸将返回该国，在尊重记忆、宗教传统和相关社区的基础上，接受他们应有的有尊严的待遇。”

paras.en: During the trans-Atlantic slave trade, over four million enslaved Africans disembarked in Brazil—more than in any other destination in the Americas. Brazil was the last country in the Western Hemisphere to abolish slavery, in 1888.
paras.zh: 在跨大西洋奴隶贸易期间，超过 400 万被奴役的非洲人在巴西上岸，这一数字比美洲任何其他目的地都多。巴西于 1888 年成为西半球最后一个废除奴隶制的国家。

paras.en: Eugenics emerged in the 19th century as the racist, pseudoscientific belief in the selective breeding of human beings. Universities like Harvard at times supported the eugenics movement, with faculty conducting since-discredited research into racial hierarchies. Exploiting enslaved people and their remains under the guise of science was “widespread,” historians Ayah Nuriddin, Graham Mooney and Alexandre I.R. White wrote in a 2020 Lancet article. “American medical education relied on the theft, dissection and display of bodies, many of whom were Black.”
paras.zh: 优生学出现于 19 世纪，是对人类选择性育种的种族主义、伪科学信仰。像哈佛大学这样的大学有时会支持优生学运动，教员们对种族等级制度进行了后来不可信的研究。历史学家阿亚·努里丁 (Ayah Nuriddin)、格雷厄姆·穆尼 (Graham Mooney) 和亚历山大·I.R. (Alexandre I.R.) 认为，打着科学幌子剥削被奴役者及其遗体的现象“普遍存在”。怀特在 2020 年《柳叶刀》文章中写道。 “美国医学教育依赖于盗窃、解剖和展示尸体，其中许多是黑人。”

paras.en: The existence of the two Brazilian skulls at Harvard came to public light in 2022 through a book by historian Christopher D.E. Willoughby and reporting in the student-run Harvard Crimson, which found that the university held remains from at least 19 people likely enslaved in the United States, the Caribbean and Brazil, Rogero reported last year in the Guardian.
paras.zh: 2022 年，历史学家 Christopher D.E. 撰写的一本书使哈佛大学存在两个巴西头骨的事实曝光。罗杰罗去年在《卫报》上报道称，威洛比和学生运营的《哈佛深红报》进行了报道，该报发现该大学保存着至少 19 具可能在美国、加勒比海和巴西被奴役的人的遗骸。

paras.en: While a 2022 university report recommended the repatriation of the remains and Brazilian researchers continued to push for the skulls’ return, negotiations only gained momentum after Brazil’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs joined the talks in late 2024, historian João José Reis told the Guardian last year.
paras.zh: 历史学家若昂·何塞·雷斯 (João José Reis) 去年告诉《卫报》，虽然 2022 年的一份大学报告建议归还遗骸，巴西研究人员也继续推动归还头骨，但在巴西外交部于 2024 年底加入谈判后，谈判才取得了进展。

paras.en: One of the skulls, transferred to the Federal University of Bahia in Salvador, is believed to belong to an enslaved man of Nagô, or Yoruba, origin who fought and died in the January 1835 Malê Revolt, the largest urban slave rebellion in Brazilian history. During that uprising roughly 600 enslaved and freed African Muslims attempted to take control of Salvador before police suppressed the revolt, killing 70 participants. After the man died of his wounds at a Salvador hospital, U.S. diplomat and sugar trader Gideon T. Snow allegedly took his head and shipped it to Boston alongside a note laden with eugenicist beliefs, describing the unnamed man as “one of the chiefs in the affair,” per the Guardian.
paras.zh: 其中一个头骨被转移到萨尔瓦多的巴伊亚联邦大学，据信属于一名来自纳戈（即约鲁巴）的奴隶，他在 1835 年 1 月的马莱起义中战斗并死亡，这是巴西历史上最大的城市奴隶起义。在那次起义中，大约 600 名被奴役和获得自由的非洲穆斯林试图控制萨尔瓦多，但警察镇压了起义，造成 70 名参与者死亡。据《卫报》报道，这名男子在萨尔瓦多一家医院因伤去世后，美国外交官兼糖商吉迪恩·T·斯诺据称将他的头颅运往波士顿，并附上一张载有优生学信仰的字条，将这名未透露姓名的男子描述为“这起事件的主要负责人之一”。

paras.en: Members of the Bahia Islamic Cultural Center in Salvador and the advocacy group Arakunrin campaigned for his return so he could receive a proper burial. “He is our brother and deserves to be buried under Islamic rites,” Sheikh Abdul Hameed Ahmad, the founder of the center, told the Guardian in 2025. Funeral rituals were often denied to enslaved individuals who died in Brazil, per researcher Hannah Romã Bellini Sarno.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦多巴伊亚伊斯兰文化中心和倡导组织 Arakunrin 的成员呼吁他返回，以便他能得到适当的埋葬。该中心创始人谢赫·阿卜杜勒·哈米德·艾哈迈德 (Sheikh Abdul Hameed Ahmad) 在 2025 年告诉《卫报》：“他是我们的兄弟，应该按照伊斯兰仪式安葬。”研究员汉娜·罗曼·贝利尼·萨尔诺 (Hannah Romã Bellini Sarno) 表示，在巴西死去的奴隶常常被拒绝举行葬礼。

paras.en: Less is known about the second skull, which was entrusted to the National Museum of the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro. It had been held at the Peabody Museum since 1870, following a transfer from Harvard’s Museum of Comparative Zoology. Museum records indicate that it was obtained by Walter Hunnewell, a Harvard graduate who served as photographer on an 1865-1866 expedition to Brazil led by naturalist Louis Agassiz, with an accompanying note stating the remains had been “exhumed in the streets of Rio de Janeiro,” per the Art Newspaper.
paras.zh: 关于第二个头骨，人们知之甚少，它被托付给里约热内卢联邦大学国家博物馆。自 1870 年起，该展览从哈佛大学比较动物学博物馆转移到皮博迪博物馆举办。博物馆记录显示，该遗骸由哈佛大学毕业生沃尔特·亨内维尔 (Walter Hunnewell) 获得，他在 1865 年至 1866 年博物学家路易斯·阿加西 (Louis Agassiz) 率领的巴西探险队中担任摄影师，并附有一张注释，据《艺术新闻》报道，遗骸是“在里约热内卢的街道上挖掘出来的”。

paras.en: Based on the skull’s size, Harvard researchers suggested it likely belonged to an adult woman. By cross-referencing 19th-century diaries, letters and maps, Bruno Véras, a historian at the University of Toronto Mississauga, concluded the remains may have been taken from Rio’s Cemitério dos Pretos Novos, a burial ground for newly arrived Africans who died during or shortly after arriving in Brazil. “To steal a skull and take it to another country was violent even in the context of racist research,” Veras tells the Guardian.
paras.zh: 根据头骨的大小，哈佛大学的研究人员认为它可能属于一名成年女性。通过交叉参考 19 世纪的日记、信件和地图，多伦多大学密西沙加分校的历史学家布鲁诺·维拉斯 (Bruno Véras) 得出结论，这些遗骸可能是从里约热内卢的新墓地 (Cemitério dos Pretos Novos) 中取出的，这是一个埋葬在抵达巴西期间或抵达后不久死亡的新抵达的非洲人的墓地。 “即使在种族主义研究的背景下，偷走头骨并将其带到另一个国家也是暴力行为，”维拉斯告诉卫报。

paras.en: “This return represents a historical responsibility for the museum,” Juliana Sayão, deputy director of the national museum, said during the Rio ceremony, per the Art Newspaper. “We are confronted with the story of a person whose life was shaped by enslavement and the removal of her body from Brazil. Beyond assuming temporary custody, we are committed to treating this history with respect and responsibility.”
paras.zh: 据《艺术新闻》报道，国家博物馆副馆长朱莉安娜·萨亚奥 (Juliana Sayão) 在里约开幕式上表示：“这次回归代表了博物馆的历史责任。” “我们面临着一个人的故事，她的生活因奴役和被从巴西运走而改变。除了暂时拘留之外，我们还致力于以尊重和负责任的态度对待这段历史。”

paras.en: Neither skull will be publicly exhibited or have its image released. Forensic anthropologists at the two Brazilian universities will conduct measurements and microscopic examinations—and, if authorized, genetic or dating analyses—to confirm the individuals’ sex and origins before both are laid to rest with religious rites.
paras.zh: 这两个头骨都不会公开展示，也不会发布其图像。巴西两所大学的法医人类学家将进行测量和显微镜检查，并在获得授权的情况下进行基因或年代测定分析，以确认个体的性别和起源，然后再以宗教仪式安葬这两个人。

paras.en: For Brazilian officials, the return marks both a reckoning and a beginning. “This history of slavery cannot be undone,” Irina Feisthauer Silveira, one of the diplomats who escorted the remains back to Brazil, tells the Guardian. “But acknowledging the mistakes of the past with transparency is a first step towards building a more equal, just and less violent future.”
paras.zh: 对于巴西官员来说，回归既是一次清算，也是一个开始。 “这段奴隶制的历史无法挽回，”护送遗体返回巴西的外交官之一伊琳娜·费斯托尔·西尔维拉 (Irina Feisthauer Silveira) 告诉《卫报》。 “但以透明的方式承认过去的错误是建立一个更加平等、公正和更少暴力的未来的第一步。”

articles.title: This 16-Year-Old Founded an AI Missile Startup. He’s Targeting ‘Cost per Kill’
articles.author: Joel Khalili

paras.en: At 16 years old, Henrijs Dandzbergs is too young to vote. Or drink. Or smoke. Or drive unsupervised. But he’s not too young to win half a million dollars for his AI-guided-missile startup.
paras.zh: Henrijs Dandzbergs 16 岁，还太年轻，无法投票。或者喝酒。或者抽烟。或者在无人监管的情况下驾驶。但他的年纪并不小，足以为他的人工智能制导导弹初创公司赢得 50 万美元。

paras.en: In September, Dandzbergs, who was born in Latvia, was admitted to Y Combinator’s fall 2026 cohort. The startup accelerator counts companies like Airbnb, Stripe, DoorDash, and Reddit among its alumni; Dandzbergs is likely the youngest solo founder in its vaunted history.
paras.zh: 9 月，出生于拉脱维亚的 Dandzbergs 被 Y Combinator 2026 年秋季入学录取。该创业加速器的校友包括 Airbnb、Stripe、DoorDash 和 Reddit 等公司；丹兹伯格可能是其引以为豪的历史上最年轻的独立创始人。

paras.en: His startup, Polemos Industries, is attempting to develop a new class of precision-guided missile that can be easily and cheaply manufactured, can be fired from portable launchers, and can resist jamming attempts. “I think missiles are the coolest thing,” Dandzbergs tells WIRED. “A lot of people that have found success in engineering early on have had a passion for blowing stuff up.”
paras.zh: 他的初创公司 Polemos Industries 正在尝试开发一种新型精确制导导弹，这种导弹可以轻松且廉价地制造，可以从便携式发射器发射，并且可以抵抗干扰尝试。 “我认为导弹是最酷的东西，”丹兹伯格告诉《连线》杂志。 “许多早期在工程领域取得成功的人都热衷于炸毁东西。”

paras.en: In conversation, Dandzbergs is poised and articulate. He talks about “attacking hard problems,” breaking things down to “first principles,” and how the Ukraine conflict has forever altered the theater of war—a personal fixation, given his country's proximity to Russia. He projects an unassailable confidence in his own abilities.
paras.zh: 在谈话中，丹兹伯格泰然自若、善于表达。他谈到了“解决难题”、将事情分解为“首要原则”，以及乌克兰冲突如何永远改变了战区——考虑到乌克兰与俄罗斯毗邻，这是他个人的执念。他对自己的能力表现出无可置疑的信心。

paras.en: “He’s a pretty exceptional person,” says Harj Taggar, a YC partner assigned to mentor Dandzbergs. “I’m still somewhat in disbelief that we’re talking about a 16-year-old.”
paras.zh: “他是一个非常杰出的人，”被指派指导丹兹伯格的 YC 合伙人 Harj Taggar 说道。 “我还是有点难以置信我们谈论的是一个 16 岁的孩子。”

paras.en: Dandzbergs has resolved to apply these unusual talents to figuring out how to optimize targeted killing. His startup’s guiding ambition, according to its investor one-pager, is to bring down the “cost per kill.”
paras.zh: 丹兹伯格决心运用这些不寻常的才能来找出如何优化定点清除的方法。据其投资者单页报称，他的初创公司的指导目标是降低“每次杀戮成本”。

paras.en: As a young(er) kid, Dandzbergs was rarely in one place for long; his family moved between Latvia, Indonesia, Australia, and Spain. His surfer father, part owner of an insurance company, likes to go wherever he might find the raddest waves.
paras.zh: 当丹兹伯格还是个小孩子时，他很少在一个地方待太久。他的家人在拉脱维亚、印度尼西亚、澳大利亚和西班牙之间迁徙。他的冲浪者父亲是一家保险公司的股东，他喜欢去任何可能发现最猛烈波浪的地方。

paras.en: Early in his schooling, which mostly took place online, Dandzbergs demonstrated a clear talent for science and math. His room started to look like a lab, littered with schematics, robotics, Raspberry Pis, and 3D-printed components.
paras.zh: 丹兹伯格在他的早期教育（主要是在网上进行）中表现出了明显的科学和数学天赋。他的房间开始看起来像一个实验室，到处都是原理图、机器人、Raspberry Pi 和 3D 打印组件。

paras.en: When Covid struck, Dandzbergs’ family returned to Latvia. His parents enrolled him in Astra Nova, an Elon Musk–linked school where students undergo an experimental curriculum built around lateral thinking and problem-solving instead of rote memorization. Dandzbergs took a class taught by a NASA employee and became fascinated by aerospace engineering. His lab creations became ever more elaborate: a bionic arm, a thermal control system for a model rocket, sensors for a self-flying drone.
paras.zh: 当新冠疫情来袭时，丹兹伯格的家人回到了拉脱维亚。他的父母把他送进了阿斯特拉诺瓦（Astra Nova），这是一所与埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）有联系的学校，学生们在那里接受围绕横向思维和解决问题而不是死记硬背的实验课程。丹兹伯格参加了美国宇航局员工教授的课程，并开始对航空航天工程着迷。他的实验室创作变得越来越复杂：仿生手臂、模型火箭的热控制系统、自动飞行无人机的传感器。

paras.en: Around this time, Russia invaded Ukraine. In Latvia, Dandzbergs started to see military jets overhead, and stray missiles were intercepted at the Russian border. With the sovereignty of Eastern European nations under threat, new defense startups began to pop up across the region. Dandzbergs wanted in.
paras.zh: 大约在这个时候，俄罗斯入侵了乌克兰。在拉脱维亚，丹兹伯格开始看到军用飞机上空，并且在俄罗斯边境拦截了流弹。随着东欧国家的主权受到威胁，新的国防初创公司开始在该地区涌现。丹兹伯格想要加入。

paras.en: “A patriotic intention to protect my country, European countries, and Ukrainian and American soldiers, and understanding the future of autonomous warfare—that’s my drive,” he says.
paras.zh: “保护我的国家、欧洲国家、乌克兰和美国士兵的爱国意图，以及了解自主战争的未来——这就是我的动力，”他说。

paras.en: To stretch his technical skills, Dandzbergs started to take part in hackathons, where software and hardware engineers compete to develop the most sophisticated prototype from scratch.
paras.zh: 为了拓展他的技术技能，丹兹伯格开始参加黑客马拉松，软件和硬件工程师竞相从头开始开发最复杂的原型。

paras.en: In April of this year, he flew to London to take part in a hackathon held by Unicorn Mafia, an invitation-only group of developers. The prize included $10,000 in cash, a plane ticket to San Francisco, and free legal assistance with O-1 visa applications to stay in the US.
paras.zh: 今年 4 月，他飞往伦敦参加 Unicorn Mafia（仅限受邀的开发者组织）举办的黑客马拉松。奖品包括 10,000 美元现金、一张飞往旧金山的机票，以及申请留在美国的 O-1 签证的免费法律援助。

paras.en: Less than 48 hours later, Dandzbergs and his two teammates, Aleksandrs Tihenko and Kai Yang, had built an AI system that could design hardware circuit boards from natural language prompts, much like how a software engineer might use AI to generate code. Though his teammates are both a few years older, Dandzbergs pushed for them to include even more intricate features in the prototype. “It was amazing,” says Tihenko. “The imagination of Henrijs in the hardware space is just crazy.”
paras.zh: 不到 48 小时后，Dandzbergs 和他的两名队友 Aleksandrs Tihenko 和 Kai Yang 构建了一个 AI 系统，可以根据自然语言提示设计硬件电路板，就像软件工程师使用 AI 生成代码一样。尽管他的队友都比他年长几岁，但丹兹伯格仍敦促他们在原型中加入更复杂的功能。 “这太棒了，”蒂亨科说。 “Henrijs 在硬件领域的想象力太疯狂了。”

paras.en: Seeing that they stood no chance of beating Dandzbergs’ group and other front-runners, teams started to drop out of the competition, according to Fergus McKenzie-Wilson, Unicorn Mafia’s director and one of the hackathon judges. “What they built was incredibly impressive,” he says. “No one had ever seen that before.”
paras.zh: Unicorn Mafia 总监、黑客马拉松评委之一弗格斯·麦肯齐-威尔逊 (Fergus McKenzie-Wilson) 表示，由于没有机会击败丹兹伯格团队和其他领跑者，各团队开始退出比赛。 “他们建造的东西令人难以置信，”他说。 “以前没有人见过这种情况。”

paras.en: When the organizers crowned Dandzbergs’ team victorious, somebody handed him the mic. “I’m 16 years old,” he said.
paras.zh: 当组织者宣布丹兹伯格的团队获胜时，有人把麦克风递给了他。 “我今年 16 岁了，”他说。

paras.en: The week after the hackathon, Dandzbergs and his teammates pitched their circuit board concept to YC. They won a place in the summer program, but Dandzbergs wavered over whether he should drop out of high school. The trio also sparred over whether the startup should focus on applying the technology to the defense sector, Dandzbergs’ primary area of interest. Dandzbergs ended up pulling out of the partnership. “It was hard,” says Tihenko. “But ultimately we just settled that the best decision for the company would be to part ways and focus on different things.”
paras.zh: 黑客马拉松结束后一周，Dandzbergs 和他的队友向 YC 推销了他们的电路板概念。他们赢得了暑期项目的名额，但丹兹伯格在是否应该从高中退学的问题上犹豫不决。三人还就初创公司是否应该专注于将技术应用于国防部门（Dandzbergs 的主要兴趣领域）进行了争论。丹兹伯格最终退出了合作关系。 “这很难，”蒂亨科说。 “但最终我们决定，对公司来说最好的决定是分道扬镳，专注于不同的事情。”

paras.en: By the summer, Danzbergs was set on building a defense startup and reapplied to YC on his own. He had spotted a gap in the market, he claimed, for AI-guided missiles that were more precise and could carry bigger warheads than the drones deployed widely in Ukraine. His products, he added, would be cheaper and easier to manufacture than hulking great rocket systems.
paras.zh: 到了夏天，Danzbergs 决定建立一家国防初创公司，并自己重新向 YC 提出申请。他声称，他发现了人工智能制导导弹的市场空白，这种导弹比乌克兰广泛部署的无人机更精确，可以携带更大的弹头。他补充说，他的产品比笨重的大型火箭系统更便宜、更容易制造。

paras.en: YC initially tried to steer him away. Dandzbergs was promising a lot of everything, all at once. It wasn’t clear whether his idea could work or whether pulling out of school was the right thing for him to do. “There’s a paternal element to it,” says Taggar. “You don’t want to be screwing up people's lives—and working on a startup is a pretty serious thing.”
paras.zh: YC 最初试图引导他离开。丹兹伯格一次性承诺了很多事情。目前尚不清楚他的想法是否可行，也不清楚退学对他来说是否是正确的选择。 “其中有一种父性元素，”塔加尔说。 “你不想搞砸人们的生活——而在一家初创公司工作是一件非常严肃的事情。”

paras.en: Dandzbergs is up against a fleet of defense companies—from Anduril to CoAspire to Leidos—aiming to develop cheaper, mass-producible missiles. The more sophisticated the guidance system, the more difficult that task becomes.
paras.zh: 丹兹贝格面临着从 Anduril 到 CoAspire 到 Leidos 等一系列国防公司的挑战，这些公司旨在开发更便宜、可大规模生产的导弹。制导系统越复杂，任务就越困难。

paras.en: “You can build a cheap missile that doesn’t go very far. You can build a cheap missile that doesn’t carry much of a payload. You can build a cheap missile that has a low reliability rate,” says Tom Karako, director of the Missile Defense Project and senior fellow at the Center for Strategic and International Studies. “There are trade-offs.”
paras.zh: 导弹防御项目主任兼战略与国际研究中心高级研究员汤姆·卡拉科（Tom Karako）表示：“你可以制造出射程不太远的廉价导弹。你可以制造出携带不多的有效载荷的廉价导弹。你可以制造出可靠性较低的廉价导弹。” “这是需要权衡的。”

paras.en: But Dandzbergs wasn’t going to be dissuaded, and YC figured that somebody else would probably invest in his idea. The incubator invited him to join its fall program. “Big picture, you never know if these things are possible or not,” says Taggar. “Is it a non-zero-percent chance that it could be possible? That’s frankly the threshold, especially if it’s a really big [idea].”
paras.zh: 但 Dandzbergs 不会被劝阻，YC 认为其他人可能会投资他的想法。孵化器邀请他加入秋季项目。 “从大局来看，你永远不知道这些事情是否可能，”塔加尔说。 “这可能的可能性不是零吗？坦率地说，这是门槛，特别是如果它是一个非常大的[想法]。”

paras.en: So far, according to Dandzbergs, Polemos Industries has developed the software system that will guide its missiles and has begun to hammer out elements of the hardware design. By the time the YC program finishes in December, he hopes to be able to showcase a prototype missile.
paras.zh: 丹兹伯格斯表示，到目前为止，波莱莫斯工业公司已经开发出了用于导弹制导的软件系统，并开始敲定硬件设计的要素。当 YC 项目于 12 月结束时，他希望能够展示导弹原型。

paras.en: If he does ultimately succeed, though, Dandzbergs will need to confront an assortment of hairy ethical quandaries. Who should have access to these new missiles? What if a technical error were to result in friendly fire? Can he make peace with his technology being used to end somebody’s life?
paras.zh: 不过，如果丹兹伯格最终成功，他将需要面对一系列棘手的道德困境。谁应该有权使用这些新型导弹？如果技术错误导致误伤怎么办？他能接受他的技术被用来结束某人的生命吗？

paras.en: Dandzbergs claims that he has come to terms with these issues. He says he takes solace in the belief that his motivations are pure: to protect the US and its European allies.
paras.zh: 丹兹伯格声称他已经接受了这些问题。他说，他感到安慰的是，他相信自己的动机很纯粹：保护美国及其欧洲盟友。

paras.en: By his logic, autonomous weapons are an inevitable part of the future, so he might as well be the one who builds them. “I choose not to shy away from the emergence of modern conflict as a global issue. I simply don’t have a lot of respect for people that do,” he says. “I want to be part of it. I want to move with the future of warfare.”
paras.zh: 按照他的逻辑，自主武器是未来不可避免的一部分，所以他也可能是制造这些武器的人。 “我选择不回避现代冲突作为一个全球性问题的出现。我只是不太尊重那些这样做的人，”他说。 “我想成为其中的一部分。我想与战争的未来一起前进。”

paras.en: But others who have found themselves in a similar position say it’s difficult to know in advance how somebody will deal with the knowledge that their invention has killed people.
paras.zh: 但其他处于类似境地的人表示，很难提前知道人们会如何处理他们的发明杀死了人的情况。

paras.en: McKenzie-Wilson, the Unicorn Mafia director, launched a drone startup in his early twenties. Initially, he had meant for the drones to evacuate wounded soldiers, but after a missile company invested, his startup retooled its technology to drop payloads too. He left around the same time.
paras.zh: 独角兽黑手党主任麦肯齐-威尔逊在二十出头时创办了一家无人机初创公司。最初，他的目的是让无人机来疏散受伤的士兵，但在一家导弹公司投资后，他的初创公司重新调整了技术，也可以空投有效载荷。他大约在同一时间离开。

paras.en: “I don’t think I was emotionally mature enough,” he says. “[Dandzbergs] will realize at some point. He’ll either have an issue with it or he won’t.”
paras.zh: “我认为我在情感上还不够成熟，”他说。 “[丹兹伯格]在某个时候会意识到。他要么对此有意见，要么不会。”

paras.en: Polemos Industries announced itself publicly on November 5 with a glossy social media video. Set to the ticking of a clock, it featured a set of four missiles fired into the sky from ground launchers, then blowing a convoy of four military vehicles to smithereens.
paras.zh: Polemos Industries 于 11 月 5 日通过一段精彩的社交媒体视频公开宣布自己的消息。随着时钟的滴答声，地面发射器向天空发射了一组四枚导弹，然后将四辆军车组成的车队炸成碎片。

paras.en: The video climbed to the top of the trending page on X. In the responses, a couple of people tagged Palmer Luckey, cofounder of Anduril, who was 19 when he started his first company. “Coming for him,” Dandzbergs responded.
paras.zh: 该视频登上了 X 热门页面的榜首。在回复中，有几个人标记了 Anduril 联合创始人 Palmer Luckey，他在 19 岁时创办了自己的第一家公司。 “来找他，”丹兹伯格回答道。

paras.en: Dandzbergs recognizes that people are likely to dismiss him for his age. But he considers youth one of his biggest advantages. “Please don’t say I’m sacrificing my childhood,” he says. “This is the childhood I dreamed of.”
paras.zh: 丹兹伯格认识到人们可能会因为他的年龄而忽视他。但他认为年轻是他最大的优势之一。 “请不要说我牺牲了我的童年，”他说。 “这就是我梦想的童年。”

articles.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Soundtrack, Gracie Abrams, LISA, Tomorrow x Together & More: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured The Hunger Games soundtrack, ATEEZ and U2 Feat. Dolly Parton.
paras.zh: 上周，我们精选了《饥饿游戏》原声带、ATEEZ 和 U2 Feat。多莉·帕顿。

paras.en: This week, the jam-packed and starry soundtrack for GT6 is out; Gracie Abrams drops the deluxe edition of Daughter From Hell; and TOMORROW x TOGETHER share a new EP… plus much more.
paras.zh: 本周，GT6 的精彩配乐已发布；格雷西·艾布拉姆斯 (Gracie Abrams) 放弃了《地狱之女》的豪华版；和 TOMORROW x TOGETHER 分享了一张新 EP……还有更多内容。

paras.en: Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 查看以下本周所有精选内容：

paras.en: The video game that defined a generation is back with a new edition — and a star-studded soundtrack to boot. Featuring contributions from Dua Lipa, Cardi B, Morgan Wallen, Tame Impala, King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard, SZA, Travis Scott, Justice, JENNIE, Lana Del Rey, Zara Larsson and Rauw Alejandro, Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album translates the game’s high-octane, gun-toting world into music spanning hip-hop, dance, Latin, country and more. Even though 10 tracks were released ahead of the full album, this towering compilation has more than enough new material for both gamers and casual listeners to sink their teeth into. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 这款定义了一代人的视频游戏以新版本回归，并推出了众星云集的配乐。由 Dua Lipa、Cardi B、Morgan Wallen、Tame Impala、King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard、SZA、Travis Scott、Justice、JENNIE、Lana Del Rey、Zara Larsson 和 Rauw Alejandro 贡献的《侠盗猎车手 VI：专辑》将游戏中充满激情的持枪世界转化为涵盖嘻哈、舞曲、拉丁、乡村等音乐的音乐。尽管在整张专辑之前就已经发行了 10 首曲目，但这张高耸的合辑拥有足够多的新素材，可供游戏玩家和休闲听众深入聆听。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: Four months after releasing her third album, Daughter From Hell, the pop singer is sharing its deluxe with five new tracks. Abrams already dropped the more experimentally-produced single “Here You Come, There You Go,” which she performed as musical guest on Saturday Night Live and is co-written and co-produced by Jim-E Stack. Stack is also credited on new focus track “Lost In It” and “Out Of Nowhere” — both of which are more uptempo — while longtime collaborator Aaron Dessner is credited on “Crazy Girl” and “Love Letter,” both of which feature his signature layered and intimate production. — LYNDSEY HAVENS
paras.zh: 在发行第三张专辑《来自地狱的女儿》四个月后，这位流行歌手将与大家分享五首新曲目的豪华专辑。艾布拉姆斯已经放弃了更具实验性的单曲《Here You Come，There You Go》，她在《周六夜现场》中作为音乐嘉宾表演了这首单曲，该单曲由吉姆·E·斯塔克 (Jim-E Stack) 共同创作和制作。 Stack 还创作了新的焦点单曲《Lost In It》和《Out Of Nowhere》——这两首歌曲都节奏更快——而长期合作者 Aaron Dessner 则创作了《Crazy Girl》和《Love Letter》，这两首歌曲都以他标志性的分层和亲密制作为特色。 — 林赛·哈文斯

paras.en: “Spread my wings, fly / me on my side,” sings LISA on the melodic ballad “Leave With Me,” which is featured over the end credits of her new YouTube Premium movie Always Lalisa. Its release coincides with the kick-off of VIVA LA LISA, the first Vegas residency from a K-pop artist. Fittingly, “Leave With Me” chronicles the feeling of quite literally flying solo — and the song and LISA’s journey so far proves, she’s not just flying but soaring on her own. — L.H.
paras.zh: “展开我的翅膀，飞翔/我在我身边”，LISA 在旋律民谣“Leave With Me”中唱道，这首歌曲出现在她的 YouTube Premium 新电影《Always Lalisa》的片尾字幕中。它的发布恰逢韩国流行音乐艺术家在拉斯维加斯的首个驻场演出“VIVA LA LISA”的启动。 《Leave With Me》恰如其分地记录了一种真正的独自飞行的感觉——这首歌和 LISA 迄今为止的旅程证明，她不仅在飞行，而且在独自翱翔。 — L.H.

paras.en: This week, South Korean boy band TXT released its ninth mini album. Perfect Storm includes six songs, including electro-pop focus track “Angel Bite” that continues the group’s distinct deliver of love songs. According to a release, the album “embraces the storm as a catalyst for change, a force capable of breaking through stagnation and opening up new possibilities. Across six tracks, it explores the pain of confronting reality, the desire for change and the courage to embrace the unknown.” Yet, the group will soon face the familiar as it heads on its fifth world tour across North America and Europe in 2027. — L.H.
