articles.title: Moog Marks 25 Years Since ESPA Design Milestone: Innovating Space Rideshare
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, N.Y. — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) marks 25 years since the Evolved Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) ring completed its Critical Design Review in 2001. The pioneering technology helped advance space rideshare by enabling multiple payloads to share a launch and broadening access to orbit for commercial, government, and defense missions.
paras.zh: 纽约州东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）庆祝演进型辅助有效载荷适配器 (ESPA) 环于 2001 年完成关键设计审查以来 25 周年。这项开创性技术通过支持多个有效载荷共享发射并拓宽商业、政府和国防任务的轨道通道，帮助推进了太空共享出行。

paras.en: Development of ESPA began in 1999 through a collaborative government-industry initiative, culminating in the successful completion of its Critical Design Review on January 18, 2001. The ESPA ring enabled launch vehicles to carry multiple secondary payloads by efficiently using previously unused volume beneath primary satellites. This approach lowered costs and increased mission flexibility, supporting commercial satellite constellations, technology demonstrations, and critical defense operations.
paras.zh: ESPA 的开发始于 1999 年，通过政府与行业的合作倡议，最终于 2001 年 1 月 18 日成功完成了关键设计审查。ESPA 环使运载火箭能够通过有效利用主卫星下方以前未使用的空间来携带多个辅助有效载荷。这种方法降低了成本并提高了任务灵活性，支持商业卫星星座、技术演示和关键防御行动。

paras.en: “ESPA helped redefine access to space by enabling additional payloads to share a launch with primary missions. Its impact continues across commercial, government, and military space—and its story reflects the value of enduring collaboration between Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) and industry partners such as Moog,” said Dr. Darren Raspa, chief historian, AFRL Space and Directed Energy Systems.
paras.zh: AFRL 空间和定向能源系统首席历史学家达伦·拉斯帕 (Darren Raspa) 博士表示：“ESPA 通过启用额外的有效载荷与主要任务共享发射，帮助重新定义了太空访问。它的影响持续遍及商业、政府和军事太空，它的故事反映了空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 与穆格等行业合作伙伴之间持久合作的价值。”

paras.en: Over the past 25 years, the ESPA family has evolved into a versatile, modular platform supporting varied payload sizes and interface configurations. ESPA-derived designs have also served as the structural foundation for spacecraft buses. Today, the platform continues to support mission planning for NASA, the U.S. government, and commercial space ventures worldwide.
paras.zh: 在过去的 25 年里，ESPA 系列已发展成为一个多功能的模块化平台，支持各种有效负载大小和接口配置。 ESPA 衍生设计也成为航天器总线的结构基础。如今，该平台继续支持 NASA、美国政府和全球商业航天企业的任务规划。

paras.en: Moog continues to offer a family of ESPA configurations, including Standard ESPA, ESPA Heavy, and ESPA Grande, designed to accommodate evolving payload and mission requirements. The platform’s modular architecture and adaptable interfaces support rideshare missions, payload integration, and spacecraft applications across the growing space market.
paras.zh: 穆格继续提供一系列 ESPA 配置，包括标准 ESPA、ESPA Heavy 和 ESPA Grande，旨在适应不断变化的有效载荷和任务要求。该平台的模块化架构和适应性强的接口支持不断增长的太空市场中的乘车共享任务、有效载荷集成和航天器应用。

paras.en: “The ESPA ring began as a technical solution to a practical challenge: maximizing every launch opportunity,” said Timothy Pargett, general manager, Moog Payload Adapters and Isolation business. “Today, it stands as a cornerstone of how missions, large and small, gain cost-effective, reliable access to orbit through rideshare. Its enduring legacy reflects visionary innovation and trusted partnerships across the aerospace community.”
paras.zh: “ESPA 环最初是作为应对实际挑战的技术解决方案：最大化每个发射机会，”穆格有效负载适配器和隔离业务总经理 Timothy Pargett 说道。 “如今，它已成为大大小小的任务如何通过拼车获得具有成本效益且可靠的轨道访问的基石。它的持久遗产反映了整个航空航天界的富有远见的创新和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”

paras.en: In conjunction with the anniversary, a Moog flight-qualified ESPA ring will be on display at the National Museum of Nuclear Science & History in Albuquerque, N.M., from November 7, 2026, through January 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 为庆祝周年纪念日，一枚符合穆格飞行资格的 ESPA 环将于 2026 年 11 月 7 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的国家核科学与历史博物馆展出。

paras.en: Museum visitors will have the opportunity to see firsthand the hardware that helped advance rideshare and enable diverse space missions.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者将有机会亲眼目睹有助于推进乘车共享和实现多样化太空任务的硬件。

paras.en: As ESPA enters its next chapter, Moog continues to advance spacecraft payload integration and develop adaptable solutions that expand flexible, cost-effective access to orbit for future space exploration and defense missions.
paras.zh: 随着 ESPA 进入新篇章，穆格将继续推进航天器有效载荷集成，并开发适应性强的解决方案，为未来的太空探索和防御任务扩展灵活、经济高效的轨道接入方式。

paras.en: Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com or www.moog.com/space.
paras.zh: 穆格是全球高性能精密运动和流体控制及控制系统的设计者、制造商和系统集成商。穆格的高性能系统控制军用和商用飞机、卫星和航天器、运载火箭、防御系统、导弹、自动化工业机械、船舶和医疗设备。有关公司的更多信息，请访问 www.moog.com 或 www.moog.com/space。

articles.title: What role does industry play in Europe’s space sovereignty push?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Jason Rainbow interviews Atle Woello, the CEO and senior vice president of the space systems and surveillance business unit at Kongsberg NanoAvionics. They discuss the role space plays for defense systems that are increasingly interconnected across domains, as well as the role that the European industrial base can play in the continent’s recent political and fundraising push to bolster sovereignty, independence and resilience in space.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Jason Rainbow 采访了 Kongsberg NanoAvionics 空间系统和监视业务部门的首席执行官兼高级副总裁 Atle Woello。他们讨论了太空对于跨领域互联日益紧密的防御系统的作用，以及欧洲工业基础在欧洲大陆最近为加强太空主权、独立和复原力而进行的政治和筹款活动中可以发挥的作用。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Xiphos Systems.
paras.zh: 本集由 Xiphos Systems 赞助。

paras.en: Xiphos Systems develops compact, high-performance embedded computing solutions for spacecraft and aerospace applications. Founded in 1996 and based in Montreal, the company specializes in commercial off-the-shelf processing platforms designed for space, combining processors, programmable logic, storage, networking, and RF capabilities in low size, weight, power, and cost designs. Its portfolio includes processor boards, onboard computers, RF payload systems, and AI-capable computing platforms for satellites, launch vehicles, lunar missions, and robotics. With more than two decades of experience and over 1,000 processor cards delivered, Xiphos supports customers from system integration through deployment, helping bring reliable computing closer to the mission.
paras.zh: Xiphos Systems 为航天器和航空航天应用开发紧凑、高性能的嵌入式计算解决方案。该公司成立于 1996 年，总部位于蒙特利尔，专注于为太空设计的商用现成处理平台，将处理器、可编程逻辑、存储、网络和射频功能与低尺寸、重量、功耗和成本设计相结合。其产品组合包括处理器板、机载计算机、射频有效载荷系统以及用于卫星、运载火箭、月球任务和机器人的人工智能计算平台。 Xiphos 拥有二十多年的经验和交付的 1,000 多个处理器卡，为客户提供从系统集成到部署的支持，帮助实现可靠的计算更接近使命。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: NASA’s Voyager 1 probe, humanity’s farthest-flying spacecraft, has reached one light-day from Earth, after more than 49 years of constant travel. A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, equaling about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion kilometers). The spacecraft achieved the milestone at 2:16 a.m. PST (5:16 a.m. EST) Nov. 18.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 的航行者 1 号探测器是人类飞行最远的航天器，经过 49 年多的不断旅行，现已到达距地球一光日的位置。一光日是光在 24 小时内传播的距离，约等于 161 亿英里（259 亿公里）。该航天器于 11 月 18 日太平洋标准时间凌晨 2 点 16 分（美国东部标准时间凌晨 5 点 16 分）实现了这一里程碑。

paras.en: Voyager team members at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California, managed by Caltech, heard from the probe 24 hours later, the time it took for the spacecraft’s radio signal traveling at the speed of light to reach Earth, early Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四早些时候，加州理工学院管理的美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室的 Voyager 团队成员在 24 小时后收到了探测器的消息，即航天器的无线电信号以光速传播到达地球所需的时间。

paras.en: “Traveling a light-day is a singular feat for a spacecraft, but Voyager is so much more than a distant traveler. The Voyager mission would be remarkable just for what it contributed to planetary science with the Grand Tour of the outer planets,” said Joe Westlake, director, Heliophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington. “But it went on to become central to NASA’s fleet of heliophysics missions offering insights into the star that we all revolve around, the Sun.”
paras.zh: “航行一光日对于航天器来说是一项非凡的壮举，但航行者号不仅仅是一个遥远的旅行者。航行者号任务将是非凡的，因为它通过外行星大巡游为行星科学做出了贡献，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部太阳物理学部主任乔·韦斯特莱克说。 “但它后来成为美国宇航局太阳物理学任务的核心，为我们提供对我们围绕的恒星——太阳的深入了解。”

paras.en: Scientists use light to measure the vast distances of space. Light travels at about 186,000 miles (299,000 kilometers) a second in a vacuum. A ray of sunlight passing Earth takes about 1.3 seconds to reach the Moon, about four hours to reach Neptune, and another 20 hours to reach Voyager 1. For comparison, a light-year is 5.88 trillion miles (9.46 trillion kilometers).
paras.zh: 科学家利用光来测量广阔的太空距离。光在真空中的传播速度约为每秒 186,000 英里（299,000 公里）。一束阳光穿过地球大约需要 1.3 秒才能到达月球，大约需要 4 小时才能到达海王星，再需要 20 小时才能到达航海者 1 号。相比之下，一光年为 5.88 万亿英里（9.46 万亿公里）。

paras.en: Even though the team has not received science and engineering data from Voyager 1 since Nov. 14, the spacecraft is sending what is called a carrier signal, which typically conveys that data to Earth. Mission engineers used the carrier signal and trajectory calculations to confirm the light-day milestone. They continue to analyze the issue impacting the science and engineering data.
paras.zh: 尽管该团队自 11 月 14 日以来尚未收到航行者 1 号的科学和工程数据，但该航天器正在发送所谓的载波信号，通常会将这些数据传送到地球。任务工程师利用载体信号和轨迹计算来确认光日里程碑。他们继续分析影响科学和工程数据的问题。

paras.en: Humanity’s only probes in interstellar space, Voyager 1 and its twin, Voyager 2, launched in 1977 to take advantage of a rare planetary alignment. Managed by JPL, they were only the third and fourth spacecraft to visit Jupiter and Saturn, and the first to return high-resolution imagery, transforming our understanding of these worlds and their moons. Voyager 2 went on to study the ethereal ice giants, Neptune and Uranus. Both spacecraft continue to measure changes in the Sun’s magnetic field across vast distances.
paras.zh: 航海者 1 号及其孪生航海者 2 号是人类在星际空间中唯一的探测器，于 1977 年发射，以利用罕见的行星排列。在喷气推进实验室的管理下，它们是第三和第四艘访问木星和土星的航天器，也是第一艘返回高分辨率图像的航天器，改变了我们对这些世界及其卫星的理解。航海家二号继续研究了空灵的冰巨星海王星和天王星。这两艘航天器继续在远距离测量太阳磁场的变化。

paras.en: “Voyager 1 crossing the light-day threshold is yet another historic feat on an extraordinary voyage of discovery,” said Dave Gallagher, JPL director. “Above all, this milestone stands as a testament to the exceptional teams who built, programmed, and fly these spacecraft today, and who have overcome countless challenges to keep them connected to Earth across the vastness of space. As NASA pushes toward new frontiers in human and robotic exploration, Voyager and the people behind its success continue to inspire us to reach farther and dream bigger.”
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室主任戴夫·加拉格尔 (Dave Gallagher) 表示：“旅行者一号跨越光日门槛是非凡发现之旅中的又一历史性壮举。” “最重要的是，这一里程碑证明了今天建造、编程和驾驶这些航天器的杰出团队，他们克服了无数的挑战，使它们在浩瀚的太空中与地球保持联系。随着美国宇航局 (NASA) 向人类和机器人探索的新领域推进，航海者号及其成功背后的人们继续激励我们走得更远，梦想更大。”

paras.en: In addition to their suite of scientific instruments, the Voyager probes carry a Golden Record, a gold-plated copper phonograph compiling images and sounds from Earth, as a message to any advanced civilization that might one day find it.
paras.zh: 除了一套科学仪器外，航海者号探测器还携带一张金唱片，这是一台编译来自地球的图像和声音的镀金铜留声机，作为向任何有一天可能发现它的先进文明的信息。

paras.en: “Nearly half a century after leaving Earth, the Voyager mission continues to push the boundaries of human exploration. Its epic journey reflects the vision of Ed Stone, the Caltech physicist and JPL director who guided the mission for decades, and the curiosity and tenacity of generations of scientists and engineers who have carried that vision forward,” said Ray Jayawardhana, president, Caltech. “Beyond its immense contributions to science, Voyager also captures something profound about the human spirit. We may never know where its journey will ultimately lead, but it will venture on, an enduring affirmation that humanity was here and we yearned to explore.”
paras.zh: 加州理工学院校长雷·贾亚瓦德哈纳 (Ray Jayawardhana) 表示：“离开地球近半个世纪后，旅行者号任务继续突破人类探索的界限。其史诗般的旅程反映了数十年来指导该任务的加州理工学院物理学家兼喷气推进实验室主任埃德·斯通 (Ed Stone) 的愿景，以及推动这一愿景的几代科学家和工程师的好奇心和坚韧。” “除了对科学的巨大贡献之外，航海者号还捕捉到了人类精神的一些深刻的东西。我们可能永远不知道它的旅程最终将通向何方，但它会继续冒险，持久地证明人类就在这里，我们渴望探索。”

paras.en: Traveling about 38,000 mph (61,155 kph), Voyager 1 in 2012 became the first spacecraft to leave the heliosphere, the bubble of particles and magnetic fields created by the Sun that deflects cosmic radiation, and enter interstellar space. Voyager 2, taking a different trajectory, crossed the boundary in 2018.
paras.zh: 航行者一号于 2012 年以约 38,000 英里/小时（61,155 公里/小时）的速度行驶，成为第一艘离开日光层（由太阳产生的粒子和磁场气泡，使宇宙辐射偏转）进入星际空间的航天器。航海家二号则采取了不同的轨迹，于 2018 年跨越了边界。

paras.en: “The Voyagers are revolutionizing our understanding of interstellar space, a previously unexplored region outside the heliosphere,” said Linda Spilker, Voyager project scientist at JPL. “One big surprise is the extent to which our Sun continues to affect interstellar space, all the way out to Voyager 1. Where does the Sun’s influence end and pristine interstellar space begin? Perhaps Voyager may endure long enough to answer that question.”
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室航海者号项目科学家琳达·斯皮尔克 (Linda Spilker) 表示：“航海者号正在彻底改变我们对星际空间的理解，星际空间是日光层之外以前未经探索的区域。” “一个大惊喜是我们的太阳对星际空间的影响程度，一直到航海者一号。太阳的影响在哪里结束，原始星际空间从哪里开始？也许航海者号可以坚持足够长的时间来回答这个问题。”

paras.en: Creative engineering solutions have enabled the probes to conserve energy and overcome challenges related to aging hardware, including clogged thrusters and a malfunctioning computer on the spacecraft. Earlier this year, engineers successfully turned off three devices on Voyager 1 and substituted them with three lower-power alternatives — a move not without risk — to help the spacecraft make the most of its 50-year-old radioisotope thermal generator. Essentially a nuclear battery, the generator converts heat from decaying plutonium into electricity.
paras.zh: 创造性的工程解决方案使探测器能够节省能源并克服与硬件老化相关的挑战，包括推进器堵塞和航天器上的计算机故障。今年早些时候，工程师成功关闭了航行者一号上的三个设备，并用三个功率较低的替代品代替它们——此举并非没有风险——以帮助航天器充分利用其已有 50 年历史的放射性同位素热发生器。发电机本质上是一个核电池，将衰变的钚产生的热量转化为电能。

paras.en: With the plutonium supply continually depleting, both Voyager probes lose about 4 watts of power each year. The latest energy-saving effort is expected to provide enough power for both spacecraft to keep their current suite of science instruments operating until at least their 50th launch anniversaries next summer.
paras.zh: 随着钚供应不断耗尽，两个 Voyager 探测器每年都会损失约 4 瓦的电力。最新的节能工作预计将为这两个航天器提供足够的电力，以保证其当前的科学仪器套件至少在明年夏天发射 50 周年之前保持运行。

paras.en: As with all NASA spacecraft that venture to and beyond the Moon, communication between Earth and the Voyager probes is managed by the agency’s Deep Space Network, large antennas located at three facilities around the world.
paras.zh: 与所有前往和超越月球的美国宇航局航天器一样，地球和旅行者号探测器之间的通信由该机构的深空网络管理，该网络是位于世界各地三个设施的大型天线。

paras.en: “We listen to Voyager 1 every day and send commands to the spacecraft weekly. It just takes a little longer to communicate than it used to,” said Suzanne Dodd, Voyager project manager at JPL. “Even traveling at the speed of light, signals now take 24 hours to reach the spacecraft and 24 hours to reach us. One day in the future, when it can no longer communicate with Earth, Voyager 1 will become humanity’s silent ambassador to the stars.”
paras.zh: “我们每天都会收听航行者 1 号，每周都会向航天器发送命令。只是沟通时间比以前要长一点，”喷气推进实验室航行者号项目经理苏珊娜·多德 (Suzanne Dodd) 说道。 “即使以光速行进，信号现在也需要 24 小时才能到达飞船，也需要 24 小时才能到达我们。在未来的某一天，当它不再能与地球通讯时，航海家一号将成为人类无声的星际大使。”

paras.en: For more information about NASA’s Voyager mission, visit:

articles.title: The Stormy Southwest Pacific

paras.en: Even as the unusually quiet 2026 storm season winds down in the North Atlantic, seas have begun to stir on the other side of the world in the Southwest Pacific. On November 15, 2026, the Fiji Meteorological Service began issuing updates about a slow-moving tropical disturbance northeast of Samoa and the Cook Islands. Within just a few days, it had become one of the most intense November tropical cyclones the region has seen in decades.
paras.zh: 尽管 2026 年北大西洋异常平静的风暴季节即将结束，但世界另一端西南太平洋的海水却开始骚动起来。 2026 年 11 月 15 日，斐济气象局开始发布有关萨摩亚和库克群岛东北部缓慢移动的热带扰动的最新信息。短短几天内，它就成为该地区几十年来最强烈的 11 月热带气旋之一。

paras.en: Named Xavier, the system intensified rapidly, thriving in an environment with minimal wind shear and sea surface temperatures of 29 degrees Celsius (84 degrees Fahrenheit)—well above the threshold required to sustain and strengthen developing tropical cyclones. Xavier was the basin’s second named storm of the season, following only Wati, a short-lived storm that emerged in October.
paras.zh: 该系统被命名为“泽维尔”，它的强度迅速增强，在风切变最小、海面温度高达 29 摄氏度（84 华氏度）的环境中蓬勃发展，远高于维持和加强正在发展的热带气旋所需的阈值。泽维尔是该盆地本季第二个被命名的风暴，仅次于 10 月份出现的短暂风暴瓦蒂。

paras.en: As Xavier developed, NASA satellite data showed the storm churning along the southwestern edge of a massive tongue of warm water spanning from the west coast of South America to the central Pacific—a telltale sign of the El Niño that has been present in the region since June.
paras.zh: 随着泽维尔的发展，美国宇航局卫星数据显示，这场风暴沿着从南美洲西海岸到太平洋中部的巨大温水舌的西南边缘翻腾，这是自六月以来该地区出现的厄尔尼诺现象的明显迹象。

paras.en: When the MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on NASA’s Aqua satellite captured this image at 02:53 Universal Time on November 17, 2026 (4:53 p.m. Cook Islands Time on November 16), forecasters estimated Xavier had maximum winds of about 195 kilometers (120 miles) per hour. Winds reached a peak intensity of 220 kilometers (140 miles) per hour later that day, a Category 5 storm on the cyclone intensity scale used in the region or a Category 4 on the Saffir-Simpson scale.
paras.zh: 当美国宇航局 Aqua 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）于 2026 年 11 月 17 日世界时间 02:53（库克群岛时间 11 月 16 日下午 4:53）拍摄到这张图像时，预报员估计泽维尔的最大风速约为每小时 195 公里（120 英里）。当天晚些时候，风速达到每小时 220 公里（140 英里）的峰值强度，根据该地区使用的气旋强度等级为 5 级风暴，根据萨菲尔-辛普森等级为 4 级风暴。

paras.en: The storm ranks as the strongest November tropical cyclone east of the international date line on record, noted Colorado State University hurricane expert Phil Klotzbach. Xavier’s formation east of the date line, near the northern Cook Islands, was unusual, but its easterly position aligns with research that indicates that storm activity in the region typically shifts northeast during El Niño years. Research also shows that El Niño tends to fuel storms that strengthen at an unusually rapid pace.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州立大学飓风专家 Phil Klotzbach 指出，这场风暴是国际日期变更线以东有记录以来最强的 11 月热带气旋。泽维尔在库克群岛北部附近的日期变更线以东形成是不寻常的，但其偏东的位置与研究一致，表明该地区的风暴活动通常在厄尔尼诺年期间向东北方向移动。研究还表明，厄尔尼诺现象往往会加剧风暴，并以异常快的速度增强。

paras.en: According to news reports, Xavier damaged homes and caused power disruptions as it passed the northern Cook Islands. It then encountered dry air and a less favorable wind shear environment and slowly weakened as it pushed westward, reducing the threat that it posed to Samoa and American Samoa.
paras.zh: 据新闻报道，泽维尔在经过库克群岛北部时损坏了房屋并造成电力中断。随后遇到干燥空气和不太有利的风切变环境，在向西推进的过程中逐渐减弱，减少了对萨摩亚和美属萨摩亚的威胁。

paras.en: Xavier is likely one of the first of several storms to affect the region in the coming months. A seasonal outlook from the Fiji Meteorological Service projects that the region could see between 11 and 15 named tropical cyclones this season, with the greatest risk east of the international date line. Storm activity in the Southwest Pacific basin typically peaks in February.
paras.zh: 泽维尔可能是未来几个月影响该地区的几场风暴中的第一场。斐济气象局的季节性展望预计，本季节该地区可能会出现 11 至 15 个热带气旋，其中国际日期变更线以东的风险最大。西南太平洋盆地的风暴活动通常在二月达到顶峰。

articles.title: Winter rains deepen Gaza crisis amid restricted access and aid cuts

paras.en: Winter rains deepen Gaza crisis amid restricted access and aid cuts
paras.zh: 由于准入受限和援助削减，冬季降雨加剧了加沙危机

paras.en: Gaza is facing a deepening shelter, sanitation and food security crisis as winter rains flood makeshift shelters, destroy scarce food supplies and leave displaced families struggling to stay warm and fed.
paras.zh: 加沙正面临着日益严重的住房、卫生和粮食安全危机，冬季降雨淹没了临时住所，摧毁了稀缺的粮食供应，使流离失所的家庭难以取暖和吃饭。

paras.en: “Most people burn rubbish to cook their food. Now even the rubbish is wet,” warned Shaun Hughes, World Food Programme (WFP) country director for Palestine.
paras.zh: “大多数人都焚烧垃圾来做饭。现在连垃圾都湿了，”世界粮食计划署（WFP）巴勒斯坦国家主任肖恩·休斯（Shaun Hughes）警告说。

paras.en: Briefing journalists in Geneva on his visit to the Strip last week, he described how floodwater and sewage had destroyed food stocks stored in tents while cooking gas and firewood are unavailable or unaffordable.
paras.zh: 他上周在日内瓦向记者介绍了他访问拉斯维加斯大道的情况，描述了洪水和污水如何摧毁了帐篷里储存的粮食，而烹饪煤气和柴火却无法获得或负担不起。

paras.en: The scale of the damage has increased fears about how displaced families will withstand the winter months ahead.
paras.zh: 破坏的规模加剧了人们对流离失所家庭如何度过未来几个月的担忧。

paras.en: “After just one day of rain, tens of thousands of shelters were damaged or destroyed,” said Karl Baker, regional crisis coordinator for the UN International Organization for Migration (IOM).
paras.zh: 联合国国际移民组织（IOM）区域危机协调员卡尔·贝克（Karl Baker）表示：“仅仅一天的降雨之后，数以万计的避难所就被损坏或摧毁。”

paras.en: At least five people were killed by a collapsed sand bank just over a week ago and humanitarian partners reported that two children had died in fires started accidentally by families trying to stay warm by cooking inside their tents, Mr. Baker added.
paras.zh: 贝克先生补充说，就在一周多前，一座倒塌的沙堆造成至少五人死亡，人道主义合作伙伴报告称，有两名儿童在帐篷内做饭取暖的家庭意外引发的火灾中丧生。

paras.en: The UN’s food and migration agencies warn that critical funding shortfalls and continued restrictions on humanitarian aid deliveries are putting additional pressure on an already fragile response. More than 1.7 million Gazans remain displaced and 1.4 million face acute hunger.
paras.zh: 联合国粮食和移民机构警告说，严重的资金短缺和对人道主义援助运送的持续限制给本已脆弱的应对措施带来了额外的压力。超过 170 万加沙人仍然流离失所，140 万人面临严重饥饿。

paras.en: In the tented camps for displaced families, WFP used to provide one hot meal a day.
paras.zh: 在流离失所家庭的帐篷营地，粮食计划署过去每天提供一顿热餐。

paras.en: “Now it’s one hot meal every two days,”insisted Mr. Hughes.
paras.zh: “现在是每两天吃一顿热饭，”休斯先生坚持说。

paras.en: The agencies warned that recent improvements in food security remain precarious, sustained mainly by humanitarian aid rather than any recovery in livelihoods, markets or local food systems. Winter flooding and the destruction of food stocks risk reversing those gains.
paras.zh: 这些机构警告说，近期粮食安全的改善仍然不稳定，主要靠人道主义援助来维持，而不是生计、市场或当地粮食系统的任何复苏。冬季洪水和粮食库存的破坏有可能逆转这些成果。

paras.en: “When you’re in Gaza, it does not feel like a ceasefire,” the WFP official stressed. “Israeli military control across nearly 70 per cent of Gaza means that people have almost no space to grow their own food. Fishing in the sea is prohibited and also life-threatening. Unemployment is over 80 per cent, so without humanitarian assistance, people have little or no alternate means of survival,” underlined Mr. Hughes.
paras.zh: “当你在加沙时，感觉不像是停火，”粮食计划署官员强调说。休斯先生强调说：“以色列对加沙近70%的地区进行军事控制，这意味着人们几乎没有空间种植自己的粮食。海里捕鱼是被禁止的，而且还威胁到生命。失业率超过80%，因此如果没有人道主义援助，人们几乎没有或根本没有其他生存手段。”

paras.en: As winter sets in, one of the most immediate and effective ways to protect displaced families is to improve the management of displacement camps, according to IOM.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织表示，随着冬季的到来，保护流离失所家庭的最直接、最有效的方法之一是改善流离失所者营地的管理。

paras.en: Humanitarian teams have worked for months to prepare sites for winter, digging drainage channels, reinforcing pathways and repurposing flour bags as sandbags to limit flooding.
paras.zh: 人道主义团队已经工作了几个月，为冬季准备场地，挖掘排水沟，加固道路，并将面粉袋改造成沙袋，以限制洪水。

paras.en: But, these efforts require at least $9 million in the coming months to support flood prevention, fire safety measures, heating points, lighting and emergency site improvements. And access to more resources and basic tools such as shovels, sandbags and nails is urgently needed to help communities protect themselves and strengthen their shelters.
paras.zh: 但是，这些努力在未来几个月至少需要 900 万美元来支持防洪、消防安全措施、供暖点、照明和紧急现场改进。迫切需要获得更多资源和铲子、沙袋和钉子等基本工具，以帮助社区保护自己并加固住所。

paras.en: Humanitarian agencies work closely with Israel’s Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories (COGAT) to ensure that the equipment entering Gaza meets Israeli’s security requirements. Clearance takes a long time and is heavily bureaucratic, UN agencies say,
paras.zh: 人道主义机构与以色列境内政府活动协调中心（COGAT）密切合作，确保进入加沙的设备符合以色列的安全要求。联合国机构表示，清关需要很长时间，而且官僚主义严重，

paras.en: IOM is urging Member States to use their influence with the Israeli authorities to secure the opening of additional crossing points and ensure the immediate and predictable entry of humanitarian supplies, including more robust and longer-lasting shelter equipment.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织敦促成员国利用其对以色列当局的影响力，确保开放更多过境点，并确保人道主义物资立即、可预测地进入，包括更坚固、更持久的避难设备。

paras.en: “Anything that can come in at any time, we just highly appreciate it and from any source; but of course, it needs to be durable and that’s what we’re looking for in order just to get through this winter,” said Karl Baker, Head of IOM’s Gaza programme.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织加沙项目负责人卡尔·贝克 (Karl Baker) 表示：“任何可以随时运来的东西，我们都高度赞赏，无论其来源如何；但当然，它需要耐用，这正是我们所寻求的，以便度过这个冬天。”

paras.en: He noted that more than 100,000 tents are standing by for delivery from Egypt, but securing entry for such essential items depends on strict criteria being met, including the diameter of central tent poles.
paras.zh: 他指出，有超过 100,000 个帐篷正等待从埃及发货，但确保这些必需品的进入取决于是否满足严格的标准，包括中央帐篷杆的直径。

paras.en: “Usually anything under 38 millimetres is okay; anything above, it’s usually deemed as not acceptable,” he explained. “It is not a statement of dual use, it is just that this tent at this time is not allowed to enter Gaza…We don’t get the specifics.”
paras.zh: “通常任何低于 38 毫米的东西都可以；任何超过 38 毫米的东西通常被认为是不可接受的，”他解释道。 “这并不是双重用途的声明，只是这个帐篷目前不允许进入加沙……我们不了解具体情况。”

paras.en: For the fourth winter, women carrying most household responsibilities are struggling to feed their children and keep their families warm, as floodwaters and sewage bring disease and rodents into tents and makeshift shelters, gender equality agency UN Women said during the briefing on Gaza in Geneva on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 性别平等机构联合国妇女署周二在日内瓦举行的加沙情况通报会上表示，今年第四个冬天，承担大部分家庭责任的妇女正在努力养活孩子并让家人取暖，因为洪水和污水将疾病和啮齿动物带入帐篷和临时住所。

paras.en: One in four households in Gaza is headed by a woman, and even before the floods, these households were more likely to be living in inadequate shelters.
paras.zh: 加沙四分之一的家庭由女性担任户主，即使在洪水发生之前，这些家庭也很可能居住在不足的避难所中。

paras.en: Widows and women whose husbands have been forcibly disappeared, severely injured or remain missing face “unimaginable hardship, often alone”, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，丈夫被强迫失踪、重伤或失踪的寡妇和妇女面临着“难以想象的困难，而且往往是孤身一人”。

articles.title: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence

paras.en: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence
paras.zh: “饥饿不应成为问题”：粮食计划署为逃离埃塞俄比亚暴力的肯尼亚家庭提供帮助

paras.en: Roughly 30,000 people crossed the border following inter-communal clashes last month and are now staying with relatives, host families or in schools and communal centres.
paras.zh: 上个月发生部族间冲突后，约有 30,000 人越过边境，目前住在亲戚、寄宿家庭或学校和社区中心。

paras.en: “Many have left behind their homes, their livelihoods and everything they know. They have arrived with little more than what they could carry, seeking one thing above all, safety,” said Betty Ka, WFP Country Director in Kenya, who was recently in Moyale, which is located in Marsabit county.
paras.zh: “许多人离开了家园、生计和他们所知道的一切。他们来到这里时只带了一些他们能携带的东西，最重要的是寻求一件事，那就是安全，”粮食计划署驻肯尼亚国家主任贝蒂·卡(Betty Ka)最近来到位于马萨比特县的莫亚莱，她说。

paras.en: The town straddles the border between southern Ethiopia and northern Kenya. The crisis erupted on 22 October on the Ethiopian side which is shared by two states, Oromia and the Somali region.
paras.zh: 该镇横跨埃塞俄比亚南部和肯尼亚北部之间的边界。这场危机于 10 月 22 日在埃塞俄比亚一侧爆发，该地区由奥罗米亚州和索马里地区两个州共享。

paras.en: Reports indicate that the root cause of clashes between rival forces are long-standing local disputes related to land ownership, governance, ethnic differences and political disagreements.
paras.zh: 报告指出，敌对势力冲突的根源是长期存在的地方争端，涉及土地所有权、治理、种族差异和政治分歧。

paras.en: A man called Alexander, 37, is among those displaced. The father of five – his youngest just an infant – said he witnessed people being killed, including his own sister.
paras.zh: 流离失所者中包括一名 37 岁的亚历山大男子。这位五个孩子的父亲——他最小的孩子还是个婴儿——说他亲眼目睹了人们被杀害，其中包括他自己的妹妹。

paras.en: “I arrived by vehicle,” he told WFP. “I want to go to Nairobi, not stay here. I cannot go back. There is no work. My wife is here with our three-month-old baby.”
paras.zh: “我乘车到达，”他告诉粮食计划署。 “我想去内罗毕，而不是留在这里。我不能回去。没有工作。我的妻子带着三个月大的孩子在这里。”

paras.en: WFP began providing emergency food assistance to the arrivals on 11 November, working with the Kenyan Government, the Kenya Red Cross Society and other humanitarian partners.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署于 11 月 11 日开始与肯尼亚政府、肯尼亚红十字会和其他人道主义伙伴合作，向抵达者提供紧急粮食援助。

paras.en: Families staying with host communities are receiving dry food rations of sorghum, yellow split peas and vegetables. Food supplies are also being distributed to provide hot meals for those sheltering in communal centres.
paras.zh: 居住在收容社区的家庭正在领取高粱、黄豌豆和蔬菜等干粮。食品供应也正在分发，为那些在公共中心避难的人提供热餐。

paras.en: “For families who have already lost so much, hunger should not be a concern,” said Ms. Ka. “At a time of such uncertainty, access to food is more than an immediate need. It is a source of stability, dignity, and hope.”
paras.zh: “对于已经失去这么多的家庭来说，饥饿不应该成为一个问题，”卡女士说。 “在如此不确定的时期，获得食物不仅仅是迫在眉睫的需要。它是稳定、尊严和希望的源泉。”

paras.en: WFP mobilised internal resources for the initial response and stressed that additional funding will be needed if displacement continues or humanitarian needs increase.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署动员内部资源进行初步应对，并强调，如果流离失所情况持续或人道主义需求增加，将需要额外资金。

articles.title: Haiti: ‘Atrocious abuses’ continue as UN warns anti-gang operations must priortise civilian protection

paras.en: Haiti: ‘Atrocious abuses’ continue as UN warns anti-gang operations must priortise civilian protection
paras.zh: 海地：联合国警告反帮派行动必须优先保护平民，“残暴虐待”仍在继续

paras.en: OHCHR has documented 4,595 people killed and 2,050 injured due to armed violence between January and 31 October, Spokesperson Marta Hurtado told journalists in Geneva.
paras.zh: 人权高专办发言人玛尔塔·乌尔塔多在日内瓦告诉记者，人权高专办已记录 1 月至 10 月 31 日期间武装暴力造成 4,595 人死亡、2,050 人受伤。

paras.en: This includes 1,167 killed and 459 injured between July and September.
paras.zh: 其中 7 月至 9 月期间有 1,167 人死亡、459 人受伤。

paras.en: During the same quarter, at least 340 women and girls were subjected to sexual violence, mainly gang rape, bringing the total number of cases from January to September to 1,497. Victims ranged from ages seven to 80.
paras.zh: 同一季度，至少有 340 名妇女和女童遭受性暴力，主要是轮奸，使 1 月至 9 月的案件总数达到 1,497 起。受害者年龄从 7 岁到 80 岁不等。

paras.en: Asked how 2026 figures overall compare with previous years, Ms. Hurtado said that although some numbers “have gone down a little”, killings, rapes and child recruitment by gangs remain “awfully high”.
paras.zh: 当被问及 2026 年的总体数字与往年相比如何时，乌尔塔多女士表示，尽管一些数字“略有下降”，但杀戮、强奸和帮派招募儿童的数量仍然“非常高”。

paras.en: “I always refer to the report that we issued in February, where we had several examples of mothers saying, ‘I prefer to give my daughter to a gang member so she's only raped and not gang raped,’” she said.
paras.zh: “我总是参考我们二月份发布的报告，其中有几个母亲说的例子，‘我更愿意把我的女儿交给帮派成员，这样她只会被强奸，而不是被轮奸，’”她说。

paras.en: Violent armed groups continue to control large areas of Haiti’s capital Port-au-Prince, and beyond. A Gang Suppression Force, authorised by the UN Security Council, has yet to be fully deployed.
paras.zh: 暴力武装团体继续控制海地首都太子港及其他地区的大片地区。联合国安理会授权的镇压帮派部队尚未全面部署。

paras.en: Meanwhile, as security operations ramp up, gangs have adapted their tactics. Armed groups have carried out retaliatory attacks on residents suspected of cooperating with security forces, targeted kidnappings, increased forced recruitment of children and young people and placed tighter restrictions on freedom of movement.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着安全行动的加强，犯罪团伙也调整了策略。武装团体对涉嫌与安全部队合作的居民进行报复性袭击、有针对性的绑架、增加强行招募儿童和青少年，并对行动自由施加更严格的限制。

paras.en: They have also sought to influence upcoming elections through violence. Ms. Hurtado noted that the leader of the ‘Brooklyn’ gang in the Cité Soleil neighbourhood allegedly prepared a candidate list to gain municipal positions. Two residents who denounced the scheme were shot dead.
paras.zh: 他们还试图通过暴力影响即将举行的选举。乌尔塔多女士指出，太阳城附近的“布鲁克林”帮派头目据称准备了一份候选人名单以获取市政职位。两名谴责该计划的居民被枪杀。

paras.en: OHCHR found that between July and September, at least 514 people were killed and 235 injured during security operations conducted by national security forces against gangs, at times with the support of a private military company.
paras.zh: 人权高专办发现，7 月至 9 月期间，国家安全部队在打击犯罪团伙的安全行动中至少造成 514 人死亡、235 人受伤，有时还得到了一家私营军事公司的支持。

paras.en: Another 44 people were reported killed in extrajudicial killings by police officers outside anti-gang operations.
paras.zh: 据报道，另有 44 人在反帮派行动之外被警察法外处决身亡。

paras.en: “The Government needs to ensure that all security operations are firmly grounded in and conducted in compliance with international human rights law,” she said.
paras.zh: “政府需要确保所有安全行动都牢固地立足于国际人权法并按照国际人权法进行，”她说。

paras.en: The UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk has called on all national and international security forces operating in Haiti, whether under the Gang Suppression Force – or outside its framework – to ensure their operations fully comply with international human rights law and prioritize protecting the population.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克呼吁所有在海地行动的国家和国际安全部队，无论是在镇压部队的领导下还是在其框架之外，确保其行动完全符合国际人权法，并优先保护人民。

paras.en: Security forces must strictly limit the use of lethal force to situations where it is unavoidable to protect life from an imminent threat, and as a last resort.
paras.zh: 安全部队必须严格限制在不可避免的情况下使用致命武力，以保护生命免受迫在眉睫的威胁，并将其作为最后手段。

paras.en: The UN rights chief also urged the Haitian authorities to strengthen effective oversight over forces under its command, investigate alleged violations – including extrajudicial executions, and ensure accountability.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员还敦促海地当局加强对其指挥下的部队的有效监督，调查涉嫌违法行为——包括法外处决，并确保追究责任。

paras.en: OHCHR is supporting efforts to reduce risks. So far this year, staff have trained more than 1,300 police officers involved in anti-gang operations on human rights norms and standards in addition to providing human rights training to newly deployed contingents with the Gang Suppression Force.
paras.zh: 人权高专办正在支持降低风险的努力。今年到目前为止，除了为新部署的镇压帮派特遣队提供人权培训外，工作人员还对参与反帮派行动的 1,300 多名警察进行了人权规范和标准方面的培训。

paras.en: “We call for strengthened protection and assistance services to affected communities, particularly survivors of sexual violence, and for the restoration of essential services in areas freed from gang control,” Ms. Hurtado said.
paras.zh: “我们呼吁加强对受影响社区、特别是性暴力幸存者的保护和援助服务，并呼吁在摆脱帮派控制的地区恢复基本服务，”乌尔塔多女士说。

paras.en: The UN human rights chief reiterated his call for the international community to promptly and fully deploy the UN Security Council-backed Gang Suppression Force, to impose sanctions on gang leaders, and to focus on those who control and benefit from criminal networks.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员再次呼吁国际社会立即全面部署联合国安理会支持的剿匪部队，对帮派头目实施制裁，并重点打击那些控制犯罪网络并从中受益的人。

paras.en: Furthermore, States must act urgently and decisively to crack down on the continuous illicit flow of weapons and ammunition into Haiti, in line with the UN Security Council arms embargo.
paras.zh: 此外，各国必须根据联合国安理会的武器禁运采取紧急、果断行动，打击武器和弹药持续非法流入海地。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the gang-driven violence is also driving a deepening food crisis.
paras.zh: 与此同时，帮派暴力也加剧了粮食危机。

paras.en: More than 5.94 million people – 53 per cent of the population analysed – are facing high levels of acute food insecurity between September 2026 and February 2027, according to the internationally-recognized acute hunger index.
paras.zh: 根据国际公认的急性饥饿指数，2026 年 9 月至 2027 年 2 月期间，超过 594 万人（占分析人口的 53%）面临严重的严重粮食不安全。

paras.en: That includes 1.8 million facing Phase 4 Emergency conditions, according to the latest Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) analysis, published on Tuesday by partners including WFP, FAO and UNICEF.
paras.zh: 根据世界粮食计划署、粮农组织和联合国儿童基金会等合作伙伴周二发布的最新粮食安全综合阶段分类 (IPC) 分析，其中包括 180 万人面临第四阶段紧急情况。

paras.en: Insecurity remains the primary driver, disrupting livelihoods, farming, markets and access to food and essential services.
paras.zh: 不安全仍然是主要驱动因素，扰乱了生计、农业、市场以及获得粮食和基本服务的机会。

paras.en: An estimated 1.49 million people have been displaced. Inflation reached 17 per cent year-on-year in August, and El Niño-related rainfall deficits and above-average temperatures are reducing agricultural production.
paras.zh: 估计有 149 万人流离失所。 8月份通货膨胀率同比达到17%，厄尔尼诺现象导致的降雨不足和气温高于平均水平正在减少农业产量。

paras.en: Conditions are projected to worsen between March and June next year, when 6.35 million people are expected to face high levels of acute food insecurity.
paras.zh: 预计明年 3 月至 6 月期间情况将进一步恶化，预计届时将有 635 万人面临严重的严重粮食不安全状况。

paras.en: In the capital’s Cité Soleil neighbourhood and Cabaret – just outside Port au Prince – acute malnutrition is projected to reach critical levels by May 2027.
paras.zh: 预计到 2027 年 5 月，首都太阳城社区和太子港郊外的歌舞厅严重营养不良率将达到临界水平。

articles.title: Whyte offers to fight Wilder - 'They know where I am'

paras.en: Dillian Whyte offers to fight Deontay Wilder on December 11: ‘If Wilder wants it, they know where I am’
paras.zh: 迪利安·怀特提出在 12 月 11 日与德昂泰·维尔德对决：“如果维尔德想要，他们就知道我在哪里”

paras.en: Dillian Whyte has made himself available to step in for Jai Opetaia and box Deontay Wilder on the undercard of the December 11 fight between Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff; "If they want it and they want to have a good fight, then I'm down," he said
paras.zh: 迪利安·怀特 (Dillian Whyte) 已准备好在 12 月 11 日泰森·富里 (Tyson Fury) 和安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua) 在卡迪夫公国体育场 (Principality Stadium) 进行的比赛中顶替杰·奥佩塔亚 (Jai Opetaia) 和拳击手德昂泰·维尔德 (Deontay Wilder)。 “如果他们想要，想要打一场漂亮的仗，那我就失望了，”他说

paras.en: Dillian Whyte is ready to rekindle his rivalry with Deontay Wilder.
paras.zh: 迪利安·怀特（Dillian Whyte）准备重新点燃与德昂泰·维尔德（Deontay Wilder）的竞争。

paras.en: At one point Whyte was the WBC's No 1 contender when Wilder held that title. He never got to box Wilder, though did eventually challenge Tyson Fury after he'd beaten the American for the belt.
paras.zh: 当怀尔德持有这一头衔时，怀特曾一度是 WBC 的头号竞争者。他从未与维尔德进​​行过拳击比赛，尽管他最终在击败美国人夺得金腰带后挑战了泰森·富里。

paras.en: Wilder is currently looking for a new opponent after Jai Opetaia withdrew from a heavyweight bout that was scheduled for the undercard of Fury's December 11 showdown with Anthony Joshua.
paras.zh: 在杰·奥佩塔亚退出原定于 12 月 11 日富里与安东尼·约书亚对决的底牌重量级比赛后，维尔德目前正在寻找新的对手。

paras.en: Whyte has made himself available as a replacement. "If they want it then they know where I am," the Brixton heavyweight told Sky Sports News.
paras.zh: 怀特已将自己作为替代者。 “如果他们想要的话，他们就会知道我在哪里，”布里克斯顿重量级人物告诉天空体育新闻。

paras.en: "If they want it and they want to have a good fight, then I'm down. You know, I always come to fight. I give it my best and I give my all.
paras.zh: “如果他们想要它并且他们想要一场精彩的战斗，那么我就会沮丧。你知道，我总是来战斗。我竭尽全力，全力以赴。

paras.en: "I've already waited 100 years for him, so if he wants it in December, then let's go."
paras.zh: “我已经等他100年了，所以如果他想要12月的话，那我们就走吧。”

paras.en: He added: "I've been trying to fight him for 100 years. I've always believed that I could have beaten him.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“一百年来我一直在努力与他战斗。我一直相信我可以击败他。

paras.en: "He's a big puncher, he's wiry, and he's fast and all that. I just believe that I have the mentality and the style to beat him and cause him all sorts of problems. And I still believe that."
paras.zh: “他是一个伟大的拳击手，他很强壮，他速度很快等等。我只是相信我有击败他并给他带来各种问题的心态和风格。我仍然相信这一点。”

paras.en: Whyte insists he could be ready for the bill at the Principality Stadium. "I'm training to fight a week after them. So I'm in a gym, I'm looking to come back December 18. So if they want it, I'm here.
paras.zh: 怀特坚称他可以为公国体育场的账单做好准备。 “我正在训练，以便在他们之后一周进行战斗。所以我在健身房里，我希望在 12 月 18 日回来。所以如果他们想要的话，我就在这里。

articles.title: England's All Blacks acid test, Erasmus circus, Boks to storm Dublin?

paras.en: Nations Championship: England's All Blacks acid test at Twickenham, Rassie Erasmus circus, Springboks to storm to win vs Ireland in Dublin?
paras.zh: 国家锦标赛：英格兰全黑队在特威克纳姆进行严酷考验，拉西·伊拉斯谟马戏团、跳羚队将在都柏林对阵爱尔兰队？

paras.en: Third week of Nations Championship Tests in northern hemisphere sees England host the All Blacks in an acid test; Ireland welcome South Africa in bonkers week Rassie Erasmus was handed six-Test ban; inaugural tournament concludes at Allianz Stadium Twickenham next weekend November 27-29
paras.zh: 北半球国家锦标赛测试赛的第三周，英格兰将迎来全黑队的严峻考验；爱尔兰在疯狂的一周迎战南非 Rassie Erasmus 被禁止六次测试；首届比赛将于下周末 11 月 27 日至 29 日在安联体育场特威克纳姆结束

paras.en: The third weekend of Nations Championship Tests in the northern hemisphere is upon us, with England hosting the All Blacks in an acid test and Ireland facing the Springboks in the week a six-Test suspension was handed down to the controversial Rassie Erasmus...
paras.zh: 北半球国家锦标赛测试的第三个周末即将到来，英格兰队将在主场迎战全黑队，爱尔兰将在本周面对跳羚队，备受争议的拉西·伊拉斯谟将被禁赛六场……

paras.en: There is a sense of déjà vu, somewhat, for England this November when looking over their autumn performances and the general outlook emanating from them.
paras.zh: 当回顾英格兰队今年 11 月的秋季表现和整体前景时，有一种似曾相识的感觉。

paras.en: This time last year, England proved too strong for Australia and Fiji before welcoming New Zealand to Twickenham. In that Test, Steve Borthwick's side thrilled to a 33-19 victory over the All Blacks.
paras.zh: 去年的这个时候，在欢迎新西兰来到特威克纳姆之前，英格兰对澳大利亚和斐济来说太过强大。在那次测试中，史蒂夫·博思威克的球队以 33-19 战胜了全黑队。

paras.en: A nervy 27-23 win over Argentina followed, but England exited November buoyed by four wins, with many talking them up as a returning force in the world game, building towards Six Nations, Nations Championship and Rugby World Cup title tilts.
paras.zh: 随后英格兰队以 27-23 击败阿根廷队，但英格兰队以四场胜利的成绩退出了 11 月份的比赛，许多人认为他们是世界比赛中的回归力量，为六国赛、国家锦标赛和橄榄球世界杯的冠军头衔奠定了基础。

paras.en: What followed was a disastrous Six Nations. The worst in England's history, in fact.
paras.zh: 接下来就是灾难性的六国之战。事实上，这是英格兰历史上最糟糕的。

paras.en: From five fixtures, they lost four for the first time ever, suffering defeat against Italy in a Test for the first time, as well as a record home loss to Ireland by a 42-21 margin at Twickenham.
paras.zh: 在五场比赛中，他们有史以来第一次输掉了四场，第一次在测试赛中输给了意大利，并且在特威克纳姆主场以 42-21 的比分创纪录地输给了爱尔兰。

paras.en: They lost to Scotland for the fifth time in six years as the wheels well and truly came off a championship campaign which began with comfortable victory over a poor Wales side at home.
paras.zh: 他们在六年内第五次输给苏格兰，因为他们在冠军联赛中表现出色，真正结束了冠军之旅，他们在主场轻松战胜了贫穷的威尔士队。

paras.en: Displays in July's Nations Championship window were hardly overly positive either. A comprehensive 45-21 defeat in South Africa, a thrashing of a poor Fiji side in a Test bizarrely played in Liverpool, and holding on with 13 players to edge to victory in Argentina.
paras.zh: 七月份的国家锦标赛窗口期的表现也不算太积极。在南非以 45-21 全面失利，在利物浦举行的一场奇怪的测试赛中击败了实力不佳的斐济队，并在阿根廷凭借 13 名球员的努力取得了胜利。

paras.en: Borthwick and his players were suddenly under major pressure again, with stories of a camp rift emerging, but this month has seen 123 points scored in just two Tests - big victories over Australia and Japan.
paras.zh: 博思威克和他的球员们突然再次面临巨大压力，阵营分歧的故事不断出现，但本月仅两次测试就获得了 123 分——大胜澳大利亚和日本。

paras.en: Like last year, the All Blacks are coming to town with everyone wondering if England are back on track, or still a side short of the top table.
paras.zh: 和去年一样，全黑队来到这座城市，每个人都想知道英格兰队是否回到了正轨，或者仍然距离榜首还很远。

paras.en: As such, Saturday's Test against a no-doubt angry New Zealand - following their shock defeat to Wales in Cardiff - represents something of an acid test for England.
paras.zh: 因此，周六对阵毫无疑问愤怒的新西兰队的测试——在卡迪夫惨败给威尔士队——对英格兰来说是一次严峻的考验。

paras.en: Put on a show in victory, and talk of them as potentially one of the world's best will start to re-emerge. Suffer defeat, and criticism will filter back.
paras.zh: 上演一场胜利的表演，并谈论他们作为潜在的世界最佳球员之一将开始重新崛起。遭受失败，批评就会被过滤回来。

paras.en: My word, it has been some week in Dublin as far as story-lines ahead of Saturday's crunch Ireland vs South Africa Test.
paras.zh: 我保证，周六爱尔兰对阵南非的关键测试赛之前，都柏林的故事情节已经过去一周了。

paras.en: First, fly-half Sam Prendergast was cited for a hip-drop tackle committed against Fiji captain Peceli Yato in last week's 43-15 Ireland win - a first of its kind, with the manoeuvre outlawed at the start of this month.
paras.zh: 首先，在上周爱尔兰队以 43-15 战胜斐济队的比赛中，前卫萨姆·普伦德加斯特 (Sam Prendergast) 对斐济队长佩切利·亚托 (Peceli Yato) 进行了一次臀部下垂铲球，这在此类动作中尚属首次，但这种动作在本月初被禁止。

paras.en: Then, South Africa head coach Rassie Erasmus gave the mother and father of all press conferences. Even for him - and he has quite the history - it was downright bizarre.
paras.zh: 随后，南非队主教练拉西·伊拉斯谟主持了所有新闻发布会。即使对他来说——他有相当多的历史——这也是彻头彻尾的奇怪。

paras.en: Off the back of the Springboks losing to France in Paris last week - clearly the reason behind Erasmus' ticking demeanour - claims and comments from South Africa's revered rugby leader ranged from extraordinary to astonishing.
paras.zh: 上周，跳羚队在巴黎输给了法国队——这显然是伊拉斯谟表现不佳的原因——这位受人尊敬的南非橄榄球领袖的言论和评论从非同寻常到令人震惊。

paras.en: He began by predicting Prendergast would get off "on a technicality" and would play in Dublin on Saturday, claiming his double Rugby World Cup-winning squad and players were treated differently at disciplinary hearings than northern hemisphere players.
paras.zh: 他首先预测普伦德加斯特将“因技术原因”下场，并于周六在都柏林比赛，声称他的两届橄榄球世界杯冠军球队和球员在纪律听证会上受到的待遇与北半球球员不同。

paras.en: Erasmus even went so far as to state "things never seem to go our way." Make of that what you will when considering he is talking about a trophy-laden side who won the last World Cup following three successive one-point knockout victories.
paras.zh: 伊拉斯谟甚至说“事情似乎永远不会按照我们的方式发展”。当你考虑到他谈论的是一支在连续三场单点淘汰赛胜利后赢得上届世界杯​​冠军的满载奖杯的球队时，你会想到这一点。

paras.en: Far worse was to follow when Erasmus claimed "17 knee-drop tackles" by France had been missed by the referee and TMO in South Africa's defeat last week - a figure almost universally debunked when reviewed by journalists and pundits in the aftermath.
paras.zh: 更糟糕的是，伊拉斯谟声称在上周南非队的比赛中，法国队的“17次膝下铲球”被裁判和TMO漏掉了——赛后记者和专家审查时，这一数字几乎被普遍揭穿。

paras.en: Erasmus then came out with the claims which were likely the reasoning behind World Rugby snappily handing him a six-Test suspension: questioning whether TMO's and referees were "match-fixing" and whether there was "manipulation of the game or result" of Test matches.
paras.zh: 伊拉斯谟随后提出了可能是世界橄榄球协会对他进行六次测试禁赛的原因的说法：质疑TMO和裁判是否“操纵比赛”，以及是否存在“操纵比赛或结果”的测试赛。

paras.en: When a journalist at the press conference commented to Erasmus he was making a "serious intimation", his response was: "It's not an accusation."
paras.zh: 当新闻发布会上的一名记者向伊拉斯谟评论说他正在做出“严肃的暗示”时，他的回答是：“这不是指控。”

paras.en: The 54-year-old has now been suspended three times in five years for these sorts of incidents, which constitute "public criticism of match officials, undermining the integrity of individuals or the sport, and fuelling online abuse."
paras.zh: 这位 54 岁的球员在五年内因此类事件已被停赛 3 次，这些事件构成了“对比赛官员的公开批评，损害了个人或这项运动的诚信，并助长了网络虐待”。

paras.en: Indeed, SA Rugby have since released a statement "condemning the online abuse of officials" following confirmation of Erasmus' ban.
paras.zh: 事实上，在伊拉斯谟禁令得到确认后，南非橄榄球协会发布了一份声明，“谴责网上滥用官员的行为”。

paras.en: During the 2021 British and Irish Lions series in South Africa, after the Springboks lost the first Test, Erasmus broadcasted an hour-long critique of Australian referee Nic Berry, and was eventually handed a two-month ban from all rugby activity and 10-month matchday ban.
paras.zh: 2021 年在南非举行的英国和爱尔兰狮队系列赛中，跳羚队输掉了第一次测试后，伊拉斯谟对澳大利亚裁判尼克·贝里进行了长达一小时的批评，最终被禁止参加两个月的所有橄榄球活动和 10 个月的比赛日禁令。

paras.en: Berry said afterwards Erasmus' behaviour had been an "assassination of my reputation" that caused "immeasurable damage." He no longer referees Tests involving South Africa.
paras.zh: 贝里事后表示，伊拉斯谟的行为是“对我名誉的暗杀”，造成了“不可估量的损失”。他不再担任涉及南非的测试。

paras.en: World Rugby found the video had contained "multiple abusive and insulting comments and attacks on the officials."
paras.zh: 世界橄榄球协会发现该视频包含“多处辱骂和侮辱性的评论以及对官员的攻击”。

paras.en: In 2022 he received a two-Test ban after sarcastic social media posts following back-to-back South Africa defeats to Ireland and France. A video critical of referee Wayne Barnes led to the official revealing he and his family had received death threats.
paras.zh: 2022年，在南非连续输给爱尔兰和法国后，他在社交媒体上发表讽刺性帖子后，受到了两次测试禁赛的处罚。一段批评裁判韦恩·巴恩斯的视频导致裁判透露他和他的家人收到了死亡威胁。

paras.en: Outside of those punishments, Erasmus has long overseen a South Africa side and setup which has sought to find loopholes in the sport.
paras.zh: 除了这些惩罚之外，伊拉斯谟长期以来一直在监督南非队和球队，他们一直在寻找这项运动中的漏洞。

paras.en: Against New Zealand in September and France last week, he changed his starting front-row for his replacements shortly before kick-off in clear displays of gamesmanship. In 2021, he acted as a water carrier, running onto the pitch to relay messages in-game before World Rugby changed regulations.
paras.zh: 9月份对阵新西兰队和上周对阵法国队的比赛中，他在开球前不久更换了首发前排的替补球员，这清楚地展示了他的球技。 2021年，在世界橄榄球联合会改变规则之前，他充当了运水员，跑到球场上传递比赛信息。

paras.en: He has fielded 7-1 bench splits to get more heavy forwards onto the park late in Tests - something criticised as dangerous - advised his team to intentionally infringe the kick-off in order to force scrums, and is widely believed to have run a Twitter burner account called Jaco Johan for a lengthy period to criticise refereeing performances and decisions against the Boks.
paras.zh: 在测试后期，他以 7-1 的板凳分流让更多的重前锋上场——这被批评为危险的——建议他的球队故意侵犯开球以迫使争球，并且人们普遍认为他在很长一段时间内运行了一个名为 Jaco Johan 的 Twitter 燃烧账户，批评裁判的表现和对阵博克队的决定。

paras.en: Mad genius? Maybe. But increasingly a toxic figure.
paras.zh: 疯狂的天才？或许。但越来越成为一个有毒的人物。

paras.en: Springboks to storm to victory in Dublin?
paras.zh: 跳羚队将在都柏林取得胜利？

paras.en: What does this all mean for the rugby on Saturday?
paras.zh: 这对周六的橄榄球比赛意味着什么？

paras.en: Well, Ireland were perhaps up against it to compete with this Springboks side in any case, but after all that has played out this week, the Springboks players are likely to come out snorting fire.
paras.zh: 无论如何，爱尔兰也许会与这支跳羚队竞争，但在本周发生的一切之后，跳羚队的球员很可能会喷出火来。

paras.en: South Africa beat Ireland 24-13 this time last year, in a Test which saw Ireland shown a 20-minute red card to James Ryan and four further yellow cards, reducing them to 12 players at one point.
paras.zh: 去年的这个时候，南非队以 24-13 击败了爱尔兰队，当时爱尔兰队向詹姆斯·瑞恩出示了 20 分钟的红牌，并又出示了四张黄牌，球队的球员一度减少到 12 人。

paras.en: Two of those sin-binnings came as a result of scrum penalties, and that is likely to be an area of pain for Ireland this weekend too. The Springboks pack will be seeking utter domination in that area again.
paras.zh: 其中两次罪责是由于 scrum 处罚而造成的，这也可能成为爱尔兰本周末的一个痛苦领域。跳羚队将再次寻求在该领域的绝对统治地位。

paras.en: There has also been a law tweak in terms of officiating maul defence, making it even more difficult to stop tries via the driving maul. In short, if South Africa get into Ireland's 22 with a five-metre lineout, the chances are it will result in a try.
paras.zh: 在裁判重击防守方面也进行了法律调整，使得通过驾驶重击来阻止尝试变得更加困难。简而言之，如果南非队以 5 米界线进入爱尔兰 22 强，那么很有可能会尝试。

paras.en: Prendergast - whose tackle was found not to reach a red-card threshold - is back in the Ireland team at fly-half, but his form last year and earlier this year fell well below the level required, particularly in defence, but also in terms of running an attack against elite sides.
paras.zh: 普伦德加斯特的铲球被发现没有达到红牌门槛，他在半场回到了爱尔兰队，但他去年和今年早些时候的表现远低于要求的水平，特别是在防守方面，而且在对精英球队的进攻方面也是如此。

paras.en: The 23-year-old has an immense task against this ultra-aggressive Springboks outfit, both in terms of leading a successful attack, and in avoiding being exposed.
paras.zh: 这位 23 岁的球员在对抗这支极具攻击性的跳羚队时肩负着艰巨的任务，无论是领导一次成功的进攻，还是避免暴露。

paras.en: If Ireland, as huge underdogs and substantially bested in terms of the power stakes, manage to win this Test, it will be one of the greatest achievements of Andy Farrell's career.
paras.zh: 如果爱尔兰作为巨大的弱者并且在权力赌注方面大幅领先，能够赢得这次测试，这将是安迪·法雷尔职业生涯中最伟大的成就之一。

articles.title: Stroud stars as Texans finally win at home with defeat of Colts

paras.en: NFL: CJ Stroud stars as Houston Texans finally win at home this season with 26-3 defeat of Indianapolis Colts
paras.zh: NFL：CJ 斯特劳德领衔主演，休斯顿德州人队本赛季最终在主场以 26-3 击败印第安纳波利斯小马队

paras.en: Houston Texans quarterback CJ Stroud throws for 194 yards and three touchdowns in 26-3 win vs Indianapolis Colts; Stroud picked apart Colts side missing injured starting cornerbacks Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward in first Texans home victory this season
paras.zh: 休斯顿德州人队四分卫 CJ 斯特劳德在 26-3 战胜印第安纳波利斯小马队的比赛中传出 194 码并取得 3 次达阵；斯特劳德将小马队的首发角卫索斯·加德纳（Sauce Gardner）和查瓦里斯·沃德（Charvarius Ward）因伤缺席，这是德州人队本赛季首场主场胜利

paras.en: CJ Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home, defeating the Indianapolis Colts.
paras.zh: CJ·斯特劳德又打了一场重要比赛，帮助休斯顿德州人队最终在主场击败印第安纳波利斯小马队取得胜利。

paras.en: Stroud threw for 194 yards and three touchdowns as the Texans used a strong defensive performance to coast to a 26-3 win over the Colts.
paras.zh: 斯特劳德传球推进 194 码并取得 3 次达阵，德州人凭借强大的防守表现以 26-3 战胜小马队。

paras.en: With the roof at Reliant Stadium open for the first time since 2024, the Texans won a home game for the first time this season after losing their first four.
paras.zh: 随着 Reliant Stadium 的屋顶自 2024 年以来首次开放，德州人队在输掉前四场比赛后，本赛季首次赢得了主场比赛。

paras.en: "To have a home game win is very good for us and exciting," Stroud said. "I think this is a start to something that we need to go on a run with."
paras.zh: “主场获胜对我们来说非常好，也令人兴奋，”斯特劳德说。 “我认为这是我们需要继续努力的一个开始。”

paras.en: - Who is NFL MVP favourite? 'He is head and shoulders above'
paras.zh: - 谁是 NFL MVP 的热门人选？ “他高高在上”

paras.en: - Latest NFL fixtures, results and UK kick-off times
paras.zh: - 最新 NFL 赛程、赛果和英国开球时间

paras.en: - Get latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Stroud picked apart a Colts secondary that was missing injured starting cornerbacks Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward to help the Texans bounce back from a 27-24 loss to Cleveland last weekend.
paras.zh: 斯特劳德挑选了小马队的二线球员，因为首发角卫索斯·加德纳（Sauce Gardner）和查瓦里斯·沃德（Charvarius Ward）都因伤缺阵，帮助德州人从上周末27-24输给克利夫兰的比赛中恢复过来。

paras.en: It was the third straight game in which Stroud had at least three touchdown passes and the fourth in his last five.
paras.zh: 这是斯特劳德连续第三场比赛至少传出三次达阵，也是他过去五场比赛中的第四次。

paras.en: "CJ is producing the way he is producing because of the work he put in throughout the off-season," coach DeMeco Ryans said.
paras.zh: “CJ 之所以能取得现在的成绩，是因为他在整个休赛期所做的努力，”教练德梅科·瑞恩斯 (DeMeco Ryans) 说道。

paras.en: "All of that is paying dividends now. He's been ready for these moments and he's been executing at a high level in these moments."
paras.zh: “所有这些现在都得到了回报。他已经为这些时刻做好了准备，并且在这些时刻他一直在高水平地执行。”

paras.en: Stroud gave the Texans a 7-3 lead when he connected with Nico Collins for a 42-yard touchdown late in the first quarter.
paras.zh: 斯特劳德在第一节末与尼科·柯林斯连线42码达阵，帮助德州人队以7-3领先。

paras.en: Kamari Lassiter intercepted Daniel Jones on the first play of the second quarter. The Texans (4-6) then capped a 12-play, 85-yard drive with a 24-yard TD reception by Kayshon Boutte to extend their lead to 14-3.
paras.zh: 卡马里·拉西特在第二节的第一次进攻中拦截了丹尼尔·琼斯。德州人队 (4-6) 随后凯尚·布特 (Kayshon Boutte) 接球 24 码达阵，完成了 12 场比赛的 85 码冲球，将领先优势扩大到 14-3。

paras.en: The Texans were up by 14 early in the third when Will Anderson Jr sacked Jones in the end zone for a safety that made it 19-3. Anderson leads the NFL with 11.5 sacks and had two tackles in the game to move into first place with 17.
paras.zh: 第三节早些时候，德州人队领先 14 分，当时小威尔·安德森 (Will Anderson Jr) 在达阵区将琼斯擒杀，将比分改写为 19-3。安德森以 11.5 次擒杀领跑 NFL，并有 2 次擒抱，以 17 次擒杀排名第一。

paras.en: "Obviously, 51 [Anderson] is a problem," Indianapolis coach Shane Steichen said. "We were trying to have a game plan for wherever he was. We were trying to see if he was going right or left. When he was playing right, he was going left. We were trying to keep it away from him as much as we possibly could."
paras.zh: “显然，51 [安德森]是一个问题，”印第安纳波利斯队教练肖恩·史泰钦说。 “无论他在哪里，我们都试图制定一个比赛计划。我们试图看看他是向右走还是向左走。当他向右打时，他就会向左走。我们试图尽可能地让球远离他。”

paras.en: Stroud found rookie Marlin Klein for a 13-yard TD on the next possession.
paras.zh: 斯特劳德在下一次控球时找到新秀马林·克莱因 (Marlin Klein) 13 码达阵。

paras.en: Ryans was proud of his team for playing a complete game after the Texans fell apart last Sunday against the Browns, blowing a 17-0 lead.
paras.zh: 上周日德州人队以 17-0 的领先优势被布朗队击败后，瑞恩斯为他的球队打了一场完整的比赛感到自豪。

paras.en: "It's fulfilling to finally see that happen," he said. "We've been in these games a ton where we were up at half-time and come out in the second half and for whatever reason not finish. So for them to actually see it and go do it, I think it will bode well for them to gain confidence for showing that they can do it."
paras.zh: “最终看到这一切发生真是令人满足，”他说。 “我们在这些比赛中经常遇到这样的情况：我们在中场休息时领先，在下半场出局，但无论出于何种原因都没有完成。因此，对于他们真正看到并去做的事情来说，我认为这对他们来说是个好兆头，他们将获得信心，证明自己可以做到这一点。”

paras.en: Jones was 12 of 27 for 144 yards with the interception as the Colts (3-8) lost for the sixth time in seven games. Anthony Richardson took over with about seven minutes left and did not complete either of his passes.
paras.zh: 琼斯27投12中，推进144码，并被拦截，小马队（3胜8负）在七场比赛中第六次失利。安东尼·理查森在比赛还剩大约七分钟时接手，但两次传球均未完成。

paras.en: Steichen was asked if Jones will remain the starter. "We'll evaluate everything," he said.
paras.zh: 斯泰肯被问及琼斯是否会继续担任首发。 “我们将评估一切，”他说。

paras.en: The Colts had their worst offensive performance of the season, finishing with a season-low 167 yards and just 38 yards rushing, which was also their fewest this season. They failed to score a touchdown for the first time since a 24-6 loss to Detroit on November 24, 2024.
paras.zh: 小马队遭遇了本赛季最差的进攻表现，取得了赛季最低的 167 码，冲球码数仅为 38 码，这也是他们本赛季最少的。自2024年11月24日以24-6输给底特律活塞以来，这是他们首次未能达阵。

paras.en: "I understand where we are as a team," Jones said. "I understand it's an issue to score three points. We have to be better offensively. I am the quarterback, and so, I am responsible. I have to play better. I know that. That's the job."
paras.zh: “我了解我们作为一个团队的处境，”琼斯说。 “我知道拿三分是个问题。我们必须在进攻上做得更好。我是四分卫，所以我有责任。我必须打得更好。我知道这一点。这就是工作。”

paras.en: Houston's David Montgomery had 26 carries for a season-high 107 yards in his return after missing four games with a groin injury.
paras.zh: 休斯顿队的大卫·蒙哥马利在因腹股沟受伤缺席四场比赛后回归，完成 26 次冲球，推进 107 码，创下赛季新高。

articles.title: Controversial birthing model abandoned after community backlash
articles.author: Isabella Kelly and Tahlia Fahey

paras.en: A birthing-service model has been abandoned in SA's Mid North, one month into a planned six-month trial.
paras.zh: 南澳中北部地区的分娩服务模式在计划为期六个月的试验进行了一个月后就被放弃了。

paras.en: It comes after a significant community backlash, including a petition that garnered almost 12,000 signatures.
paras.zh: 在此之前，社区强烈反对，其中包括一份获得近 12,000 个签名的请愿书。

paras.en: The petition will be tabled in parliament next week, calling for an inquiry into the local health network.
paras.zh: 请愿书将于下周提交议会，要求对当地卫生网络进行调查。

paras.en: The trial of a birthing model at two SA Mid North hospitals has been abandoned one month after it began, following a community backlash.
paras.zh: 南澳中北部两家医院的分娩模式试验开始一个月后，由于社区强烈反对而被放弃。

paras.en: The planned six-month trial by the Yorke and Northern Local Health Network (YNLHN) entailed a one-team, one-site birthing model that would see services alternate between the Jamestown and Crystal Brook hospitals.
paras.zh: 约克和北部地方卫生网络 (YNLHN) 计划进行为期六个月的试验，采用单团队、单地点分娩模式，詹姆斯敦医院和水晶溪医院将轮流提供服务。

paras.en: The local health network today announced it would discontinue the trial, after local clinicians this week advised they would not participate.
paras.zh: 在当地临床医生本周建议他们不会参加之后，当地卫生网络今天宣布将停止试验。

paras.en: Local GPs wrote to the health minister when the trial began in October with "urgent concern" about the changes, which they said restricted doctors from simultaneously providing maternity and emergency on-call roles, while complicating and heaping pressure on clinical handovers.
paras.zh: 10月份试验开始时，当地全科医生写信给卫生部长，对这些变化表示“迫切关注”，他们表示，这些变化限制了医生同时提供产科和急诊值班工作，同时使临床交接变得复杂化并增加了压力。

paras.en: YNLHN governing board chair John Voumard said the trial had been put in place to address workforce shortages and non-compliance with SA Health rostering requirements at the two hospitals, which he said were the only sites in the state that did not comply.
paras.zh: YNLHN 理事会主席 John Voumard 表示，进行这项试验是为了解决劳动力短缺和两家医院不遵守南澳卫生局排班要求的问题，他说这两所医院是该州唯一不遵守规定的医院。

paras.en: "The risk aspect that was not acceptable to the governing board was that we must have compliant medical rosters, and that requires five doctors per site, per roster, 365 days a year," Mr Voumard said.
paras.zh: Voumard 先生表示：“董事会无法接受的风险是，我们必须拥有合规的医疗名册，这需要每年 365 天每个地点、每个名册有五名医生。”

paras.en: Both sites will continue offering birthing services, but only when they meet the rostering requirement.
paras.zh: 两个站点将继续提供分娩服务，但前提是它们满足排班要求。

paras.en: The trial began on October 12, and was only in effect during weekends.
paras.zh: 该审判于 10 月 12 日开始，仅在周末生效。

paras.en: Chief industrial officer of the South Australian Salaried Medical Officers Association (SASMOA), Bernadette Mulholland, said the local practitioners did not agree with the network's "rostering position".
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚受薪医疗官员协会（SASMOA）首席工业官 Bernadette Mulholland 表示，当地从业人员不同意该网络的“排班立场”。

paras.en: She said SASMOA would be writing to the YNLHN to say that the rosters were "unsustainable".
paras.zh: 她表示，SASMOA 将写信给 YNLHN，表示这些名册“不可持续”。

paras.en: "It is being determined by the GPs that they will return to the previous rostering practices, and they expect the support of the YNLHN," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“全科医生正在决定他们将恢复以前的排班做法，他们希望得到 YNLHN 的支持。”

paras.en: "It will be up to the YNLHN leadership to make those doctors understand why it is important to have 10 doctors on at the same time. It doesn't seem conceivable by those expert doctors as to why these arrangements continue."
paras.zh: “YNLHN 领导层应该让这些医生明白为什么同时有 10 名医生很重要。那些专家医生似乎无法想象为什么这些安排会继续下去。”

paras.en: Mr Voumard said he was "disappointed" the local clinicians had decided not to participate in the trial.
paras.zh: 武马尔先生表示，他对当地临床医生决定不参加试验感到“失望”。

paras.en: "When that [workforce] pressure can't be addressed through supplementation with locum workforce, there will be short-notice diversions.
paras.zh: “当这种[劳动力]压力无法通过补充临时劳动力来解决时，就会出现临时通知的转移。

paras.en: "The rostering requirements will not change.
paras.zh: “排班要求不会改变。

paras.en: "The community has chosen to go back to the previous system, with all its uncertainty for birthing families. That will not change unless we have an influx of midwives and doctors wanting to work in Crystal Brook and Jamestown."
paras.zh: “社区选择回到以前的系统，尽管这对生育家庭来说充满了不确定性。除非我们有大量助产士和医生想要在水晶溪和詹姆斯敦工作，否则这一点不会改变。”

paras.en: SA Health paused birthing services at the hospitals for one month in June, citing a workforce shortage.
paras.zh: 六月份，南澳卫生局以劳动力短缺为由，暂停了医院的分娩服务一个月。

paras.en: There were a total of 41 birthing service diversions from Jamestown and Crystal Brook between July 2025 and June 2026.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，共有 41 次分娩服务从詹姆斯敦和水晶溪改道。

paras.en: The change follows weeks of community advocacy against the birthing-model trial, including a petition which closed today, having attracted more than 10,000 signatures in two weeks.
paras.zh: 这一变化是在社区对生育模型试验进行了数周的倡导之后做出的，其中包括一份于今天结束的请愿书，两周内吸引了超过 10,000 名签名。

paras.en: Local private midwife Chrissy Mackinnon said she was "absolutely thrilled" by the change.
paras.zh: 当地私人助产士克丽丝·麦金农 (Chrissy Mackinnon) 表示，她对这一变化“非常激动”。

paras.en: "It doesn't matter how they've listened, but they have listened," she said.
paras.zh: “他们如何听并不重要，但他们确实听了，”她说。

paras.en: "If it's been the petitions, the hundreds of letters written into them, the media campaign, the papers, the radio, I don't know what, but something finally has got through to them that we're not happy.
paras.zh: “如果是请愿书、写在其中的数百封信、媒体宣传活动、报纸、广播，我不知道是什么，但最终他们明白了一些我们不高兴的事情。

paras.en: "It has just been an incredible support of community for their health services. How blessed we are in this region to have such permanent, residential, caring, compassionate people that work in health."
paras.zh: “社区对他们的医疗服务提供了令人难以置信的支持。我们在这个地区拥有如此常驻、居住、充满爱心、富有同情心的从事健康工作的人们是多么幸运。”

paras.en: Member for Stuart Geoff Brock said he would still table the petition in parliament next week, seeking an "investigation" into the matter.
paras.zh: 斯图尔特·杰夫·布罗克（Stuart Geoff Brock）议员表示，他仍将于下周向议会提交请愿书，寻求对此事进行“调查”。

paras.en: He said there was a "lack of confidence" from the community in the YNLHN board and its operation.
paras.zh: 他表示，社区对 YNLHN 董事会及其运作“缺乏信心”。

paras.en: "The communities out there were very, very frustrated with the lack of clear communication from the board," Mr Brock said.
paras.zh: 布罗克先生说：“董事会缺乏明确的沟通，社区对此感到非常非常沮丧。”

paras.en: Ms Mackinnon agreed the lack of communication was a big issue.
paras.zh: 麦金农女士同意缺乏沟通是一个大问题。

paras.en: "How could we all be just happily going along until one day … it came out in the paper that this was all changing and we all found out from the newspaper,"
paras.zh: “我们怎么可能一直幸福地相处下去，直到有一天......报纸上报道说这一切都在改变，我们都从报纸上发现了，”

paras.en: Mr Voumard said communication with expectant mothers could have been better, but said the wider community concerns were "based on misinformation".
paras.zh: 武马尔先生表示，与准妈妈的沟通本来可以更好，但他表示，更广泛的社区担忧是“基于错误信息”。

paras.en: "I regret that the community has been put through the level of anxiety, which was completely unnecessary," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我对社区陷入如此程度的焦虑感到遗憾，这是完全没有必要的。”

paras.en: "It was not a decision that you would consult communities about, as to whether or not you would follow an SA Health policy."
paras.zh: “关于是否遵守南澳卫生政策，这不是一个需要咨询社区的决定。”

articles.title: Police warn rock-throwing targeting cars in WA could be fatal
articles.author: Rachel Jackson and Esse Deves

paras.en: A Kununurra resident says she has been left hundreds of dollars out of pocket after a group of children threw a large rock at her car.
paras.zh: 库努纳拉的一名居民表示，一群孩子向她的车扔了一块大石头，她的口袋里损失了数百美元。

paras.en: It is one of multiple rock-throwing incidents under investigation across northern Western Australia.
paras.zh: 这是西澳大利亚州北部正在调查的多起投掷石块事件之一。

paras.en: Police say the offence is a priority for officers, as the consequences for drivers and passengers could be fatal.
paras.zh: 警方表示，这一罪行是警官的首要任务，因为这对司机和乘客来说可能是致命的。

paras.en: Police in Western Australia's far north say rock throwing by local children has the potential to cause injury or death if not brought under control.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚州最北部的警方表示，当地儿童投掷石块的行为如果不加以控制，可能会造成伤害或死亡。

paras.en: Kununurra, about 3,200km north of Perth, has been in the spotlight in recent years in relation to youth crime, with four children charged recently after alleged rock throwing in the East Kimberley town.
paras.zh: 库努纳拉 (Kununurra) 位于珀斯以北约 3,200 公里处，近年来因青少年犯罪而成为人们关注的焦点，最近有四名儿童因涉嫌在东金伯利镇投掷石块而受到指控。

paras.en: Kununurra Police officer in charge Nathan Carbone said rock-throwing was a priority, after multiple incidents involving young people had been reported and posted to social media.
paras.zh: 库努纳拉（Kununurra）警官内森·卡本（Nathan Carbone）表示，在多起涉及年轻人的事件被报道并发布到社交媒体后，投掷石块是当务之急。

paras.en: "Unfortunately with these types of incidents, they're not just harmless pranks," he said.
paras.zh: “不幸的是，这些类型的事件不仅仅是无害的恶作剧，”他说。

paras.en: "Anyone in that vehicle could be seriously injured or potentially killed."
paras.zh: “车内的任何人都可能受重伤或可能死亡。”

paras.en: Police data shows criminal damage of property has increased in both Kununurra and the wider Kimberley in recent years.
paras.zh: 警方数据显示，近年来库努纳拉和金伯利地区的刑事财产损失有所增加。

paras.en: It jumped from 358 incidents in 2021 across the Kimberley region to 775 in 2025, while there were 277 reports in Kununurra alone in the first six months of 2026.
paras.zh: 金伯利地区的此类事件从 2021 年的 358 起增加到 2025 年的 775 起，而 2026 年前六个月仅库努纳拉就有 277 起报告。

paras.en: Resident Camila Nielsen took to social media after her car window was smashed in a separate incident.
paras.zh: 居民卡米拉·尼尔森（Camila Nielsen）的车窗在另一起事件中被砸碎后，在社交媒体上发布了消息。

paras.en: Ms Nielsen said she was driving along Messmate Way on the afternoon of November 15, when she drove past a group of children who were throwing small rocks over the road.
paras.zh: Nielsen 女士说，11 月 15 日下午，她沿着 Messmate Way 行驶，当时她驶过一群正在路上扔小石块的孩子。

paras.en: "They got angry because I asked them to stop,"
paras.zh: “他们很生气，因为我要求他们停下来，”

paras.en: "[They] started throwing some big things behind my car."
paras.zh: “[他们]开始在我的车后面扔一些大东西。”

paras.en: Ms Nielsen said the damage to her four-wheel-drive left her about $600 out-of-pocket, and without a car for more than a week.
paras.zh: 尼尔森女士表示，她的四轮驱动车受损，导致她自掏腰包约 600 美元，并且已经一个多星期没有车了。

paras.en: Ms Nielsen, who has lived in Kununurra for three years, said it was lucky nobody was sitting in the back seat.
paras.zh: 尼尔森女士在库努纳拉生活了三年，她说很幸运没有人坐在后座。

paras.en: "I've heard this happens to people with other people in the car and kids in the car,"
paras.zh: “我听说这种情况发生在车里有其他人以及车里有孩子的人身上，”

paras.en: It is the latest in a string of similar incidents in communities across WA, but particularly in the state's north.
paras.zh: 这是西澳各地社区（尤其是该州北部）发生的一系列类似事件中的最新一起。

paras.en: A 14-year-old boy was charged with assault in September after allegedly throwing the rock that seriously injured a man in Falcon, south of Perth.
paras.zh: 9月，一名14岁男孩在珀斯以南的法尔肯（Falcon）扔石头，导致一名男子重伤，随后被指控袭击罪。

paras.en: In the Pilbara, police called for information on social media after a group of youths targeted moving cars with rocks over a period of several weeks in the same month.
paras.zh: 在皮尔巴拉，一群年轻人在同月的几周内用石块瞄准移动的汽车后，警方呼吁在社交媒体上提供信息。

paras.en: Similar incidents were reported by police in Carnarvon on social media in October, with rocks damaging vehicles and property.
paras.zh: 十月份，卡那封警方在社交媒体上报告了类似事件，石块损坏了车辆和财产。

paras.en: For Ms Nielsen, it was not the first time she had been targeted by rock throwing, describing another incident in April this year.
paras.zh: 对于尼尔森女士来说，这并不是她第一次成为投掷石块的目标，她描述了今年四月的另一起事件。

paras.en: "There were some kids just waiting by the corner, waiting to throw rocks at cars," Ms Nielsen said.
paras.zh: 尼尔森女士说：“一些孩子就在街角等着，等着向​​汽车扔石头。”

paras.en: No charges have been laid in relation to Ms Nielsen's experiences.
paras.zh: 目前尚未对尼尔森女士的经历提出任何指控。

paras.en: Senior Sergeant Carbone confirmed four children had been charged after a separate incident, also occurring on Sunday.
paras.zh: 卡本高级警官证实，周日也发生了另一起事件，四名儿童因此受到指控。

paras.en: The group, aged between 12 and 14, allegedly threw rocks at a car on Erythrina Street, causing damage to the vehicle.
paras.zh: 该团伙年龄在 12 岁至 14 岁之间，据称向 Erythrina Street 上的一辆汽车投掷石块，导致车辆损坏。

paras.en: They are set to face Kununurra Children's Court next month, on one count each of criminal damage or destruction of property.
paras.zh: 他们将于下个月在库努纳拉儿童法庭受审，罪名分别是刑事损坏或破坏财产。

paras.en: Senior Sergeant Carbone said the offending was linked to complex social issues surrounding youth crime in Kununurra.
paras.zh: 卡本高级警官表示，这起犯罪行为与库努纳拉青少年犯罪的复杂社会问题有关。

paras.en: "Any group of kids outside late at night out on the street is a concern," he said.
paras.zh: “深夜街上任何一群孩子都值得关注，”他说。

paras.en: "That's why we work closely with our partner agencies to try and identify and address these broader issues kids are experiencing."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我们与合作伙伴机构密切合作，试图找出并解决孩子们正在经历的这些更广泛的问题。”

paras.en: Senior Sergeant Carbone said anyone who experienced or witnessed rock-throwing should call police immediately.
paras.zh: 卡本高级警官表示，任何经历或目击投掷石块的人都应该立即报警。

paras.en: "We can't be on every street corner at every moment, " he said.
paras.zh: “我们不可能每时每刻都出现在每个街角，”他说。

paras.en: "What we can do is respond when the incidents do occur, investigate them, and we do put significant effort into identifying the people responsible."
paras.zh: “我们能做的就是在事件确实发生时做出反应，进行调查，并且我们确实付出了巨大的努力来确定责任人。”

paras.en: The Kununurra community has been calling for a permanent youth night space in a battle to combat youth crime and provide a safe space for street-present children.
paras.zh: 库努纳拉社区一直呼吁建立一个永久性的青少年夜间空间，以打击青少年犯罪，并为街头儿童提供一个安全的空间。

paras.en: However, the decision for it to be established on the town's outskirts, near agricultural properties, has been questioned.
paras.zh: 然而，将其建在该镇郊区靠近农业地产的决定却受到了质疑。

articles.title: Celebrations in Australian suburbs at international court's genocide ruling
articles.author: Libby Hogan and Will Jackson

paras.en: The International Court of Justice on Thursday delivered its judgement that Myanmar had committed genocide against the country's Rohingya Muslim minority group.
paras.zh: 国际法院周四做出判决，认定缅甸对该国罗兴亚穆斯林少数民族实施种族灭绝。

paras.en: Rohingya living in Australia have welcomed the development saying it represents recognition for the suffering endured and hope for the younger generation.
paras.zh: 生活在澳大利亚的罗兴亚人对这一进展表示欢迎，称这代表了对所遭受苦难的认可，也代表了年轻一代的希望。

paras.en: But they say the ruling must be backed up by action from the international community including Australia.
paras.zh: 但他们表示，这一裁决必须得到包括澳大利亚在内的国际社会行动的支持。

paras.en: There were celebrations in suburban Brisbane last night as the International Court of Justice delivered its judgement that Myanmar had committed genocide against the country's Rohingya people.
paras.zh: 昨晚，当国际法院宣布缅甸对该国罗兴亚人实施种族灭绝时，布里斯班郊区举行了庆祝活动。

paras.en: Robi Alam, president of the Rohingya United Youth Network, said members had gathered at the group's Logan youth centre to watch the proceedings.
paras.zh: 罗兴亚联合青年网络主席罗比·阿拉姆表示，成员们聚集在该组织的洛根青年中心观看会议进程。

paras.en: He said they were in touch with relatives and friends back in the Cox's Bazar refugee camp in Bangladesh where "thousands and thousands" were gathered to watch the hearing.
paras.zh: 他说，他们正在与孟加拉国考克斯巴扎尔难民营的亲友保持联系，那里聚集了“成千上万的人”观看听证会。

paras.en: "We also had a couple of brothers that were crying [here] last night, because this means that … it feels like the world will finally listen."
paras.zh: “昨晚我们还有几个兄弟在这里哭泣，因为这意味着……感觉世界终于会倾听。”

paras.en: The United Nations' court found that a campaign mounted by Myanmar's security forces that killed thousands and perpetrated widespread sexual violence against the long-persecuted Rohingya Muslim minority population in 2017 amounted to genocide.
paras.zh: 联合国法院认定，2017年缅甸安全部队发动的一场行动，造成数千人死亡，并对长期受迫害的罗兴亚穆斯林少数民族实施广泛的性暴力，构成种族灭绝。

paras.en: It was the first time the court held a state responsible for committing genocide.
paras.zh: 这是法院首次判定一个国家对种族灭绝负有责任。
